tei:div.tei:p: ༄༄jo—sterangabasngarangapeworitheb d+ku rwadziklo ca ṭ+wāṃ 0 tshi ba 1rdoṭ+wāṃṭ+wāṃ ca 7 0 ‘ sdu5 0rwa 0 /༷ 2tshitha0rdo~X7sdu~Xsdu~X⑥༵ 58221 dzi go kyi lo rgyus rig gnas dpyad gzhi'i rgyu cha gdams bsgrigs/spyi'i 'ar+pā thengs 23sa5smo01 60spusmokro 01tha555sapyithab⑫spujikro'isputha26 1lnga〉khu0smo'ithaspu'i7co6byathamathaciwawawawawawawawawago'i0smo wa/da wa wa0rte wa/wawawawat+t+waṃwawawawawawawawawa wa

dzāne+e/ 6gyi smo ṇa 7phya༄ 6‘stachu —snetsā r+yā rnerkusto — tswa phyonyeji4tsādzo — nyasna jikhuchitswa chotsāshā — ji / ṭ+wāṃphyo ji3rtswa /chid+ngha d+ngha zhesna 4 — tsā — sngurāho ṭ+wāṃ/ṭ+wāṃ rna 〉 ( ri sru/— sdi ri ri ri snagli ci ji pha /// dhe zu rjo0 ‘ ri/tsho 9) (ga rgari'ica/ 4 di sbyoḥmihwa/ r+sha di tsho 6latsuci 4snyeyo 3 d+ngha‘thor+yā 4 r+yā tswakyid da 'tsho pha/ 4 ca shārī 0/ jiphathi—rīrgyu paṃ rī1 ’/ ṭ+wāṃ3 / ji〉trī ne+elha — zhe ri — sne — ce swoXtram̐( tsho 〉 ( cho bye/s+t+ra jine+e byu ri ri lnga ༄—7 ma tsho 〈( ga tsho di ṣ+ṭitrīspyoṅkatshor+sha skyispre spre lke 4 spre dhe

zlo' la—5ṣ+kaspu nalhadzilha'i//nalha4 spyo/oṃ5༷ninadzi / 4skesnye d+ngha (bsta spyi'i 'don thengs 23pa/bod rang skyong ljongs srid gros lo rgyus rig gnas dpyad gzhi'i rgyu cha u yon lhan khang gis rtsom sgrig byas pa/mi rigs dpe skrun khang /
ma sa mcho
pal ma
cang

phran bya sa rgan po skal bzang che dbang gi khyim tshang dang rang gi gnas tshul skor/skal bzang tshe dbangaka nga'i khyim tshang ni lho kha sne gdong rdzong khongs kyi gzhung rgyugs mi ser yin zhing / pha mes mi rabs 'ga'i ring rgan po'i las 'gan 'khur te sne gdong rdzong gi gzhung yig nang bya sa rgan po zur khang pa zhes 'bod/ nga'i pha bya sa rgan po nor bu dang / ma kun bzang la bu gsum dang bu mo gnyis bcas ming sring lnga yod pa'i nang nas nga rang bu gnyis pa chu byi (1912)lor skyes/ rang lo 12la slebs skabs pha mas lho spyi mkhan chung blo bzang dbang 'dus kyis gnyer ba'i sger gnyer slob grwar lo gnyis man tsam skyod nas bod yig 'bri klog la sbyangs brtson byas par sbyangs 'bras kyang mi dman tsam thob byung /rang lo 14yas mas la spun mched a khu par khang dza sag rgyal mtshan phun tshogs kyi zhabs phyir lha sar phyin nas lo gnyis tsam bsdad/ khong nga rang gi a khu yin gshis byams po gnang rung pha ma dbang med du dran pas lha sar sdod 'dod med par gsang thabs kyis lho kha'i rang khyim du log nang du log skabs pha ma gnyis kyang dga' po gnang gi 'dug la nga rang ha cang dga' tshor chen po byung / nga tsho'i khyim tshang dang thog gzhung rgyugs mi ser rkang gsum dang phyed sde son khal gsum brgya skor yod pa de ni rgan po rkang gcig dang /1

dmag rkang gcig gar phrug rkang gcig khral rkang phyed bcas yin stabs spyir btang son khal rgya khyon la gzhigs pas sa zhing gang 'tshams yod/phyugs rigs rmon mdzo bzhi dang / bong bu lag gcig (10nas 12)gzhan yang ba phyugs drug glang lnga/ ra lug brgya dang lnga bcu skor/ rta lnga/ gzhi khyon cung che ba'i gling kha zhig yod par shing rtsa rkang lnga stong lnga brgya lhag tsam yod pa dang / nang zan mi grangs bco lnga tsam bcas yod/ a khu rgyal mtshan phun tshogs bsam yas rdzong sdod gnang skabs kyi rogs ram 'og khang pa nyis thog ka ba lnga bcu skor gyi sa cha yod pa ma zad cha sgam mchod gshom dang /gdan chas sogs gra 'grigs yod/ nga rang khyim du 'byor rjes sa sbrul lor a khujo sag rgyal mtshan phun tshogs pho brang po tā la'i shar rgyud nyams gso do dam gnang skabs lcam gdung sogs rlon pa btang stabs bab zhod byung ba red ces don der brnyas nas dang thog lha sa'i shag tshang sgo rgya gzhung bzhes btang ba dang / de rjes nga tsho'i a khu rgyal mtshan mkhas mchog sbyor ra gzhis sdod yin stabs gzhis 'khyol gyis tshur lha sar phebs lam du a drung dang sgo thel rgyag mkhan thug nas slar yang sbyor gzhis su khrid nas rgyu dngos gzhung bzhes btang / skabs der par khang shag tshang nas zin pa'i gzhis ka stod lung ser byes gangs dkar gzhis dang / sku 'bum thang khams sding gzhis/bsam yas cho khang gsar gzhis/ sne gdong tshar nub gzhis bcas gzhung bzhes btang ba dang chabs cig a khu dza sag rgyal phun pa'i skyes khang nga tsho bya sa rgan po'i khang khyim rgyu dngos sa zhing lo tog dang bcas pa'ang yongs rdzogs gzhung bzhes btang stabs nga tsho nang mi rgan gzhon rnams sdod gnas su thab tshang sprad de rtsam pa 'bo gang dang ka to ra gang / ja phran bu tsam/ gyon chas dang / gdan nyal chas tsam sprad byung / de'i skabs lho spyi'i bka' sgyur ltar mkhar dbang gzhung bzhes btang rjes khral sngar bzhin rgyugs dgos yod 2

stabs khral rten med par khral rgyugs dgos par lo gcig tsam ring dka' ngal chen po byung / de'i skabs gtso bo a ma'i nang 'on na sbug nas rogs ram gnang ba dang / de bzhin bkra shis chos sde dgon grwa tshang dang / rtse tshogs pa'i grwa tshang / chu 'khor 'og bcas nas kyang shugs che'i rogs ram gnang ba ma zad sems bzang can gyi mi ser yongs nas rtsam mar sogs gang ci'i rogs ram—byas byung / de'i skabs nga tsho gzhung rgyugs mi ser yin stabs rang nyid khral snon du brgyab mi yong ngam snyam pa'i 'jigs skrag gis lha sar bskyod de 'bras sgo mang grwa tshang du grwa pa byas te lo gsum tsam bsdad/ sa sbrul zla 6pa'i nang sgo thel brgyab rjes zla 7pa'i nang rtse drung zhig 'byor nas lho spyi dang zung sbrel gyis dngos po phyir 'tshong byed rgyu dang / bka' rgya'i nang ‘‘par khang rgyal mtshan phun tshogs nas rtse pho brang dmar po'i nyams gso'i skabs rtse pho brang shar rgyud bab zhod phyin pas mkhar dbang gzhung bzhes byas par brten skye khang gzhung rgyugs bya sa rgan po la sngar gyi gtan tshigs khungs btsan bstan rgyu yod na pha gzhis rang 'jags thog rgyu dngos sems can rnams gzhung bzhes byed rgyu yin mizhes 'khod 'dug skabs der nga tsho'i nang la gu shrī bstan 'dzin chos rgyal sogs srid 'dzin rim pa'i gtan tshigs sman tse'i brgyab ldan la sdig dam dang / dam dmar chen po yod pa de 'dra sgam chung gang tsam 'dug pa spyan zhus rjes sgo rgya bkrol nas sa khang phyir stsal byung /'dzin dngos rnams a khu rgyal mtshan phun tshogs lags nas rtse tshogs pa grwa tshang dang / sding po che grwa tshang sogs nas dngul bun g.yar bzhes kyis gzhung sar dngul 'bab phul te bod dngul zho pad rta rgyab 15skor phul song bas 'dzin dngos rang 'jags byung / de skabs rta gsum khrid pa rjes su kun 'phe‘ra lags kyi khyim du yod skad 'dug de rjes nang du a khu rgyal mtshan phun tshogs kyis rtse tshogs pa'i grwa pa zhang po nag ril zhes pa khyim du pha ma gnyis la 3

rogs byed mkhan du bzhas/ pa dang / khra 'brug gzim khang nas son rtsa 'bru bun g.yar gnang gis zhing 'debs byas te pha ma gnyis nas khyim bskyangs/rang nyid 'bras spungs su grwa pa byas nas bsdad/ de rjes phal cher chu sprel lo tsam la dgon pa nas khyim du gzhis 'khor la 'ong nas nang du 'byor skabs pha ma rnams bde thang ngang bzhugs 'dug 'on kyang 'tsho ba'i cha rkyen zhan tsam 'dug de'i skabs rang nyid chos tshugs ma zin pas slar yang dgon par log thabs bral bas rjes su dge rgan yod sar bcar nas skyid sdug dgongs pa zhus/ skabs der pha ma lo na bgres la 'tsho gos zhan pa dang / khyim gyi dpal 'byor 'gyur ba gang yang ma byung gshis a zhang nag ril rtse tshogs par phyir log gnang rogs zhus te khyim gyi 'gan rang nyid nas blangs nas khyim tshang phyug tsam yong rgyu'i ched 'bad thabs byed rgyu'i sems thag bcad de de don a khu rgyal mtshan phun tshogs lags su zhus pas mos mthun gnang byung /skabs der pha lo na bgres pas spyan yang thang po med stabs rgan tshogs su ngas mnyam skyod kyis las ka'i rgyus mnga' khong du chud thabs byas/ da dung dmag rkang gcig gi gtan tshigs gta' mar bzhag ste rtse thang 'bras gling dgon nas lnga drug 'gro'i skyed kha sprod rgyu byas nas 'bru khal lnga brgya dang / gzhung mchod 'bru do dam nas lnga drug 'gro'i skyed kha 'bul zhus kyis 'bru khal lnga brgya bcas khyon 'bru khal chig stong g.yar/ gong gsal 'bru rigs kyis son rtsa btsugs te lo rim bzhin zhing las thon 'bras legs tsam byung bas lo ngo lnga tsam 'gro skabs gong gsal bu lon ma skyed gtsang sprod byas te gzhi nas khyim tshang rkang tshugs thub pa byung ste 'tsho ba yang rim bzhin legs su 'gro 'go tshugs/chu bya (1933)lor nyin zhig bsam yul las 'das pa zhig la glo bur du rtse phyag jo lags gnyis bka' rgya dang sbrags te 'byor byung zhing / bka' rgya'i 4

nang ‘‘pa ra khang rgyal phun gzhung bzhes skabs skye khang gzhung rgyugs pa bya sa rgan zur khang pa'i dngos po gzhung len skabs phyi'i lcam shing rnams gcod bregs byed lus la da cha sne gdong mnga' khul mi ser bskul 'ded kyis shing cha rnams gcod bregs kyis lha sar dbor 'dren byed rgyu/ slad gsar skyes shing rnams bya sa rgan po khyim tshang la bdag ’’ces 'khod stabanu/ sne gdong mi ser bskul 'ded kyis gling kha'i nang yod pa'i phan yod kyi lcam shing lon pa'i shing rtsa rkang 5500gcod bregs byas te sa tshugs rim pas lha sar dbor 'dren byas rjes/ su grwa bzhi glog 'phrul khang zer ba'i khang pa gsar rgyag byed skabs bed spyod byas pa red/ nge nas shing phag (1935)lor phran nas a khu rgyal phun lags su de snga'i mi rabs mang po'i skabs kyi bu lon skyed la skyed rgyag gis chu gnyer dang mtshangs pa 'di dag nam yang sprod 'jal thub min la bun zhib snyan zhu 'bul ༄rogs zhus don ltar a khu lags nas rgyal blon mtshan 'khod kyis/ snyan zhus su/par khang rgyal phun nyid nas sngar rtse tshos/sa pa'i grwa pa byas te lo 25nas mthar lo 65bar gzhung zhabs rim zhus kyi skor dang / mjug tu bka' nyes gzhung bzhes gnang lugs/ zhor du skye khang bya sa rgan po zur khang pa'i mkhar dbang gzhung bzhes gnang stabs 'di ga bya sa'i khyim tshang gzhung rgyugs mi ser yin pa ma zad/ la so khag drug gi khral rigs/ dmag khral sogs khral rigs ji rnyed zhabs phyi zhu dgos la de snga sa sbrul phan gyi sger gzhung chos bcas kyi bun zhib skyabs 'jug yod pa'i snyan zhu ha cang zhib phra zhig 'bul gnang mdzad/de rjes rgyal tshab ra sgreng mchog nas bka' yig phebs gsal/ ‘‘khyod rang mkhan che rgyal mtshan phun tshogs de snga rtse pho brang bzhengs skabs kyi le khrir mkhar dbang gzhung bzhes su song rung rgyal ba'i phyag tu 'byor bas sem neg pham mi dgos shing / de snga khyed rang gi gzhung zhabs zhu ring lhag bsam /ma

dag la byas rjes che bas bdag rkyen du /'bru khal nyis stong dang / dngul ṭam rdo lnga bcu yod pas/ gong gsal 'bru 'bab 'phyongs rgyas bkar steng dang /grwa phyi bkar steng nas blangs 'thus dang / dngul 'bab bla phyag nas len 'thus ’’zhes dang / ‘‘sne gdong gzhung rgyugs bya sa rgan zur khang pa'i sa sbrul phan gyi bun rigs rnams skyed kha rtsa chag thog ngo bo'i thog nas gsum zur bcags pas de'i 'phros sa zhing thog nas brgyad skor phyed shas kyis sprad de lho spyi mkhan chung 'jam dpal skal bzang dang / 'bru skyed phogs dpon 'bum thang gnyis nas thag gcod kyis lag 'dzin 'dra gsum bzos te 'di byas snyan zhu 'bul dgos ’’zhes pa'i bka' yig lho spyir 'byor te bun zhib mdzad byung /de nas lo ngo bcu skor 'gro skabs bun gsar rnying rnams gtsang sel thub pa ma zad/ rang khongs mi ser la 'bru bun khal 400nas 600bar bun gtong byed rgyu byung ba dang / shing cha spus tshong gis lag dngul yang 'dang tsam yong gi yod/ chu bya lo nas bzung rang nyid nas rgan po'i las khur byas pa yin/lcags yos (1951)lo tsam la nyin zhig nga tsho tshogs 'du 'tshog skabs brda yig cig 'byor gsal rgya rigs hre shan sing sogs phebs tshul 'dug pas/ nga rang 'tshams zhu'i mjal dar 'bul bar sne gdong nas rtsed thang ‘spa yong skabs hre shan sing zhes pa dang / khong gi sku zla rgya mo skra sbeg byas pa phru gu skye rgyu mtho po yod pa zhig a mdo ba lo chung zhig sne shan ldan bya tshang ba/ rgya sbyong dmag zhal ngo gcig dang dmag mi bcu shog gcig bcas 'byor song /de nas dmag mi dang ldan bya tshang nyin gsum tsam song rjes lha sar phyir log byas/ de skabs hre shan sing ngo 'khor gsum la zhabs 'degs zhu mkhan nga rang dang / yar stod dar rgyas gling gi gtso drag gnyis nyal chas khyer nas nga 6

cho bkar khang du bsdad/ hre shan sing zhes pa lo 40tsam slebs pa mi babs chags la zhi 'jam dang ldan pa yid la 'gro ba zhig 'dug khong gis nga tshor ‘‘khyed tsho zhed snang byed mi dgos/ dbyin ji dang / a ris nga tshor yag po byas yos ma red/ rjes su bcings 'grol dmag mi mang po yong skabs nga tsho yag po yong gi red ’mices gsungs myong / khong ni ngas gung khran tang gi las byed pa dang 'brel gtugs byed pa'i dang po yin/ dang thog nga tshos bod kyi lugs srol ltar sgo nga dang / gro/ sha sogs phul rung gtan nas bzhes kyi mi 'dug pas rang nyid ya mtshan zhing / de skabs khong rnam pa'i zas gron gtong byed ni rgya dngul rta mig ma bcad pa che chung sna tshogs 'dug pa dang / skad sgyur mnyam du skyod de gro mo rdo rje zhes pa'i tshong pa de'i sa nas dngul brjes brgyab nas zas rigs nyo gi yod/ de skabs kha lag bzos rjes nga tsho dang mnyam za mnyam 'thung byed du bcug gnang ba sogs dngos 'brel 'dra mnyam gyi spyod tshul 'dzin pa gnang gi 'dug khong skabs re lho spyi thub bstan mkhyen rab yod sar phebs pa dang / skabs re chu 'gram dang g.yas g.yon la 'cham 'cham gnang bar phebs kyi 'dug de nas zla ba gcig tsam song rjes glo bur du gad pa gru thon nas lha sar phebs pa red/1956lor lho kha sa gnas spyi khyab don gcod las khungs dbu brnyes nas rdzong don gcod las khungs kyi khongs su rang nyid la dmangs srid kho'o krang gi go ming stsal te zla rer phogs nā yang 130gnang byung / skabs der rang nyid dang / wang tse sun zhes pa mnyam du sa gnas las khungs la me shing bsdu nyo byed rgyu dang / de bzhin las byed par rta 'ul gtong rgyu sogs zhabs zhu byas pa yin/ gad pa gzhis la slob grwa skong bsdu gnang skabs rang nyid slob grwa'i gnyer pa'i las 'khur zla gcig lhag tsam byas/ de nas 1958lo 'gor spyi 7

khyab don gcod las khungs khu bsdu gnang song bas phogs kyang med/gong lo'i bod zla 8pa'i nang khams jag khongs kyi a 'brug tshang shog kha dang / dga' skyid rgu mdo khongs yin zer ba'i rta dmag lnga bcu skor rang khyim du 'byor nas bsdad song / skabs der khams jag gi 'go gtso gzugs ring la sha rgyags pa mgo ril zhig 'dug pas der khams jag byings kyi brtsi bkur che mdog byed kyi 'dug kho pa tshos nga tsho'i tshoms chen dang gzim chung nang du bsdad/ dmag rta rnams g.yul kha'i nang ston tog brngas te yod pa de rang bza' ru bcug nga tsho'i nang du pad spungs mchod rten gsum yod pa las gnyis khyer ba dang / de bzhin ja ril bdun star gnyis dang mar gdar ma gnyis khyer 'dug kho tshos thog steng du bsangs gtong ba dang / lha mo khang du 'phrin bcol kyang byas song / 'go gtso des nga la ‘‘sgang phu (sa ming )la rgya mi sa/ tshod (radug ’’ces dris byung bar/ ngas shes ma byung zhes lan rgyab pa yin/ de nub nam phyed tsam la khams jag de tsho go mtshon khyer nas/ rta bzhon te rtsed thang du thon te dmag 'thab byas pa'i me mda'i sgra thos kyi 'dugade'i phyi nyin nam langs skabs khams jag de rnams pros zin 'dug de nas nyi shar tsam la bcings 'grol dmag mi dang / skad sgyur phun tshogs lags rang khyim du phebs nas khams jag nang snyel yod med 'dri brtsad gnang byung bar khams pa med ces zhus pas bcings 'grol dmag mi kha shas khang pa'i thog steng du 'dzegs song / de skabs ngas bcings 'grol dmag la gsol ja zhu rtsis byed skabs skad sgyur phun tshogs lags nas chu khol byung na 'grig gsungs pas lam seng bcings 'grol dmag la chu khol zhus/ de'i mus su wu'u hru'u ci rlangs 'khor chung ngu'i nang phebs byung bas gong gsal khams jag gi gnas tshul rnams gsal po zhus pas ‘‘de'i skor lho spyi las tshab shes bya lags su zhus/ khyed rang la skyon cha ma byang ba legs po red ’’ces gsungs /ji) ri ri

nas phebs song / wu'u hru'u ci'i bka' slob ltar gong gsal khams jag gi gnas tshul rnams rdzong tshab shes bya lags su zhus pa yin pas khong rang yang hang sang ba lta bur sdod pa las gzhan gyi bya thabs dben/ dmag thengs dang po mjug sgril te zla gcig song rjes/ sa ud nas sne gdong rdzong la so khang rgyag byeng/ kyi shing cha dgos lugs gsungs pa ltar rang nyid nas kyang shing rkang 1000lhag tsam spus tshong zhus pa dang / bya sa khul gyi shing spus tshong zhu bya rnams rang nas 'gan khur bsdu len gyis so khang rgyag yul la dpa' bo ri dang / gdong brag nyag tu 'or 'dren byas pa'i rin 'bab ja ril blangs te khungs so sor sprad/ de'i dbar bya sa nas gtsang chung gling kha bar lam bzo bya rgyu/ lam bzo'i bka' bkod khang rang nyid kyi khyim du byas te 'go khrid bkra shis rgyal mtshan dang / em rje lags (mtshan ma dran )rang nyid bcas yin/ gtsang chung gling kha bar nyin gcig tsam lam bzo byas te sdod skabs lha sa nas krang tse yon dang / bcings 'grol dmag brgya skor phebs 'byor gyis lam bzo ba tsho yang bka' bkod khang nas gla 'bab sprad de phyir slog byas/1958lo'i bod zla 12pa'i nang khams jag cha 'drin pa rta pa drug cu skor rang khyim du 'byor te gzim chung dang / tshoms chen nang du btsan sdod byas/de nyin nyin gung tsam la jag pa'i dmag spyi ngag dbang zhes pa rta dmag lnga bcu tsam yod pa zhig kyang grwa nang brgyud 'byor nas sngon du slebs pa'i cha 'drin pa de tsho dang chu tshod gsum mnyam tshogs byas rjes thon song / skabs der rang gi bsam par khams jag 'di tshos 'di dang de dgos zhes bsun po bzo gi red bsams pa las gzhan gyi dogs gzhi gang yang ma byung / nyin de'i mtshan mo nga rang gnyer tshang du sdod skabs khams pa lo na rgan tsam byas pa zhig ya ra yong nas ngag 'jam pos ‘‘da lta dmag sgar nas bka' 'byor don khyed rang za chas dang / mal chas gra sgrig byas te khe gsum du 'du spyi 9

tshogs sar skyod dgos ’’zhes bshad byung bar rang nyid nas dngos 'brel 'du spyi'i tshogs 'du yin shag las mnar gcod gtong rgyu yin pa bsam yul du ma shar stabs za chas dang / mal chas 'gel rta 1 rta slog phru gu zla ba rgyal mtshan lo na 13la slebs pa zhig yod pa kho pa khrid nas 'gro skabs lcags ri'i 'gram du btsan thang nas yong ba'i khams jag rkang dmag lnga bcu skor 'dug pa de'i dkyil du bcug ste btsan thang zla ba tshe ring zer ba'i (btsan thang khul gyi rgan po red )khyim du khring/ nas nga rang phyi'i seng g.yab tu bzhag nas zla tshe sogs dang thug 'phrad byed du bcug ma byung / de skabs khams jag rnams tshogs 'du khyug tsam 'tshogs rjes khams jag mi gnyis dang mnyam du nga rang da nga rta slob/ phru gu bcas mnyam du khra rabrug la khrid de shar rgan po'i nang bzhag byung bas rgan pos nga la ja phor pa do gsum tsam blugs rjes jag dmag de gnyis kyis brjod don/ ‘‘shar rgan ngo/ dang / lho sgor rgan po (bud med )khyed tsho mnyam du khe gsum gzhis kar song ’’zhes brjod byung / de nas nga tsho dang mnyam du jag dmag de gnyis slebs ma byung / nga tsho mtshan mo zla 'od kyi 'og khe gsum la skyod skabs tshang ma kha khu sim mer bskyod pa las phan tshun gtam gleng gang yang ma byung la 'du tshogs yin shag byas stabs bros byol 'gro rgyu'i bsam blo gang yang 'khor ma byung / nga tsho khe gsum du 'byor nas gzhis ka'i thab tshang nang skyod skabs mi mang che ba nyal zin 'dug rung thab tshang sgo phye thog/ bzhu mar snum bzhu zhig kyang spar 'dug cing / phal cher gzhis gnyer yin snyam/ kho pa brgyud nga tsho 'byor yod ces a 'brug bla mar (a 'brug bla ma zhes pa de skabs der khams jag gi phogs khang khe gsum du yod pa de'i 'go gtso lte ba red )snyan seng zhu rogs zhes bshad nas nga tsho phran bu sgug sdod skabs yud tsam song rjes khams pa gzugs che la sha rgyags pa gdug tsub can zhig gzim chung nas thab tshang du yong ste ‘‘bya sa rgan po su yin pā ’mizhes dris 10

byung bar/ ngas phyag 'bul zhus te ‘‘lags nga yin ’ zhes brjod pa dang / kho pas ‘‘ā de ring yag po byung / bya sa rgan po khyod nga tsho'i lag par theb byung zhes bshad pa dang sbrags nga'i skra nas 'jus te rdung rdzogs gtong bzhin par shar rgan po dang / lho sgor rgan po log rgyugs zhes bshad song don bzhin log song ba las nga'i ched du zhu ba 'then yag sogs byed nus ma song / de'i skabs dang thog rang nyid nas dgongs dag thugs bden zhus rung ya nga snying rje til 'bru tsam med par brdung rdzogs byas stabs gang 'tshams nas dran pa thor ba lta bus shod yag mi 'dug de lta bu'i tham thom gyi khrod du mgo'i skra nas 'jus te skas steng nas drud cing gzhis kha'i 'og khang brag shur nang lag gnyis thag pas bsdams te gnam btag brgyab/ kho pas ‘‘'di rgya yi khrims red khyod rgya'i phogs za mkhan red ’rices bshad de kham sa jag dang / rgan po rkang 'dzugs sogs log song / nga ni na tsha'i sdug bsngal bzod dka'i gnas su gyar stabs bkra shis chos sde'i dbon sprul rin po che byams pa blo gsal snga ra nas nga tsho mchod yon sbyin bdag yin stabs/ ‘‘dbon sprul rin po che nga'i srog skyabs gnang rogs gnang mimizhes nyams thag pa'i skad shugs chen brgyab pas gang 'tshams shig nas skad kyang 'gag cing / de'i skabs khams jag gis rang nyid gsod kyi red snyam pa byung / de'i phyi nyin nam langs skabs khe gsucha/ rgan po rkang 'dzugs nas thag pa bkrol te rlung gsang bkag yod 'dug kyang nga rang gis dran gyi mi 'dug de nas dran pa sos skabs btson srung mi ser mi bzhi btsugs nas gzhis ka'i sgo rwa'i nang bzhag 'dug rtsam pa phran tsam dang / ja thang zhig ster byung rung lus po'i na zug gis rkyen pas lto yang za thub ma byung / de nas zhogs pa'i chu tshod 10yas mas tsam la ldum rwa khang gsar gyi sras rnam rgyal (kho pa 'phyongs rgyas ldum rwa ba'i bu yin cing skabs der 'phyongs rgyas khul nas bsdus pa'i bstan srung dang blangs dmag 11

gi brgya dpon byas )zer ba de dang / a 'brug bla ma'i rogs pa kham sa pa grwa gzugs byas pa mgo ril lag na phreng ba thogs pa lo na 60yasatshoms tsam la slebs pa zhig nga'i 'gram du yong ba dang / a 'brug bla ma sogs thog kha'i seng g.yab nas bltas/ kho pa sras rnam rgyal zer bas lam seng nga'i dpral bar lham 'jur rtas rdog rgyag gzhus te khrag mang po thon stabs lus khrag ral yog yog tu gyur bzhin par lcang rgyug mang po 'khyer yong ste btson srung sa/cig la mgo dang / gcig la rkang pa bzung du bcug nas sha dmar rjen steng du lcang rgyug gzhus byung / der lta mkhan khams pa grwa rgan de dang / ldum rwa'i sras rnam rgyal gnyis kyis smyo ba lta bus btson srung par ‘‘lcang rgyug tsha po gzhus shig ’’ces lcang rgyug gzhu mkhan yang nyes grabs byed kyi 'dug skabs der kho tshos bka' sgyur btang don du ‘‘khyod rgya mi'i phogs za ba dang / lhag don rgya mir lcam shing phon che btsongs nas rgya mis so khang brgyab ste nga tsho'i mi mang po 'phro brlag phyin song / khyod srog thog tu gtong rgyu yin/ rgya mis sprad pa'i phogs dang / shing rin gyi ja bcas bstan srung dmag sgar la rtsis 'bul zhu dgos ’’zhes bsgrags shing / nga ni dang thog lcang rgyug lnga bcu skor gzhu skabs na gzugs ba zod par dka' rung gang 'tshams nas lus por glog 'khyud pa lta bur sbir sbir byed pa las gzhan bsam rgyu dran rgyu mi 'dug kho pa tsho blo thag ma chod bar du lcang rgyug gzhus mthar jag pa de gnyis yar log nga ni yar langs kyang gom pa rgyag ma thub stabs btsan srung pas ga ler btson khang du bskyal te sngar bzhin brag shag de rang gi nang du bcug byung /de rjes de snga nga tsho'i shag tu sdod mkhan thogs med zer ba skabs der khra 'brug gi dkon gnyer dpon yin zhing / khong gis ri bo chos gling dgon dang / bkra shis chos sde dgon bcas la re bskul mdzad thog dgon khag gnyis kyi sku tshab dang khong gsum po mnyam du khe gsum du yong nas khams jag 12 —

gi 'go gtso a 'brug bla mar phran rang srog thog la mi 'gro ba'i re zhu gnang ste/de sngon rang nyid kyi phogs dngul dang lcam shing btsongs pa'i rin pa rnams kho pa tshor sprod rgyu dang / dmag thag ma chod bar nang mi dang thug 'phrad mi byed rgyu/ rtsed thang sgang phu'i sa gnas tang ud la gsang ba'i yi ge gtong mi chog rgyu sogs kyi gan rgya bzhag nas 'gan len dgon khag gsum nas byas te rang nyid btson khang nas bton thub tsam byung zhing / khe gsum gzhis sdod dbang 'dus rdo rjer rtsis sprod byas/ dbang 'dus rdo rje ni skabs der khams jag gi drung yig dang blos 'gel bya yul zhig red/ de nas khe gsum gzhis ka'i nub rgyud steng thog khang pa lcam gang ma zhig gi nang bzhag pa dang / nga'i g.yog zla ba rgyal mtshan nyin mo khe gsum gzhis kas g.yog bskul ba dang mtshan mo nga ri 'gram du nyal/ btson srung mi gnyis res mos kyis bsdad song / nyin bco lnga tsam 'gro skabs btson srung pa'ang yong mkhan mi 'dug khe gsum gzhis ka'i gnyer pas blta srung byed kyi 'dug nyin zhig nga'i spun mched dpa' bo dgon pa'i btsun ma dbu mdzad dang / ras chung phug gi grwa pa ngag dbang don grub nas rtsam pa dang / bag leb bskyal byung bar lta srung byed mkhan gnyer pas rtsam pa'i nang dang / bag leb kha gshags nas lta zhib nan po byed kyi 'dug skabs der khra 'brug dkon gnyer dpon gyis shag tshang dbang 'dus btang nas lto bskyal byung / de'i skabs nyes brdung btang ba'i rma khar sman bcos sogs gang yang byed mkhan med stabs rang gi am phrag tu yod pa'i gsang sngags dang skabs re sgo nga'i ser sprin 'dra byugs pa las gzhanasnan sogs med stabs rma kha drag rgyu shin tu dka' bas chab gsang du 'gro skabs rtsig par 'khyud de 'gro dgos byung // de skabs phyin chad gang yong sngon las su gang bskos red bsam pa tsam las gzhan gyi 'byung 'gyur gyi 'char gzhi dang dmigs yul sogs gang yang dran gyi mi 'dug khe gsum 13

gzhis kha'i tshoms chen nang nas lam rim dpe cha zhig g.yar nas der sdod ring tshar gcig klog pa des bkag nyar du sdod ring sems pa gu yangs su 'gro rgyur phan thogs byung / de ltar zla ba gsum tsam sdod ring bod zla 2pa'i tshes 1nyin gyi zhogs pa snga por mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag gi dmag 'thab kyi gnam gru gnyis 'byor nas me mda' brgyab song bas zing slong jag pa rnams brel brel 'tshub 'tshub kyis bros 'gro skabs khe gsum du sdod mkhan khams jag gi 'go gtso'i gras cha 'dren bla ma zer ba kho yang thog steng gzim chung nas yong ste ‘‘kho re bya sa rgan po nga tsho mgyogs po yong gi yin/ khyod 'dir bsdad nas ca lag la mig yag po blta dgos ’’zhes brjod de bros 'gro gi 'dug pas ngas kyang kho'i rta chas 'ga' zhig 'khyer rogs yin khul gyis mnyam du phyir thon/ de'i skabs khams jag tshang ma bros zin 'dug pas nga rang yang phyir thon nas thog mar gzhis kha'i 'gram gyi sbyar sdong chen po gsum gyi 'og tu yib nas bsdad pa dang / de'i mtshan mo khe gsum gling kha'i glang tshal bstugs po'i khrod du bsdad/ de skabs gzugs po ha cang skyo rung jag pa'i lag nas thar ba'i dga' ba dang / nang mi thug 'dod kyi 'dun pa drag pos bskul te sdug rus kyis lam du skyod na nyen kha yod stabs dka' ngal khyad bsad kyis shel brag gi phyogs su skyod de pad sgang gzhis khar 'byor skabs gzhis sdod sku zhabs nas khyed jag pa'i lag nas thar ba yag po byung zhes dga' tshor chen pos nga la rlung gsang bkag pa dang / richang dang lto chas ster ba ma zad nga la bshad don srid gzhung gsar pa dbu brnyes song / rdzong dpon bkra shis rgyal mtshan lags red ces bshad byung bas/ nga'i bsam par da khams jag gi 'jigs skul nas thar te nga tsho bza' mi spun mched tshang ma mnyam 'dzoms bya rgyu byung song snyam pa'i dga' ba nam langs pa lta bu byung /de nas nga rang dang / shel brag phyag mdzod lags mnyam du shel brag tu skyod 14

pa dang / g.yog zla ba rgyal mtshan sne gdong rdzong du snyan seng zhu bar btang /nga rang shel brag dgon du sdod ring de'i dgong mor grwa pa zhigatsho gis lan bskyal bar nga rang gi chung ma dang / bu mo/ tsha mo gnyis bcas shel brag rgyab kyi sbyar brgyud la rgyab ste chos dgon pa ru (btsun dgon )nga 'tshol bar phyin song zhes go thos— byung rjes nga'i bsam par phal cher btsun ma blo bzang chos sgron yod sar phyin pa red snyam nas phyag mdzod la sa gnas der yi ge zhig bskyal rogs zhus pa ltar yi ge 'byor nas sang nyin rang gi bza' zla blo bzang chos sgron dang / tsha mo tshe ring sgrol ma/ tshe ring sgrol dkar gsum shel brag tu slebs byung / de skabs khong gsum dga' skyo zung 'brel gyis mig chu lhung lhung du gtong bzhin tog tsam skad cha yang shod thub kyi mi 'dug bza' zla blo sgron nas ‘‘nga'i bsam par khyed rang bsad tshar yog red snyam byung / bsad yod tshe ro ga par yod rung ngas blta thub pa byed rgyu'i ched 'tshol bar phyin pa yin mi’ces zer gyi 'dug de nas bu mo gnyis nang du slog nas blo sgron nga rang la nad ga mog rgyugs te bsdad/ de nas nyin shas song rjes rdzong nas phyag bris 'byor nas nga rang rdzong du log shog 'di gar las ka mang po byed rgyu yod ces gsungs 'dug pas log grabs kyis pad sgang gzhis su 'byor skabs sa gnas u yon lhan khang gi rlangs 'khor chung gras shig de khul du rdo rgyud 'tshol bar phebs 'dug pa dang thug nas rlangs 'khor de'i nang bsdad de shan du 'byor skabs bkra shis rgyal mtshan sogs dbu khrid nas nga khams jag gi lag 'og tu ma shi bar dga' tshor chen po gnang ba ma zad/ thugs 'khur chen pos em rje ched 'bod kyis nad gzhir lta ru bcug pa dang / sman bcos gzab nan gnang ba brgyud gang 'gyogs drag skyes byung zhing / de nas rdzong nang las ka bkod sgrig gnang nas dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur gyi las don nang zhugs pa dang / tang gi srid jus ltar rang gi sa zhing sogs thon skyed rgyu 15

chas la blu nyo gnang ba/ bod las byed slob grwar gtong gnang mdzad pa/kron hru'u nang tsung wu'u kho yi kho krang gzhon par bsko gzhag stsal ba dang / sa gnas srid gros u yon du'ang bkod sgrig gnang ba sogs mdor na lo mang nang rang nyid tang dang mnyam las mnyam sgrub byas pa'i nang rang gis tang la yid ches blo gtad byas tshe tang gis nga tsho rgyal gces pa rnams la ‘‘skyid sdug mnyam myong dang / khrel grags mnyam 'khur mdzad kyi yod pa nga la shes tshor gting zab byung /

nye rabs lo rgyus thog gzhis rtse sa khul gyi rdzong sgyu/ ga la rang byung gnod 'che rim byung skor gyi gnas chul khag gcig phyogs bsgrigs byas pa/gzhis rtse sa gnasaXsted gros lo rgyus rig gnas rtsom sgrig uyon lhan khang nas/dus rabs nyi shu pa'i dus dkyil te spyi lo 1954lo nas 1998bar gzhis rtse'i khongs gtogs rdzong khag la rang byung khams kyi gnod 'tshe 'dra min sna tshogs te gangs skyon dang / chu skyon/ sa yom/ rlung chen bcas kyi rang byung gnod 'tshe sna tshogs byung bar srid gzhung nas mi dmangs mang tshogs kyi bde rtsar thug pazhi gnad don la gegs 'gog gegs sel gyi rgyab skyor rim par gnang yod/ gcig shing rta (1954)lo rgyal rtse rdzong khul nye ru'i phu'i mtsho brdol te chu log gi gnod 'tshe tshabs shin tu chen po byung ba/gong lo'i spyi zla 7tshes 17nyin nye ru'i phu'i ri sbub nang ‘‘rigs gsum mgon po'i bla mtsho ri’zhes pa'i mtsho khag gsum yod pa'i nang nas phyag rdor gyi mtsho zhes pa de gting tshad spyi khre nyis brgya tsam dang / zheng tshad spyi khre brgya tsam 17

gyi kha sho thon te bsam yul las 'das pa'i chu log tshabs chen byung nas nye 'dabs nye ru grong tshor them grangs 20yod pa de dag dang / dar pa grong tshor them grangs 30lhag tsam yod pa'i nang nas mi gcig skabs der gzhis rtser phyin te gson ngo/ra gnas pa phud de 'phros grong tsho gnyis kyi mi dang / sa zhing /khang pa/ sgo phyugs sems can bcas rtsa med du khyer ba dang / mtshan mo'i chu tshod 3pa tsam la rgyal rtse grong rdal khul du chu log 'byor te sa/tsang po'i nye 'gram lcang lho hin rdu'i sdod shag khang pa yongs rdzogs dang / gling kha'i shing sdong stong phrag lhag tsam yod pa rtsa khyer shul med du gyur pa ma zad/ hin rdu'i dpon dmag las bzo sum brgya tsam yod pa'i khongs nas hin dpon sa heb sogs na gzhon mi grangs bcu gcig bros thar ba ma gtogs de byings chus khyer nas shi/ phyogs mtshungs rgyal rtse rdzong dang / pa rnam rdzong gnyis su chu lam 'khel yul gyi gnod 'tshe phog pa'i grong tsho 170dang / them grangs 3017 mi grangs 16180 khongs nas chus khyer shi ba mi grangs 691dang /nad gzhi phog nas shi ba mi grangs 34 khang pa rtsa rdib song ba khang mig 10074 chu 'khor khyer grangs 37 che phyugs shi grangs 1730 ra lug shi grangs 6949 sa zhing snubs pa son khal 64810 'debs re med par rtsa stong du gyur pa son khal 13320bcas tshabs shin tu che ba'i gnod 'tshe byung bar/ skabs der krung dbyang nas rgyal rtse'i chu skyon gyi gnod 'tshe byung khul la ṭ+wā yang sgor khri 80dang / za 'bru rgya ma khri 73yod khongs nas 'bras rgya ma khri 50dang / 'bru rgya ma khri 23 dngos rigs grangs 9718 ras gur bzo byed ras kung khre 2496 son rtsa bun btang 'bru rgya ma khri 4 zam rgyag mthun rkyen sgor 8000 khang pa gsar rgyag grangs 4174bcas rgud skyob gnang yod/ de min gzhis rtse khul la chu skyon byung ba'i skor gzhis rtse sa gnas yig tshags nas de snga'i bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi 'tsho zhib do dam 18

zhes pa'i yig char gzhis rtse khul chu skyon bsdoms 'bor ston bsdu med pa son ru'i khal 20859 18561(nyis khri stong med brgyad brgya lnga bcu nga dgu dang /bre bco brgyad phul lnga drug cha gcig )slad 'debs re med pa'i son khal 1927 83(chig stong dgu brgya nyi shu rtsa bdun dang / bre brgyad phul gsum )mi pho mo shi grangs 18 rta rti'u shi grangs 12 ba bong shi grangs 120 ra lug shi grangs 31 sdod khang rtsa rdib song ba ka grangs 6838bcas kyi gnod 'tshe byung bar de snga'i bod sa gnas srid gzhung nas rgyal rtse'i chu skyon gyi rgud skyob la 'bru ru'i khal 80000tham pa 'don sprod byas lugs 'khod yod pa red/gnyis/ sa bya (1993)lo lha rtse dang / ngam ring rdzong gnyis su sayom gyi gnod 'tshe byung ba/gong lo'i zla 3tshes 20nyin gyi chu tshod 22 57thog lha rtse rdzong dang / ngam ring rdzong gnyis la rim pa drug dang tshag drug gi sa yom brgyab cing / thengs 'di'i sa yom ni rang re'i khul du lo rgyus thog mthong dkon pa dang / gnod 'tshe tshabs shin tu chen po byung yod/ dus mtshungs shar phyogs su gro mo dang /nub phyogs su skyid grong gnyis la'ang tshad mi 'dra ba'i sa yom brgyab thog dpal 'byor gyi gyong gun nges can zhig phog yod cing / sa yom ma brgyab gong gi sngon rtags su spyi zla 3tshes 16nas bzung lha rtse khul du nyin mtshan bstud mar rlung chen brgyab rjes bar snang khams su sprin nag 'khrigs pa dang /sa ngos su rgyun chad med par 'od 'khyug pa/ sa yon chen mo ma brgyab sngon la sa yom chung ba khag gsum brgyab pa dang / phyogs mtshungs ngam ring rdzong du yang rlung chen bstud mar brgyab nas bzang bzang sogs 'brog khul du sdod gur brgya lhag tsam dang / ra lug brgya tsam/ mang tshogs kyi thab chas sogs — 19

kyang rlung chen gyis khyer ba dang / lhag par du sa dga' dang / 'brong pa rdzong gnyis la rim pa bcu yi rlung chen gyis phyugs rigs khyer nas shi ba dang /khyags shi thebs pa mang po byung 'dug sa dga' rdzong gi tshogs khang dang rlangs 'khor 'jog khang yang lhag pas bslogs pa red/skabs de'i sa yom gyi gtso gnad ni lha rtse dang / ngam ring gnyis kyi bar yin pas zhib 'jug byas pa ltar na/ lha rtse rdzong du grong rdal gnyis dang /shang dgu/ grong sdo brgya dang lnga bcas la thengs 'di'i sa yom gyi gnod 'tshe phog yod cing / gnod 'tshe phog pa'i them grangs 85 37lkozin pa dang /gnod 'tshe phog pa'i mi grangs 38743yod pa des rdzong yongs kyi mi grangs bsdoms 'bor gyi 92gli zin gyi yod/ gnod 'tshe phos/ pa'i khang mig 29180yod pa'i nang nas khang mig 226rdib skyon byung yod/ rdzong de'i gra phu shang gi gra phu grong tsho dang / sne bzhi grong tsho/ lcags kha grong tsho bcas la khang mig 170rdib pa dang / mi gcig shi ba/ mi gnyis la rmas skyon byung ba/ rdzong yongs la thad kar dpal 'byor gyi gyong gun sgor khri 3554byung yod pa red/ngam ring rdzong la khyon bsdoms chus 2dang / shang 17 grong tsho 191yod pa'i nang thengs de'i gnod 'tshe phog pa'i shang 10dang / grong tsho 115yod pa des thems grangs bsdoms 'bor gyi 58glidang / mi grangs bsdoms 'bor gyi 60lko zin gyi yod/ gnod 'tshe phog pa'i thems grangs 1756dang / mi grangs 9922yod pas rdzong yongs kyi thems grangs bsdoms 'bor gyi 25glidang / mi grangs bsdoms 'bor gyi 24 8lkozin gyi yod/ gnod skyon byung ba'i khang mig 5580yod pa'i nang rdib skyon byung ba'i khang mig 1558yod/gad kha shang gi spo dga' la sogs pa'i grong tsho lnga la khang pa rdib grangs 1260dang / mi gcig shi ba/ mi gnyis rmas pa bcas sngon rtsis byas pa ltar na/ rdzong yongs la dpal 'byor gyi gyong gun sgor khri 2746phog yod pa red/20

sa yom brgyab rjes gegs 'gog gegs sel bya thabs spel zhing /gzhis rtse sa gnas u yon lhan khang dang / srid 'dzin kung hru'u/ yan lag dmag khul khang bcas nas 'phral mar dza drag gi tshogs 'du 'tshogs te yom 'gogaghonod sel gyi las don bkod sgrig gis mtshan mo de rang du las don tshogs chu nga khag gsum btang ste 'thab sa mdun mar zab zhugs kyis mang tshogs sgrig 'dzugs byas te gnod 'gog byas pa'i zhib phra'i bya thabs ni/ 1 sa ud kyi hru'u ci blo mthun bsam grub nas bkod 'doms pa byas pa dang /srid gros kyi kru'u zhi dang srid 'dzin kung hru'i kron yon gzhon pa/ dmag khul khangagi chab srid u yon bcas kyis bkod 'doms pa gzhon pa byas nas sa gnas yom 'gog gnod sel bkod 'doms khang btsugs pa dang / gsham du don gcod khang btsugs te khyon yongs nas yom 'gog ga/nod sel gyi las don bkod 'doms byas yod/ 2 sa yom bar ma chad pa brgyab rkyen mang tshogs kyi tshe srog rgyu nor bde 'jags ched bsam blo'i las ka yag po byas pa dang / chabs cig mang tshogs rnams nyen kha med sar gnas spo byed du bcug ste nyem med bde 'khod kyi 'gan srung byas yod/ 3 tang srid dmag dang mang tshogs bcas nas mthun sgril mnyam las byas te 'bad brtson chen pos gnod 'gog las don hur thag byas shing / sa yom chen po brgyab rjes mang tshogs khag gcig thang du nyal dgos byung rkyen nad yams phog par brten sa gnas dang / dmag dpung gi 'go khrid tshos mang tshogs kyi tshe srog bde thang chedasnan bcos ru khag gnyis tsam btang ste na tsha sngon 'gog gi sman bcos byas pa dang / da dung mang tshogs la gnod 'gog gi dngos rigs sdod gur brgya lhag tsam dang / btsugs phrug bzhi brgya lhag tsam/ rtswa ras chig khri lhag tsam bcas sprad pa red/21

gsum/ shing phag 1995lor gzhis rtse sa khul du gangs skyon byung ba/gong lo'i spyi zla 11pa'i zla mjug tu rang ljongs kyi sa khul khag gcig la a she ya lho ma'i skam sa 'khel ba'i rlung gi 'khor rgyugs kyi shugs rkyen 'og lo rgyus thog mthong dka' ba'i gangs skyon gyi gnod 'tshe byung nas zhing 'brog mang tshogs kyi tshe srog dang / rgyu nor/ thon skyed/ 'tsho ba bcas kyi thad la gnod 'tshe tshabs chen bzos yod/ zla 11tshes 9nyin gyi dgong dro nas 'go tshugs te gro mo dang / gam pa/ skyid grong / gnya' nang / gting skyes/khang dmar/ ding ri/ pa snam/ sa dga'/ lha rtse/ ngam ring / sa skya/rnam gling / bzhad mthong smon/ rin spungs/ rgyal rtse/ 'brong pa/ gzhis rtse bcas rdzong dang grong khyer bco brgyad nang gangs chen babs shing / gangs gyi mthug tshad cha snyoms kung h+phun brgyad cu yan zin pa dang / gro mo/ gam pa/gting skyes/ gnya' nang / skyid grong / ding ri/ khang dmar sogs la bu yug 'tshub pa/ gangs skyon gyi dus tshod ring la rgya khyon che ba/ gangs 'bab tshad chesnye ba bcas kyi gnas tshul 'og gnod 'tshe phog pa'i sa khul du 'brog las thon skyed dang / mi dmangs mang tshogs kyi tshe srog rgyu nor la sngar byung myong med pa'i gnod 'tshe phog pa ma zad/ tshabs che'i god chag byung yod/ tho bkod byas par gzhigs na/ zla 11tshes 25bar thengs 'di'i gangs skyon phog yul rdzong khag bco brgyad nang nas gzhis rtse grong khyer dang / rin spungs/rnam gling / bzhad mthong smon bcas la gnod 'tshe byung med pa phud/ de min rdzong khag bcu bzhi'i nang gnod 'tshe phog pa'i shang dang / grong rdal 129yod pa de sa khul yongs kyi shang dang grong rdal gyi 59 44ltazin yod pa de'i nang gnod 'tshe tshabs chen phog pa'i them grangs 30622yod pa des 22

gnod 'tshe phog pa'i them grangs bsdoms 'bor gyi 64 4smozin yod pa dang /mi grangs 174548yod pa des gnod 'tshe phog pa'i mi grangs bsdoms 'bor gyi 675zin yod/ dmigs bsal gyi gnod 'tshe tshabs chen phog pa'i them grangs 18099yod pa des gnod 'tshe phog pa'i them pa grangs bsdoms 'bor gyi 38smozen pa dang / mi grangs 103166yod pa des gnod 'tshe phog pa'i mi grangs bsdoms 'bor gyi 39 6gli zin gyi yod/ thengs 'di'i gnod 'tshe'i nang 'khyags shi thebs pa'i mi grangs 17yod pa dang / brdabs skyon byung nas shi ba 1 kha thor nas skabs shig ring gar song med par gyur pa mi grangs 25yod kyang rjes su tshes 29nyin gyi gong lā tshang ma rnyed thub tsam byung yod/ 'khyags skyon gyis rmas pa dang / gangs 'phyid brgyab pa'i mi grangs 18000yan zin pa/ gangs dkyil nas thar ba'i rdzong 1dang shang 14 mi grangs 12000yas mas zin gyi yod/ khang mig 52rdib pa dang / rlung chen gyis khyer nas khang mig 40lhag tsam 'gyel ba/ gnod skyon byung ba'i khang mig 1053dang / sbra gur 2505 lhas rwa 'gyel ba 35ba/6 gangs dkyil nas ma thar ba'i phyugs rigs kha grangs khri 76zin pa dang / rdzong bcu bzhi'i nang gnod 'tshe phog pa'i phyugs rigs kha grangs khri 333yod pa des rdzong bcu bzhi'i phyugs rigs bsdoms 'bor khri 546gi 61glizin yod pa dang / de'i nang gnod 'tshe tshabs chen phog pa'i phyugs rigs kha grangs khri 256yod pa des gnod 'tshe phog pa'i phyugs rigs kyi 76 745zin yod/ dmigs bsal gnod 'tshe tshabs chen phog pa'i phyugs rigs kha grangs khri 142yod pa des gnod 'tshe phog pa'i phyugs rigs bsdoms 'bor gyi 42 6glizin yod/shi skyon byung ba'i phyugs rigs kha grangs khri 35045yod pa des sa khul yongs kyi phyugs rigs bsdoms 'bor gyi 5lkozin yod/ 'khyags skyon dang gangs 'phyid brgyab ste shi ba'i phyugs rigs nges gsal tho bkod bya thabs med cing / 23

tshod rtsis rags tsam byas pa ltar na thengs de'i gangs skyon gyis thad kar dpal 'byor gyi gyong gun sgor khri 36110 9bzos yod pa red/thengs de'i gangs skyon nang gro mo dang / gam pa/ skyid grong / gting skyes/ gnya' nang bcas la de bas tshabs chen po byung ba dang / gro mo rdzong du gangs kyi mthug tshad cha snyoms kung h+phun 70yan zin pa ma zad/ phag ri grong rdal du gangs kyi mthug tshad kung h+phun 120yan zin yod/ gnod 'tshe phog yul shang dang grong rdal bdun trem yod pa/ rdzong yongs la 'grim 'grul dang 'phrin skyel/ glogagi mkho 'don bcas re zhig bar mtshams chad/ phag ri dang / kham bu/ dgyes ru bcas la gangs kyi mthug tshad kung h+phun 100yan zin rkyen phyugs rigs bsdoms 'bor gyi 80lkonas 90lkotsam la nyen kha tshabs chen bzos pa dang / mi grangs 10shi yod pa de'i nang phyugs rdzi mi grangs 8dang / bcings 'grol dmag mi 2 phyugs rigs kha grangs 5641shi ba/ 'phrin skyel glog shing grangs 300tsam 'gyel ba bcas kyi gnod skyon byung yod/gam pa rdzong yongs la gangs kyi mthug tshad kung h+phun 70zin pa dang /sa cha khag gcig la kung h+phun 100yan zin gyi yod pa red/ 'khyags shi thebs pa'i ra lug kha grangs 17000skor dang / kha rlung mtho po yod rkyen zla dang po nas gnyis pa bar gangs bzhu ma thub par phyugs rigs kha grangs khri 14tsam 'khyags shi dang / ltogs shi thebs pa'i nyen kha tshabs chen bzos yod/skyid grong rdzong du gangs kyi mthud tshad cha snyoms kung h+phun 50zin cing /rtswa thang khyon yongs gangs kyis bkab par brten phyugs rigs kha grangs khri 10tsam la tshabs che'i dka' ngal bzos pa dang / mi gcig 'khyags shi thebs pa red/24

gting skyes rdzong du gangs kyi mthug tshad kung h+phun 80yan zin cing /grong tsho 68stiyan gyi 'gro lam 'gag pa dang / gnod 'tshe phog pa'i phyugs rigs kha grangs khri 26 6zin pa/ de'i nang gnod 'tshe tshabs chen phog pa'i phyugs rigs kha grangs khri 18tsam zin gyi yod/ gangs skyon gyi gnod 'tshe byung rjes sa khul du gangs 'gog gnod sel bkod 'doms pu'u btsugs pa dang / skabs der kron yon phun tshogs lags kyis bkod 'doms gnang ba ma zad/ gnya' nang rdzong gi 'go gtso dang / gro mo rdzong gi phag ri grong rdal gnyis 'a1 'thab sa mdun ma'i bkod 'doms khang gnyis btsugs te sa khul u yon lhan khang gi mu yon rdo rje phun tshogs dang / sa khul srid gros kyi kru'u zhi gzhon pa ngag dbang 'gyur med rnam gnyis nas 'thab sa mdun mar bkod 'doms gnang yod/ gnod 'tshe phog pa'i rdzong khag tshang mar gnod 'gog bkod 'doms khang ngam/ 'go khrid tshogs chung dang / don gcod khang btsugabasdo pa ma zad/ gnod 'tshe phog sa'i shang khag la'ang 'go khrid tshogs chung btsugs te gnod 'gog 'go khrid la shugs snon brgyab yod pa red/gnod pa 'gog thabs ni/ dang thog rlangs 'khor 'gro lam gtso bo rnams bshangs te rlangs 'khor shar bskyod thub pa byas yod pa dang / hur brtson chen pos mi'i bde 'jags srung skyob kyi mang tshogs sgrig 'dzugs byas te gar song cha med du gyur pa'i mi btsal 'tshol byas stabs gong gsal ribor brlag song ba'i mi grangs 25tshang ma rnyed son thub pa byung ba dang /gangs dkyil du lus pa'i mang tshogs dang / phyug4 rigs tshang ma phyir 'don thub pa byung yod/ gnod 'gog gi dngos po grangs tshad nges can zhig gra sgrig byas te sa khul yongs la gangs 'gog gnod sel bkod 'doms pu'u yi gnod 'gog ched dngul sgor khri 120dang / phyugs rtswa rgya ma khri 200 phyugs chag tun 160 'ba' cha tun 370 dngul sgor khri 18zin pa'i mi'i sman 25

rigs dang / dngul sgor khri 17zin pa'i phyugs sman bcas btang nas gnod 'tshe phog khul gyi rdzong khag la bgo 'grems byas yod/ sa khul dmangs srid cus kyis gnod 'tshe phog pa'i mang tshogs tshor gyon chas kha grangs 3000lhag tsam dang / nyal chas 800lhag tsam/ 'bru rigs rgya ma khri 5tsam sprad pa dang /de bzhin spyi tshogs yongs skul slong byas te gnod 'tshe phog pa'i mi dmangs la brtse sems mtshon pa'i byed sgo spel nas zhal 'debs dngul sgor khri 50lhag tsam dang / grangs tshad nges can gyi dngos po bskyal ba bcas byas stabs gnod 'tshe phog pa'i mang tshogs tsho'i zas gos sdod gsum gyi kha tsha dgos gtugs che ba'i dka' ngal rtsa ba'i cha nas sel thub pa byung yod/bzhi/ me byi (1996)lo mthong smon rdzong la sayom gyi gegs bar byung ba/gong lo'i spyi zla 5pa'i zla 'go dang / zla 7pa'i zla 'go dang zla mjug bcas kyi nang bzhad mthong smon rdzong khul du sa yom gyi gegs bar thengs mang byung nas gegs khul gyi las byed dang / mang tshogs tsho'i tshe srog la 'jigs skul chen po bzos pa dang / zhing 'brog thon skyed dang / mang tshogs kyi 'tsho bar gyong gun dang dka' ngal chen po byung yod/ zla 5tshes 10nyin gyi chu tshod 17 6gi thog bzhad mthong smon rdzong gi byang ngos su rim pa 5 1gi sa yom brgyab pa dang / sa yom rgyag sa'i lte gnas ni phred thig byang ma'i tu'u 30 8nga/nga / gzhung thig shar ma'i tu'u 88 23gyi thog brgyab pa red/1996lo'i zla 7tshes 3nyin gyi chu tshod 14 44thog bzhad mthong smon rdzong gi byang ngos su rim pa 6gi sa yom brgyab pa dang / sa yom gyi lte gnas ni phred thig byang ma'i tu'u 29 7dang / gzhung thig shar ma'i tu'u 87 8kyi sar brgyab pa red/26

1996lo'i zla 7tshes 31nyin gyi chu tshod 16gi thog mthong smon rdzong gi byang ngos su slar yang rim pa 5 7gyi sa yom thengs gnyis brgyab pa ma zad/de rjes kyang sa yom thengs mang brgyab cing / sa yom gyi lte gnas ni khred thig byang ma'i tu'u 30 4dang gzhung thig shar ma'i tu'u 88 5thog 'khel yod/de'i rjes chu tshod 16 2kyi thog rim pa lnga yi sa yom brgyab cing / bzhad mthongasmon rdzong gi byang phyogs su zla 5tshes 10nas zla 8tshes shar bar sa yom rim pa lnga yan thengs lnga tsam brgyab pa ma zad/ sa cha de gar nam rgyun dang mi 'dra ba'i sa yom gyi 'gul bskyod thengs mang byung yod/ thengs 'di'i sa yom ni byang shar khul gyi shan rtsa'i mnga' khongs kyi gad srub sa khyud phyogs la 'gyur phyin pa dang / sa yom gyi rtags mtshan yod pa snga sa nas rim pa khag gi sa yom sde tshan la do snang gang zab byung yod/ shan rtsa khul gyi gad srub khyud ni sa yom che tsam rgyag pa'i sa cha shig yin gshis 1908lo dang / 1924lo gnyis la rim pa bdun gyi sa yom rgyag myong yod pa dang / sa yom sde tshan gyis sngon dpag byas pa star na/ sa cha de ga'i mnga' khongs su slad phyin rim pa 6nas 7bar gyi sa yom rgyag rgyu'i nyen kha'i rang bzhin gnas yod pa red/bstud mar sa yom thengs mang brgyab rjes sa yom rgyag khul la gyong gun ha cang chen po phog yod cing / thengs 'di'i sa yom nang stabs legs pa zhig la mi la shi mes gang yang byung med/ 'on kyang sdod khang sogs la gnod skyon tshabs chen byung yod pas khang pa mang che bar tshad gzhi mi 'dra ba'i ser kha gas pa dang / gdung ma 'khyog par brten mi sdod thabs bral zhing / mus pa bye chen dang / chin du'u/ na mo che/ tsha bzhi bcas shang bzhi'i srid gzhung gi khang pa'i gyang ldebs la ser kha gas pa dang / yo shor ba/ ser kha'i zheng tshad kung h+phun 4nas 12tsam yod pa dang / gdung ma 'khyog pa/ sgo dang sge'u khung yo shor ba bcas kyis khang pu rdib nyen chen po yod rkyen las byed las 27

bzo shang du sdod thabs bral zhing / lung bzang chus kyi mkho sgrub tshong khang dang / yid rton khang / phyugs rigs sman khang bcas kyi khang pa yongs rdzogs la ser kha gas pa dang / gdung ma dang / sge khung sogs 'khyog nas nyen khar gyur pa/ ching du'u shang gi gag ring grong tsho'i thems grangs 6gi khang mig 21la gnod 'tshe tshabs chen phog yod pa/ tsha phu shang gi me ra dang /khang legs/ gnas bcas grong tsho gsum nang gnod 'tshe tshabs chen phog pa'i khang mig 12dang / gnod 'tshe 'bring tsam phog pa'i khang mig 15gnod 'tshe cung tsam phog pa'i khang mig 200bcas yod pa/ lhas rwa rdibs grangs 25bcas byung yod/ thengs 'di'i gegs skyon nang slob grwa khag la gnod 'tshe che shos byung bas brag la chus kyi lte ba'i slob chung dang / lung bzang chus kyi lte ba'i slob chung / bde legs cus kyi lte ba'i slob chung / mus pa bye chen shang gi dmangs btsugs slob grwa/ tsha phu shang gi lte ba'i slob chung bcas kyi slob khang dang / slob phrug gi nyal khang la ser kha gas pa dang /gdung ma dang / sgo sge'u khung (rakhyogs pa/ khag gcig rdib pa/ stag mo shar shang gi glog khang gi rtsig rmang dang / bzo khang / glog khang gi chu yur bcas la ser kha chen po gas rkyen glog gtong mtshams chad pa/ gzhan yang rdzong nas bde legs chus dang / lung bzang chus bar gyi gzhung lam gtso bo'i thogargyus rdo nyil nas lam 'gag pa dang / rkyang gong zam pa dang rong 'go zam pa/rong smar zam pa/ shar phyogs zam pa sogs la tshad gzhi mi 'dra ba'i skyon cha shor ba yod pa ma zad/ rkyang gong zam pa'i rtsig rmang rdib ste rlangs 'khor 'gro thabs med par chags pa/ stag mo shar shang dang / chab kha shang / rin chen rtse bcas shang gsum nang rka yur ring tshad bsdoms spyi le 39tsam la gnod 'tshe chen po bzos pa bcas thengs 'di'i sa yom nang dpal 'byor gyi gyong gun bsdoms sgor khri 632 25bzos yod pa red/28

sa yom brgyab rjes rim pa khag gi 'go khrid tshos do snang dang thugs khur chen po gnang ba ma zad/ rang skyong ljongs kyi dbu khrid dang / ljongs dmangs srid thing / ljongs sa yom cus sogs 'brel yod sde tshan nas kyang thug khur dang rgyab skyor chen po gnang yod/ sa gnas u yon lhan khang dang /srid 'dzin kung hru'u yis ched mngags tshogs 'du skong tshogs gnang ste gnod 'tshe 'gog thabs la zhib 'jug dang / gnod 'gog las don bkod sgrig gnang zhing / 'brel yod sde tshan sgrig 'dzugs byas te gnod 'tshe phog khul mang tshogs la sems gso dang 'brel gnod 'gog las don bkod 'doms gnang ba dang / 'brel yod sde tshan nas gnod sel gyi dngul dang dngos po nges can zhig gnang ba dang / phyogs mtshungs bzhad mthong smon rdzong nas kyang nor shugs kha thang po yod pa 'i gnas tshul 'og sgor khri 35bton nas gnod 'tshe phog khul mang tshogs kyi gnas skabs dka' ngal sel rogs byas pa dang / mang tshogs skul slong byas te thon skyed rang skyob dang / khyim gzhis rang 'dzugs byas nas gnod 'tshe'i gyong gun chung du gtong gang thub bcas byas yod pa red/lnga/ meglang (1997)lor skyid grong rdzong du sayom gyi gnod 'tshe byung ba/skyid grong rdzong du gong lo'i spyi 11tshes 3nyin gyi zhogab pa'i chu tshod 10 30thog rim pa lnga dang tshag drug gi sa yom shugs chen brgyab ste rdzong yongs kyi gzhung spam dang / zam pa/ chu bed sogs kyi rmang gzhi'i sgrig chas dang /gzhung khang / sger khang bcas la gtor bshig tshabs chen phog cing / skyid grong rdzong yongs kyi shang drug dang / grong rdal gcig la gnod 'tshe phog pa ma zad/ lhag par du spre pa dang / gung thang / rdzong dga'/ gra dang sa sle/29

skyid grong grong rdal bcas la gnod 'tshe tshabs chen phog yod/ sa yom ma brgyab gong rdzong dang / shang / grong tsho'i mi rnams kyi rna bar rlangs 'khor 'gul bskyod kyi 'ur sgra lta bu'i sgra thos pa dang / de rjes khang pa dang / glog skud ka ba sogs la 'gul bskyod chen po thebs pa/ khang pa'i nang gang sar sa zag pa dang / sge khung dang / sgrog tse/ tshong khang gi zog stegs thog gi tshong zog dngos po gang sar zag pa/ khyis sdug skad rgyag pa/ byis pa dang bud med kyi ngu sgra gang sar thon te de snga 'di lta bu'i sa yom rgyag myong med rkyen nyin der rdzong dang / shang / grong tsho gang sar mi rnams 'jigs skrag gi rnam pas khengs te nang du sdod blos ma bzod par phyir don dgos byung ba dang /zla 11tshes 4nyin gyi nyin gung chu tshod 12thog slar yang tshabs che'i sa yom brgyab nas las byed dang mang tshogs kyi rgyu nor la ches che ba'i nyen kha bzos yod/ thengs de'i sa yom gyi gnod 'tshe khyab che rkyen rdzong dang / shang gi las khungs/ slob grwa/ sman khang / rgyang bsgrags/ brnyan 'phrin/ yig zam/dngul khang / glog khang la sogs pa'i sde tshan gyi gzhung las thog brtsegs khang dang / mdzod khang / las byed dang mang tshogs kyi sdod khang / lhas rwa/gzhung lam/ zam pa/ rme yur la sogs par tshad gzhi mi 'dra ba'i gtor bshig dang gnod skyon phog yod/ khang pa'i gyang rtsigs tshabs che yo ba dang /ser /ba gas pa/ lhas rwa dang chu 'khor mang po rdib pa/ skyid grong grong rdal srid gzhung gi las shag gi rtsigs ldebs la ser kha kung h+phun bzhi nas drug bar gas skyon gyur par brten nyen khar gyur te mi sdod thabs bral bas las byed las bzo mi grangs 16gnas spo bya dgos byung ba dang / de bzhin spre pa shang dang / brag sna shang / gung thang shang bcas kyi tang srid las khungs kyi khang pa dang sdod khang gi rtsigs ldebs la ser kha kung h+phun gsum nas lnga bar gas skyon byung bar brten las byed las bzo mi grangs 14gnas spo mi byed thabs med 30

byung ba/ rdzong nas skyid grong grong rdal bar gyi gzhung lam spyi le 75sar ri nas rdo nyil bar brten lam khag bdun gyi 'gro lam 'gag pa/ phyogs mtshungs zam pa gsum gyi rtsigs rmang log pa sogs kyi gnod 'tshe tshabs chen phog yod pas thengs 'di'i sa yom gyi gnod 'tshes dpal 'byor gyong gun sgor khri 682tsam bzos yod pa red/gong gsal skyid grong rdzong khul du sa yom gyi gnod 'tshe byung rjes rim pa khag gi 'go khrid nas gegs 'gog gegs sel bya rgyur thugs khur che bzhes kyis gnod 'tshe phog khul mi dmangs kyi khyim gzhis gsar 'dzugs bya rgyu'i thad zhib phra'i mdzub ston bkod sgrig gnang thog ljongs dmangs srid thing nas khyim gzhis gsar 'dzugs kyi mthun rkyen gron dngul sgor khri 60tham pa gnang ste gnod 'tshe phog pa'i mang tshogs la dus thog tu bgo 'grems gnang bar brten khong tshos sems kyi gting nas tang gi bka' drin rjes dran zhu ba dang 'brel khyim gzhis gsar 'dzugs kyi bya ba'i nang spro ba rab tu 'khol te sems shugs ldab brgya ldan pa'i 'bad brtson byas yod pa red/drug sa stag (1998)lor gzhis rtse sa khul du chu skyon sogs kyi gnod 'tshe byung ba/gong lo'i spyi zla 4pa'i nang gzhis rtse sa khul du sngon la than pa btang ba dang / de rjes zla 6tshes 20nas bzung sa khul khyon yongs la char zhod tshugs te nyin bdun cu tsam ring nyin mtshan bstud mar char pa 'bab shugs ha cang che rkyen chu log don pa dang / snyi rdol ba/ ser ba 'bab pa bcas kyis sa khul khyon yongs la tshad gzhi mi 'dra ba'i gnod 'tshe shin tu tshabs chen phog cing /lo bcu phrag kha shas nang byung myong med pa'i gnod 'tshe tshabs chen de dag gis sa khul yongs la sa zhing mu'u khri 150lhag tsam yod pa'i nang nas chu log dang /31

zhod skyon/ snyi rdol bcas kyis gnod 'tshe phog pa'i rgya khyon sa zhing mu'u khri 17 4yod pa de dag gi nang gnod 'tshe tshabs chen phog pa'i rgya khyon mu'u khri 3 43dang / gnod 'tshe cung chung ba'i rgya khyon mu'u khri 9 72 bsdu 'bab med pa'i rgya khyon mu'u khri 3 89bcas zin gyi yod pa red/'brog las thad phyugs rigs chus khyer ba dang chus bsubs grangs bsdoms 6523yod pa'i nang che phyugs 220dang / ra lug 6303yod pa dang /rtswa thang la gnod 'tshe phog pa'i rgya khyon mu'u khri 43 68yod pa'i nang rtswa thang chus khyer ba'i rgya khyon mu'u khri 16 66dang / chus bsubs pa mu'u khri 27 2lhas rwa dang lug ra khyer ba 1266yod pas/ thad kar dpal 'byor gyong gun sgor khri 846 62bzos pa red/nags las thad chus khyer ba'i nags tshal rgya khyon mu'u 1132 6las shing rkang grangs khri 15tsam yod pas thad kar dpal 'byor gyi gyong gun sgor khri 155 19zin yod/ lo shas kyi sngon la btab pa'i lcang gsar chus khyer ba mu'u grang sa 4446 3zin pa las shing rkang grangs khri 70 96zin pas thad kar dpal 'byor gyong gun sgor khri 200 29zin yod/chu bed thad mu'u khri yan la chu gtong thub pa'i ma yur grangs 27 chus khyer bar ring tshad kung le 181 48yod pa dang / chus khyer ba'i chu bed sgrig chas sne grangs 190 sa zhing mu'u khri man dang stong yan la zhije chu gtong thub pa'i ma yur grangs 74 chus khyer bar ring tshad kung le 128 4zin yod/sa rdos chu yu ra khengs pa rgya dpangs gru bzhi 45 69 mu'u chig stong yan la chu gtong thub pa'i chu yur grangs 1334 chus khyer ba ring tshad kung le 344 6 chus khyer ba'i chu bed 'dzugs skrun grangs 164 chu rag khyer ba grangs 508la ring tshad kung le 124zin yod/ da dung chu 'then 'bab tshugs bzhi dang / chu mdzod 105 sa 'og gi chu 'then sgrig chas 32

grangs 19 phyugs rigs dang / mi'i 'thung chu'i las grwa khag grangs 20bcas chus khyer ba red/glog shugs kyi thad rdzong rim pa'i glog khang grangs 7 shang grong gi glog khang grangs 8 sa gnas kyi do dam byed pa'i stong chu glog khang dang / 'chad mang glog khang / sa khul glog 'don khang gi chu yur dang / glog shing bcas khag mang po chus khyer ba red/ 'grim 'grul thad rdzong dang / shang gi gzhung lam gyi rtsig rmang chus khyer grangs 672dang / lam khyer grangs 418 gzhung lam gyi zam pa grangs 383 lam 'og gi chu lam grangs 399bcas chus khyer ba red/ mang tshogs kyi thon skyed dang 'tsho ba'i thad sa khul yongs nas gzhis rtse dang / lha rtse/ bzhad mthong smon/ rin spungs/ ngam ring / sa skya/ rgyal rtse/ pa snam/rnam gling / khang dmar/ sa dga'/ gting skyes/ gam pa/ ding ri/gnya' nang bcas rdzong dang grong khyer bco lngar gnod 'tshe tshabs che tsam phog cing khyon bsdoms mi shi grangs 38dang / mang tshogs them grangs 3513dang mi grangs 19790tsam la gnod 'tshe phoban nas khang pa rdib grangs 1332dang / nyen kha bzos pa'i khang mig grangs 6344zin yod/ gnod 'tshe phog pa'i spyi'i rgya khyon spyi khre gru bzhi ma 137075yod pa'i nang shang dang grong rdal grangs 138kyi grong tsho 1084la them grangs 10397dang / mi grangs 56715yod pa de dag la za 'bru mi 'dang ba dang / them grangs 5035dang /mi grangs 25939la gyon chas dang nyal chas mi 'dang ba sogs mang tshogs kyi 'tsho ba'i thad la gyong gun tshabs chen bzos pa red/gsar spel chen po gsum gyi 'dzugs skrun rnam grangs thad/ rnam grangs sa khongs su sa zhing mu'u 10738dang / nags tshal mu'u 7034 5 rtswa ra mu'u 9298bcas chus khyer ba red/ gnod 'tshe phog 33

pa'i rnam grangs 39 nang gtsang chu'i las grwa'i rnam grangs khag 10 dbul skyor gyi rnam grangs 17bcas tshud yod/ gong gsal rnam grangs de dag gi nang chu log dang / zhod skyon/ snyi rdol bcas kyis bzos pa'i thad ka'i dpal 'byor gyong gun sgor khri 28846 84zin yod pa red/ gong gsal sa khul gang sa gang la chu log dang zhod skyon kyi gnod 'tshe tshabs chen byung rjes sa ud dang / srid 'dzin kung hru'u/ gzhan yang 'brel yod sde tshan bcas kyis thugs 'khur che bzhes 'og sngon la gegs 'gog gegs sel gyi las don nang las byed las bzo dang / mang tshogs/ bca' sdod dpung sde/ nyen rtog dpon dmag bcas gnod sel ngal rtsol nang zhugs pa khyon bsdoms mi grangs khri 300lhag tsam zin gyi yod pa dang / sa sa/nas rim pa'i 'go khrid kyisagatso 'gan bzhes te gnod 'tshe phog tshabs che shos kyi sa khul du gnod sel ched du las don tshogs chung khag lnga btang ste gnod 'tshe'i gyong gun ji byung dang / zhib phra'i 'gro gron rtsis rgyag byas te khyim gzhis gsar 'dzugs dang / 'grim 'grul/ chu bed/ sa zhing / glog khang bcas bskyar gso'i las don nang rang sa gnas la nor shugs kyi dka' ngal chen po yod pa'i gnas tshul 'og sa gnas nas sgor khri 200tsam 'don sprod dang / sa khul yongs kyi las byed las bzo dang / las rigs khag gi mi sna/ mang tshogs bcas kyis zhal 'debs dngul dang dngos po dngul bsgyur byas na sgor khri 70lhag tsam zin gyi yod/ lhag par ljongs tang ud dang / srid gzhung gi shugs che'i rgyab skyor 'og ljongs dmangs srid thing nas khyim gzhis gsar 'dzugs ched snga rjes su sgor khri 263lhag tsam gnang ba rnams dus thog tu khyim gzhis gsar 'dzugs sogs gnod sel nang bed spyod byas par brten kha tsha dgos gtug gi dka' ngal sel yod pas/ gnod 'tshe phog khul gyi mi dmangs la dro skyid zab mo thob pa dang / de 'brel rang byung gnod 'tshe'i 34

gnas tshul nang mdog gzhung gtsang 'gram du bod rigs gzhon nu las byed pa'i mig dpe bzang po ngag rdor dang / nor bu tshe ring gnyis nas kyang rgyal khab kyitsho rgyu nor dang / mi dmangs kyi khe phan/ — 'thab grogs kyi bde 'jags srung skyob byed phyir gzi brjid ldan pa'i ngang rang srog dor nus kyi dpa' bo'i mtshan snyan yongs su grags pa'i byas rjes bzhag yod pa red/gong gsal rang byung gnod 'tshe'i lo rgyus la nga tshos bsdoms tshig bzhag na/ nye rabs lo rgyus thog stod gtsang rdzong gzhis khag gi sa khul mang po zhig la gzhi khyon che ba'i rang byung gnod 'tshe zhing 'brog mi ser gyi bde rtsar tshabs che'i god chags rim byung skabs kyi gnas tshul la bltos na da res rī'adi lta bu'i tshabs che'i gnod 'tshe phog yul mi dmangs rnams yul gzhis chags rten dang bral te yul gru mang po mi shi khyim stong dang yang na yul gyar 'gro rgyu las ma 'das kyang / da cha ni gung khran tang gi yang dag dbu khrid yod pa dang / spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi khyad 'phags stobs shugs 'og skabs 'phra' so sor rim pa khag gi tang ud dang / srid gzhung nas thugs 'khur che bzhes kyis gegs 'gog gegs sel byed thabs rab dang rim pa bton gnang thog gnod 'tshe phog yul nyam thag mi dmangs kyi bde rtsar rgyal khab smos ci/ spyi tshogs skul slong gis zas gos sdod gsum thag gcod rang bzhin ldan pa'i nad thog sman 'khel gyi skyob gso'i rogs ram shugs che gnang yod pas nyam thag mi ser ltogs grir shi ba dang / yul gyar 'gro dgos sogs kyi gnas/ tshul thon rigs gtan nas med par 'gyel sa nas langs thub pa'i dpe ltar byung yod/ 'di dag ni gung khran tang gi mkhas mdzangs srid jus dang spyi tshogs ring lugs lam lugs kyi khyad 'phags las byung ba nyag cig yin pa ni chig dgu nga bruzhi lo'i rgyal rtse nye ru'i chu skyon tshabs chen de lta bu byung ba'i gnas tshul thog nas kyang gsal po mtshon thub/ dper na/ ma gzhi 35

skabs der de snga'i bod sa sa/nas srid gzhung gnas yod stabs 'tsho zhib do dam zer ba bsko sazhag dang 'brel rgud skyo ba ma thun rkyen 'bru ru'i khal brgyad khri tham pa 'don sprod byas yod kyang / de dag gis ral pa lhan pas khebar+sā tshod gtan nas med gshis skabs der krung gung bod las don u yon lhan /lang nas thugs 'gan rkang bzhes kyis krung dbyang nas gong gsal gnod sel mthun rkyen dngul dang dngos po za 'bru bcas khyon che gsol ras stsal ba dang / rgyal rtser bca' sdod mi dmangs srid gzhung gi las byed las bzo dang / mi da mangs bcings 'grol dmag mis kyang rang nyid la'ang thad kar chu log gi nyen kha 'phrad pa'i gnas tshul la ma ltos par chus khyer mang tshogs kyi tshe srog rgyu dngos srung skyob la bla na med pa'i rgyab skyor gnang yod pa lta bu red/ gong gsal rdzong khag la bar lam gnod 'tshe 'dra min rim byung nang rang skyong ljongs dang sa gnasarutang srid las khungs/ de bzhin rang rang gi sde tshan/ spyi tshogs phyogs yongs bcas nas 'phral 'phral gegs 'gog gegs sel byas stabs zhing 'brog thon skyed slar gso dang mi dmangs kyi zas gos sdod gsum gyi dka' ngal thag gcod thub rgyur rgyab skyor nus ldan byung yod pa bcas so/36

lho kha spyi khrab rim byung gi lo rgyus rag sa rim/lho kha sa gnasasrid gros lo rgyus 'tshol bsdu tshogs chung nas/lhospyi dang po/lho spyi dang po par khang ye shes thub bstan ni yar mda' se'u lho ma nas yin cing / sne gdong rtse tshogs pa'i dgon du grwa pa byas/ rtse tshos/sa pa dgon nas rtse slob grwar grwa 'phyags gtong srol yod pas rtse slob grwar zhugs/ de nas gzhung zhabs zhus/ snga rting du nyag rong spyi khyab dang / rgyal tshab kun gling rta tshag rtse drung ngag dbang dpal ldan gyi sne mgron byas/ rta tshag sku gshegs rjes k+shi/nga ljoribrug (1904)lo dbyin 'gog las byar rgyal rtser bskyod/ shing 'brug g.yul 'gyed la pham nyes byung ba'i dza drag che skabs de sngon nyag spyi byed dus khrid yong ba'i mdun g.yog khams pa a rdis zer ba des khong la lwa ba dkar po'i gyon pa g.yogs/ bzhon rta sga med la bskyon te bros btang bas dmag sa nas bros thar stabs phyis mdun g.yog a rdi la mthong chen byed kyi yod pa red/ye shes thub bstan las zhabs chabs cig dgongs zhu byas nas gzhis dgom rtse tshogs dgon du bskyod pa dang / de rjes yar mda' nor 'phrod bu cho/ dbang mo dang gnyen sgrig byas/ 1909lo tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pas gdeng 'jog chen po gnang ste zhabs zur mtshan gnas thog dmigs bsal gyis lho spyi bsko gzhag mdzad thog lho kha spyi khyab pa'i mnga' 'og tu lho 37

kha sne gdong dang / 'phyongs rgyas/ lhun rtse/ seng ge rdzong / do ba rdzong /mtsho sna/ gong dkar/ sna dkar rtse/ bsam yas/ 'or+ṣa/ kha/ rgya tsha/ sku rnam bcas kyi rdzong khag rnam pa dang / dar ma gzhis sdod dang / lha khang gzhis sdod// grwa phyi gzhis sdod/ grwa nang gzhis sdod/ 'on gzhis sdod/ snang gzhis sdod/ skyems stong gzhis sdod/ dol gzhis sdod/ zangs ri gzhis sdod/ gri gu gzhis sdod/ rgya ri mdzod pa bcas yod pa de rnams kyi gnad don gal che'i rigs kyang bka' shag tu snyan seng zhu ma dgos par stabs bde yong ched lho spyi nas 'os 'gan thag gcod byed 'thus ma zad/ lho khul gyi dgon sde che chung tshang ma'i 'dul khrims slob gnyer sogs nyams pa sor chud yong phyir dgon sde'i spyi 'doms kyang byed dgos bcas kyi 'gan dbang yang stsar+ṣa// khong gis lho spyi'i las 'gan bzhes nyid lho khul dgon sde khag gi las sne dang / gong gsal khyab khongs rdzong gzhis tshang ma'i rdzong ngo ma re dang /dgon sde khag gi bla ma las sne/ mi ser gyi gtso rgan spyi 'thus/ nye 'khor yar klung phu mda' bar gsum gyi them re mi resgrobacas ched bskongs kyis dang thog lho kha spyi khyab gsar du bsko gzhag mdzad dgos don skor dang / de nas bod rje chos rgyal gong ma'i bzhed srol bzang po lha chos dge ba bcu dang / mi chos gtsang ma bcu drug gi rtsa ba dang 'grel bshad bcas khyab bsgrags dang 'brel ‘‘da nas nga rang the ba'i rdzong gzhis sne mo ba mtha' dag nas khrims kyi rtsa 'dzin tshul bzhin srungs dgos pa dang / lha sde mi sde tshang mas rtsa ba'i khrims srol de las mi 'gal phyin tshang ma bde bar gnas chog ’’pa'i dril bsgrags/ skabs der lho spyir lag rtsa dang / phogs thob/ sdod khang / rta thab sogs med pa ma zad/ mdor na yig 'bri yang sne gdong rdzong gi las drung nas gcis/ lcogs byas yod la phyis kyang de ltar gnas/ lho spyi ye shes thub bstan nas mi drag 'byor ldan nyes 'dzol byung rigs 38

la yang lus steng gi nyes chad gcod pa dang / dbul phongs la lam bzo dang /zam bzo sogs nyes chad gcod kyi yod pa/ khong ni khrims lugs lag bstar byed phyogs thog nan zhing / mchog dman bar pa mtha' dag la ngo srung med par drang gzhag gis gnon 'doms byed kyi yod pa dper na/ de snga khong gi gnas tshul dngos mthong thos yod mkhan da bzhugs sne gdong rtse tshogs dgon pa'i grwa pa rang lo 86la son pa zhang po skal bzang gis gsung gsal ltar na/ de snga gri gu gzhis sdod shod drung zhig gis mi ser thog khral 'phar brdab gsig ha cang chen po btang rkyen mi ser rnams nas rdog rtsa gcig sgril gyis lho spyir bde sdug snyan zhu zhus ma thag gnad don la zhib 'jug nan tan byas thog ‘‘gzhung zhabs mi grags can zhig nas sger don kho na'i byed 'dzol de rigs ni gnas dbyung gtong rgyu las 'os med pa'i ’’skor lha sar snyan zhu gnang bas phyir phebs dgongs don ltar shod drung de'i spa lcog lho spyi'i las khang du bkrol te las zhabs chabs cig gnas dbyung thag gcod byas/ de bzhin sbyar gsang sngags chos gling bla brang gi phyag mdzod nas kun bzang rtse dang nye po yod pa'i ltag shed la brten nas tshul min ngan rgol byed bzhin thog thengs gcig phyag mdzod kho pa lha sa nas phyir log grwa phyir zhag sdod skabs rta drel rnams mi ser gyi lo tog yod pa'i zhing nang glod stabs mi ser byed thabs bral nas lho spyir snyan seng zhu bar phyin pa dang / lho spyis gnad don rtsad zhib dang 'brel gyod don bdag sprod kyis gsang bla'i phyag mdzod sne gdong du 'byor 'phral gnas tshang ra sprod thog rta drel rnams sne gdong rta zam la rtsis sprod byas rjes gyod ya gsang bla'i phyag mdzod ched bkug zhu tho blangs mthar mi ser 'khyer dman gyi khral bun 'jal rten dang za rten gyi sa zhing thog rang snang gang shar du rta drel btang ba shin tu ma 'os pas nyes don la gzhigs te lus steng nyes chad gtong rgyu'i bka' dpyad btang / de skabs sne gdong rdzong dang 39

las drung chu 'og sogs nas u nan zhus ngor gsang phyag la lus steng nyes chad ma dgos tsam byung yang / lo thog la gnod skyon ji byung mi ser spyi 'thus kyi sa nas son tho blangs te son 'gro'i thon 'bab gzhir bzung dngul sgyur 'gel bkod kyis dngul 'a bab rnams mi ser zhing bdag so so'isgyulag tu sprad stabs mi ser tshos ‘‘lo re'i thon 'bab las yag pa byung ’’zhes brjod de dga' spro chen po byung yod/ skabs der gang sar brjod srol la lho spyis nyes can ko bstum brgyab ma/sa chu la dbyug pa dang / sna tha tha mag 'then na sna dang / rna gshog bregs te skud par brgyud nas khrom tshogs che sar bkram pa ’’zer ba'am ‘‘lho spyis mi za gi yod pa zhe sa zer yang khong gi khyim gzhis kyang gzhung rgyugs khral pa spyir btang zhig yin pa dang / rjes sor lho spyi byas kyang khyim gzhis la yar rgyas kyi 'gyur ldog gang yang byung med la khong gi sku mched kyi bu mo'i mag par sne gdong chu 'og gi bong rdzi 'gyur med tshe brtan gyi bu nor bu phun tshogs dbu tshugs kyis slong nas bza' pha'i 'gan dbang yang sprad/khong gis mi ser nyams dman gyi bde sdug 'tsho tshis la sems khur chen po byed kyang / phyi'i ltar snang du khrims kyi 'jigs zil chen po mngon par byed kyi yod gshis don dngos thos/ khong gi khrims gnon bya thabs ni/ dper na/ska/bas shig ring yar klung phu mda' bar gsum la rkun bus mi bsad 'phrog bcoms byas te yul lung bde bar ma 'khod nga/ra mi rnams chom rkun gyi 'jigs skrag che tsam byung zhing / rkun bu'i shog kha mang dag yod pa'i nang nas ming can gte po dkom/ cog zer ba sogs yod pa lho spyis shes 'phral rto ga zhib nan tan byas rjes yar klung khe smad gling ga dang / mab/ ra thog sras khang / yar stod brag la sogs la yod pa'i rkun bu rnams gcig kyang ma lus pa 'dzin bzung gis nyes tshabs la gzhigs pa'i thag gcod byas shing / nyes can gte po dkon cog zer ba rkun po'i 'go gtso yin pa ra 'phrod par brten 40

lho spyis sne gdong khul gyi gzim pa'i lding dpon dang / sne gdong rdzong gi gad pa sogs rtse tshogs pa dgon pa'i gzhung sgo'i phyir bkug thog ‘‘nyes can dkon cog khyod rang da phan mi bsad rgyu 'phrog gi byas nyes ha cang tshabs che bas de mur bzhag kyang khyod nas lam nor ldog shes yong re bral bas de ring nas brtsis pa'i nyin bdun song mtshams khyod rang ko btums brgyab nas gtsang chur dbyugs rgyu yin zhing / de'i bar spyan ras gzigs la gsol ba btab nas ma ṇi hur thag bgrang dgos/ sne rdzong nas khyod la lho chas yag po sprod du bcug chog ’’ces dang / sne gdong bshas pa tshe ring nas g.ya ga ko rlon pa gra sgrig byed dgos pa dang / gzim pa'i lding dpon nas nya mgor nges can 'di pa khrid 'gro skabs mar lam mi dmangs tsho nyes khrims la ltad mo lta bar yong ched zangs dung gtong mkhan gnyis gra sgrig byed dgos la ga ler khrid dgos/ sne rdzong khang gad nas kho pa btang shor med pa dgos rgyu ’’zhes khrims bsgrags byas/ btson srung nas brjod gsal ‘‘skabs der nyin gnyis gsum nang dkon cog la dngangs skrags cher mi 'dug kyang / de nas nyin lnga pa'i skabs ma ṇi mang po 'dren bzhin 'dug de nas nyin drug 'gro skabs lto la snang ba med pa dang / skad cha bshad kyang lan mi 'debs pa/ mig 'bur tshugasartsosu bltas nas skad chen pos ma ṇi kho na 'dren bzhin 'dug ’’ces zer skad dang / nyin bdun song nyin sne gdong rdzong gad pas kho'i lag pa rgyab tu bkyig cing / bshas pas g.yag ko rlon pa khyer te zangs dung gtong bzhin khrid 'gro skabs nyes can dkon cog nas mig phar lta tshur lta mi byed par lam la'ang skad chen pos ma ṇi bgrangs nas smyon pa'i gomyo/ stabs ltar 'gro bzhin yod pa dang / de nyin sne gdong rdzong 'og sger rag rtsib pa'i gzhis bzhugs dang lho spyi nang gros byas nas sngon gtan 'khel ba lhor nyes can dkon cog srog skyo bas zhu bar yong ste nyes can kho pas phyin chad tshul mthun bya rgyu'i 'gan 41

len rag rtsib pas zhus lugs kyi gnas tshul dang sbrags rag rtsib pa'i g.yog po ched btang gis nyes can kho pa phyir 'bod du btang ba nya mgo gru sa'i ltag tsam nas rjes zin te phyir log khrid yong na'ang dkon cog ni da dung yid ches med par ma ṇi kho na 'dren bzhin yong yod pa dang / de nas lho spyi'i sar 'byor skabs lho spyis ‘‘dkon cog la khyed rang nyes tshabs che bas chu la dbyug rgyu kho na yin rung / rag rtsib pas zhu ngo che bar brten srog nyes ma dgos pa byas shing / da nas khyod rang rag rtsib par rtsis sprod byas zin pas phyin chad tshul mthun 'gro bzo sdod mkhas bya rgyu'i skor rag rtsib pas 'gan len gan 'bul zhus pa ltar blang dor 'dzol med byed dgos ’’zhes pa'i bkod khyab btang ste rag rtsib par rtsis sprod byas/ rab/ rtsib pas kho nga/ dkon cog kho tsho'i rta g.yog le bkod sgrig byas nyin nas bzung dkon cog gis tshe gang ring rag rtsib par lhag bsam rnam dag byas nas tshe mjug bskyal yod pa red/yang lha sa nas mi gsod nyes can gcig lhun rtse rdzong khongs sgron dbang bskur gzhis su skyel sgrol a drung la lam yig nang gsal rta 'ul gcig dang /btson par bzhon pa gcig (bong glang la zer )bcas gsal yang / a drung gis btson par yang bsam yas nas sgron bar rta 'ul bskul ba lho spyis mkhyen nas sne gdong rta zam la a drung phyir 'byor skabs snyan seng dgos pa'i bka' btang don/ a drung 'byor nyin rta zam gyis lam yig blangs nas lho spyir phul/a drung nas rta zam la rta 'ul khrid shog brjod par lam yig lho spyis bzhes song zhes brjod par a drung nas lam yeg phyir stsol yong ba zhu bcar skabs lho spyis a drung la 'dri bcod zhib (rajug byas rjes ‘‘'gal 'dzol byed babs la gzhigs pa'i sne gdong grong dkyil nas gong po rir phyag brgya tham pa 'tshal dgos pa dang / de nas sne gdong zam pa ma sgrol bar rta sgro rgyab tu bskur/er kha ske la g.yogs te sne gdong gzim pas zangs dung gtong gin ngang skyel 42

grol dang 'brel de nas bde chen bar rta 'ul bskul mi chog phyin chad de rigs mi chog ’’ces bka' nan gyis thag gcod bcas byasari yod pa red/yang dper na/ bya sa lha khang dkon gnyer yar klung bkra shis chos sde'i grwa pa bya sa nang nub skal bzang stobs chen dang / dgon gsar bsam sding dgon pa'i a ne byams pa chos nyid gab mthun byas pa'i gnas tshul thon skor de ni ‘‘dam nyams kha sbyor ’ zhes pa'i sdig nyes khar khong gnyis gnyen mtshan yang 'gro bar brten kho gnyis kha sbyor gyis mnyam du ko btums brgyab nas chu la dbyug rgyu yin tshul du phyi gyar khrims thag bcad de nang don lho spyis sne gdong las drung chu 'og skal bzang rdo rje dang / bde skyid khang gsar jo lags dang mol te ‘‘khong gnyis nas srog thog gi nyes chad zhu ma dgos pa mthar nan zhus ngor srog khrims yang pa yin ’’lugs bsgrags thog shel brag pad khang nas bla brang dbu rtse bar gyi lam bzo'i nyes chad btang ba/ de yang sa cha bgo bsha' brgyab ste do bdag gnyis mi ngo rang nas lam bzo byed dgos pa las gzhan glas mi chog pa'i khrims thag bcad pa sogs lta bu dang / yang lho spyi ye shes thub bstan nas lho khul mi ser 'khyer dman rnams la bun zhib byas shing / chos rgyun bun chad rnams nyes dngul thog nas lho spyi rang gis sel gang thub byas pa dang / de min sger gyi bun chad yod pa rnams rta lcag phran bu re gzhus te dag par byas/ rta lcag gzhu mkhan la ‘‘mi ser 'khyer dman thabs zad bun chad bsdad pa yin gshis rta lcag tsha po btang mi chog ’’ces zur du bkod khyab kyang byas skad 'dug yang dper na/ 'phyongs rgyas rdzongagi sngar srol la bskul tham skyel rgyu dang rta thab g.yog bcas 'khri khungs khral pa sgo dud lnga nas sgrub dgos pa dang / gal te 'phar bskul dgos na gla cha sprod dgos pa rtsa tshig tu gsal yang 'phyongs rdzong shod drung sgo yangs pa'i skabs gla med 'phar bskul byas pa ma zad/ 'brog pa cong tsho dang / sgo dud/43

brag rtsa khe ru bcas nas snga lam 'phyongs rdzong la bal 'jam zhes snam bu rgyugs ljoridoms stong phrag bskyel dgos thad (snam bu spus zhan sang ras lta bu yin )rdzong 'di pas gla lto gang yang med par bal las byed mi 'phar bskul thogagong gsal snam bu bshigs nas snam bu spus legs 'thag skyor byed du bcug pa dang / rta khal gtong phyogs thad sngar lam thag nye 'brel mtshungs dang khral pa che khag nas btang ste zla drug rtsis rgyag skabs rta khal 'khri khungs nas gla cha sprod len byed srol yod na'ang / rdzong sgo yangs pas ‘‘rta ngo gtong ma byas par gla cha len pa 'os min red ’’ces skabs de'i las drung nam mkha' zhol ngag dbang bstan 'dzin la rta lcag gtong rtsis byed skabs 'phyongs rgyas ri bde'i las snes zhu brgyud byas pas lus steng nyes chad ma phog tsam byung yod/ rdzong tre/sa rnam kun mi ser thog 'phar brdab che khar las drung la don med 'khon 'dzin bzos par brten las drung nas lho spyis snyan seng zhu rtsis yod skor gtso drag ri bde zhol khang dang / 'bum thang / chang khyim lkog grong khang gnyer bcas la mol bsdur byas pa gcig mthun byung don lho spyi'i sar 'phyongs rdzong gi yong rkyen rnams snyan seng zhus par lho spyis 'phyongs rdzong ched 'gugs kyis nyes chad chen po btang bas skabs der 'phyongs rgyas khul du bshad srol la ‘‘'phyongs rgyas nas byung ba sne gdong la bskyal ririzhes pa'i brjod tshul yang byung 'dugachu byi rgya bod nang zing skabs rgya dmag khag gcig lho khar 'byor nas rtsed thang lnga mchod grwa tshang gi khang khungs 'gro don khang gsar dang / khra 'brug lnga mchod pho brang / 'phyongs rgyas sras khang bcas la bsdad/ lho spyi rtse tshogs dgon du bzhugs blos bzod min gyis las tham bsnams / khong gi sku mched sne gdong smin skyid pa'i bu mo mthong grol dgon gyi a ne dbu mdzad zer ba zhabs zhur 'khrid nas gsang stabs kyis phu lha mkhar zer ba'i brag phug 44

btsan po zhig zangs ri rdzong rong chus khongs su yod pa der bzhugs nas lu'u cun dmag 'gog thabs dang / las don gang ci de nas gsang thabs kyi yig chung btang nas bkod 'doms gnang yod tshod 'dug lu'u cun dmag lho khul gang sar 'khyams nyul btsan bsnyas byas te nyin gcig rtse tshogs dgon du dge 'dun pa tshogs 'tshog bzhin pa'i skabs su dmag mi khag gcig yong nas dgon pa'i bzhengs brda rnga chen phab ste tshogs gzhung du yar mar drud pa dang / tha mag 'then pa'i du ba dge 'dun pa'i ngo la phu rgyag pa sogs ci ngan gang sdug byas/ tshob/sa gzhung rang du lho spyi gar song rtsad gcod byas kyang su la'ang shod rgyu med stabs dge bskos la gdan 'phar yod pas 'go khrid yin par ngos 'dzin gyis dge bskos byang chub tshul khrims 'dzin bzung thog lho spyi gar yod 'dri rtsad nan po zur du byas kyang shod rgyu med/ rtse tshogs las sne nas dge bskos glod bkrol dgos pa'i zhu gsol rim byas mthar dge bskos rgya mar btegaṭaṭa pa'i ljid tshad ji yod ltar dngul ṭam dkar 'jal dgos pa'i nyes bcad bsgrub dgos byung / dmag mi de gras kyis 'byor ldan khag nas za 'bru dang / mi ser 'khyer dman nas bya phag gzan shing yan btsan 'phrog byas pas khul der bya phag ha lam rdzogs la nye bar thug lha sar dmag 'khrug gi gtor skyon mi 'byung ched lho khar yod pa'i lu'u cun dmag bkag sdom byas na lho khul yod pa'i lu'u cun dmag lho khar kha phyogs sgyur re'i ched lho khul 'don dmag cha gses dang dgon sde khag nas ser dmag bsdu bskong byas pa dper na/ rtse tshogs dgon nas grwa pa 30 sban tshang nas grwa pa 10de bzhin dgon sde che chung la gzhigs pa'i ser dmag bskul/ de min phan stag khul nas bsdus pa'i dmag mi rnams lho khar gnas mjal du 'gro mkhan yin khul gyis bskongs nas bkag sdoms bya rtsis byas pa red/ lu'u cun dmag de dag bi/ nang gong ma'i phyogs gtogs khag gcig dang / sun krung 45

hran gyi phyogs gtogs khag gcig yod 'dug pa sun krung hran phyogs gtogs ma/sa ‘‘gong ma med par bzos zin pa dang / tā la 'i bcu gsum pa phyi rgyal du bros shing / gang ltar gnyis ka mi phal pa red ’’ces 'bo/ da pa'i dril bsgrags sbyar yig bkram par se rwa'i grwa pa dang gong ma'i phyogs gtogs lu'u cun dmag ngan 'brel gyis sbyar yig thog btsog pa byug pa sogs kyi rkyen las phyogs khag gnyis po nang 'khrug yong nyen la brten lho khul yod pa'i rgya dmag rnams phal cher glo bur du lha sar bskyod dgos byung skad 'dug de rjes lho spyi rtse tshogs dgon du phyir log phebs nas lho khul rdzong gzhis so sor bod mda' dang / rdzas/ sbi thi/ zha nye/ gri/ 'ur rdo/ mdung sogs bsdus nas ser dmag gi 'go gtsor rab shar stobs rgyal zer ba dang / ser smad grwa skal bzang / de min rtse tshogs pa'i grwa rdo ring po/ grwa zhang po nag ril/ dpal 'bar/ lnga mchod grwa tsa mun dri ngag dbang bstan dar/ ngag dbang byams pa/ngag dbang dge legs (ming ngan la dom lpags zer ba ) sogs bskos/skabs der ser dmag gi 'go khrid dang dmag dkyus bcas kyi gyon pa ni lā ba dkar po'i phyu pa mtha' la skud mtha' dmar pos brgyan cing / ras dmar po'i gir sgang btang ba/ zhwa mo ar zhwa zhes pa bcas yin/ de skabs dmag khag gcig bye la brgyud lha sar rdzong brda byas pa dang / de min ser dmag khag gcig lho khar bzhag mtshon cha ni mdung dang gri yin zhing / mdung rtser rnga ma bsgar/ mi 'ju bzung sogs phar tshur 'gro skabs zangs dung gtong bzhin bskyod de zil brngam ston gyi yod pa red/ lho khar lu'u cun dmag sdod skabs sngon yod rgya rigs skya pa'o dang / mig lug sbo lo'o/ phru gu dge slong zer ba bcas nas rgya dmag dang ngan 'brel byas pa ma zad/ mi ser sa zhing thos/ rta drel gang byung gis gtong rkyang byas pa sogs tshul min bya spyod tshad med byas par brten lho spyis ser dmag bskul te 'dzin bzung thog mtshan mo zhig 46
