tu sne gdong zam steng du srog thog btang ba'i rkang lag zam pa'i g.yas g.yon du bkal nas nyin shas bzhag skad 'dug ko ko gul lan zer ba dang sne gdong rab shar ba'i khongs mi gcig ngan 'brel gyis lho khul nas lu'u cun dmag 'gog thabs gra sgrig byed pa sogs kyi gsang gnas lha sar bskyel bar phyin rkyen lho spyis ser dmag dang 'don dmag bskul slong gis khong gnyis 'dzin bzung thog rab shar ba'i mi der rta lcag mang po gzhus thog rkang par tshe lcags brgyab ste mi bdag sne gdong rab shar ba rang la rtsis sprod byas pa dang /rgya rigs ko ko gu9shaṃ lan sne gdong sha rgyab thang du srog thog btang / de min rtsed thang dbang ldan gling gi ko ko yang tung san zer ba yang rgya bod nang 'khrug skabs rgya dmag dang ngan 'brel byas lugs kyis srog nyes gcod rgyu byas na'ang rtsed thang lnga mchod dgon pa'i spyi bso skal bzang lags da nga /mkhyen rab nor bu gnyis kyi zhu ngor srog nyes ma dgos par sne gdong grong sne nas sdong gog gcig hrang zer ba'i bar lam bzo dang / zam pa gsar rgyag bya rgyu'i snyes chad btang / skabs der zam pa'i ming la dbang ldan zam pa zer/ rgya bod nang zing lhod 'jags byung na'ang skabs de'i dus su spyi tshogs thog zhi lhod bde 'jags med pa'i shugs rkyen gyis mang tshogs bag phebs spro snang med stabs mi rnams spro ba 'phel slad du lho spyis rtse tshogs dgon pa'i grwa pa 'demyo/sa sgrug byas nas rtse tshogs dgon pa'i gling kha klu khang lcang gseb nang lha mo dri med kun ldan dang / rgya bza'/ bal bza'/ bro dang 'brong rtsed 'khrab pa sogs nyin 3ring 'khrab ston byas pas mi rnams kyi bsam blo'i 'khyer so 'gyur ldog byung nas sne gdong nye 'khor tsam ma zad yul gru tshang mar glu gzhas dang rnam thar sogs gtong mkhan je mang du song ba'i bshad srol 'dugade rjes chu phag (1923)lo tā la sku phreng bcu gsum pa'i yig chung phebs 47

don ltar khong gis sne gdong chu 'og sogs nas bzhon rta g.yar te lha sar mjal bcar du phebs/ sku phreng bcu gsum pas bzhon rta phyir slog gis lha sar sdod cing bzhon rta nor gling chibs rwa nas bskong 'thus kyi dmigs bsal gzigs skyong gnang skad/ khong lho khar phyir phebs mdzad khar sku phreng bcu gsum pas dad rten du na bza' chos gos bsnams sbyar cha tshang gsol ras stsal bas khong nas sne khul lha sde mi sder na bza'i phebs bsu gzab rgyas zhu dgos pa'i brda yig btang don ltar sne gdong 'du spyis sger pa gru khar ras gur brgyab nas gsol ston stabs bde 'bul bshoms dang 'brel na bza' dang lho spyir mjal dar phul/ na bza'i mjal kha byin rlabs zhus rjes lha sde khag na sa ser sbreng dang bcas lho spyi pazhugs yul rtse tshogs par na bza' gdan drangs pas rjes sor yang rtse tshogs pa'i nang brtan du bzhugs/ de rjes khong bsnyun mnar skabs tā la'i sku phreng bcu gsum pas dmigs bsal gyis rgyal rtse chos rje ched rdzong gnang nas tshe sgrub gnang ba dang chabs cig 'bras ljongs em rje gcig kyang gtong gnang 'dug rung / rtsa ba'i dgung lo mtho tsam yin pas/ shing byi (1924)lor 'das/lho/spyo gnyis pa/ lho spyi gnyis pa blo bzang dbang 'dus/ (ming ngan pho rog lags zer )shing glang (1925)lor lho spyir bskos/ snga lam ltar lho spyi'i sdod gnas rtse tshogs dgon du bsdad pa dang / de rjes sne gdong ka gling byang nub rgyud du rtsed thang lnga mchod grwa tshang gi sa cha'i thog nye 'khor rdzong gzhis khag nas rdo shing dmangs 'ul bskul te spro khang gsar rgyag byas pa der spos/ khong yig gzugs ha cang yag po yod pas gzhung zhabs ser skya'i nang skad grags yod la/ kho rang gi khyad yon brgyud spel ched skabs der nye 'khor 'byor ldan khag 48

gi bu phrug 30skor slob grwar nyar/ chu bya (1933)lo lhun rtse rdzong 'og sger zhag pa'i 'dzin khongs tsha gur gzhis zer ba dgon pa zhig la chos thebs su stsal tshab tu lhun rtse rdzong 'og sbyar gzhung rgyugs gzhis rab/ che khong / brag srib/skyid stod/ phu 'brog bya rab bcas lding drug sger zhag pa'i 'don khongs su zhusasnal bzhin sa khang mi gsum rtsis sprod byed par lho spyi'i ngo tshab sne rdzong las drung chu 'og skal bzang rdo rje ched btang gis sger zhag pa'i go mag tshe dpag la rtsis sprod zin nas lho spyi'i ngo tshab phyir log tshe dpag stang rtse shar pa zhes par bsdad/ skabs der sbyar khral mi 'go dmangs rnams nas nga tsho mi rabs mang po'i gzhung rgyugs mi ser sger khongs su gcig thog nyis brtsegs kyi zhabs radegs 'grub re bral bas bka' shag tu bde sdug zhu rgyu las 'os med ces pa'i gros bsdur byed skabs 'bum tsher lding dpon chos dar dang /zhol gsar zhal ngo rnam rgyal mgon po zer ba gnyis kyis ‘‘ri mgo skam po gtor ba las/ mi mgo rlon pa bcad pa dga' ’’zhes bshad par tshang ma blo mos byung ste tshe dpag gsod thabs bya rgyur thag bcad/ gsod thabs skor nang gros kyis tshe dpag zhag gzhis su phyir log byed skabs dang bstun nas sa 'gag cig tu sgug ra sprod rgyur thag bcad don ltar/ mi ring bar tshe dpag dang g.yog pad+ma sogs dpon g.yog lnga tsam zhag gzhis su phyir log skabs sbyar mi ser nas sngon gtan 'khel ba'i bya thabs bzung ste phu 'brog rdo phog blo chen dang / 'bum tsher tshe ring dpal 'byor zer ba khas len pa gnyis nas 'bur kharibur thim zhes pa'i phrang dog po zhig yod pa der sgug sdod kyis tshe dpag ngo g.yog gdong thub mtshams ‘‘ga le phebs shog ’’ces 'dri mol gtong khul gyimusdo de ma thag tshe dpag rta thog nas phab pa dang chabs cig rgyug brdung kho nas smungs rgyu med pa bzos/ g.yog pad+ma zer bas 'phrul mda' gcig rgyab 'dug rung kha gtad phyogs la skyon gnod thub med/ me mda' gnyis pa 49

rgyag rtsis byed skabs me mda' kha 'byar nas bya thabs zad de g.yog po rnams bros/ tshe dpag sa cha de rang du bsad/ phung po g.yang skyur btang nas mi ser rnams snying nad sangs pa'i las 'gan 'grub song zer ba'i gtam gleng byung / de nas lam seng lding dpon chos dar dang / rnam rgyal/ rdo khog blo chen/ tshe ring dpal 'byon bcas bka' shag la snyan 'bul zhu bar bskyod skabs khra 'brug zhag sar slebs nyin zhag pa'i g.yog mgon pos rjes snyegs yong nas lho spyir snyan seng zhus 'phral gra nang don grub rab brtan dpal 'byor lho spyi'i sa/ma du bcar ba'i dus 'khel te lho spyi'i ngo tshab tu mngags gtong dang sbrags rdzong gad sogs mi hrag bcu grangs skor khra 'brug tu slebs nyin lho spyi'i ngo tshab dpal 'byor gyis sbyar mi ser spyi 'thus rnams snga 'phros lho spyi'i las khang du bcar dgos zhes bshad/ sbyar 'thus rnams gnas mal gyi sgo nas don rim bzhin bzung ste lho spyis sne gdong khral pa che gras dang rtse tshogs dgon pa'i gnyer tshang bcas la khag bgos kyis rtsis sprod 'gan dkri byas/ de nas rim bzhin re re byas te lus steng du rta lcag gi khrims gcod btang 'og 'bum 'tsher chos dar rkang pa gum/ de min khas len pa gnyis po rta lcag btang nas khrims 'og tu bsad/ sbyar mi ser sdug nad bzod thabs bral stabs slar yang 'thus mi dkyil sdod skar ma sogs gsang thabs kyis lha sar bskyod de snyan 'bul zhu nye'i mtshams zhag pa'i nye 'brel yig tshang gnyer pas g.yo thabs kyes 'thus mi rnams la 'jam bshad blo 'gugs bya rgyu'i bya thabs shig btsal brnyed byung ste nang mol bya rgyu yin lugs dang / khyod tsho'i bde sdug zhus gsal ltar lho spyis thag gcod gnang dgos pa'i skor 'di nas lho spyir zhib phra'i yi ge kha gsal 'bul rgyu yod pas khyod tsho phyir log byas te lho spyir zhabs skul zhus na 'grig ces bshad par/ mi ser spyi 'thus rnams g.yo 'og tu tshud de gzhung ko brgyud lho spyi'i sar phyir log gis ngo bcar skabs ‘‘nga 50

zin spu 'thog ’’ces pa'i dpe ltar re re bzhin 'dzin bzung byas/ (yig tshang gnyer pas zhag par ngan skyor de 'dra byed dgos don ni/ zhag pa'i mi ngo chibs cheri bza' zla rig 'dzin chos nyid dang lkog 'brel byed mus yin 'dug) slar yang bsam yul las 'das pa'i gnas tshul de dag sbyar mi ser gyi rna bar thos 'phral bzod thabs bral te yang bskyar bka' shag tu thengs gsum pa'i bde sdug zhu mkhan spyi 'thus don dngos rgya mtsho sogs gra nang brgyud lha sar gsang thabs kyis bgrod thabs byas nas skabs der spyan bsal kun 'phel lags grwa bzhi glog 'phrul khang du 'gro ba'i dus dang bstun nas 'thus mi rnams bye rag nang bsgugs te bde sdug snyan zhu gdong 'bul zhus par brten zhib sa lha sar spo thub pa tsam byung yod rung mi ser la bden don yod kyang brgyab rtsa med stabs sger zhag pa'i 'og tu khral khrims 'khur ma dgos tsam byung ba las de min don 'bras gang yang byung med/ don rkyen de'i ched du 'gro gron gtong rgyur gsang gling bla brang nang dngul 'bor chen g.yar ba'i ngo skyed sbyar mi ser lding drug gi mi mgor cha gses byas pa'i dngul bun lo mang 'jal sprod thub med pa red/yang lho spyi ngo ma lho brag khul du ser zhib (dgon sde'i 'dul khrims sogs zhib bsher )tu bskyod par lho brag lha lung dgon pa'i grwa pa mi nyung ba zhig gis bar skabs grong 'khyam gyis bud med dang 'brel ba byas pa'i gnas tshul mang tsam byung yod par brten dgon pa'i las snes dgong dro grwa pa tshang bsher gyis gzhung sgor sgo lcags brgyab pa sogs do dam gang yong byas rung /dgon pa'i lcags ri'i steng mchod rten chung ngus bskor nas yod stabs grwa pas mchod rten la thag pa bkon te thag shur btang nas 'khyams 'chal mu mthud byas mthar dgon pa de dag ser khyim dgon du 'gyur nye'i mtshams lho spyis zhib 'jug gis bslab gtsang min pa'i grwa pa dang / de tsho'i skyes dman 51

la rta lcag btang ste grwa pa rnams sgrig khongs nas phud/ tha na bud med sbrum ma la'ang sa shur drud pa'i nang grod khog bcug ste rta lcag gtong rkyang byas stabs khrims zil gyis gtsang dgon slar gso thub tsam byung ba ma zad/ de min dgon pa gzhan dag la'ang zhib 'jug nan po byas stabs dgon pa'i 'dul khrims la bskyar gso gang mtshams thub pa byung yod/ lho spyi lha lung dgon du zla gcig tsam sdod ring sku 'khor rnams la gsol chas nar 'bul zhu dgos byung bas brdabs gsig kyang che tsam byung / de nas sna dkar rtser skyod skabs yar 'brog stag lung thar gling chos sder de snga chos gzhis gzhis g.yog mi ser med stabs dus bzhi'i so nam grwa pas byed dgos kyi yod/ lho spyis chos gzhis bogs mar gtong rgyu thag gcod byas thog lo re'i bogs 'bru'i thog nas grwa pa rer phogs 'bru khal 16re dang dgon pa'i chu 'khor gyi phyed gla'i thog nas rtsam khal gnyis re sprod rgyu gtan 'bebs byas stabs dge 'dun pa tsho chos kyi byed sgo 'thus tshang bya rgyur 'gan srung byung 'dug yang lho spyis mtsho sna rdzong khongs mkhar stag dgon du ser zhib byas shing / thog ma'i char na dge 'dun bslab skyon yod pa dbye 'byed kyis bslab gtsang bskyar gso gnang rtsis yod 'dug rung / dge 'dun lo na chung gras ma gtogs rgan pa phal cher bslab skyon yod pa ma zad/ 'ga' shas nas bud med grwa shag nang nyar nas sdod pa'ang yod stabs grwa pa de dag la nyes chad btang thog phyin chad de rigs mi chog pa'i gan rgya blangs/ grong drag dmag bskul rgyag par lho khul rdzong gzhis kha shas la lho spyi ngo skyod skabs za sgo chen po byas pa'i bshad srol yod cing /dper na lho brag khul grong drag dmag bskusnyel rgyag stangs thad la mtshon na bod dngul ṭam rdo bcu lon pa'i dpal 'byor yod na grong drag dmag re gtong dgos zhes bshad de de skabs lho spyi'i 'dod blo ma khengs phyin dmag mi'i lag thel rgyag rkyang byed pa dang / khul der thog ma'i char grong drag dmag mi 52

70skor 'gel bkod byas kyang zhu rten 'dod blo tshim pa byung rim bzhin dmag mir 'gro mi dgos pa byas mthar mi grangs 17skor la dmag mi'i lag thel brgyab/ lho spyi lho brag la sdod ring rta g.yog thab g.yog mi ser tsho yang gnas skabs mnyam du 'tsho ba gang legs spyod rgyu byung stabs dmangs khrod du zur za'i bshad srol zhig ste ‘‘da res skyid po e byung lag g.yog tsho/ mchu lto zhag 'tshod rnams la gsol ba thob mi’ces gleng skad 'dug lho spyi 'di nyid shing phag (1935lor 'das/) lhospya gsum pa/lho spyi gsum pa mkhan chung 'jam dbyangs skal bzang shing phag 1935lo mjug tu lho spyi'i las gnas su slebs shing / lho spyi sngon ma'i lam ltar sne gdong rtse tshogs dgon du bsdad/ skabs der lha sa nas rgod la brgyud rtsed thang du dbyin ji sab gcig dang / rogs pa dbyin ji mi gsum/ skad sgyur sger blon chen/ 'bras ljongs pa mi bco lnga bcas 'dug cing / 'bras ljongs pa de tshos 'go snam mtshal kha'i gog rtse gyon 'dug khong rnams la bod sa gnas srid gzhung nas btang ba'i lam yig 'khyer 'byor ltar sdod sgrig bya yul rtsed thang dga' chos kyi chab bzhugs gtong yul sku gsum gling ga'i nang yod kyang / kho rang tsho'i gur phub nas bsdad pa dang / ster blon chen rtsed thang grong dkyil lo gro'i rgan po blo bzang 'jam dbyangs kyi nang du sdod sgrig byas par bsdad/ rtsed thang du nyin gnyis bsdad pa'i dang por rtsed thang gong po ri'i spre'u brag phug la phyin nas phyi nang gang sar par brgyab pa dang / de nas bod la mi dar rjes kyitsho thog ma'i zhing ga yin zhes shod srol gyi sba ras zhing dang / za ram zhing gnyis la par rgyag dgos zer bar mi ser nas phyi rgyal gyi mis par brgyab na sa bcud nyams kyi red zer nas zhing ga ngo ma ma bstan 53

par zhing ga gzhan dag gnyis bstan par par brgyab/ de nas rtsed thang dga' chos dgon pa dang lnga mchod grwa tshang sogs la blta skor du bskyod/ nye 'dabs yul ljongs dang / grong tsho/ khrom rwa sogs la'ang par brgyab/ de'i phyi nyin lho spyi'i sar phyin nas lho spyir lag rtags sa bzhu gcig dang / cog tse'i steng 'jog rgyu'i chu tshod gcig sne rdzong skya ser gnyis la chu tshod che ba re/'tsho dpon gnyis la dbyin sgor sum cu re/ rgan por dbyin sgor bco lnga re bcas sprad 'dug sne gdong 'du spyis bya 'bras brgya tham pa sprad kyang blangs ma song / dbyin ji de tshos ‘‘da lam 'dir yong ba ni nga tshos sde pa gzhung la me mda' dbyin ji sprad pas yong chog pa byung ba las gang byung gi yong ba min ’’zhes bshad/ dbyin ji de tshos skabs der tsa ri'i nang bskyod de dag la shel rir skor ba brgyab pa dang / ri brag dang mtsho/ mtshe'u/ bya/ ri dwags/gcan gzan/ shing 'bras/ me tog sogs la par brgyab/ de nas slar yang rtsed thang du phyir log skabs dwags po rgya tshar slebs nas lha gsol gzhis sdod khongs lcang rwa mkhar thog la bsdad cing / mkhar thog gi ri der rin po che'i gter kha sna tshogs yod pa dang / lhag par dngul chu spyad na 'dzad mtha' med pa 'dug pas 'dzam gling gi dgos mkhor btang yang 'deng pa 'dug ces dang / khong tshos sa cha de nga tsho dbyin jir lo lnga bcu'i ring sprad na nga tshos bzo grwa btsugs te lo lnga bcu song mtshamasku b.ro tha'i da

tshang mar rtog zhib byas nas nor bu ri zhes pa 'dir rin po che'i gter kha mang po 'dug zer nas par brgyab cing ri de'i sgang la sa dkar gyi ri mo bris pa dang / ri de'i sa cha khag gcig la nor bu yod tshod kyis rdo tshugs btsugs pa de dag deng sang yang bsdad yod/ sa cha de ga'i chu 'go tshang ma'i chu la brtag dpyad byas te chu thur srang la 'degs mgyogs byas par gzhigs na nor bu ri'i lho phyogs su chu mig gcig yod pa de'i chu de 'phyongs rgyas khul nas chu bzang shos red ces bshad 'dug lho spyis g.yog po'i gang byas ltar las las don la jus gtogs mi byed pa ma zad/ thengs shig g.yog pos rtse tshogs dgon pa'i sgrig lam la ltos med byed pa dang / rnam kun grong nang chang 'thung brgyab nas 'khyams te sdod kyi yod stabs rtse tshogs sde pa gzhon pa bkra shis phun tshogs zer ba nas g.yog por slob gso btang bas lho spyi'i g.yog po de tsho ma 'dod par lho spyir snyan seng zhus rkyen lho spyis g.yog po'i rgyab langs kyis rtse tshogs sde pas lho spyi'i g.yog por sgrig lam 'gal tshul brjod pa 'os min yin ces bshad thog sde par nyes brdung btang rkyen sde pas yig tshang las khungs su snyan seng zhu mur sku bcar thub bstan kun 'phel dang /lcang can gung gnyis kong po rtse sgang du snga phyir rgyang 'bud btang ba bros byol song bas lho spyis mjug gnon chung skyon yin lugs kyis gang ltar me glang (1937)lo lho spyi phyir 'then byas/lhospya bzhi pa/lho spyi bzhi pa rdar han rgyal mtshan phun tshogs bsam yas ar po'i do dam yin mus thog sa stag (1938)lor lho spyir bsko gzhag byas te rtse tshogs spro khang du bsdad/ skabs der 'jar man bu lnga dang / bu mo gnyis/ sne shan zhol pa bsam mkhar mkhyen rab kun bzang bcas lha sa nas rgod la brgyud 55

rtsed thang du 'byor/ rtsed thang khang byang gling ga'i nang sne gdong 'du khongs kyi sdod sgrig yod kyang kho pa tsho'i nyal khri rkub stegs rang gshoms kyis bsdad pa dang / sne shan ngo g.yog lnga rtsed thang dga' chos khang khungs su bsdad/ rtsed thang du sdod ring gong (mgon )po ri'i spre'u brag phug dang srin mo brag phugakhyung tshang brag phug bcas la 'gro skabs dam can khang gi 'og tsam la mchod rten lnga yod pa'i nang nas mchod rten thog sa gnyis tsam byas pa gser zangs las grub nga4'i chos 'khor bcu gsum dang nyi zla bcas yod pa'i mchod rten zhig yod pa der 'jar man pas 'di'i nang nga tsho'i pha mes kyi sku gdung yod pa red zer nas phyogs bzhi nas par brgyab 'dug bod rigs rgan rabs tshos sngon ma'i shod rgyun la mchod rten de'i gzungs su pha sprel rgan byang chub sems pa'i dbu thod yod zer srol yod pa dang (1960)lor bskyar zhib skabs mchod rten bshigs 'phro de'i nang nas mi zhig gis thod pa zhig 'khyer song zer ba'i gtam tsam las da phan rtsad gcod thub med/ 'jar man pas sger pa dang / za ra'i gling ga nas 'jol mo dang / byi'u/ 'ol pa/ bya rog phru gu sogs bzung nas rlung rtsi'i nang bcugs te mi ser gla glas kyis 'khyer/lho spyi sdod yul rtse tshogs spro khang du 'jar man pa gnyis phyin nas lho spyir lo grangs 'dri smed byas pa dang lho spyis khong gnyis la ‘‘khyed gnyis lo chu nga chung red ’’ces bshad par khong gnyis nas gcig lo nyi shu rtsa lnga dang / gcig lo nyi shu tham pa yin lugs bshad song / paṇa chen shākya shri'i gsung 'bum dgos lugs kyis rtsad gcod byas 'dug kyang mig ston byed mkhan byung mi 'dugayang 'jar man mi gsum grwa nang du song nas grwa nang byams gling mchod rten chen mor zhib 'jug byas nas par brgyab pa dang / dang po bzhengs skabs kyi rgya khyon dang / mtho tshad sogs de bzhin las 'go tshugs nas ma grub bar gyi dus tshod lo rgyus bcas zhib phra 'khod pa'i dpe cha cha tshang yod pa de dag bshu 56

ru bcug ste shog lho brgya lhag tsam byung 'dug pa shog lte rer gla cha bod dngul zho re sprad 'dug dpe cha bsdu mkhan bag gro zer ba da lta'ang (1986)bsdad yod/ lho spyi de lo na mtho bas dus tshod thung ngu las khams ma 'tsho bar lcags 'brug (1940)lor 'das/lhospyi lnga pa/lho spyi lnga pa lo tsā blo bzang 'byung gnas lcags sbrul (1941)lor lho spyi'i las gnas su slebs shing / lho spyi sngon ma ltar rtse tshogs dgon du bsdad/ lho spyi 'di'i dus lho spyi'i khyab khongs rdzong gzhis nyi shu rtsa gsum nas (8/ra po'i dgos dngul dang / las mi'i gla phogs mnyam rub bya rgyu dang / rdzong gzhis thag ring nas las mi ngo gtong mi dgos par nye 'khor rdzong gzhis brgyad sbrel te sne gdong dang / 'phyongs rgyas/ grwa phyi/ grwa nang / dol/ 'on/ bsam yas/ zangs ri bcas nas 'ul mi gtong rgyu byas te lho spyi'i las khang gsar rgyag byas/ de bzhin 'dzin chas cha sgam/ rgya cog sogs kyang gsar bzo byas/ar po'i do dam sne gdong rdzong gtsos byas shing ar po'i 'gro song rtsis rgyag dang phyin chad shag sgor rgyag phyogs skor zhib gros byed par 'brel yod rdzong gzhis tshang ma skong 'gug gnang rogs zhus don ltar lho spyis rdzong gzhis ngo ma re dang / gtso rgan re bcas ched 'gugs kyis sne gdong ban tshang dgon pa'i nor gling zer ba'i nang zhib rtsis byed skabs 'gro song rtsis gsal khyon cher brten rdzong gtso tshang 'dzoms gros tshogs thog nas da phan gyi ar po'i 'gro song khyon che de tsam chab 'bangs mi ser nas zhabs 'degs 'grub re bral bas ar po'i 'gro song srid gzhung rang nas gsol ras yong ba'i snyan zhu phul chog pa zhes lho spyir snyan seng zhus don ltar 'gro song rtsis phra dang sbrags bka' shag la snyan zhu phul ba'i lan du ‘‘las mtshams 'phral du bzhag ste las mi 57

rnams phyir slog bya dgos pa dang / 'gro gron sngon song rjes su dgongs bzhes gnang rgyu min ces phebs don bzhin de rjes lag bkar byas/ shing sprel (1944)lo lho spyi ngo ma nad mnar gyi drel byams thog lha sar bskyod de 'das zhes bshad srol 'dug nye 'khor rdzong gzhis brgyad sbrel gyis lho spyi'i las khang dang 'dzin chas rtsis len skabs lho spyi'i ngo tshab chos mdzad zer ba nas 'dzin chas khag gcig rang mtshams kyis btsongs pa 'os min yin pa'i klan ka byung ste bsam yas rdzong thub bstan legs smon gyis gtso bo byas te lho spyi 'das po'i ngo tshab chos mdzad la rta lcag zhu nye'i skabs sne gdong chu 'og las drung skal bzang rdo rje nas zhu ngo byas pas lus nyes ma dgos tsam byung ba dang /'dzin chas rnams ngo yod ngo dang ngo med tshab sgrig byas nas thag gcod byung 'dugari lhospyi drug pa/lho spyi drug pa mkhan chung thub bstan byang chub shing sprel (1944)lor lho spyir 'byor nas (1949)bar las rgyun lo lnga tsam sdod yun ring rnam kun sgam brling can zhig yin la/ g.yog po'ang don ma go krog krog rigs med/bka' dgongs lho khul gnas rten khag la zhal gser spyan 'byed do dam gnang ba dang / mkhan chen dom po mkhyen rab dbang phyug gis lho khul ser zhib byas te dgon sde khag so sor 'dul khrims srung phyogs skor gan rgya blang pa rnams lho spyir rtsis sprod byas/ lho spyis mjug gnon lag bstar nan po byas pa dang / mi ser thog za bed rdab mnar yang de tsam byung med/ lho spyi gnyis pa nas lnga pa bar gzan shing rta thab g.yog sogs bskul 'ded chog pa'i lag rtsa gtan 'khel med par gang byung gis nye 'khor rdzong gzhis khag nas len rkyang byas par mi ser gyi lab gleng yod mus la brten lho spyi 'dis slad phyin lugs 58

mthun dpyad rgya yong ba'i bka' shag tu snyan 'bul zhus pa'i phyir lan du lho spyi'i gzan shing rnams rdzong gzhis 'brel mtshungs nas bsdu len dgos pa las/ thag ring ri rdo rlung bskyel rigs mi chog ces 'khod don ltar sne gdong rdzong 'og nas gzan pa rgya ma 5000dang / bsam yas rdzong 'og nas shing rgya ma 5000 'on gzhis 'og nas shing rgya ma 5000 'phyongs rgyas rdzong 'og nas lci ba rgya ma 5000bcas 'debs 'bul zhu rgyu dang / thag ring rdzong gzhis nas gzan shing rin pa spyi bsdus nas sprod rgyu bcas gros mthun gtan 'bebs bzos don ltar lag bstar thog gnas/ dgon sde so so'i 'dul khrims dang / yul lung bde 'jags thog la'ang mjug gnon nan po byas pa dper na se ra spyi bso'i mi khongs rkun bu gnyis btson 'jug byas par spyi bso'i mi ser rgan po lha dbang gis spyi bso'i mi rtsa yin phyin 'gal nyes ji ltar byung rung / rgan po rang nas thag gcod chog pa yin gshis/ rkun bu gnyis phyir sprod gnang rogs zhes zhus par lho spyis dga' ldan pho brang gis nga la gnang ba'i 'gan dbang spyod rgyu yin pas/ khrims 'khur mi dgos pa'i gtan tshigs yod na khyer yong dgos/ de ltar med tshe khyod rang yang mnyam du 'dzin bzung bya rgyu yin ces bshad 'dug pas rgan pos chu 'og las drung zhu ngo brgyud mthar spyi bso'i mi rtsa'i rgan po kho par 'dzin bzung ma byas tsam las nyes chad 'os 'tsham btang ba dang / rkun bur lus steng nyes chad nan po bcad de thag gcod byas 'dug de min rkun po mi gsod 'phrog bcom byed mkhan byed gte lag sbrel dang bcas pa khag gcig la khrims gcod nan po byas stabs lho spyi 'di'i dus yul lung bde 'khod dang / lho khul dgon sde khag gi 'dul khrims bsrung rgyur phan nus chen po byung yod/lhospya bdun pa/lho spyi bdun pa mkhan chung thub bstan bzang po sa glang (1949)lor lho 59

spyi'i las gnas su slebs shing / de rjes rgya rigs hre shan san zer ba bod sa gnas sridatshogazhung dang zhi gros byed par byang rgyud nas yong skabs hor tsho'i rdzong khag khongs ar rtsa be sog 'go pa bzhugs yul du slebs par byang spyi mdo mkhar bas las bya shod drung ldan bya sne shan bskos te/ lam yig dang sbrags 'gro yul kha phyogs bsgyur nas lho khar btang 'byor bzhin sdod sgrig sne gdong bkar khang du byas/ de nas nyin shas song rjes hre shan san sger gru thon nas lha sar shar bskyod mtshams lho spyi thub bstan bzang po rta bzhon rjes bsnyegs su bskyod kyang hre shan san rgod dkar la brgyud lha phyogs su thon zin te thug 'phrad byed thub med pa red ces pa'i bshad srol 'dug lho spyi 'di'i las rgyun nang ri bo chos gling dgon pa'i 'du khang / shag 'khor bcas pa gsar rgyag dang bya sa lha khang gsar bzhengs/ yum bu brla sgang nyams gso bcas kyi do dam spyi khyab kyang byas/ srid skyong stag brag skabs bka' blon ka shod chos rgyal nyi ma lho kha sne gdong rdzong du rgyang phud gtong skabs srung skyel grwa bzhi rgya sbyong dang sbrags 'byor bas bka' dgongs bzhin sne gdong rdzong rnying pa'i sgo rwa'i nang btson khang 'dom gang gru bzhi dang / steng du btson srung sdod khang /mtha' skor lcags ri bcas gsar rgyag byas/ de nas dus tshod gang 'tshams song dus btson srung pas ka shod pa btson srung sdod khang yang steng du bzhugs su bcug pa dang / sku bcar kun 'phel lags kyi gnyer rab rgyas sne gdong du gzhis chags yod pas khong gi bza' zla'i spun a ne blo bzang chos sgron zhes pa ka shod pa'i btson grogs su'ang bskyal 'dug ka shod pas khong la rgyan gos sogs nyo dmigs yin ces 'bru khal 500tham pa gnang ba red ces skabs der sne khul du yongs su grags/ de rjes lho spyi ngo mas skor g.yeng du yong stabs ka shod pa btson srung sdod khang du yod pa dang dus 'khel te 'phral mar ka shod btson khang du bcug btson srung la rta lcag gzhus nas srung bya 60

gtso drag re 'khor gsar bskos byas/ skabs der ka shod pas chibs rta gnyis nyar yod pas lho spyis bzhon rta nyar mi chog ces bshad skad 'dug lho spyi 'dis tha na bshas pa'i sa nas sha nyo skabs sha rin sne sel tsam las mi sprod pa dang / de min lag shes bzo rigs khag la'ang lag khral 'phar bskul sogs 'phar ma'i brdab gsig mang dag btang yod/ shing rta (1954)lor lho spyi 'phos/ lhospya brgyad pa/lho spyi brgyad pa dza sag zhol khang don grub rdo rje (1954)lo'i bod zla 5par lho spyi'i las gnas su 'byor/ shing rta (1954)lo nas bzung rdzong gzhis gzhung 'dzin byas te rdzong gzhis so so'i lo re'i 'bab bsdu sngar lam yong bzhes zhes pa ma dgos par rdzong gtso thun mong nas bsdu 'jug zhus pa'i rtsis khrar lho spyis zhus dag gis 'grigs rtags phab nas legs bcos las khungs la snyan seng zhu lam gtan 'khel gsal po byas yod na'ang 'phyongs rgyas rdzong rtse srung ngag dbang kun bzang ngo ma dang / shod drung shar sgo'i ngo tshab gnyis nas za sems kho na bcangs te gtso drag tsho'i lkog tu rdzong skyong gzhis bag g.yul las zin mtshams su gzhung 'bru phon che rku bherikhyer bar bzos byas pa ma zad/ rdzong rtse drung ngagatshodabang kun bzang nas skabs der 'phyongs rdzong gtso drag nas gzhis 'bru'i sgo zam 'dreng sgrog la thel tse rgyag ma dgos zhes brgya kha gcig gcod kyis bshad pa sogs rdzong gtso do dam mnyam gnyer bya rgyu'i gtan 'bebs dang mi mthun pa'i tshul min yong rkyen rnams gtso drag gis lho spyir snyan seng zhus stabs lho spyis 'phyongs rdzong ngo ma ngo tshab skong 'gugs kyis zhu ba blangs thog de skor yongs rkyen zhib phra bka' shag tu snyan zhu btang ba'i lan du do bdag gnyis ka lha sar rdzong brda zhu dgos phebs 61

pa ltar rdzong brda byas/ rtse drung gi ngo tshab g.yog bag gro dang / shod drung ngo tshab 'khyams stod rgyal mtshan skal bzang / lho spyi'i ngo tshab lcags zam phyag mdzod gtso drag bcas thun mong thog bkar 'bru bskyar gshor dang / de min gzhung 'bab rnams zhib bsher byas te rtsis khra dang bcas legs bcos las khungs su 'bul lam zhus/ mtha' ma'i thag gcod ji byas sa gnas sne sdod kyis gsal shes thub mi 'dugalho spyi de'i dus me sprel (1956)lor lho kha spyi khyab don gcod las khungs dang rdzong rim pa'i don gcod las khungs 'dzugs skabs bod rgya mthun lam zhu sgo gang cir yag po byung yod pa/ dper na/ de skor skabs der 'phyongs rgyas zhol khang gzhis sdod dang gtso drag gcig lcogs gnang myong mkhan 'brel yod pa'i mi sna dbang chen tshe ring gis gsungs par gzhigs na/ bod me sprel (1956)lo'i lo 'gor wang hruri'u ci sogs rtsed thang shag lhor phebs pa dang / de'i phyi nyin lho spyi'i bzhugs gnas su phebs te phyag btags dang bcas spyi khyab don gcod las khungs 'dzugs rgyu'i skor bka' mol gnang /de rjes rdzong gzhis khag gi rdzong gtso dang / dgon sde che khag gi las sne sogs 'du 'dzoms kyis tshogs 'du nyin kha shas 'tshogs rjes spyi khyab don gcod las khungs kyi mi sna bkod sgrig gtan 'khel gnang zhing / kru'u ren rgan pa'i las 'gan lho spyis byas te spyi khyab don gcod las khungs dngos su tshugs/gsham 'og kho'o khag dang gzhon nu tshogs pa/ bud med mnyam 'brel tshogs pa/ las byed slob grwa bcas btsugs pa dang / rdzong rim pa'i don gcod khang sogs 'dzugs rgyu'i las don gang cir wang hru'u ci dang bka' sdur gyis phyag las gnang / tshogs 'du grol te 'thus mi rnams rdzong gzhis so sor thon khar lho spyi'i sar thon mjal du bcar mkhan tshor khyed rnams da lam tshogs 'dur phebs pas rtsa ba'i dgongs mngags min yang / spyi khyab don gcod 62

las khungs dang / rdzong don gcod las khungs 'dzugs rgyu 'di krung dbyang dang / bod sa gnas srid gzhung gnyis bka' sdur gyis gtan la 'khel ba zhig yin pas sa gnas su phebs rjes khyab bsgrags dang 'brel gtor bshig mi 'gro ba'i las don sgrub thub pa'i dgongs zhes gnang dgos zhes gsungs/skabs der dbang chen tshe ring zhol khang gzhis sdod thog gtso drag khongs yin gshis/ rdzong don gcod las khungs 'dzugs rgyur sa gnas 'phyongs rgyas su phyir slog gnang stabs thon khar lho spyis ‘‘rdzong don gcod las khungs 'dzugs rgyur 'di nas krang kru'u ren sogs phebs rgyur khyod rang gi blo mngags ltar bod rgya mthun sgril la mi phan pa'i gnad don rigs byung na khyod rang rang tshugs zin pa byed dgos ’’zhes pa'i mngags bkod dang 'brel gang byung the tshogs bya rgyu med ces gsungs yod pa dang / 'phyongs rgyas su rdzong don gcod las khungs btsugs rjes dbang chen tshe ring sne gdong du skyod skabs der lho spyi'i drung yig thub bstan zhes pa'i sar lha sa nas bka' drung ldum rwa bas lho spyir btang ba'i nang ma'i yi ge zhig yod pa gong gsal dbang tshe nas mthong zhing / de'i nang ‘‘deng skabs gzhung zhabs nang mi kha shas kyis zhol khang gis rgya mis gang zer lag len byed pa las/ gzhung zhen med pa red zer gyi yod tshod 'dug pas glog la mar me'i gsal 'debs zhu ma dgos kyang dgongs pa zab bzhes gnang dgos zhes ’mi zer ba zhig btang 'byor byung yod la/skabs der kha bral ring lugs pa ches nyung shas shig gis gang byung gi gtam 'chal yang mang po yod rung / lho spyi zhol khang ba'i rgyal gces kyi dgongs par g.yo 'gul med par lho spyi'i mjug skyong gnang rgyu mtha' 'khyongs thog bod rgya mthun lam gyi thog nas sa gnas don gcod las khungs dang / rdzong rim pa'i don gcod las khungs 'dzugs rgyu'i las don la 'bad brtson hur thag gnang yod/63

lhospya dgu pa/lho spyi dgu pa phun rab tshe ring skal ldan me bya (1957)lo stod du lho spyi'i las 'dzin du 'byor/ las yun lo gcig tsam las song med/ khong dang po 'byor skabs sa gnas u yon lhan khang nas sger pa gru khad du phebs bsur rlangs 'khor gtong gnang mdzad 'dug yun ring sgug kyang mthar sngar lam phebs bsu sne gdong rdzong gtso dang mnyam du rta gral bsgrigs nas bskyod pa las rlangs 'khor nang ma yong ba dang / sa gnas u yon lhan khang nas rnam kun tshogs 'dur gdan zhu gnang skabs lho spyi phun rab pas ga dus yin na'ang dus thog tu yong gi med par brten de rjes tshogs 'du'i sngon brda gtong skabs chu tshod gnyis gsum bsngun bsus nas sngon brda 'bul gyi yod 'dug kyang da dung dus thog yong gi med skad 'dug lho spyi phun rab par rgya bod 'gal zlar 'dzin pa'i lta ba shugs che tsam yod skad ma zad bod rgya mthun lam yang de tsam yag po byung med/ sa khyi (1958)lor sde drug bla brang dang /'bras spungs khongs grwa skor mtshan zhabs gnyis dbar 'gal zla byung zhing /skabs der grwa skor mtshan zhabs la rgyab skyor byed mkhan gnyal lhun rtse grwa skor grwadzishar 'ga' shas nas sde drug bla brang la ya bzung bya rgyu'i skad cha yod tshul la bsnyad de sde drug bla brang nas lho spyir snyan seng zhus par lho spyis ngo tshab gnyer blo gros ched btang gnyal lhun rtse sa gnas su 'byor te sde drug bla brang gi mdzod pa dang / lhun rtse rdzong tshab dgra 'dul lho spyi ngo tshab bcas nas ngan gros kyis rdzong gi nye 'dabs pho hrag bskul te grwa skor bla brang du btang thog mtshan zhabs sprul sku dang grwa pa rdab rdob bdun 'dzin bzung btson 'jug byas shing / gong gsal grwa pa rnams la mtshan mo de rang la sa bzhu spar te lcang rgyug tshad med btang ste mu mthud btson 'jug byas pa dang / mtshan zhabs 64

rin po che yang btson bcug gis zhu ba rim len byas mthar gong gsal grwa pa bdun sde drug bla brang khongs dgon pa so sor grwa pa re rtsis sprad pa dang / rin po che lho spyi'i sar khrid nas khong gi 'dzin dbang bdag gces zhu mkhan dang khong la gsol phogs 'bul mkhan grwa dmangs khongs nas mi gcig zur bskos byas thog mtshan zhabs rin po che chos lugs gnang sgo gsan bzhes gang legs gnang dgos pa dang gyod gzhi 'di'i le rtsa mtshan zhabs rin po cher thug lugs kyis nyes chad kyang yang po zhig btang skad 'dugalhospyi bcu pa/lho spyi bcu pa mkhan chung thub bstan mchog grub dang (tsha rdor yang zer )las tshan pa 'byor rgyas sa khyi (1958)zla 3pa'i nang lho spyir 'byor zhing / lho spyi rnying pa phun rab pa rtsis sprod ma grub pas gsar pa gnyis gnas skabs sne gdong rdzong du bsdad/ skabaspu der khams jag lho khul du 'byor 'go tshugs te yul lung bde 'jags med pa'i bcom 'phrog tshul min bya spyod spel skor lho spyi gsar pa gnyis nas bka' shag tu snyan 'bul zhus rung / lan gsal gang yang byas mi 'dug gong lo'i bod zla 4pa'i nang dza sag smin skyid gling pa dang /gdan sa 'bras se dga' gsum gyi 'thus mi bcas gzhung ko brgyud rtsed thang sger pa gru khar 'byor zhing / phyi nyin dza sag smin gling pa dang / lho spyi ser skya gnyis bcas sa gnas u yon lhan khang du ngo bcar gyis ‘‘lho kha khul du khams rigs kyis spyod ngan byed par sa gnas srid gzhung gi bka' mngags ltar go bskon mol khyab bya bar yong ba yin zhing / zhib phra'i gnas tshul phyir bskyod skabs 'di byas snyan seng zhu bar bcar rgyu yin ’rizhes zhus yod skad kyang dza sag smin gling pa dang gdan 'thus bcas 'phyongs rgyas nas gri gur bskyod de phyir log skabs 'di byas gang yang med par ngan gros byas pa'i rang mnong 65

gis myos te rdo pho brang du shar bskyod kyis lha sar phyir log byas/ de rjes bod zla 8pa'i nang rtsis dpon rnam gling pa dang / dngos gzhi thub bstan bsam mchog gdan sa gsum gyi mkhan 'thus se ra stod pa mkhan po bcas lho khul du 'byor zhing / skabs der phyi tshul bshad yas la sa gnas srid gzhung gis khams jag la zing cha slong ba'i don rkyen bzo gzhi nam yang mi chog pa'i bkod 'doms byed mkhan yin lugs brjod pa tsam las don du thog mar lho khar yong stangs kyang gzhung lam du shar skyod bya rgyu las g.yol te gra phyi rnam gling phu la brgyud 'phyongs rgyas 'phyos chang khyim du 'byor/ lho spyi tsha rdor ba yang skabs de dang bstun nas 'phyongs rgyas la mnyam 'dzoms byas/ kho tsho thun mong nas rtsed thang sa gnas u yon lhan khang du yi ge zhig phul gsal ltar na ‘‘'phyongs rgyas su khams rigs sa srung tsam las 'go pa sdod mkhan mi 'dug pas thugs dogs gnang dgos med la/ khong tsho'i 'go pa thug 'phrad byas rjes nges par du snyan seng zhu rgyu dang chabs cig ngo bcar zhu rtsis yod mi’ces pa'i brjod bya tsam las don dngos thog de las ldog ste nyin de'i mtshan mo de rang du rtsed thang sgang sbug tu thengs dang po'i zings 'khrugs bslangs/ lho spyi tsha rdor ba la rtsed thang dga' chos bla gnyer nas deng skabs khams jag gis chab 'bangs drag zhan tshang ma bde bar ma 'khod pa'i gnas gyar 'di dag gang myur 'gog thabs dgongs bzhes yong ba'i re ba zhu skabs lho spyis ‘‘dga' ldan pho brang gi bstan pa chab srid la sman ched rang nus gang yod 'don dgos pa yin na'ang / nga tshor thugs blos 'khel gyi yod bzo mi 'dug gang lags zer na sa dbang zur khang pa'i 'gag pa 'phyongs rgyas ldum khang la zla tshes bkod med pa'i bka' shag lam yig 'bog sgril gang 'khur rgyu 'dug mi’zhes bshad 'dug de ni lkog g.yo'i thabs shes gzhan zhig yin pa dang / de rjes mkhan chung thub bstan bsam mchog dang rtsis dpon rnam gling pa/ lho spyi tsha rdor ba bcas e 66

lha rgya rir khams pa'i brten gzhi yod sar bskyod pa dang / de nas mi ring bar lho spyi'i las sbrel 'byo ra rgyas kyang lha rgya ri ra rjes bskyod byed skabs sne gdong bde skyid khang gsar mthu stobs rnam rgyal dang / sne gdong las drung snang ldum ra byams pa mnyam khrid thog snang ldum ra byams pa rgya rigs dang 'brel ba che bar brnyad de khams jag gis 'dzin bzung byas mthar bros byol 'gro rtsis kyis gad pa'i steng nas mchongs te shi/ lho spyi skya ser ngo ma gnyal lhun rtser bskyod khar lho kha'i rdzong gzhis tshang ma lhun rtse rdzong du rtsis khur ngo 'byor dgos pa'i tshes grangs dus btag gi yi ge btang don ltar rdzong gzhis rnams lhun rtser 'byor skabs rtsis zhu'i skad cha tshig gcig me da par gnad don ngo ma ni bod la dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur bya ma dgos pa bod srid gzhung ma/sa krung dbyang la zheb mol yong ba'e snyan zhu 'bul rgyu dang / gal te don smin ma son tshe dmag bskul brgyab nas khams jag dang mnyam sbrel thog kha gtad 'jal dgos pa'i ngan gros byas te mos mthun yod rmad 'dri rtsad byas par mos mthun yod ces brjod rgyu las ma 'das stabs tshang mas gcig sgril bya rgyu'i mna' gan bzhag pa ma zad/ rdzong gzhis so so'i 'go 'dzin mi snas ming yig lag bstar bris pa dang 'brel sa gnas srid gzhung la snyan zhu phul ba ngang / gdan pa 'bras se dga' gsum la 'di skor rgyab skyor yong ba'i zhu yig re dang / gzhan yang gzhis rtse dang mnga' ris skor gsum la snyan zin re dang skul slong gi yi ge/ de dang 'dra ba nag chu dang byang rigs khul/ kong po rgya mda'/ lha ri/ dpal 'bar/ mchin 'brog khul bcas la'ang snyan zin dang yi ge bcas btang thog rdzong gzhis sne sdod tshang ma lha rgya ri gong po khang gsar du rtsis dpon rnam gling pa dang / mkhan chung thub bsten bsam mchog sar 'di byed snyan seng zhu bar 'gro rgyu byaṭasdo te tshogs 'du grol 'dug e gong po khang gsar du sa phag (1959)bod zla 1tshes 28nyin 67

rdzong gzhis 'dzoms skabs mi 98yod 'dug cing / de nyin mkhan chung dngos gzhi thub bstan bsam mchog slebs mi 'dug rtsis dpon rnam gling pas gtso skyong gis tshogs 'du de'i snying don slor brgyud sgrags bskyar du byas pa dang / khong gis bshad don du ‘‘khams khul sde dge phyogs su ngo rgol gsum dang / chag yang gnyis byas pa ltar na/ dgon sde mang po rtsa gtor btang ba ma zad/ mkhar dbang btsan 'phrog chags rten dang bral ba bzos rkyen rgan skyor gzhon khrid sems thag gtsang bcad kyis phyi rgyal du bros byol 'gro rgyu las 'os med pas khams rigs phal cher rgya gar du rim par 'gro bzhin pa red na gang ltar bod ljongs la'ang 'di dang 'dra ba yong nges shing / sa 'jam bong nyal blo bde bag phebs yong thabs bod sri da gzhung nas krung dbyang la zhi ba'i bka' mol yong ba'i snyan 'bul zhus pa gang legs byung 'dug zing 'khrug 'di skor bod bzhugs krung dbyang sku tshab kyis bka' shag nas ji ltar bya rtsis yod med ha cang nan pos bka' 'dri gnang bzhin par brten bka' shag nas lan gsal brjod dka' ci bya'i gnas su gyar nas bsdad yod ’’lugs bshad 'dug skabs der 'phyongs rgyas rdzong shod drung sding yon nas ‘‘da res tshogs 'du'i re 'dun ltar krung dbyang nas dgongs bzhes gnang na gang legs yong rgyu ma gtogs dmag 'khrug rgyag rgyu ni mi 'bor mtshon cha gang thad nas ya zung thub thabs rtsa ba nas med nges ’’zhes bshad song / yang de nas gang 'tshams song rjes khong gis rang nyid nas bsam zhib ma byas nor 'khrul gyi skad cha de 'dra shod thal gyur song dgongs 'gal med pa zhes bshad 'dugade nas rtsis dpon rnam gling pa dang mkhan chung thub bstan bsam mchog lho spyi bcas gnyal lhun rtser bskyod pa dang / 'thus mi rnams so so'i sa gnas su phyir log gis dmag bskul rgyag rgyu'i las 'go tshugs nas rdzong gzhis so so'i mi 'bor la gzhigs te skyes pa rang lo 36man dang / lo 18yan/68

dgon sde khag nas ser dmag bcas bsdus nas rdzong gtso'i ma/nga rgyab dang sbrags e bla 'bring dgon par 'dzoms dgos pa'i bkod /khyab btang na'ang /gong lo'i bod zla 3pa'i nang khams jag dang / bcings ‘sprugrol dmag e chu mdo gyang khra tshang yas mas su 'khrug zing byung ste khams jag rnams rtsa 'thor song ba bcas so/

gyi las sne/ sras mkhar dgon gyi las sne dang de min rdzong gzhis khag gi gtso drag khag bcas seng ge rdzong du 'dzoms/ lho kha sa gnas don gcod khang nas phebs mkhan las don ru khag gi 'go khrid rgya rigs hru'u ci rgan pa des gtso bo gnang ste tshogs 'du'i thog don gcod khang 'dzugs dgos pa'i gal che'i nang don gsung bshad gnang rjes ‘‘sang nyin ni zla 10tshes 1red/ de ni krung hwa mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khaspodabu brnyes nas lo ngo bdun 'khor ba'i dus chen yin pas de ring 'dir phebs pa'i blo mthun dang grogs po rnams mnyam 'dzoms byung ba'i bkra shis bde legs dang rten 'brel zhu ched dgong dro gsol tshigs shig 'bul rgyu yin pas tshang ma snga tsam phebs dgos ’rizhes gsungs/ de'i phyi nyin te zla 10tshes 1nyin gsol tshigs gzab rgyas gnang zhing / tshang ma lhan 'dzoms thog hru'u ci nas gsung don ‘‘nga tsho de ring mnyam 'dzoms byung ba ni ma bu thug pa lta bu'i dga' tshor ha cang chen po byung / khyed rnam pa yang mes rgyal khyim tshang chen por gcig gyur byung ba red/ de snga bod rjesrong btsan sgam po'i btsun mor rgya sa 'un shing kong jo bsu len byas pa nas bzung mes bod gnyis sha rgyus gcig tu 'brel ba'i spun mched lta bu yin rung / bar lam dbyin ji btsan rgyal ring lugs pa sogs kyis dbyen sbyor dkrug shing byas rkyen mes rgyal dang bod gnyis dbar skabs shig ring kha bral lta bu song yang da lta krung go gsar pa dbu brnyes par brten btsan rgyal ring lugs pa'i btsan 'dzul mthar skrod btang bas bod ljongs 'di mes rgyal gyi mnga' khongs bsnyon med yin stabs ma'o kru'u zhi dang / tang krung dbyang gi byams brtse'i thugs 'khur 'og 〈bod zhi bas bcings 'grol 'byung thabs skor gyi gros mthun 〉don tshan bcu bdun la ming rtags bkod zin pa gzhir bzung tang krung dbyang gi bka' ltar nga tsho de ring 'dir yong ba red/ tā la'i bla ma dang / paṇa chen rin po che rnam gnyis nas 〈gros mthun 〉don tshan 71

bcu bdu na nang gsal bod la zhi ba'i bcings 'grol gtong rgyu'i thad bod mi dmangs kyi khe phan yin pa khas len gnang ba ma zad/ tā la'i rang skyong ljongs kyi kru'u ren rgan pa'e 'as/na bzhes gnang ba'i skor gyi gsung bshad par 'debs byas pa'i deb chung re khyed tshor 'bul rgyu yin zhes gsungs te tshogs 'dur yod pa'i 'thus mi tshang mar deb re gnang /— lho brag khul du rdzong don gcod las khungs 'tshug yul sa cha seng ge rdzong du byas na rdzong gzhis phan tshun 'gro skyod stabs bde yod pas seng ge rdzong la don gcod las khungs tshugs yul gyi khang pa gas ra rgyag bya rgyu'i las mi ji dgos dang / yul lung so sor sems can che chung ji yod kyi tho bzo dgos pas da res tshogs 'dur phebs pa'i 'thus mi tshang mas nyin lnga'i ring gros bsdur yag po zhig gnang ste thag gcod byed dgos ’’zhes gsungs/ skabs der tshogs 'dur lho brag dar ma gzhis sdod 'byor med pa dang / lha khang gzhis sdo da dang / seng ge rdzong sdod/ do rdzong rdzong sdod bcas dang gtso drag dgon sde khag gi bla ma las sne/tsho dpon/ rgan po bcas 'dzoms nas gros bsdur byas thog las mi dang sems can tho 'god bya rgyu de 'thus mi tshang ma sa gnas so sor log rjes zhib bsher byas te tho skyel rgyu byas pa dang / don gcod las khungs 'dzugs rgyu'i skor gros bsdur byed skabs seng ge rdzong 'jun pa'i ngo tshab gnyer pa dbang 'dus dang / gtso drag sbang mkhar rang byung / rmu thod sbang ka/ khyim gsar karma dbang rgyal/ drung dbon po bcas nas brjod don ‘‘nga tsho seng ge rdzong 'di rdzong gzhis chung gras yin pa ma zad/ tā la'i bla ma dang / bka' shag gi bka' med na nga tsho brtsi bkur byed thub ma song / gal te rdzong don gcod las khungs 'dzugs 'dod yod na do rdzong gzhi rgya che bas khyed tshos do rdzong rang la 'dzugs dgos ’mizhes brjod de tshang ma gros ma mthun pa'i ngang gcig gis gcig la mig ce rer lta bzhin pa'i ngang tshogs mi gcig thon gnyis thon byas 72

te mthar tshogs 'du grol/ de nas nyin nyi shu tsam song rjes lho kha sa gnas spyi khyab don byed khang nas phebs pa'i las don ru khag rnams do rdzong sa gnas su phebs bzhugs gnang / las don ru khag la dgos pa'i rta thab gzan shing rnams rdzong gtso dang / tsho dpon/ rgan po bcas kyis mi ser nas bsdu cha byas te sne len zhus/ nyin shas song mtshams do rdzong mnga' khul lha sde mi sde tshang ma tshogs 'du zhig skong tshogs gnang ste lho kha sa gnas nas phebs pa'i las don ru khag nas slar yang bod dang mes rgyal gyi 'brel ba'i skor gsungs pa dang 'brel ‘‘bod ljongs 'di nyid krung hwa mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab kyi mnga' khongs bsnyon med yin pas tang krung dbyang dang / ma'o kru'u zhi'i dbu khrid 'og rgyal yongs bcings 'grol btang zin par brten bod ljongs la yang rgyal yongs dang 'dra ba'i zhi ba'i bcings 'grol gtong rgyu'i thad bod kyi dpon rigs dang rgya che'i mang tshogs nas mos mthun byung ba ltar gyi yig cha khyed tshor phul yod/ bod rang skyong ljongs gra sgrig u yon lhan khang yang dngos su dbu brnyes zin pa dang / kron chus (sa khul )khag la spyi khyab don gcod las khungs btsugs zin cing / deng skabs rdzong rim pa'i don gcod las khungs 'dzugs mus yin la/ lho kha sa khul la yang rdzong don gcod las khungs mang che ba btsugs zin nyer yod pa red/ nga tsho lho brag rdzong la yang gcig mtshungs don gcod las khungs 'dzugs dgos pa las rjes lus thebs na mi 'grig pa red mi’ces gsungs pa bzhin lho brag rdzong la rdzong don gcod las khungs 'dzugs rgyu'i gtan 'khel byung zhing / do rdzong shod drung mkhar ldan rdzong don gcod las khungs kyi kru'u ren rgan pa dang / rtse drung ngo tshab spro khang rgyal mtshan blo gros kru'u ren gzhon pa bya rgyu dang / khong gnyis kyi lcam chung gnyis bud med kyi kru'u ren rgan gzhon bya rgyu/ gtso drag so sor gsham 'og gi rig slob kho'o/ dmangs srid kho'o/ spyi bde las khungs/ 'dzugs skrun 73

kho'o sogs la rim pas bkod sgrig byas pa dang / so so'i las gnas rim pa gzhir bzung gla phogs thob thang bzos pa ltar gla phogs gnang yod/ skabs der shod drung mkhar ldan nas gla phogs len gyi min zhes brjod de rtsa ba nas blangs med pa dang / de min tshang mas phogs dngul blangs/ skabs der don gnyis gling dgon pa 'i gnyer zur rab 'byams 'jigs med dang / lha lung dgon pa'i tsho dpon zur pa 'phrin las rgya mtsho gnyis kyis bkod jus byas pa'i 'og dgon sde bzhi'i las sne dang / rgan po khag gcig bcas nas ngan tshogs lkog gshoms kyis don gcod las khungs rtsa ba nas 'jugs ma dgos pa yong rgyu'i lkog gros nyin mtshan kha shas byed pa'i mur do rdzong gtso drag khag gcig gis gla phogs blangs pa kho pa tshos shes tshor byung rkyen khong khro dang nga rgyal ci cher song nas kho tshos brjod don ‘‘ da yag ma song rdzong gtso 'di tshos rang 'tsho zin ma thub par sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang / dga' ldan pho brang gi chab srid snyespas dngul ṭ+wā yang dkar po la dga' zhen che ba byed bzhin 'dugadakar po lding khang rgyal mtshan shes rab kyi bu o rgyan zer ba de yang rgya mi'i g.yog por bzhag 'dug pa 'di dag phyi nang ngan 'brel bya ba thabs rdug yin ’’tshul sogs bshad thog kho pa tsho tshang ma lha sar re 'dun snyan seng zhu bar 'gro rgyu'i gros thag bcad pa red/ skabs der kru'u ren gzhon pa do rdzong rtse drung ngo tshab rgyal mtshan blo gros dang / don nyid gling dgon pa'i tsho dpon brkos par gnyis nas mgo gnyis ma'i g.yo thabs la brten nas kho tsho gsham du ngan tshogs byas pa nga gnyis nas da lta gzhi nas shes tshor byung tshul las don ru khag la snyan seng zhus par de'i lan du las don ru khag nas gsung don ‘‘khyed tshos mi dmangs kyi khe phan don du tā la'i bla ma dang / bka' shag srid gzhung / bod rang skyong ljongs gra sgrig u yon lhan khang gi khongs su yin pa yid ma ches na khyed tsho ga par 'gro 'dod yod kyang phyin na 'grig khyed 74

tshor lam gron gang dgos nga tsho las don ru khag nas btang chog khyed tsho len par yong na shog ’rices gsungs/ de nas rgyal mtshan blo gros dang / don nyid glingagi tsho dpon brkos par zer ba gnyis kyis 'go khrid byas pa'i 'og gtso drag dang / rgan po bcas mi grangs bcu gcig lha sar bde sdug zhu mkhan yin tshul gyis gsang stabs ngang thon pa dang / sa gnas der sdod mkhan don nyid gling dgon pa'i grwa pa kha shas mngon sum du phyir thon te krog krog dang /spobs nyams che zhing ngar shugs yod mdog gis do rdzong las don ru khag yod sa'i nye 'gram g.yas g.yon gang sar phar 'gro tshur 'ong zam mi chad pa byed bzhin pa'i thog ‘‘rgya ro skyag pa zo shig ’’zer ba dang / ‘‘nga tsho rgya mi'i kha la rtsa ba nas nyan gyi min ’’zer ba/ ‘‘lho brag do rdzong gi rdzong dpon dang / gtso drag 'di tsho rgya mi'i rgyugs khyi red ’’zer ba/ ‘‘nga tsho dus da lta bar gzhung sa dga' ldan pho brang gi bka' drin la brten nas 'tsho ba yin ri’zer ba sogs 'ud shob dang / tshig ngan sna tshogs kyis ku co ldir ba red/ skabs de dus rgyal gces kyi bsam pa yod mākhan gtso drag khag gcig la lta stangs 'dra min sna tshogs byung stabs nyen kha'i rang bzhin dang / mthar srog mgo yang thon e yong bsam pa'i sems khral dang sems sdug gis nyin mtshan bskyel dka' bar gyur/rdzong gtso tshang mas kha mkhas 'dra chags kyi ngang tshul 'dzin te do rdzong du bzhugs pa'i las don ru khag gi 'go khrid dang las byed/ bcings 'grol dmag bcas la dgos mkho ma chad tsam bskyal te dus tshod zla gcig tsam song mtshams don nyid gling dgon pa'i bar lding shag gi rab 'byams 'jigs med dang / lha lung dgon gyi tsho zur 'phrin las rgya mtsho bcas mi khag gcig lha sa nas phyir log gis bod rang skyong ljongs gra sgrig u yon lhan khang gi bka' rgya shan 'byar gcig 'khyer yod pas bka' rgya'i nang don du 〈gros 75

mthun 〉don tshan bcu bdun nang bod 'di zhi ba'i bcings 'grol gtong rgyu'i thad bod mi dmangs kyi go rtogs sad rim bzhin sa gnas so so ra rdzong don gcod las khungs 'dzugs rgyu dang / de bzhin gzhon nu mnyam 'brel tshogs pa dang / bud med mnyam 'brel tshogs pa bcas kyi nang rang mos kyis mi su 'dra zhig gzhug rgyu'i 'dod mos yod phyin de la sus kyang bkag 'gog byas mi chog pa sogs kyi rtsa don yod pa red/ skabs der lha sa nas phyir 'khor byas pa'i 'thus mi tshos ‘‘da res do rdzong rtse shod dang / gtso drag rgan po/ tsho dpon/ dgon pa khag gi bla ma las sne dang / las don ru khag bcas do rdzong du tshogs 'du tshogs rogs gnang / tshogs 'du'i thog nga tshos lha sar bde sdug zhus pa'i snying por rang skyong ljongs gra sgrig u yon lhan khang nas gnang ba'i bka' rgya zhig yod pas de tshang mar khyab bsgrags gnang rogs ’’zhes bshad don ltar tshang ma do rdzong du tshogs 'du 'tshogs te bka' rgya sgrogs sbyangs byas shing / bka' rgya'i 'bru don ni ‘‘bod mi dmangs rim bzhin go rtogs sad mtshams rang mos kyis don gcod las khungs btsugs chog ’’ces pa'i tshig mtshams der slebs mtshams 'thus mi khag gcig tshogs chen thog ma gros bsam pa gcig mthun lta bu'i lkog g.yo ngan jus sngon gtan zin pa'i gnas tshul mngon sum du phyir thon te yar langs thog ‘‘da 'grigs song las don ru khag rnams phyir log gnang dgos ’’zhes zer ba'i 'bod sgra grags ma thag gtso drag dang / tsho dpon/ rgan po sogs mi grangs brgya skor nas tshogs 'du'i thog skad cor brgyab ste tshogs 'du zang zing bzos pa dang /de'i nang nas tsher sgo'i rgan po o rgyan zer ba des skad shugs chen pos ‘‘de ring 'dir yod pa'i rdzong dang gtso drag 'di tsho gzhung sa dga' ldan pho brang nas thob gdan lto phogs gnang bas grod pa mi rgyags par rgya mi'i dngul dwo yang 'dod nas kha la zas pas mi tshad rkub la so bsgar nas za rgyu byung na 76

bsam pa'i 'dod brngams yod tsang rgya mis gang bshad la nyan nas rkub g.yog rgyugs pa dang / rgya mi'i ched du skad cha shod kyi mi 'dug gam tshang mas bsam blo yag po gtong dgos/ mi 'di tsho'i gras re re byas nas sngon la thag gcodagatong dgos/ sngon ma'i gtam dper/ sngon la bal po bsad de de nas gser bgo bsha' rgyab chog pa ltar byed dgos pa mi 'dug gam ’’zhi sa zer nas ngar ngar rdzig rdzig byas/ tshogs 'du der yod pa'i mi mang che ba mgo sgur sgur byas nas bsdad pa las cang mi smra yang / do rdzong mkhar ldan nas bshad don ‘‘ngas dngul phogs blangs med/ yin na'ang rgya bod mthun sgril yo nga ched nga tshos sne len bya rgyu'i las ka yag po bya dgos ’mizhes bshad/las don ru khag gi 'go khrid rnams nas ‘‘khyed tsho mi dmangs kyi don du 'di gar tshogs 'dur sku ngal chen po byung song bas khyed rnam pa 'gro song ga tshod song yod rung nga tshos sprod rgyu yin la khyed rnam pa la bka' drin yang gsol rgyu yin/ de ring tshogs 'du'i thog zang zing bzo ba dang skad cor bskyon mkhan 'thus mi su yin gsal po shes song rung / nga tsho'i las don skor la zhib lhod kyis phan tshun bka' mol gnang na 'grig gi red/ khyed tsho mi dmangs kyi don du tshogs 'dur phebs nas bka' mol gnang bar thug rje che zhu rgyu yin/dgong dro lhan rgyas tshang mar gsol tshigs stabs bde zhig 'bul rgyu dang de nas do dgong glog brnyan gyi gzigs mo'i le'u kha shas 'bul rtsis yod pas rdzong dpon lhan gnyis dang / gtso drag tsho dpon/ rgan po bcas 'thus mi rnam pa tsho nges par phebs thub pa gnang rogs ’zhes gsungs thog mjug tu tshang mar mjal dar zub phyi re sgron gnang ba red/ shod drung mkhar ldan nas ‘‘nga do dgong gsol tshigs la bcar gyi min ’’zhes bshad/ de nas slar yang de nub gsol tshigs la phebs dgos pa'i mgron brda bskyar du sprad stabs mkhar ldan pas g.yogs po gcig tshab btang ba red/ 'thus mi'i gras nas ri 77

don nyid gling dgon pa'i tsho dpon rab 'byams 'jigs med dang / lha lung dgon gyi tsho zur 'phrin las rgya mtsho gnyis nas kyang de nub gsol tshigs la rtsa ba nas phyin med pa phud/ de min 'thus mi tshang ma gsol tshigs la bcar zhing / gsol tshigs gnang ring tshang mas dga' dga' spro spro'i ngang yun tsam lhing 'jags pa'i rnam pa bstan rung tshang ma'i bsam blor dngangs tshabs kyang yod gshis/ mi gnyis gsum tsam rub rub byas te skad shugs chung ngus skad cha shob shob shod kyi yod pa red/ de nas dgong dro'i chu tshod 8 30tsam la do rdzong gi sgo rwa'i nang glog brnyan bstan 'go tshugs shing / glog brnyan lta mkhan rim 'byor gyis las don ru khag gi 'go khrid dang / las byed pa dang /'thus mi gtso drag rgan po/ dgon pa'i las sne/ de khul mang tshogs bcas glog brnyan lta bar yong mkhan mi grangs sum brgya lhag tsam dang / don nyid gling dgon pa'i grwa pa brgya tsam bcas 'dzoms/ bde 'jags kyi ched du mtha' 'khor du mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag bcu tsam dang / em rje/skad sgyur bcas go mtshon rang 'grigs bskor g.yeng bde srung byed kyi yod/glog brnyan bstan 'go tshugs nas chu tshod gnyis tsam song mtshams glo bur du glog chad de mun nag chags stabs tshang mas ‘‘gang byas song ngam ’’zhes hon 'thor byed pa dang / las byed pa dang / dmag mis gang sar rtog zhib byed skabs don nyid gling dgon pa'i grwa pa rub sdod kyis glog brnyan lta mkhan grwa pa sdod sa'i 'og gi sa cha nas glog skud dum bur bcad yod pa ra 'phrod cing /de 'phral las byed pa nas ‘‘do dgong glog brnyan thog nas dril bsgrags gzigs mo phul bar tshang mas gang byung gtor bshig ma gnang rogs ’’zhes bshad ma thag grwa pa mang po sdeb langs kyis nga tshos gtor bshig bya rgyu ma byung tshul bshad nas phan tshun kha rtsod rgyag bzhin pa'i thog don nyid gling gi grwa pa ming la ‘‘zhang po ’’zer ba des zur du thon te ‘‘glog skud gcod mi 'di yin 78

med par nga tsho ‘grwa pas bcad pa red ’ces zer ba ham pa chen po de 'dra nga tsho sdug nad theg pa mi 'dug ’’zer nas tshur gshor yong ste rgya rigs sman pa gcig yod pa der sbud rgyag gtong ba dang sbrags sman pa der mig bltas te gang shod 'di shod med pa dang / sman pa des ‘‘glog skud khyed tsho grwa pa sdod sa'i 'og nas bcad pa ra 'phrod song ’’zhes tshigs 'jam pos gsed bkrol byas rung / grwa pa des ngar shugs de bas che ru btang nas sbud rgyag rgyag thengs gcig la sman pa de lab dong zhig nang lhung par brten sman pa de khong khro mnan mi thub par me mda' brgyab ste grwa pa de 'chi skyon song bas der 'dus pa'i mi tshang ma zang zing ngang phar bros tshur bros byed skabs grwa pa tshang mas 'ur langs kyis rdo grangs med gzhus stabs las don ru khag rnams kyang rim bzhin sdod gnas su log ste sgo brgyab/ grwa pas zing cha mtshams 'jog rtsa ba nas ma byas rkyen rdzong gi thog steng nas grwa pa'i mjug tu me mda' re gnyis brgyab stabs bar lding rab 'byams 'jigs med la rmas skyon byung zhing / grwa pa rmas ma sgosteng du bkyag nas kho pa'i sdod shag tu bskyal/ chu tshod 12tsam la yang grwa pas rdo gzhus te zang zing mtshams 'jog ma byas stabs mu mthud me mda' kha shas brgyab rjes gzhi nas lhong 'jags trem byung yod/ gtso drag re gnyis ma/sa do rdzong mkhar ldan sar phyir te glog brnyan lta sar tshabs che'i don rkyen de 'dra byung lugs snyan seng zhu skabs mkhar ldan dngangs skrag skyed de sdod mi tshugs par phar 'gro tshur 'gro'i ngang ‘‘ga 'dra byas song ngam ’’zhes dri ba dang rabrel sge'u khung nang sogs gang sar phar lta tshur lta byed bzhin ngang ‘dpe srid kyi ma red/ nga tsho sa gnas rdzong sdod ga 'dra byed dgos sam/sdod blos mi bzod pa'i gnas su gyar ba red/ don nyid gling dgon pa chung chung yin yang grwa pa mang po yod pa dang / las don ru khag mi nyung nyung las med rung rgyal khab chen po red mi’ces brjod bzhin dngangs 'tshabs chen po 79

byas/ de'i nub mo phan tshun 'gro mtshams chad tsang gnas tshul zhib phra gang byas yod med gas/la po ma the/sa par lus/ de'i phyi nyin don nyid gling dgon pa'i las sne khag gcig do rdzong ldan rgyas sar yong ste mdang nub grwa pa 'ga' shas shi rmas song lugs dang dgon pa yang gnas thabs bral ba'i nyen kha'i rang bzhin yod tshul/ dgon pa srung skyob gnang dgos la grwa pa shi rmas song ba rnams la gzigs par phebs dgos tshul bshad don bzhin rdzong gi ngo tshab dang / gtso drag 'ga' shas dgon par lta bad gtong skabs don gling grwa pas slar yang brjod gsal la/ ‘‘grwa pa shi rkyen song ba rnams la khrims ltar mi stong bsgrub dgos pa dang / de bzhin las don ru khag la thab shing sogs dgos mkho gtong mi dgos par mtshams 'jog byed dgos miritshul sogs bshad song yang der bdag sprod byed mkhan med stabs grwa pas ngan tshogs dang ngan bshoms byas te zang zing bzo ba dang / gang byung gtam ngan shod rgyu tshang ma lhing 'jags mi byed mthu med du gyur/ rdzong gtso 'du khongs/ tshogs 'du 'tshogs te don snying las don ru khag la rta thab gzan shing sogs sngar mus ltar gtong rgyur gros mthun byung / nyin shas song rjes rdzong gtso mnyam 'dzoms kyis las don ru khag sar bcar te don gling dgon pas bde sdug zhu gsal rnams snyan seng zhu skabs las don ru khag gi 'go khrid nas ‘‘da res gnas tshul byung ba de'i thad la me mda' sngon 'a/ nga tsho'i sman pa des brgyab thal song 'dug pas sman pa de lam seng 'dzin bzung bya rgyu gtan 'khel ba yin/ rtsa ba'i gnad don 'di'i skor nga tsho 'di gar phan tshun skad cha shod res byas pa trem gyis mi 'grigs pas lho kha sa gnas spyi khyab don gcod las khungs la kha par thog nas dgongs skor snyan zhu phul zin cing / spyi khyab don gcod las khungs kyi rgya bod gnyis ka'i gtso bo 'go khrid phebs rgyur brten gnas skabs ngang sgug gnang rogs ’’zhes gsungs thog ‘‘sman pa de de ring 80

nga tsho tshang 'dzoms sar do dam bya rgyu yin ’’zhes gsungs don de 'phral sgug 'bodakyis bsdams bkyig byas thog ‘‘lho kha nas 'go khrid ma phebs bar yang khrims gcod yan por ma song ba bya rgyu yin pas/ de don ltar don gling dgon par khyed tshos gsung dgos ’’zhes gsungs/ de nas nyin shas song mtshams lho kha sa gnas spyi khyab don gcod las khungs nas sku tshab cha'o pu'u krang dang / las byed skad sgyur mi gsum/ spyi khyab don gcod las khungs kyi kru'u ren dkar chung tshe ring don grub/ rdo brag dgon gyi rgyal sras rin po che skal bzang rnam rgyal/ rin sgang pa/ sger pa gzhis sdod rtse drung sogs mi bcu skor phebs te rdzong gtso dang / dgon pa'i las sne/ tsho dpon/ rgan po bcas tshogs 'du skong tshogs thog ‘‘rdzong so sor don gcod las khungs 'dzugs rgyu de rang skyong ljongs gra sgrig u yon lhan khang gi bka' ltar 'dzugs dgos nges yin zhing / lho khul gyi rdzong mang che bar btsuges zin kyang khyed tsho da dung rjes lus thebs 'dug las byed nas slob gso brgyab ste lag len mgyogs myur bstar dgos/ don nyid gling dgon pa'i grwa pa kha shas shi bas mi stong sgrub dgos zer ba'i gnad don de don gling dgon pas 'os 'tshams kyi grangs tshad kha gsal byung na sprod rgyu yin ’’zhes gsungs/ don gling dgon pa'i las snes brjod don ‘‘da res kyi gnas tshul tshabs chen de nga tshos 'di byas 'di 'thus thag gcod mi thub/ gong sa rgyal dbang rin po cher snyan seng zhu rgyu dang 'brel nga tsho'i dgon bdag dga' ldan dgon pa yin pas der snyan seng zhu rgyu yin/ las don ru khag nas rang mos kyi rtsa don thog nas las don sgrub rgyu yin zer rung don du btsan shed kyi bka' dang / me mda' brgyab ste bya ngan 'di 'dra byas pa'i rgyu rkyen snyan seng zhus na ma gtogs rtsa ba nas 'grigs ma song / lho kha spyi khyab don gcod khang gi sku tshab kyis bshad pa nga tshos brtsi srung byed kyi min ’’zhes bshad/ rdzong dang / gtso drag rgan po/81

dgon sde'i las sne tsho dpon bcas gros bsdur gyis ‘‘don gcod las khungs 'dzugs rgyu'i thad nga tshos mi ser mang tshogs dang / grwa dmangs la slob gso brgyab ste kho cho'i bsam blo'i go rtogs dang bstun te zhu rgyu las da lta lam seng thag gcod thub pa zhu mi thub ’’ces brjod de nyin nyi shu tsam de mur lus/nyin nyi shu tsam song mtshams lho kha spyi khyab don gcod las khungs nasaci phebs mkhan rnams nas nga tsho so sos dgon pa khag la sku 'gyed 'bul ba dang chabs cig grwa par slob gso'i las ka byed par 'gro gi yin gsungs te lha lung dgon par rdo brag rgyal sras rin po che phebs te grwa par sku 'gyed 'bul gnang thog slob gso btang rung grwa pas sku 'gyed mthun lam ched du zhus pa las slob gso gnang ba nyan rgyu lta ci/ grwa pas da dung rgyal sras rispo po che la ‘‘khyed rang bla ma yin pas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa 'dzin dgos pa las bstan pa bshig rgyu'i bya ba'i nang zhugs na mi 'grigs pas dgongs pa yag po bzhes dgos ’rizhes bshad pa dang / de bzhin nyi lde dgon dang / sras mkhar dgon pa gnyis nas kyang sku 'gyed blangs pa tsam las slob gso gnang bar dang len med pa'i rnam 'gyur bstan/ don nyid gling dgon pa'i grwa pas slob gso'i bka' mol 'go btsugs tsam nas rnam 'gyur ci rigs kyis nyan 'jog ma byas pa red/skabs der gtso drag dang tsho dpon nang nas rgyal gces kyi bsam pa yod pa'i mi kha shas rjes su le thogs mi yong ngam bsam ste las gnas nas dgongs zhu yang byas pa bcas kyi gnas tshul byung yod/ 82

rtse gdong khul gyi mi rigs lag shes zangs bzo'i lo rgyus skor/gzhis rtse sa gnasasrid gros/gzhis rtse sa gnas rnam gling rdzong khongs rtse gdong khul 'dir mi rigs kyikhyad yon ldan pa'i lag rtsal bzo rigs sna mang phun sum tshogs pa'i nang tshan rten bzhengs zangs bzo'i lag rtsal ni rang ljongs su skad grags yod cing / da phan rtse gdong zangs bzo'i lag rgyun 'di ko dus snga mo zhig nas yod nga4'i ngos 'dzin byed pa tsam las dus ji tsam la dar stangs dar lugs nges gsal ni sa khul rang nyid kyi ser skya rgan rabs mang che bas kyang ngos 'dzin gsal po med gshis/ nga tshos khul 'di'i rten bzhengs zangs bzo ba bgres bzhugs re zung sogs la bcar 'dri dang 'brel lo rgyus gnas tshul gyi dpyad gzhi ltar na lo ngo nyis brgya tsam gyi sngon rol nas sa skya sgrol ma pho brang gis bal po'i bzo bo mkhas can rten bzhengs 'bod gnang skabs rtse gdong 'di nyid sa skya'i mnga' khongs la brten rtse gdong khul nas bzo grwa'i lag g.yog bskong 'gugs byas shing / mtshams 'dir lo rgyus kyi gleng srol zhig yod pa ste/ rtse gdong phu mda' bar gsum la phyug po thogs pa'i dud tshang che gsum yod pa de yang phu'i rgan tshang dang / bar bde skyid khang gsar/mda'i du ma rdza la zer ba bcas kyi nang tshan bar bde skyid khang gsar ba'i spe'i drung zer ba de nyid skabs der sa skya'i rten bzhengs lag g.yog khongs yod cing / (spe'i drung zer ba ni khyim tshang za dpon gyi che ming lta bu zhig las/83

ming dngos nor bzang zer gyin yod/) khong ni skye stobs kyi shes rab ldan pa zhig yin pas rgyun ring bzo grwa'i lag g.yog byas pa'i nang ngo lkog gang thad nas bal po'i lag rtsal la do snang chen po byas rkyen bal po'i bzo bos ‘‘rmā pad kha ’’'dis nga tsho'i lag shes rku yi 'dug ces gshe gshe btang tshul yang zer sgros yod pa/ gang ltar dus de nas bzung khong gis zangs bzo'i lag shes mkhyen te skyes sbyang gi lag rtsal rtser son gyis rdung rgyu dang / tshag las/ lug dpar/ 'jim bzo bcas kyang gcig shes kun grol ltar byung ba ma zad/ sku brnyan gyi cha tshad mdo rgyud dgongs don dang mthun pa'i zangs bzo chen mo ba skad grags ldan pa zhig byung ba de nas bzung rtse gdong zangs bzo'i lag rgyun dar 'phel byung zhing / spe'i drung nor bzang ni shod rgyun ltar na rang bzhin ma yin pa'i slob dpon chen po'i rnam par sprul pa zhig yin lugs pad+ma thang yig gam bka' thang zangs gling zhes pa las kyang gsal ba'i lung zin gyi sprul pa yin par grags/ gang ltar khong gis skyes sbyang gi phyag rtsal mthar phyin khong du chud de dang thog bzo phud du khong rang khyim tshang bde skyid khang gsar ba'i rten gyi gtso bor gser zangs kyi o rgyan rin po che'i snang brnyan mda' tshad ma zhig bzhengs gnang mdzad rjes nub rtse gdong gnam rtse dang / byang pad+ma 'od ri khrod/ shar rin chen sgang bcas dang / lhor kho rang nyid kyis gsar btab mo dgon bsam gtan gling ri khro da bcas phyogs bzhir gser zangs kyi o rgyan rin po che'i snang brnyan mi tshad tsam re bzhengs gnang mdzad pa ma zad/ khong gi phyag bzhes kyi yong 'bab chud mi mdza' bar mchod rgyun kho nar smin gtong mdzad mthar khong nyid mo dgon bsam gtan gling ri khrod du tshogs bsags sgrib sbyong gnang slad rgan chos gnang ste ri khrod de nyid du sku tshe'i 'du byed stong pa bcas kyi lo rgyus gsungs rgyun yod/dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur skabs bde skyid khang gsar ba'i mkhar 84

dbang gzhung len la brten rten gtso snang brnyan de dag chus su yod skabs sku brnyan de zhid nas ring srel mang dag phebs pa dngos su mig mthong lag zin gyi ngo mtshar khyad chos ldan pa zhig byung yod pa dang / de 'brel rtse gdong khyim shar zer ba'i rten gtso gu ru rin po che zhig yod pa de'ang bde khang spe'i drung nor bzang gi phyag bzo yin pas ‘‘rigs gsar mi’skabs sku rten nyar blos bzod bral gyis rtse gdong phu shar nang mtsho zhig yod par skyur dgos byung yang /chu nang rtsa ba nas ma dim par chu'i mthar phebs rkyang byung rkyen rdza gseb cig tu sbed dgos byung rjes chos dad rang mos kyi srid jus bzang po'i skabs rdza gseb nas gdan zhus kyis rtse gdong chos sder phul te deng skabs chos sde'i rten gral du bzhugs su gsol yod pa bcas rtse gdong zangs bzo'i lag rgyun bdeskyid khang gsar ba'i spe'i drung nor bzang gis rtsa ba btsugs te de'i bu dbang 'dus rgyal po dang / de'i bu 'dzam bha ('di dmangs bcos gong sa gnas srid gzhung gi 'dod dpal zangs rdung chen mo ba drung gtogs kyi go gnas bskos pa de yin )bcas skad grags ldan pa'i chen mo ba mi thog gsum byung ba dang / de min 'das grong song zin pa'i chen mo ba'i gras mgron dpon bso da nams dbang 'dus dang / rdzong dpon pa tshing nor rgyas/ lcang rag g.yung drung bcas kyi mi thog dang / de rjes kyi mi rabs 'das grong song ba mgron po dbang rgyal dang / lcang rag phun tshogs dbang 'dus ('di dmangs bcos ngo/nga 'dod dpal zangs rdung chen mo drung gtogs kyi go gnas bslos pa de yin )bcas dang / da lta 'tsho zhing yod pa'i zangs bzo'i chen mo ba khang lhag 'dzam lha rdo rje dang / khang lhag spen rdor ('di deng sang rgya gar du yod pa )bcas gong gsal chen mo ba 'di rnams kyi lag rtsal khyad chos ni rdung rgyu dang / 'jim bzo/ tshag las/ lug dpar/ ri mo bcas tshang ma khungs sne re re brgyud ma dgos par mi gcig rang gis shes pa de yang 85

sku brnyan cha tshad mdo rgyud dgongs don dang mthun thog kho tshos bzhengs pa'i sku brnyan spyi dang mi 'dra tsam mtshar sdug yid dbang 'phrog pa'i khyad chos yong gi yod stabs rtse gdong lha bzo'i 'jon thang skad grags ljongs yongs su khyab gdal gyis gtso bo de snga'i bod sa gnas srid gzhung dang / sa skya/ se 'bras dga' gsum sogs dgon sde khag dang / bla brang che khag gzhan yang 'byor ldan khag bcas dbus gtsang stod smad gang sar ma khyab pa med pa ma zad/mtsho sngon sogs zhing chen 'ga' zhig dang / tha na 'brug 'bras sogs la'ang khyab yod/ nye dus la mtshon na bde khang che mo 'dzam bha dang / lcang rag che mo phun tshogs dbang 'dus gnyis ni lag rtsal phul du byung ba zhig yin pas rwa sgreng rgyal thog tu bsam yas nyams gso'i skabs dbu rtse'i gser zangs rgya phib gsar bzhengs dang / khams gsum zang mkhar gling / khra 'brug gtsug lag khang gi nye gras brgyad sogs gsar bzhengs mjug skyong gi chen mo ba bde khang 'dzam bha yin pa dang / rwa sgreng gtsug lag khang nyams gso gnang skabs rten bzhengs chen mo ba lcang rag phun tshogs dbang 'dus yin zhing / nang tshan bde khang chen mo ba 'dzam bha lag rtsal mkhas nges kyang / 'go 'dren 'gro khungs zab los sogs kyis lcang rag chen mo ba phun dbang la de snga'i sa gnasasrid gzhung nas kyang mthong che byed kyi yod pa bcas rtse gdong zangs bzo'i rten bzheng lag rgyun thun mong ma yin pa 'di dag gong smos phyug po bde skyid khang gsar gyi spe'i drung nor bzang nas bzung dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur phan rten bzhengs zangs bzo chen mo ba mkhas can mang dag cig byung ste bod kyi sa gnas gang sa gar rten bzhengs dar khyab ci che byung yod kyang /bar skabs ‘‘rig gnas gsar brje'i ’’nang lag shes bzo rtsal de dag 'gro khungs med par gyur te ha lam lag rgyun stong nye'i gnas su gyar yang / tang gi skabs bcu gcig pa'i krung u tshang 'dzoms gros tshogs thengs gsum pa'i 86

srid jus bzang po'i 'og sgo gang cir nyams pa sor chud mi nyams gong 'phel gtong gnang la brten deng dus rtse gdong gi rten bzhengs zangs bzo rgan gras re zung 'tsho bsdad yod rkyen mi rigs kyi khyad chos ldan pa'i lag rgyun slar yang nyams gso byung ste nye lam bkras lhun du paṇa chen rin po che'i sku gdung snga rjes gsar bzhengs dang / sa skya/ se ras gtsos lha sa khul/ a mdo/ skye mdo sogs la rten bzhengs byed dang byed mus bcas phun sum tshogs pa'i lag shes bzo rtsal de dag khungs stong ma song ba'i slar gso yod mus lags so/

gzhis rtse grong khyer khongs bkra shis skyid tshal khul gyi mi rigs lag shes bzo las kyi 'phel rim/ gzhis rtse grong khyerasrid gros/de yang paṇa chen sku phreng bzhi pa blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan chen pos gzhis rtse khul la sogs pa'i gatreng khul gyi lag shes bzo las pa thor bu rnams gcig bsdus gnang skabs gzhis rtse bkra shis skyid tshal khul gyi da lta'i mi rigs lag shes bzo las 'di gsar 'dzugs gnang zhing / de'i nang zangs rdung dang / phra bzo/ tshag pa/ lug pa/ 'jim bzo/ rdo bzo/ shing bzo/'tshem bzo sogs bzo rigs rnam grangs mang dag cig yod 'dug paṇa chen sku phreng bzhi pa gzugs sku'i bkod pa chos dbyings su 'thims tshul bzhengs skabs gsung 'bum nang phyag mdzod blo bzang dge legs kyis bla mar sri zhu chen po'i sgo nas 'khur blangs te/ sku gdung rin po che bzhugs pa'i mchod sdong bzhugs khang dang bcas pa bzhengs pa'i bzo rigs pa sogs kyi do dam du lhan dung lha ba phun tshogs rab brtan dang / mgron gnyer gzhon par mngags shing / sprul pa'i bzo bo bi sho karma gnyis pa lta bu chos dbyings rgya mtshor bzo bkod pa mdzad/ shing bzo mkhas dbang chos dgon blo gros kyis dbus/ dbu chung gram pa rdo rje sogs byings so lnga dang /rdo bzo dbu mdzad gnam mthong bkra shis/ lha bkras/ dbu chung mdzes dpe 88

rdo ra sogs bcu gsum mkhas mang bsdus nas sku gdung lha khang gsar skrun mdzad pa dang / lha 'bri ba mchog gyur dge slong blo bzang lags kyi dbu mdzad kyi 'gan bzhes/ shes pa'i blo mig rab tu yangs pa bal po'i mkhas pa 'phrul gyi dbu mdzad bkra shis/ rdzi na de'o/ brdung pa dbu mdzad rdzi na can dang / grwa pa dbu mdzad la'an rnam rgyal sogs gtso bor gyur pa mkhas rtser son pa bcu phrag lnga tsam yod 'dug dus de nas bzung dgon kyi lha sku rten gsum gyi lag bzo'i sgrig 'dzugs gtan 'khel gyi sku phreng bzhi pa'i skabs gsar skrun gnang ba'i rta rwa dang / klu lding gcig dgon gyi lha sku rten gsum bzhengs pa'i bzo grwa gnang zhing / skabs der bzo rigs khongs bal po'ang yod pa dang / de rjes bal bzo rgyun ring las bzhugs byas te phan tshun nyams myong spel res byed pa sogs kyis bzo rigs 'dir yar rgyas chen po byung 'dugade rjes paṇa chen sku phreng lnga pa blo bzang ye shes kyi rnam thar dz+nyo'od darkya/ra can gyi phreng ba 〉zhes pa'i nang ‘‘sku gsung thugs rten bzhengs yul nub kyi klu lding bcas rgyang grags brgal ba'i sar spo dgos byung bar bkra shis skyid tshal du bzo rigs rnams sdod gnas dang / dung mtsho'i 'gram du rta rwa gsar rgyag byed dgos byung ba ’’sogs gsal ba ltar na dus de nas bzung bkra shis skyid tshal klu lding bzo rigs zhes pa'i ming gzhi byung bar nges/ bal bzo dang rgyun ring mnyam las byas stabs bkra shis skyid tshal du bal pos ‘‘rgyal po a tsa ra ’’zhes pa ltar brten stabs dus de nas bzung yul de'i lhar gyur te deng skabs kyang bkra shis skyid tshal gyi yul lha ‘‘rgyal po a tsa ra ’bsten bzhin pa yin/bal po'i lo gsar skabs sgar zing zhes pa 'khrab byed kyi yo byad 'dra min dang / 'tsho ba'i yo chas kyang dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur bar bzo grwa der yod skad 'dug 89

bkra shis skyid tshal klu lding lag shes bzo grwa der zangs bzo dang / phra bzo/ tshag pa/ lug pa/ dngul bzo/ rdo bzo/ 'tshem bzo sogs lag shes bzo rigs kyi 'go gtsor ‘‘klu lding dpon mi’zhes pa'i go thob yod pa'i bkras bla'i zhabs 'bring gnas drug pa gcig dang / de'i gsham du dbu chen/dbu chung bcas yod/ dbu che mor zhabs sdod kyi thob thang thog grwa pa'i 'gyed skal yang yod pa phud/ de min lag shes byings rnams bkras dgon bla brang gi lto zan thog rgyun ldan grwa par yod pa'i 'gyed dang / bzhes spro 'gag chen/'gag chung bcas phyed thob re yod pa dang / sa/zhung las nam tshugs skabs bkras dgon bla brang rtse phyag nas dgos cha zhes/ ja mar dang / gnyer tshang las khungs nas rtsam pa phran tsam bcas sprod srol yod/ skabs de'i lag shes bzo rtsal gtso che ba ni lug tu blug pa'i li'i snang brnyan de rnams la bkra shis skyid tshal gyi ‘‘bkras dge'i li ma ’’zhes skad grags yod la/ phyogs mtshungs grang gser 'dul spyong dang mchod chas 'dra min sogs kyang lug tu blug pa dang / de bzhin spyi tshogs thog 'tsho ba'i spyod chas dngul gyi sgrog tse'i yo chas cha tshang / khra dban khra stegs/ bod mi rigs kyi pho mo'i gser dngul gyi rgyan cha sogs lag brdung gi rigs sna tshogs bcas thon pa byed kyi yod/paṇa chen sku phreng dgu pa chos kyi nyi mas chos dad mang tshogs kyi gsol ba 'debs yul gyi don du thugs bzhed bla med kyis 'dzam gling thog gser zangs kyi sku brnyan che shos skad grags ldan pa'i rig dngos byin can bkras dgon rgyal ba byams pa chen po de nyid gtso bo bkra shis skyid tshal lag shes bzo rigs rgan rabs tshos 'bad pa hur len gyis gsar bzhengs legs sgrub thub pa byung yod/chu phag (1923)lor paṇachen sku phreng dgu pa chos kyi nyi ma mes rgyal nang sar phebs rjes bod sa gnas srid gzhung nas dza bla ngo mas zhes pa'i 90

dpon rigs lnga drug tsam ched gtong gis nang sgang gi gzhi rtsa'i 'gan dbang yongs rdzogs 'dzin skyong byas kyang skabs shig ring kho tsho nang sgang gzhung las kha nga gi bya ba cher med stabs sku drag de rnams kyis rang so so'i mkho byed dang /lha sa sogs dga' nye khag nas mngag bcol byung ba dper na/ sku gsung thugs rten/ 'tsho ba'i spyod mkho'i yo chas dngul gyi sgrog tse/ sgrogs dkar/khra dban khra stegs/ dngul phor/ dngul rgyan sogs mi nyung ba zhig bzo skrun bya rgyur bzo pa skul 'ded kyis nyin ji song gi lto chas nar gtong dang / gla cha'i thad sngar srol phran bu re sprod pa dang re zung gis rngan pa gang 'tshams sprod kyi yod skad las don snying skabs bstun gyi las ka bskul rgyu kho na las/sgrig 'dzugs la shugs snon dang / shul 'dzin gso skyong / dus skabs dang 'tshams pa'i lag rtsal yar rgyas gong 'phel gtong rgyu sogs la shugs snon dam 'dzin rtsa ba nas byas med par brten bkras dge bzo rigs kyi sgrig gzhi yang nyams zhan du gyur te 'tshem bzo/ rdo bzo sogs khag gcig rim bzhin sgrig 'dzugs de nas phyir don 'dug rung rtsa ba'i nang sgang gi lto zan sngar mus yin pa red/rab byung bcu drug pa'i me glang (1 937)lor paṇa chen sku phreng dgu pa mchog skye rgu mdor dgongs pa chos dbyings su 'thims tshul bzhes rjes gzhis byes ser skya mi dmangs tshang ma'i re 'dun ltar sku gdung rin po che bod du gdan zhus kyis gdung rten sogs mchod khang srid gsum mdzes rgyan bzhengs skabs rtsa ba'i mi dmangs la khral 'ul sna tshogs bskul 'ded byas pa ni smos ma dgos kyang bkras dge bzo rigs gtso bor byas pa'i khul 'di'i lag thes bzo rigs mi dmangs bcas kyis gdung rten gsar bzhengs nang 'bad thabs kyi 'bras bu g.yur du za ba thon pa byas yod/paṇa chen sku phreng na rim nas snga phyi bar gsum du rgyal gces kyi dgongs 91

pa'i dar cha mthor bsgrengs gnang zhing / lhag par paṇa chen sku phreng bcu pa chen po ni mes rgyal gcig gyur la srung skyong dang / mi rigs mthun sgril la shugs snon/ kha bral la ngo rgol gyi mdzad phyogs la g.yo 'gul spu tsam med par rgyal gces kyi mdzad pa bsam brjod las 'das pa kun gyi slob sbyong zhu 'os su gyur pa kun gyis mkhyen chos ltar ma zad/ paṇa chen sku phreng bcu pa chen po gdan sar zhabs sor 'khod rjes gang gi mdzad pas lo rgyus yun ring ldan pa'i bkra shis skyid tshal mi rigs lag shes bzo rigs 'di yang shul 'dzin gso sbyong dang 'brel sngar lam ltar khungs so sor tshag pa dbu chen dang /zangs brdung dbu chen/ lug pa dbu chen bcas so sor zhabs 'bring rim pa bdun gyi go thob thog zhabs sdod spyi mtshungs ltar zla rer phog thob nā sgor 70re bstsal ba dang / bzo rigs so sor dbu chung re bsko bstsal gyis skabs der bka' 'brel gzhung las che phra khag le med sgrub dgos pa ltar/ paṇa chen sku phreng bcu pa chen pos ljags bkod gnang ba'i gser zangs kyi rten gtso tshe lha rnam gsum dang / sgrol ma stong sku sogs gsar bzhengs zhus pa dang /spyir btang mang tshogs kyi 'tsho ba'i dgos mkho gser tshag ldan pa'i khra dban khra stegs/ dkar brgyad sde brgyad/ dngul gyi sgrog tse'i yo chas cha tshang dang /dngul phor dngul rkyan/ pho mo'i gser dngul gyi rgyan cha/ g.yer kha che chung sna tshogs sogs thon skyed byas pa rnams yul gru gang sar khyab che tsam byung yod pa red/ ‘‘rig gnas gsar brje'i ’’dus rim nang sngon gyi lag rtsal mkhas can rgan gras khag la gral rim gyi zhwa mo g.yogs te snga rting du bzo rigs kyi skyid sdug nas phyir 'bud byas stabs zhing las thon skyed nang zhugs dgos byung 'dug pa phud/ de byings bzo bo rnams kyis zhing las thon skyed kyi mkho byed thongs lcags/ 'bru 'don 'phrul 'khor/ btsab gri/ 'jor sogs stabs bstun gyi thon skyed mi nyung ba zhig byas/ tang gi skabs bcu gcig pa'i 92

krung u tshang 'dzoms gros tshogs thengs gsum pa 'tshogs tshun dang / lhag par bsgyur bcos sgo dbye'i mdzad phyogs kyi srid jus yang dag pa'i rtsa don 'og mi rigs lag shes bzo las de yang slar gso byung ste/ gzhis rtse grong khyer mi rigs lag shes bzo las cus kyi thad ka'i 'go khrid 'og gzhis rtse grong khyer bkra shis skyid tshal gser dngul zangs chas las snon bzo grwa 'dir mi dmangs srid gzhung nas khang rgyag gron dngul sgor khri 8dang / dge phrug gso skyong gi ched dngul sgor khri 3tsam gnang ste slar gso dang / sgrig gzhi gsar 'dzugs gnang bas/ bkras dge bzo rigs 'gan 'khur mi sna dang / dge rgan rgan rabs tshang mas tang dang srid gzhung gi gzigs skyong thugs 'khur gyi bkra shis rjes dran thog rang mi rigs kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i lag shes rnam grangs khag la mig 'bras ltar gces 'dzin dang 'brel shul 'dzin gyi slob ma mang po gso skyong sbyong brdar byas par phan 'bras nges can thob ste/da yod mi grangs 70tsam yod pa nas brgya cha dgu bcu tsam na gzhon yin pa dang / rgya che'i mang tshogs kyi dgos mkho sngar mus ltar bskong thub pa'i thogabazo grwa 'di nas thon pa'i khra dban khra stegs dang / zing phor bcas la rgyal yongs thon rdzas phul byung gi gzengs bstod thob yod pa dang / rgyal khab kyi yang ba'i bzo las pu'u yi gnas gzhi'i bzo grwa zhig yin pa dang / tang krung dbyang dang mi dmangs srid gzhung gi chos lugs srid jus yang dag pa'i bka' drin dang / gzigs skyong 'og mi dmangs la bsnyad gtser rtsa ba nas med par paṇa chen sku phreng dgu pa bar gyi sku gdung lha khang mchod khang shar bkra shis rnam rgyal 'di paṇa chen sku phreng bcu pa chen pos ljags bkod ltar bskyar bzhengs legs sgrub kyis dad ldan ser skya mang tshogs kyi gsol ba 'debs yul deng rabs kyi bzo rtsal ldan la mi rigs kyi goms gshis dang sangs rgyas chos lugs pa'i 'gro lugs tshang ba bcas kun gyi yid 'phrog pa 93

zhig byung zhing / sku'i gdung rten ni dngul gdung yin pa dang / dbus su gser dang / g.yu byur/ gzi sogs rin po che sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa dang /gser zangs kyi snang brnyan/ gser gtso ma'i 'khor yug sogs mchod chas bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ bkra shis rnam rgyal chen mo'i yang thog gi rtse la gser zangs kyi rgya phibs bzo bkod gnyis ldan sogs bzo skrun gyi las rim dang /phan 'bras bcas la yongs su cha tshang ba'i sgo nas gzhan gros re bcol ma dgos par khul 'di'i bzo rigs kho nas rang stobs rang spel gyi sgo nas bzo skrun byas pa kun gyi gzigs lam du lham mer gsal ba ltar dang / rgyal srid spyi khyab khang nas paṇa chen sku phreng bcu pa chen po'i sku gdung mchod khang gsar skrun gnang rgyu sogs la gzigs skyong bla med kyis de sngon mchod khang shar bkra shis rnam rgyal la'ang gong mtshungs ched dngul stsal bas snga rjes gnyis rob tsam bsdoms na khyon ched dngul sgor khri 2026gnang ba ma zad/ las don khag bde blag tu 'grub ched zhib phra'i byed phyogs gtan 'bebs dang 'brel rgyu cha mkho 'don yang gnang yod/ sku gdung mchod khang 'di nyid la khyon gser srang bdun stong dang dngul rta mig ma brgyad brgya bzhi bcu tham pa dang /shing cha li'i h+phang ( rgya dpangs gru bzhi )1233 lcags rigs tun 135 69 zangs shog tun 10 9 ar 'dam tun 885tsam bcas song yod/ 'di dag gsar bzhengs kyi las rgyun lo ngo brgyad tsam nang mi rigs lag shes bzo pa dper na/ rdo bzo ba dang / shing bzo ba/ lcags bzo ba/gser bzo ba/ khra bzo ba/ lug pa/ 'jim bzo ba/ lha 'bri ba/ chos lugs gzungs las pa/ 'tshem bzo ba sogs bzo rigs tshos sku gdung lha rdzokhang gsar zhengs kyi las ka legs grub thog las rigs khag bcu grangs gnyer pa brgyud lag rtsal thog 'phel rgyas dang / gsar gtod bcas la'ang 94
