grub 'bras mi dman pa thob yod pas mi rnams ngo mtshar skye 'os pa zhig byung yod/kun gzigs paṇa chen rin po che sku phreng bcu pa chen po'i gser gdung mchod khang gsar skrun zhu skabs de sngon mchod khang shar bkra shis rnam rgyal gsar bzhengs zhus pa'i nyams myong phun sum tshogs po yod pa'i khar/ lag rtsal byang chub pa'i rgan rabs pa yang khag gcig yod pas lag rtsal thad la'ang rgyun mthud thub pa byung ba dper na/ de snga lag rtsal gyi shes bya med pa'i dge phrug chung shos lo 12nas 20tsam gyi bar mi grangs 80tsam rjes su lag rtsal rang mgo rang thon gyi tshad mi 'dra ba'i gso skyong spyong brdar thob pa dang / lag rtsal shes bya'i rnam grangs gtso bo shing bzo dang / rdo bzo/zangs bzo/ tshag pa/ lha 'bri ba sogs kyi mi rigs lag shes kyi lag rtsal pa gsar pa mi nyung ba zhig thon thub pa byung yod/mchong/ khang 'di'i bzo rtsal rnam grangs kyi thad dper na/ rgya phibs lta bur cha mtshon na/ rgya phibs kyi hor pa dang / gzhung bzang / klong dra/ chu dzar/ chu srin/ tog skyog gnam 'brug gyad mi/ gardzir/ ri dwags pho mo/ bya khyung / chos 'khor sogs dang / mda' g.yab rgya phra'i me long la lwañtsa 'bur don dang tog pad ma rang 'grigs/ lha khang la zur seng dang spen rgyan rnam dbang dang / e waṃ/ rgyal mtshan/ lha khang nang mchod rdzas phan mgo rdzi par dang / gdung rten dngos la rgyal chen dang / seng ge/ pad ma/ zur bkag khri drug btegs sogs gser dngul zangs bzo'i bzo rtsal dang / de min tshag rgyag rgyu dang / tsha ser 'dul sbyong dang 'brel tsha gser gtong rgyu/khra bzo/ gzhan yang mchod rdzas 'dra min sna tshogs dang / gser zangs sku brnyan sna tshogs bzhengs rgyu/ dril bu sogs lug rgyag rgyu sogs ci rigs pa zhig yod la/ de bzhin ar las kyi shing sgrig khag dang / rgya phibs dang 95

mchod rten gyi shing sgrigs/ ri mo 'dra min sna tshogs bzo dkrol rgyag rgyu/'jim bzo'i sku brnyan 'dra min sna tshogs bzhengs rgyu/ ldebs bris su dkyil 'khor dang / sku brnyan zhing bkod rang lugs ltar gyi ri mo 'bri rgyu sogs rang rang lag shes bzo rigs sna tshogs pa zhig gis mi rigs rang nyid kyi bzo rtsal dang khyad chos 'don spel thub pa byung yod/paṇa chen sku phreng bcu pa chen po sku 'tsho bzhugs skabs bod mi rigs kyi lag shes bzo las chung ngu nas chen por 'phel rgyas gtong gnang mdzad rgyu'i dgongs gzhi zab mo yod pa dper na/ gzhis rtse khul la sogs pa'i lag shes thor bu ba khag gcig bsdu rub kyis gangs rgyan mthun gnyer khang nas mi rigs lag shes bzo las gnyer skyong gnang rgyu'i 'char gzhi zab mo bting gnang yod kyang / dgongs gzhi de dag dngos su 'grub ma thub par re zhig dgongs pa chos dbyings su 'thims tshul bstan rung / dgongs don ni spyir btang zhig gtan nas ma yin zhing / slad nga tshos gang gi rlabs chen gyi dgongs gzhi zab mo de phyis mi rigs lag shes bzo las 'phel rgyas gtong rgyu'i stobs shugs su 'gyur bar byed dgos nges shig yin pa bcas so/96 ri

ga dang dmag sgar gyi skor dang rang nyid kyi 'brel yod gnas chul rags tsam/ snyan grong gongaspa bsodanams/ga dang gzhis rtse rgya sbyong dmag sgar ni rgya sbyong dmag gsum stong tham pa'i gras shig yin zhing / de'i mi 'gro yong khungs thad gtsang khul pa snam dang / 'dus byung / dbang ldan/ gting skyes/ gam pa/ sa skya/ lha rtse/phun gling / rta nag gdong dkar/ gzhis rtse/ e sgang / rtsed gdong /thob rgyal/ rnam gling / rgya mtsho/ lha bu/ gling dkar/ rin spungs bcas rdzong gzhis so so'i khongs gtogs sger pa/ gzhung rgyugs/ chos gzhis bcas kyi khyim tshang khag gcig la dmag rten sa zhing rkang re (son khal 40tsam 'gro ba )yod pa nas dmag mi re 'khri 'dzugs byed dgos/ dmag brten 'dzin mkhan khyim tshang gis mi ngo bcug na dang / de min mi 'gro gzhan glas byas te btsugs na'ang 'grig 1930lo tsam gyi nang lo re mi rer dmag gla dngul srang 80re dang / dbyar dgun gyon dod dngul srang 12re sprod len byed pa dang / 1940lo tsam nas rim 'phar gyis dmag gla dngul srang 350re dang / dbyar dgun gyon dod dngul srang 12re sprod len byed cing / dmag mi thog mar gsar 'jug byed skabs gzhis brtser ‘‘bzhugs res ’’zhes mda' dpon gyi sku tshab re yod pa'i sar dmag gsar rang lo 18nas lo 30man ngo ma dang / 'dra bcas mi gnyis re 'khrid de go lo min spyan zhu byed dgos shing / de'i skabs 'khri khungs so sos ‘‘bzhugs res ’’la sha mar/ bya 97

'bras sogs kyi 'bul mtshon khyer nas nang bcar zhu dgos pa dang / dmag mi go lo gtan 'khel byung mtshams dmag gsar de'i lag par bal skud kyis lhas pa'i lag tse zhig bzos te ‘‘bzhugs res ’’kyis der tham ga rgyag srol yod/ gtan 'khel zin pa'i dmag mir 'khri khungs nas gyon chas lus rkang cha tshang dang zla gnyis phogs 'bab rtsam pa/ sha mar/ ja/ tshwa bul/ lag sne dngul bcas blo khengs sprod dgos kyi yod/ga dang dmag sgar la phran rang dmag zhugs skabs 'go dmag khyon bsdoms grangs 1052yod pa dang / 'go byed mda' dpon gnyis/ ru dpon bzhi/ brgya dpon brgyad/ lding dpon bzhi bcu tham pa bcas yod/de'ang mda' dpon gnyis ni sa gnas srid gzhung gi sger pa shod drung rim bzhi'i khongs nas bsko gtong byed pa dang / de min ru brgya lding bcas ni dmag mi'i khongs nas bsko gzhag byed srol mchis shing / ru brgya lding bcas 'das pa dang / 'pho 'gyur byung ste tshab gsar bsko gzhag byed skabs dmag mi'i khongs nas go rim bzhin 'os bsgrug bya rgyu min pas ru brgya lhan khang gis gros bsdur gtan 'bebs bya dgos pa dper na/ ru dpon zhig gsar bsko bya rgyu yin na brgya dpon gyi nang nas 'os mi gnyis bsgrug dgos pa dang /brgya dpon zhig gsar bsko bya rgyu yin na lding dpon gyi nang nas 'os mi gnyis bsgrug dgos pa/ lding dpon zhig gsar bsko bya rgyu yin na bcu dmag yongs kyi nang nas 'os mi gnyis bsgrug dgos pa bcas byas thog ru brgya lhan khang gros bsdur gyis 'os dang gnyis bsgrigs nas 'char zin bzos te mda' dpon la dgongs skor zhus thog bod sdod skabs bod ljongs dmag spyi khang dang / khams sdod skabs mdo smad spyi khyab la 'char gzhi'i snyan zhu phul te chog mchan zhu dgos/ 'go byed gsar bsko byed skabs mda' dpon dang /ru brgya bcas la bza' sgo gang 'tshams yod pa dper na/ 'go byed byed 98

'dod yod pa'i mi tshos mda' dpon dang / ru brgya bcas la dngul dang dngos po'i 'bul mtshon khyer nas nang bcar zhu ba ma zad/ da dung 'ga' shas kyis re don gtan 'khel byung mtshams 'bul rgyu'i ‘‘skyabs 'dzin ’’zhes dngul 'dzin bzos nas 'bul srol yang yod/ der brten mang che ba go rim gyi nye ltos sam yang na 'go 'dren bzang ba dang / rgyu shugs che ba sogs kyi dbang du 'gro rgyu smos ci dgos/skabs der dmag sgar spyi yongs su me mda' me sin ghan (ces chang che ba )gnyis dang / lu'u si snyan (cis chang 'bring ba ) bzhi/ snye reng ghan (sbag sbag ) bzhi/ kreng ghan (sbag sbag chung ba ) brgyad/ mde'u rgyab grangs 80tsam/ lag sbom rgyab 5tsam bcas dang / 'go dam/ga mi rer lag mda' dbyin ji kha thung rtse gri rang 'grigs re/ 'go byed lding dpon yan la mde'u rtog 50re/ bcu dmag mi rer mde'u grangs 25re bcas rtsis sprod byed kyi 'dugamada' dpon la srid gzhung gi phogs thob zur yod thob/ dmag sgar nas mda' dpon rer zhabs khongs zhes dmag mi bco brgyad kyi gla phogs cha tshang 'bul dgos pa dang / ru dpon re la zla rer 'bru ru'i khal 10re dang dngul srang 50re/ ru dpon la dmigs bsal gyi thabs rten zhes lo re 'bru ru'i khal 180re lo ltar srid gzhung gi 'bru mdzod nas 'don sprod byed srol 'dug brgya dpon re la zla re 'bru ru'i khal 6re dang dngul srang 30re/lding dpon re la zla re 'bru ru'i khal 4re dang dngul srang 20re/ bcu dpon dmag me 'dra ba mi rer zla re 'bru ru'i khal 2re dang dngul srang 10re bcas sprod len byed pa dang / yang de min 'go dmag yongs la 'bru phogs zhes rgyal rtse sa khongs 'brum pho lha gzhis da nga / khang gsar gzhis/ shangs khul bkras rtse gzhis bcas kyi gzhis 'dzin nas snga dus 'go dmag mi rer 'bru 99

ru'i khal 7dang bre 10re sprod lam yod 'dug kyang / bar lam zhig nas de dag dngul bsgyur btang ste lo re lo rer dngul srang bco brgyad dang zho lnga skar phyed brgyad re lo ltar sprod srol yod pa dang / khams sdod skabs 'bru phogs bsdu len du mda' shog re nas brgya dpon re res bskor gyis lo ltar bod du 'gro dgos kyi yod pas yar mar brgya dpon ngo g.yog la rta 'ul 3dang / khal ma 4 mar lam dngul 'bab 'gel khal 8tsam re bcas lam 'khel mi ser nas bskul gtong bya rgyu'i srid gzhung gis lam yig sprod kyi yod pa da nga / de 'brel khams sdod skabs su 'go dmag gi dmag gla dang / dbyar dgun gyon dod bsdu bar lo ltar lding bcu nas 'gro dgos pas/ lding bcu rnams thog mar rgyan dkyus gyis ang rim bsgrigs nas lo re mda' shog re nas lding dpon ngo g.yog gnyis dang / bcu dpon gnyis 'gro rgyur yar mar lding dpon la rta 'ul gnyis dang / bcu dpon re la rta 'ul re/ lding bcu spyir khal ma 5 yar lam 'go dmag 'tshams rtags 'gel khal 10tsam re/ mar lam 'go dmag mi 12rer 'tshams rtags 'gel khal re brtsis bsdoms khal ma 45tsam re bcas mi ser nas bskul gtong bya rgyu'i srid gzhung gis lam yig sprod kyi yod/ dbyar dgun gyon bsdur 'gro mkhan lding bcu la za sgo phran bu yod pa ste/ bsdu yul lung tshan lding bcu phyogs bgos kyis dmag 'khri re'i sa nas ‘‘'ded gla lto dod ’’ces dngul srang gang re dang / de min 'khri khungs so sos sha mar ja chang sogs mjal zhu phran bu byed lam yod pa ma zad/ mar lam dngul 'bab la rgya zog nyo sgrub kyis 'khyer nas lam bar tshong bsgyur byed bzhin skyod skabs khe bzang yang gang 'tshams yod pa red/ de mtshungs 'bru phogs len skyod brgya dpon gyis kyang mar lam dngul 'bab la rgya zog sgrub 'khyer gyis lam bar 'tshong bsgyur byas nas khe bzang yong 'bab phran bu yod pa/ dmag sgar du 'byor 'phral so sos dngul 'bab gra sgrig byas te ru brgya 100

lhan 'dzoms sar 'bo dmag khungs so sor sprod dgos kyi yod/dmag sgar sdod yul du srid gzhung gi dpon rigs che khag don gcod lta zhib sogs la 'byor skabs phebs bsu phebs skyel la 'go dmag tshang ma ru sgrig thog gus btud zhu dgos pa dang / mda' dpon la rgyun du chibs zhabs zhes lding dpon gcig dang / bcu dpon gcig dmag dkyus nyi shu rtsa lnga bcas la nga/ra cha dang / rnga dung / 'ba' cha sogs rang 'grigs ched 'dzugs kyis mda' dpon sdod yul nye 'gram du bca' sdod dang 'brel 'gro sdod gang du sku srung 'bral med byed dgos kyi yod/ khams phyogs sa srung du sdod skabs sa gnas de ga'i zhi drag spyi 'doms ni mda' dpon yin pas/khral bsdu/ khrims gnon dang drag po'i jus 'god sogs mda' dpon gyis 'go khrid byed dgos kyang dmag sgar nang gi gal che'i don gnad gong rim la snyan seng dgos rigs ru brgya lhan khang gis mda' dpon la dgongs bskor zhus te/ mda' dpon gyis gong rim la snyan 'bul rta shas ched gtong bya srol dang / de min dmag sgar 'go dmag gi khrims bkod tshang ma ru brgya lhan khang gis thag gcod byed lam yod/ rgyun ldan nyin ltar dgong dro'i chu tshod 4pa tsam la ‘‘sgrol dung ’’zhes dung brda zhig btang 'phral lding dmag yongs rdzogs dmag sgar gyi thang sder du 'dzoms nas sgrol ma tshar 21re krig car 'don nga/gos pa dang / de'i thog tu las don bkod sgrig dang nyes chad gcod rgyu sogs yod tshe khyab bsgrags byed srol yod/ zla re'i nang dmag rtsal (me mda' 'phen stangs/ shed sbyongs sogs )sbyong brdar thengs re gnyis tsam byed pa dang / zla re'am/ zla gnyis re'i mtshams su rtses bsher chen mo thengs re byed kyi yod pas de'i skabs so so'i rtsis sprod go lag mdel bcas tshang ma rakhyer nas 'dzoms thog ming tho klog pa dang sbrags re re bzhin du go lag gi ang grangs dang / mdel bcas zhib bsher byed kyi yod/ rtso/nga gsal 101

sgrig bsher khag gi skabs la chad pa dang / go lag mi tshang ba sogs byung tshe skabs so sor sa/nad don brtsad zhib thog nyes 'tshab che chung la gzhigs pa'i nyes chad las khral nyin grangs 'gel ba'am/ yang na ko lcag dang / rta lcag grangs dpyad zhu ba sogs kyi thag gcod ru brgya lhan khang nas byed srol yod/gzhan yang rgyun du lding bcu re bskor gyis lding dpon gnyis dang / bcu dpon gnyis nas nyin bdun re 'gan 'khur gyis dmag sgar nang dang / sde zhol du rkun ma dang / 'khrug rtsod sogs kyi gnad don mi lhag pa'i rtog zhib bskor g.yeng byed dgos pa dang / gal srid gnas tshul byung na chung gras nang 'dum thub pa bskor g.yeng lding bcus thag gcod byed pa las de min ru brgya lhan khang la snyam/ seng 'phral 'phral zhu dgos/dmag mis sger gyi dpal 'byor thabs 'tshol byed phyogs thad khag gcig gis phyogs mtha' nas bza' ca'i rigs dang / de min gyon gos kyi dngos rdzas sgrub ste 'tshong gnyer byed pa dang / 'ga' zhig gis gos lham 'tshem bzo'i las ka byed pa/ 'ga' shas kyis g.yag lug sgrub nas bshas 'tshong rgyag pa/ yang re 'gas 'bru rigs sgrub ste chang 'tshong ba sogs rang rang sger gyi dpal 'byor 'phel rgyas gtong ba'i thabs lam sna tshogs spel chog srol yang yod/phar tshur 'grul bzhud skabs mda' dpon la rta 'ul 1dang / khal ma 15 chibs zhabs dmag 25la so sor rta 'ul re dang / khal ma gcig dang phyed ka re/ ru dpon la rta 'ul 6dang / khal ma 10re/ brgya dpon la rta 'ul 4dang / khal ma 7re/ lding dpon la rta 'ul 3dang / khal ma 5re/ rnga dung mkhan dang dmag dar 'khyer mkhan/ 'ba' cha/ dge rgan sogs mi grangs 45tsam la rta 'ul re/ bcu dpon 40la bzhon rta re dang bcu dmag mi rer khal ma gcig dang phyed ka re/ mda' shog re la spyi rdzas 'gel khal 102

40tsam bcas skul chog pa'i thob thang gtan 'bebs yod/ de bzhin tsha zhag gang 'khel sar go bab sdod sgrig thab gdan dang / me shing yan lam 'khel mi ser nas go sgrig byed dgos pa'i lam yig sprod srol yod pa dang / sa gnas so sor 'byor 'phral 'go byed tshor go bab la gzhigs pa'i sa mjal zhes sa gnas de ga'i 'go pa dang / rgan po yong ste mjal zhu byed srol yang yod/dmag sgar la spyi gsog yong khungs ni 'go dmag tshe 'das song ba dang /yulakhyol song ba sogs kyi tshab gsar dmag sgar du ma 'byor bar gyi phogs thob rnams spyi gsos/ tu 'jog gi yod cing / de dag snga bar phyi gsum du ru brgya lham khang dang / bdag gnyer 'thus mi lding bcu gnyis bcas kyis do dam byas nas bun gtong byed pa dang / gzhan yang lding dpon nam dmag mi re 'gar tshong rtsa ma dngul bun gtong gis ma srang 100la khe srang 50re lo ltar bun rtsis rgyag rgyur gtong ba sogs kyi ma skyed rim gsog byas stabs spyi rdzas 'bru dngul yang khyon 'bor mi chung ba zhig yod pa de dag gi thog nas dmag sgar gyi dgos mkho rnga dung dang dar cha/ de bzhin gur dang / gdan chas/thab chas sogs bzo sgrub byed pa dang / gzhan yang spyi gsog nas 'gro gron btang ste lo ltar nye skor dgon sde nas bla sprul dang dge 'dun gdan zhu byas te bstan srid bde thabs dang / nad mug 'khrug rtsod zhi ched rim gro thengs re gnyis byed pa ma zad/ skabs re ma ṇi dung sgrub bam/ sirdi dung sgrub thengs re tsam yang gtong srol yod/ de min lo ltar dbyar dus dbyar gsol zhes 'go dmag tshang mas gzab mchor spras te ru sgrig gis lha gsol byed pa dang de nyin 'go dmag tshang mar lha chang yang bster srol yod/ de rjes mda' dponartsodang / ru brgya lding bcas la dbyar gsol thugs spro nyin gsum re tsam dang / dgun kha lo gsar tshes gcig nyin ru brgya lding bcas nas gzab 103

mchor spras te thog mar mda' dpon la lo gsar gyi rten 'byung mjal dar 'bul ba dang / de rjes tshes 3tsam nas 'go byed yongs la thugs spro nyin gsum re tsam bcas kyi 'gro song spyi gsog nas btang ste spro skyid gtong srol yang yod/'phrod bsten gyi skor mda' shog re la srid gzhung gis lcags po ri'i sman pa re gtong gi yod cing / sman pa der dmag sgar nang rgyun ldan thob thang yongs rdzogs brgya dpon dang 'dra ba yin/ des 'go dmag la nad gzhi byung tshe sman bcos 'gan 'khur byed pa dang / lo ltar srid gzhung nas sman rgyu sne 'dzoms kyi sman phogs sprod lam yod/ sman rigs bzo sbyor byed sgo sman sbyin rang gis 'gan 'khur byas te las mi dgos rigs dmag sgar nas skabs mtshams so sor dmag mi gtong gi yod/dmag chas gyon gos thad dmag sgar khams phyogs su sdod skabs lo drug bdun re'i mtshams su gzhis 'khor la yong skabs bod ljongs dmag spyi khang la snyan seng zhus te chog mchan thob pa brgyud 'khri khungs so so nas dmag mi rer bod lugs dmag gos bzo byed snam bu spu phrug 'doms pa 14('doms rer kung khre gang dang phyed ka re tsam )re dang / tshos gla 'tshams dod dngul srang 30re bsdu len byas te tshos rgyag gis dmag chas gyon pa bzo ba dang / zhwa lham bzo 'tshem byed pa/ ras sa mdog gi stod thung gos thung cha tshang re dang / lham rgyu ko ba/ gyon pa'i gong rgyan rgya log sogs spyi gsog dngul nas btang ste nyo sgrub kyis bzo skrun byed/ dmag chas snam bu bsdu skabs spus tshad sogs kyi skor la 'khri khungs so sos ru brgya dang / bzhugs res bcas par 'bul rten sha mar/ bya 'bras sogs 'khyer nang bcar zhus te go lo yong thabs byed dgos kyi yod pa red/ ga dang dmag ni mang che ba khams phyogs su sa srung sdod dgos kyi yod cing / snga dus dmag sgar stong 104

dmyo/ga hril sgril gyis sde dge lcang rwa khu'/ gyi sa srung du bsdad yod pa dang / de rjes ru shog dang po dang gnyis pa mda' shog gcig dang / ru shog gsum pa dang bzhi pa mda' shog gcig byas te go rdzas dang / spyi chas tshang ma phyogs bgos kyis dmag sgar khag gnyis su dbye nas khams phyogs yas mas sam/phan tshun gyi sa srung du bca' sdod byas 'dug spyi 1940lor ru shog dang gnyis dmag sgar 'go dmag rnams gzhis 'khor du yong ste gtsang khul sdod bzhin skabs rang gi pha de nyid kyang ga dang ru dpon gnyis pa yin zhing /1941lor rang nyid rang lo 17la son skabs ga dang dmag sgar nang zhugs nas rang lo 18la lding dpon byas pa/ 1942lor ru shog dang gnyis dmag sgar gyi mda' dpon snye mo mdo mkhar ba bsko gzhag gis bod ljongs dmag spyi khang gi bkod 'brel hor sbra chen sa srung du bskyod nas der lo gcig min tsam bsdad rjes khams rdza sdod karma g.yu rdzong khul gyi sa srung du 'gro dgos byung zhing / der lo gcig tsam sdod ring rang nyid dbyar dgun gyon dod bsdu bar gtsang khul bskyod nas phyir 'byor skabs dmag sgar brag g.yab sa srung du spo bskyod zin 'dug brag g.yab tu lo gnyis tsam bsdad pa dang / de rjes mdo spyi'i bka' 'brel dmag sgar sde dge 'jo mdar sa srung du spo bskyod kyis sde dger lo gcig lhag tsam bsdad rjes slar yang rang nyid dbyar dgun gyon dod bsdu bar 'go mkhan lha sar 'byor skabs lha sa dmag sgar gsar pa'i khang srung lding pa dbang de nyid nad 'das song tshab tu lha sar sdod dgos zhes gong rim gyi bkod 'brel ltar 1947nas 1951lo bar lha sar khang srung 'go byed dang / bod ljongs dmag spyi khang gi yig 'bri/ ja gnyer gcig lcogs byas/ de'i skabs 1948lor rang gi pha de nyid lo na mtho khar rkang pyobardabs gcong gi rkyen pas dmag zhabs 'pher min la brten lha sar 'byor nas ru dpon las gnas dgongs zhu'i snyan zhu phul bar chog mchan thob ste rang khyim 105

du bsdad yod pa dang / mda' dpon snye mo mdo mkhar yang mda' dpon 'phos nas lha sar 'byor song zhing / mda' dpon gsar pa dkar byung par bsko gzhag gis ru shog dang gnyis dmag sgar sde dge sa srung du sdod mus red/skabs der mda' dpon mu bya ba dang / ru shog gsum bzhi'i dmag sgar yang khams khyung po khul gyi sa srung du bsdad yod pa dang / de'i mjug tu mdo smad zing 'khrug langs nas bod dmag pham nyes byung ste/ go lag rnams bcings 'grol dmag gis rtsis bzhes gnang thog lam phogs sprod gnang dang 'brel rang khyim la phyir log gnang don lha sar rim 'byor byung song bar bod ljongs dmag spyi khang nas khyim gzhis sa thag ring thung la gzhigs pa'i lam phogs 'bru dngul sprod gnang dang 'brel sa gnas 'khri khungs so sos gnas skabs ring dmag mir 'tsho skyong rogs ram byed sgo'i lag 'khyer yang sprad song / de skabs ru dpon bzhi pa'ang lo na mtho stabs lha sar dgongs zhu'i snyan zhu phul te chog mchan thob yong ba bcas la brten/ rang nyid ru dpon gyi shul mi zhig yin stabs bod ljongs dmag spyi khang brgyud rang la ru dpon gyi go gnas zhu rgyu'i snyan zhu phul bar sa gnas srid gzhung nas mgo mchan gnang gsal/ru dpon gnyis bzhi gang 'os shig gi ming thog tu 'char 'bul byung bstun khyod rang la dmigs bsal gyis ru dpon bsko gzhag yong 'gro bas de don khungs su 'di thog nas mol 'thus kyis zhes bka' shag gi tham ga 'byar ma zhig sprad son byung yang / de mjug lha sar bcings 'grol dmag dpung khag gcig 'byor ba'i bzhugs yul dmag sgar gsar par gra sgrig gnang song don rang nyid lha sar sdod 'dod ma mchis pas khang srung dmag bdun po dang bcas gnas skabs gzhis 'khor la dgongs pa zhus te gtsang khul rang khyim du bsdad mus thog 1956lor rin spungs bde smon du rgya rigs wu'u hru'u ci dang / hā ji tsang / thung si kan tse yon sogs phebs nas rdzong rim pa'i gra 106

sgrig don gcod khang 'dzugs rtsis gnang song / skabs der rang nyid kyang de'i nang zhugs nas rin spungs su slob grwa'i dge rgan byas pa yin/ 'on kyang de'i phyi lor dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur lo drug 'gyangs lugs kyis don gcod khang de ma gnas stabs rang nyid khyim du bsdad mus yin pa dang /gong gi dus tshod de'i ring la ga dang dmag sgar gyi 'go byed ru brgya kha shas gzhis rtser yod pa tshos sa gnas srid gzhung la snyan zhu phul te dmag mi khag gcig log sa sdod gnas med pa 'khyams lus kyis sprang 'gyings mi shes pa'i gnas su 'dug pas/ dmag sgar rnying khungs kyi bde sdug la dgongs nas phogs thob gsol ras yong ba dang 'brel gzhis rtser bskong sdod byas chog pa zhes zhus par/ sa gnas srid gzhung gis mda' dpon mu bya bar gzhis rtse spyi rdzong dang / mda' dpon gcig lcogs thog 'go dmag brgya skor zhig la phogs thob gnang lugs dang / de mjug mda' dpon mu bya ba gro mo spyi khyab tu 'phos tshab mda' dpon gsar pa nu ma bsko gzhag dang 'brel 'go dmag bzhi brgya skor la phogs thob gnang nas gzhis rtser bca' sdod byas/ de'i skabs rang nyid ni khyim du bsdad mus yin pas zhib cha ma shes kyang 1958lor sa gnas srid gzhung gis dmag sgar la bka' rgya btang nas khams tshong 'ga' shas kyis lam bar mi ser la brnyas 'phrog sna tshogs byed kyi yod 'dug na mi ser gyi nyen srung du dmag sgar nas rgyal rtse sa khongs khang dmar rgyud du brgya dpon gcig dang / lding dmag 50dang / sna dkar rtser lding dpon gnyis dang dmag 30bcas 'dzugs gtong byed dgos phebs par sna rtse'i nyen srung du lding dpon 1dang dmag 30ched gtong byas te lding dpon gcig gus pa 'gro dgos zhes bkod mngags btang 'dug pa ltar sna rtser 'gro skabs 'byor ba'i nyin mo de rang la sna rtse'i sa khongs 'ong sgo khang shar gyi khyim du khams tshong mi gnyis 'byor bsdad kyis de'i nub nā yang stong sgam gcig 107

bor brlag song tshul la brnyas de khang shar gyi dre'u gnyis 'phrog bcom byas pa'i gnas tshul zhu 'byor byung don lam seng rdzong gtso dang / phran tsho 'go dmag bcas rjes 'ded du 'gro skabs khams tshong gnyis po thon zin te phran tsho mthong 'phral dre'u bzhon nas myur bskyod kyis bros 'gro yi 'dug gang 'tshams rjes 'ded byas kyang rjes non dka' stabs rgyang thag 'os 'tshams shig nas me mda' 'phen dgos byung don khal dre'u rnams dkyur 'jog gis mi gnyis po dre'u re bzhon te bros shor song bar brten khal drel rgyab cha rang 'grigs rdzong gtso dang / dmag sgar zung sbrel gyis do dam byas pa'i nang mi ser gyi dre'u gnyis po de'ang 'dug pa do bdag khang shar la rtsis sprod byas pa dang / de byings bdag bzung gis sa gnas srid gzhung la gnas tshul snyan zhu phul yang / khams tshong gnyis po ltag log gis lha sar 'byor nas srid gzhung la snyan zhus kyis srid gzhung nas dre'u dang / dngos po phyir sprod byed dgos pa'i bka' rgya phebs stabs phyir sprod byas pa yin/ de nas zla gcig tsam song mtshams su dmag sgar gyis gus pa brje le'o/ du lding dpon ga'/na zhig btang nas gus rang gzhis rtser yong dgos pa'i yi ge 'byor pa ltar gzhis rtser phyin te lo gcig min tsam bsdad mjug dgongs zhus kyis rang khyim du yod pa'i skabs lha sar zing 'khrug langs pa dang / gzhis rtser dmag sgar 'go dmag rnams do dam gnang zin 'dug cing / skabs der rang nyid khyim du bsdad pa las gzhan gyi gnas tshul gang yang med na'ang rang dgar sdod blos ma bzod pa ra gzhis rtser phyin nas gra sgrig u yon lhan khang du gnas tshul zhu bcar skabs nyin shas slob sbyong la 'gro dgos zhes dmag sgar gyi 'go byed mnyam du bskyal gnang byung / de rjes lha sar gtong gnang gi zla ba brgyad tsam slob sbyong la bsdad rjes spa se dang sbrags gu yang byung bas rang khyim du 'byor sdod skabs bskyar zhib las 'gul brgyud rang gi 'byung khungs mnga' tshab la dbye 108

nas blu nyo'i srid jus lag bstar gnang byung ba dang / bskyar zhib tshar rjes shang gis dmangs btsugs slob dge byed dgos gsungs don ltar slob dge lo gsum lhag tsam byas pa yin/ de rjes gral rim 'thab rtsod dza drag che bas mang tshogs dang 'brel 'dris byed thabs med stabs slob dge bzhag nas zhing las byas te bsdad pa dang / de rjes 1981lor srid jus don 'khyol gnang ste rang nyid la phogs thob gnang thog las byed ngo mar bsgyur gnang byung ba bzhin them tho yang rdzong nang bsgyur nas rdzong mi dmangs srid gzhung do na gcod khang du las ka bkod sgrig gnang byung / deng skabs rdzong mi dmangs srid gzhung rtsom sgyur khang gi las ka byas te bsdad yod pa bcas so/

ru thog khul du de snga mi ser gyi gyen log rim par byung ba'i nang gi don rkyen zhigamanga' ris sa gnasasrid gros lo rgyus bsdu rub tshogs chung nas/ru thog ni de snga bod yongs dang 'dra ba'i chos srid gnyis ldan bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi sku drag dang / mtho rim grwa pa'i srid dbang sger 'dzin 'og mi ser rnams gdug rtsub che ba'i gnya' gnon dang bshu gzhog tshad med myong dgos kyi yod par brten mi dmangs kyis gyen log byas pa'i lo rgyus gnas tshul rim par byung 'dug pa de tsho'i nang nas mtshon tshul mngon gsal dod po zhig ni gsham gsal te/ rab byung 16me yos (1927)lo'i gong tsam la rdzong dpon mthu stobs dbang phyug zer ba zhig byung ba kho pa de sngon rdzong dpon ma byas gong du gzhung tshong gi las gnas 'khur nas ru thog tu slebs 'dug pa dang / de rjes ru thog mi ser 'go pa kha shas dang kho pa 'cham mthun ma byung stabs/ kho par rdzong dpon gyi dbang cha thob 'phral 'go pa kha shas ske breg gi yin zhes 'jigs gtam bshad pa dang / don du bsnyad 'dogs 'ga' shas byas rkyen ra bang dang / steng rtses gtsos 'go pa tshang ma mnyam gros kyis rdzong dpon mthu stobs la gyen log bya rgyu'i sems thag bcad cing /lo ltar bod zla 6pa'i nang ra bang leb rar rdzong dpon ngo ma khral bsdu ba dang /tshong rgyag par 'gro gi yod pas de dus 'go pa rnams nas brda yig gcig bris pa'i nang ‘‘'di lo rdzong dpon khyed 'di ga ra bang leb rar yong gi yod na sdug 110

srog skyel bar shog nga tshos 'di gar dmag sgar rgyab yod ririces 'khod pa de 'byorari 'phral rdzong dpon kho pa lam bul dkar po zer ba nas rdzong la phyir log mi byed ka med byung zhing / phyir log byas te khos kyang dmag rgyag rgyu'i gra sgrig byas nas bsdad pa bcas la brten lo der ra bang sogs leb ra khag 'tshog thub med pa dang / de'i ston kha tsho pa so so'i 'go pa khag dang grwa tshang gi 'go khrid bcas khag gcig lha sar bka' shag srid gzhung la zhu gtug byed par bskyod cing / zhu gtug byed par 'gro mkhan gyi mi sna ni ra bang 'go pa rta mgrin lha dbang dang / grags pa rgyal mtshan/ jo jo/ o rgyan/ rting smad 'go pa dkar po 'byor ldan/ lcags khang 'go pa bu tsha/ dbo byang 'go pa chos 'phel/ gus pa'i bu chung / grwa tshang lhun grub chos lding nas dpon gragakhusdo pa brtson 'grus/ dpon chos dar grags pa/ shag brtson 'grus sogs yin pa dang / rting smad 'go pa sba lug dang ra bang 'go pa chung bdag bkra shis sogs 'go pa 'ga' shas kyis mi ser rnams la 'go khrid nas sdod rgyu byas thog rdzong dpon mthu stobs dang thug 'phrad mi byed rgyu dang gal te thug 'phrad byas pa yin na khos gsod rgyu'i nyen kha yod pa'i don gnad gsal bshad byas te dogs zon lhad med byed dgos pa'i kha ta bslab bya yang byas/de'i dgun kha mnga' ris sgar dpon rag rtsib pa zer ba de mi dmangs kyi bde sdug smu zhib 'jug blta rtog byed mkhan yin khul gyis ru thog tu 'byor zhing /'go pa sba lug sogs ched 'bod kyis nyin der sgar dpon sar rdzong dpon mthu stobs dang / 'go pa sba lug chung bdag bkris sogs 'go pa khag gcig dang zhu gtug byas/ zhu gtug sar 'go pa sba lug gis rdzong dpon mthu stobs nas khrims med lugs med byas pa rnams re re bzhin ther 'don byas stabs rdzong dpon mthu stobs ci bya med par lus/ 'on kyang sgar dpon rag rtsib pa dang / rdzong dpon mthu stobs gnyis khyi spyang lag sbrel gyis snga sa nas 111

lkog g.yo ngan byus bshams zin yod pas gang 'tshams shig nas sgar dpon rag rtsib pa zhu gtug sa nas langs te phyir song ba dang / mthu stobs kyis snga sa nas gra sgrig byas yod pa'i rgyug khyi ma chen mkhas btsun zer ba dang /mchod ba/nas yin zer ba'i mi 'khyam khams pa gnyis bcas phyi log tu sgug bsdad yod pa de gsum mthu stobs kyis skad btang nas 'go pa sba lug dang /chung bdag bkra shis gnyis 'dzin bzung bsdam bkyig byas thog rdzong dpon mthu stobs khos am phrag nas me mda' thung mda' zhig bton nas 'go pa sba lug la mde'u gsum dang / chung bdag bkra shis la mde'u gnyis bcas brgyab pas/ sba lug gi rgyu mar phog pa dang / chung bdag bkra shis kyi lag pa ya gcig bcag me mda'i sgra thos pa dang dgon pa nas grwa pa khag gcig gis sba lug dang chung bdag bkra shis skyob par rgyug yong ba dang / skal bzang 'phel rgyas kyis sba lug dang chung bdag bkra shis gnyis kyi bsdams thag 'grol bar phyin te thag pa grol skabs rgyug khyi zhig gis skal bzang 'phel rgyas kyi mgo la gri gzhus nas rmas skyon bzos pa dang / khang pa'i sgo'i phyi log tu ra nag dge slong dang / rgyug khyi khams pa gnyis lag 'dzings thug ste gri ring thung shor nas ra nag dge slong gi mgor gri phog nas de gar shi ba dang / rgyug khyi 'ga' res gri dpa' dam 'khyer nas phyi log tu yod pa'i mang tshogs rnams ded phyin/ mthu stobs kyi bza' zla yon tan sgrol mas rdzong gi rtse thog nas me mda' ring mda' kha shas mang tshogs dkyil la brgyab nas mang tshogs rnams gar 'gro 'di 'gro med par zang zing lang long du gyur pa'i skabs der mos skad shugs chen pos bshad don/ ‘‘mi dkar po rnams gsod cig mi dkar po rnams kyi rkang pa gcog zhog ’’zer ba dang / kho pa mthu stobs rdzong du log phyin/ de nub 'go pa sba lug sa ma rub tsam la shi ba dang / ra nag dge slong de rang du shi ba/ chung bdag bkra shis lag pa bcag pa/ skal 112

bzang 'phe'/ rgyas kyi mgo la rmaru/ skyon chen po byung nas khong zla gcig tsam nyal sar lus pa bcas kyi rkyen pas mang tshogs rnams 'jigs skrag dang sdug bsngal gyi gnas su gyar zhing / khong khro'i me lce gnon mi thub par mi gsod khrag dmar gyi don rkyen gnas tshul snyan zhu dang sbrags mi sna ched gtong gis bka' shag srid gzhung la zhu gtug byas stabs/ de rjes bka'ari shag srid gzhung nas rdzong dpon mthu stobs 'bod 'gug gis gyo da gtug byas mthar bka' shag srid gzhung nas mthu stobs la rta lcag brgya phrag kha shas gzhus shing ske la sgo g.yog ste lho shel dkar rdzong du rgyang 'bud btang ba red/gong gsal gyod gzhi zhu gtug lo gcig lhag tsam byed ring rdzong tshab la mthu stobs kyi bza' zla yon tan sgrol ma dang / g.yog nor rgyas tshe ring zer ba gnyis bsdad yod cing / phyi rgyal la tshwa tshong 'gro dus rdzong la tshwa khral rgyag dgonu/ kyi yod pas dbyar kha zla ba lnga pa'i nang 'bong pa g.yu lha zer ba'i mi ser zhig tshwa tshong bar 'gro skabs rdzong tshab nor rgyas nas tshwa kha grangs brtsi bar yong nas don dag gang yang med par 'bong pa g.yu lhar gri btsugs nas dmar gsod btang ba ma zad/ nor rgyas kho pa rdzong la phyir log slebs skabs yon tan sgrol mas kyang snying tshims mdog gis de ring jo lags sku grib bzhes yod pas/ 'khrus bskyon zhig ces bshad yod skad/ de'i phyi lo smon grong rtse drung mkhyen rab kun bzang zer ba zhig rdzong dpon du bskos nas rdzong dpon gyi dbang cha rtsis len byed skabs nor rgyas dang yon tan sgrol ma ru thob/ tu lkog tu khang pa zhig la bsdad yod pas/ de dus mang tshogs rnams kyi snying nad gnon mi thub par grwa pa dang mang tshogs khag gcig gis mtshan mor kho tsho'i khang pa'i thog khar rdo gzhus pa sogs byas rkyen kho tsho skrag nas sdod blos ma bzod par nam ma langs tsam la phyir thon nas bros phyin pa dang / de'i shul khang pa'i nang du kho rang tsho'i drel pa a blo zer ba de la mang tshogs kyis ske 113

la thag pa brgyab ste khang pa'i thog la btags nas bsad/ de'i nyin rdzong dpon nas mang tshogs la ra mdar 'gro dgos lugs bka' phabs par brten mang tshogs khag gcig gis rjes 'ded btang ste wa rong zer ba'i ri'i sgang du rjes zin nas phan tshun me mda' rgyag res byed skabs rdzong dpon mthu stobs kyis dmar gsod btang ba'i 'bong pa g.yu lha 'das po'i bu karma zer ba des nga'i pha'i dgra sha len par 'gro gi yin zer yang nor rgyas kyi me mda' karma la phog nas ri mgo de rang du shi ba dang / mang tshogs khag gcig dang rdzong/dpon mkhyen rab kun bzang sogs la dwags la 'gro sa'i lam khu lu'i sna zer ba der sgug nas bsdad pas/ nyin shas song rjes nor rgyas sogs lam kha ma shes pa dang char pa mang po babs pa sogs kyi rkyen pas phyi rgyal la 'gro sa'i lam de gar slebs pas/ phan tshun 'dzing res byas te rdzong dpon mkhyen rab kun bzang gi me mda'i mde'u zhig nor rgyas kyi phrag par thebs te de gar 'dzin bzung byas nas ru thog tu 'khrid yong yang rkun ma'i rgyab rtsa rdzun mas byed zer ba'i dpe ltar/ nor rgyas nyin shas bzang btson la bcug tsam byas rjes do dam ma byas par glod/de rjes lcags lug ( 1931)lor bka' shag nas mthu stobs kyis mang tshogs la zang zing dang / rnyog gra bzos pa'i skor/ rtse drung bal po dang / rtswa rdzong brag dkar dbang phyug ser skya gnyis bka' zhib la mngags gtong byas nas lo de'i dgun kha'i ring gtan sdod byed skabs yon tan sgrol ma dang /rtse drung bal po gnyis lkog tu gab mthun byas pa mang tshogs kyis shes nas bka' shag srid gzhung la 'phral du snyan zhu phul bar brten de'i dbyar kha zla ba drug pa tsam la bka' shag srid gzhung nas dmag mi nyi shu dang / brgya dpon gcig bcas nyin mtshan bltos med btang thog sgar dpon nas rgyab gnon byed dgos pa'i bka' 'byor te rtse drung bal po dang / yon tan sgrol ma/114

nor rgyas tshe reng bcas tshang ma 'dzin bzung gis btson chas spras nas lha sar khrid phyin/ de nas zla ba gcig tsam gyi mjug tu mthu stobs shel rdzong nas glod de rgya gar brgyud la dwags nas ru thog tu slebs pa dang de 'phral bka' shag nas yon tan sgrol ma dang / rtse drung bal po'i gyod gzhi dang chabs cig mthu stobs bros phyin pa'i nag nyes sogs la brten nas mthu stobs slar yang 'dzin bzung gis lha sar btson khang du bcug nas rta lcag gzhus mthar shi ba dang / de rjes yon tan sgrol ma dang / nor rgyas gnyis rgya gar la 'khyams nas yon tan sgrol ma mtsho pad+mar shi/ nor rgyas tshe ring la dwags dgon du shi ba bcas thengs 'di'i gyod gzhi ni snga mo'i kha rgyun du ‘‘kha mchu su rgyal zer na dpon po rgyal ’’zer ba'i dpe ltar/ ru thog 'thus mi rnams lha sar lo snga tsam sdod dgos byung ba dang / sde pa gzhung gi dpon khag la zhu rten dang / mi sna'i zas sdo da kyi 'gro song rdo tshad mang po song yod pas mi ser rnams la gyong gun brjod las 'das pa zhig byung yod/ de'i 'gro song gi dngul rnams ser byes grwa tshang nas g.yar yod pa de dag bod zhi ba'i bcings 'grol ma btang bar 'jal tshar thabs byung med/ ru thog mi dmangs la cha mtshon na don rkyen de dag myo/nga gyong rgun kho na las rgyal kha thob pa gcig kyang byung myong med la/yong yang mi srid/ 'on kyang gung khran tang dang ma'o kru'u zhi'i dbu khrid 'og bod du dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur thob pa brgyud ru thog mi dmangs kyang gzhi nas yar langs bde skyid thob thub pa byung ba bcas so 115

ding rir bzhugs res kyi lo rgyus rags tsam bkod pa/ljongasasrid grosa.uyon phar bachu 'brug (1952)lor ding ri dmag sgar gyi mda' dpon brag 'jun bstan pa tshe ring gi skabs su ding rir bzhugs res kyi ngo tshab skabs de'i gzhis rtse spyi rdzong tha'i ji zom phud lha dbang nor bus lo gsum ring bogs mar blangs te zom phud pas mda' dpon brag 'jun la lo re shug bogs bod dngul ṭam rdo sum brgya tham pa'i thog lo re mda' dpon la 'khri ba'i lha ldan smon lam chen mo'i skabs ya sor gyi rta pa bcu gnyis gtong rgyu'i 'gan len byas don bzhin 'khri sgrub byas pa dang / sa gnas su las 'khur ngo tshab phran phur bu btang byung zhing / zom phud pas bzhugs res bogs len byas pa de ni 'char can khral bsdu'i yong 'bab kho nar dmigs pa zhig ma yin par de bas lhag pa'i mnga' khongs mi ser thog tshong 'khos thabs len byed ched yin gshis/ phran ngo tshab mi 'gror tshong rtsa ṭam rdo nyis stong tham pa dmis/sa bkar gyis sprad de lo re ma dngul de dag la bun tshong rtsis rgyag bya dgos pa'i las 'gan dkris byung bas/ tshong rtsa ma dngul gyis gzhi rtse khul nas 'bru rigs dang / ja/ snam chas/ zon lham/ lham shol tse/ rta chas srab rmed sogs tshong zog sna tshogs sgrub 'khyer gyis bzhugs res kyi dbang cha spyad nas ding ri sa khul gyi mi ser dang / gzhan yang khyab khongs sa dga' khul gyi 'brog 116

rigs la lo 'dir bkram pa'i tshong zog gi rin 'bab phyi lo bsdu ba'i lam lugs bzos te zog rim/ la 'bri g.yag dang / lug bal/ dngul sogs thon khungs sne rigs bsdu len byed kyi yod/ gong gsal tshong 'khos len thabs de thog nas zom phud par bun tshong khe 'bab smos med thog da dung ngo tshab la'ang khe 'bab mi nyung ba tsam zhig yong gi 'dug ding rir bzhugs res 'a/ skyid grong dang / rong shar/ kha ta/ gnya' nang bcas kyi sa gnas spyi khyab kyi 'gan dbang yod par brten rong shar rgyud bal khongs sa char tshong rigs dang / 'grul zhud byed mkhan la shwa rdor smad du zhib bsher byed mi gcig dang / khum bu khul tshong 'grul la zhib bsher byed mi gcig sa mtshams sa gnas so sor 'gag sgo'i tshul du 'jog dgos/ tshong 'grul pas 'gag sgor ston byed lam yig bzhugs res nas zhu dgos la sa mtshams de gnyis su gtso bo tshong 'grul par zhib bsher byed khul tsam las zhib tshags de tsam byed srol med/bzhugs res kyi las 'gan lci ba gzhan zhig ni ‘‘gor shug— chings dngul ’’zhes pa bod sa gnas srid gzhung nas gor ṣa rgyal khang la ‘‘a lad ’’zhes gor ṭam khri gcig re sprod dgos pa'i dmigs brten la mnga' ris dang /'brong pa/ sa dga'/ rdzong dga'/ skyid grong / gnya' nang / mkhar stagagating skyes/ gam pa/ shel dkar/ phun tshogs gling / lha rtse/ ngam ring /ding ri bcas kyi mi ser la 'bri dang g.yag lug bcas skye med 'chi med kyi 'gan len lam lugs su rtsis sprod byas thog lo re 'bri g.yag rer rgyab dod gor ṭam 25re dang / lug re nas gor ṭam 2re lo ltar bsdu len byed pa/de'i khral ming la ‘‘rgyab dod ’’ces zer zhing / lo re'i khral 'bab bsdu len byed mi bzhugs res dang / ding ri dmag sgar nas ‘‘'phrang 'gag ’’pa zhes dmag mi gsum re gtan 'jags 'jog gin yod pas mi de dag bkol spyod 117

kyis gor shug chings dngul sprod byed pi|nga gsal rgyab dod dngul 'bab bsdu len byed par lo re'i bod zla 6nas 'go tshugs te/ bod zla 11nang bsdu mjug sgril zin rjes bod zla 12par bal yul rgyal sar bzhugs res ngo bskyod thub na dang / de min dmag mi'i zhal ngo zhig mngags gtong gis dngul 'bab gor ṭam rnams do po bzhi bzos nas gnya' nang bar mi ser thog rta khal skul 'ded kyis bskyod thog de nas gnya' shos mi ser mi grangs bcu gtong srol khongs ‘‘la pa ’’zhes gor skad shes mi gcig skad sgyur du btang ste dngul dos dang / lam chas dgos mkho rnams mi'i sgal par 'khur te nyin brgyad ring 'phrang 'gros chu brgal dang / nags gseb tu dka' spyad kyis bskyod mthar gzhi nas bal yul du 'byor gyi yod/ bal yul du bza' sdod tshang ma'i 'gro gron nar gtong las gor ṣa phyogs nas lta rtog gang yang med/dngul 'bab bal gzhung dngul khang du rtsis sprad rjes blangs pa'i byung 'dzin bka' shag la 'bul lam zhu dgos/ dngul skyel mi bal yul du sdod ring bal yul gzhung nas ‘‘su pa ’’zhes pa'i go ming yod mkhan zhig ched btang byas pa'i 'gro rogs 'og rdo ring zhig dang / gcan gzigs gling kha/ rgya bal rim byung khri phebs gnang yul tshogs khang chen mo bcas la lta bskor du khrid srol yod/ gor shug chings da ngul sprad 'phros nas bka' shag thugs spro'i 'gro song thog ṭam rdo nyis brgya re dkrigs car 'bul dgos/ da dung lhag 'phro bzhugs res rang nyid la'ang bed spyod bya rgyu yod/ding rir bzhugs res la de min gyi khral rigs yong 'bab bsdu khungs khag mang zhig yod pa dper na/ ding rir sa gnas gzhan nas rang rang thon khungs tshong 'khos su yong mkhan lha rtse nas bod snum dang / grang so nas rdza chas dang / shog bu/ mkhar ltag nas gshag lcam dang / snyug ma/ gzar bu/gzhong pa/ thong gug tog yu sogs shing bzo yo byad tshong zog sne rigs yod 118

pa nas tshong phud zhes sne grangs re bsdu len byed srol yod la/ gtan 'jags thab g.yog skul rgyu yod pa dang / ding ri'i yul mi chang ma so sos chang khral nyin ltar ka ras (shing bzo chang snod )gang re dang sbang ma tshod re skyel dgos pa der sngar srol rin 'bab gtan 'bebs bod dngul skar phyed brgyad re sprod pa de ni skabs de'i yul thang chang gong la gzhigs na'ang sne sel las med/de bzhin rnam kun bal las kyi thog nas lto tshe skyal mkhan rnams la'ang lo ltar lag khral bal nyag gsum nas lnga'i bar thengs re gnyis bsdu len byed par bal nyag rer gla lto bsdoms rtsam pa rgya phyed re las sprod kyi med pa dang / ‘‘la khrod ’’zhes pa sa khul 'brog rigs khyim dud bco lnga tsam yod pa de rnams sngar lam rgyun 'jags lo ltar bod zla 5tshes 1nas bod zla 10tshes 25bar 'char can ding rir dmar khe rgyag par yong dgos la tshong 'dus ring bzhugs res la nyin ltar lug sha bzhi ling re dang / lug lpags re skyel dgos par rin 'bab bod dngul zho brgyad re las sprod kyi med pas skabs de'i yul thang sha pags bsdoms bod dngul srang brgyad re byed kyi yod stabs gong tshad thad te bag chen po yod/ lo ltar bod zla 8pa'i zla mjug tu bzhugs res kyi ljag rtswa brnga bar du ba gnam gtong them dud re nas mi re nyin gsum ring skul ba skabs der them grangs 220tsam yod 'dug pa'i 'ul mi rnams la rtsam thug sla po zhig dang / gla dngul zho gsum re sprod pa ma gtogs de min rgyag rang 'khur gyis brnga 'dren byed dgos pa bcas de dag 'char can khral rigs bsdu skul byed phyogs kyi dpe mtshon tsam yin/sa glang (1949)lor sa dga' 'go pa rong dga' bde ba yin skabs zom phud pas lo re shug bogs ṭam rdo brgya re sprad de bogs mar blangs shing 'go pa'i khongs gtogs sde shog zang zang / ra kha/ kre pa lho/ kre pa skyid sbug/dga' shog kre pa byang ma/ re lha/ legs rtse/ kra bdun/ bu 'brog sba sba/119

rtsa rul chu rul/ phan che bcas ni sa dga' rdzong khongs gzhung rgyugs mi ser yin pa dang / mar khral bsdu khungs sa dga' rdzong khongs su gtogs kyang dpon khungs mi 'dra ba'i nang gses dga' bzhi dang / nang sgang / rdzong dga' rdzong / ser byes/ rgyud stod/ bshad sgra bcas kyi mnga' zhabs sde shog dang / gzhung rgyugs mi ser gyi ngo 'don phyugs rigs ji yod la lo gsum re'i thog mgo grangs rtsis bsher gyis rta gcig dang / g.yag gcigalug drug ra bdun bcas par leb re brtsis pa dang / gal te phyugs rigs rtsa ba nas med mkhan la sdod gur la leb re brtsis kyi yod/ gong gsal leb grangs la gzhigs te sa dga' rdzong khongs nas mar khral rta khal bcu gnyis re yod pa'i mar ltang drug brgya ma zin tsam bsdu len byed pa'i thog nas mar ltang lnga brgya tsam 'bras spungs tshogs chen la btang 'phros rdzong sdod sbrel por bgo bsha' rgyag rgyu yod/ de bzhin leb re nas leb khal zhes ṭam dkar re dang /sbra snam/ thug ral dkar nag bcas bsdu len gyis bla phyag las khungs su char can sgrig 'bul zhu dgos/ gong gsal mar khral bsdu len ma bgyis gong 'khri khungs rnams nas rdzong sbrel la ‘‘gzigs phud ’’zhes mar rgya ma lnga drug re 'bul len byed srol yang yod/lo ltar sa dga' 'go pa'i mnga' khongs nas stod rdzong khag tshwa sho/gzhung tshong pa la sogs par sbug dam dang / rgyal dam/ bka' tham bcas kyi lam yig nang gsal lam thog rta khal sne mang 'khri sgrub kyis 'khos dman mi ser tshor brdab mnar ci che myong dgos kyi yod/ rtse phyag las khungs kyi gzhung tshong pa dang / la dwags lo phyag pa/ shing tog 'phar sgrub pa/ sa bcud bum pa/ ru thog rdzong dang / tshwa sho gnyis/ rtsa hreng rdzong dang / tshwa sho gnyis/ spu hreng shin pa'i gling dgon/ bla brang ko pa tshwa sho/ 'brong pa spyi khyab/ gzhung ru tshwa sho/ dga' chos dgon/ ba tshwa bul tshwa sho/ dar rgyas gling dgon/ spub 120

brag dgon/ sa dga' rdzong shar nub/ jo nang rta ra bcas pas yar mar lam thog rta khal skul 'ded byed pa'i nang tshan rtse phyag las khungs kyi gzhung tshogs snga rting gsum tsam yong gi yod par lam yig nang gsal rta 'ul nyi shu skor dang / khal ma drug brgya tsam las med kyang lam yig dang ma 'brel ba'i 'phar skul gyis yar lam kho nar khal ma brgyad brgya skor zin gyi yod pa de ni gzhung tshong dos rgyab pas lha sa khul gyi stod tshong 'gro mi'i sger khal nang shug tu blangs te dos rgyab pa rang nyid kyi za sgo yong 'bab ched rta khal 'phar ma btsan skul byed kyi yod/ de min gong gsal rta khal skul 'ded pa tshos kyang rang rang lam yig nang gsal rta khal khyon 'bor la gzhigs te gang ‘star rta khal 'phar ma btsan skul byed cing / ma dor na lam yig la rta gcig khal gcig las 'khod med kyang ma mthar rta 'ul gnyis gsum dang / khal ma bcu grangs skor skul gyi yod/ rta tshugs so so'i rta khal skul bkod 'go par ‘‘zhal ngo ’’zhes zer zhing / zhal ngo tshos rta khal skul 'ded pa'i 'dod pa ltar rta khal 'phar ma ma btang tshe kho tshos dos khal 'byor thabs med pa'i sa char dus bkag thog slebs dgos rgyu'i btsan bka' 'bebs pa'am/ dos khal gyi dngos rigs tshang min sogs bsnyad dkri khag 'dogs ci rigs byed kyi yod stabs lam yig dang ma 'brel ba'i rta khal 'phar ma rang shugs su mi gtong mthu med ma dag rgyun 'byams chu ngan lam shor lta bur song bar brten skabs der sa dga'i mnga' khongs kyi rta dang / khal g.yag phal cher gyi sgal par sgal rma med pa mthong dkon pa'i gnas tshul la gzhigs na deng skabs 'gro ba mi tsam ma zad/ phyugs zog sems can la'ang bcings 'grol thob yod ces bshad chogaji 121

mkhan chung grags pa rnam rgyal gyi 'byung khungs dang des hor spyi byas pa'i lo rgyus rags bsdus shig shag ru shes rab rgyasatsho/grags pa rnam rgyal ni de sngon dpa' shod bla brang gi mgron gnyer byed myong mkhan tsha ba bskor chen khul gyi khral dud 'bring tsam yin pa'i smin drug tshe dpag zer ba de'i bu yin par grags shing / grags pa rnam rgyal chung dus dpa' shod dgon pa'i grwa pa byas pa dang / lo na son skabs 'jon thang che tsam yod pas kun bde gling gi zhabs sdod kyi go gnas zhus rjes sho mdo gzhis sdod zhus thob byung bas sho mdo'i khul yongs kyi khral bsdu khrims gnon byed sgo dang / mi ser phan tshun bar gyi gyod gzhi 'ga' shas zhib 'jug gis 'dum sgrig 'khon bral byas pa sogs mdo sde pa sngon ma'i skabs las dbang shugs che tsam byas 'dug la/ khong ni khrims lugs lag bstar byed phyogs thog bden don la gzhi 'dzin byed mkhan zhig yin par brten mi ser dmangs nas bstod bsngags kyang byed kyi yod/ mdo dgon pa zhes pa ni sngon ma'i lo rgyus thog nas btsan dgon lta bu'i mi ser thog khral khrims byed sgo'i skor la rdzong dgon zung sbrel gyi the jus byed mkhan zhig yin tshod 'dug kyang / grags rnam nas rdzong gi byed sgo rdzong gis byed pa las rdzong dgon zung sbrel dgos med kyi dbang cha ma sprad par brten mdo dgon pa'i grwa pas klan ka btsal te mi mang 122

dpung sgrig gis grags rnam la brdung brdzog gtong rtsis byas kyang / grags rnam gyis shes nas gnas skabs nyen g.yol ched khyung po ba bde gang lug zer ba mi blo stobs che la g.yo khram yod mkhan/ gzugs bong chen po zhig yod pa kho pa sho mdor tshong rgyag par yong ba dang skabs 'khel bas kho pa rogs su sbran nas dpon g.yog gsum mtshan 'grul brgyab ste mdo dgon pa'i nyen kha las ma bral bar bde gang ga lug gis bskyel rogs byas pa dang / de nas spo stod rdzi ra gnas po tshe dbang rab brtan dang sngon ma ngo shes rgyus mnga' yod par brten grags rnam dpon g.yog gsum rdzi ra bu'i 'brog sar bskyod cing /rdzi ra gnas pos de 'phral sne len byas te sbra khyim du bos pa dang / dpon g.yog gsum la bzhon rta re dang khal dre'u rgyab chas dang bcas lha rtse sa tshigs bar bskyal/ lha rtse sa tshigs yan sngar lam gzhung gi gtan lam dgongs don lag bstar gyis bskyod/ lha sar 'byor mtshams grags rnam gyis mdo dgon pa'i gnas tshul byung rkyen rnams kun gling bla brang la nan zhus byas kyang de 'phral bkal lan ma byung bas bod sa gnas srid gzhung la snyan zhu phul bar brten shing stas/ ( 1914)lor ta la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pa mchog nas grags pa rnam rgyal la gzhung zhabs las tshan gyi go gnas bsko stsal gnang ste/ bka' blon bla ma byams pa bstan dar gyi las byar mdo smad mnga' khul du bskyo da skabs sho mdor 'byor nas mdo dgon pa'i de snga'i byed gte khag la rnag thog gtsag 'khel gyis nyes pa mig ltos la phan pa'i khrims bcad byas pa dang / spo bo rdzi ra gnas por mdun bcar dgos lugs kyi yi ge btang ste ngo 'byor skabs ‘‘khyod nas nga rang sngon ma gnas babs ma bde ba'i skabs lhag bsam gyis zhabs 'degs zhus par ngos la phan thogs yag po byung bas/ da lan khyod la drin gsab rgyu dang / khyod tsho spo khul gyi mi nas sho star lho gsum khul du rku 'phrog sogs kyi rtsod gzhi mi nyung ba zhig yod pa de dag gi skor 123

bka' blas sa gnas so so zlos gzhi 'phral thag chod pa gnang skabs khyod tsho spo khul dgon tshan khag la bka' rgya gnang don ltar dang len zhus te thag gcod thub pa zhu rgyu ni gnad don gal 'gangs chen po yin gshis/ khyod rang nas/ sde dgon khag la go bskon slob gso byas te gang thub kyis 'khrug thag chod pa byas na 'byung 'gyur phan thogs chen po yod ’ lugs gsungs pa ltar/ spo khul nas sde dgon kha shas kyes bka' slob nyan 'jog gis sho star lho gsum khul dang / spo stod sde dgon bar zlos gzhi mi nyung ba zhig thag gcod thub pa byung yod pas/ rjes su spo bod g.yul 'khrug skabs dang / spo bo gzhung khongs gcig gyur bzos zin rjes bod kyi dpon rigs su 'byor yang /bkaljori bla'i dpyad khra bskyar zlos gtan nas byung med pa dang / de skabs grags rnam gyi bka' slob la ma nyan pa'i spo la bar gyi zlos gzhi lus pa rnams rjes su ha cang dka' rnyog chen po byung yod stabs/ phyis kyang rgan rabs tshos sngon ma grags rnam gyis bka' slob gnang ba de tsho yang dag pa dang bka' drin bskyangs 'dug zhes shod kyi 'dugagrags pa rnam rgyal gyis bka' bla'i las bya byed skabs spyir na bod gzhung la lhag bsam che ba dang / yang sgos las don bsgrub par snying stobs ldan cing / dus dang bstun mkhas pa/ gong 'og tshang mas cha 'jog bya yul zhig tu gyur bar brten rim bzhin mkhan chung gi go gnas thob/ me 'brug (1916)lor mdzo sgang du phebs nas zi bod mtha' mtshams khag la zhib 'jug skabs mkhan chung grags rnam gyis bsam pa gru khar sa srung sngon yod phyir bros yong mkhan brgya dpon bstan 'dzin legs bshad ske bcad de srog thog btang ba dang // bcu dpon dgu yod par nyes khrims rkang pa bcad pa sogs drag shugs chen pos 'jigs bskul byas pa des mi rnams bla 'dar dgos pa zhig bzos thog gzhi nas gsang sngags chos rdzong dang / mdzo sgang 124

gnyis kyi khul nas yul dmag 500gsar bsdus kyis bsam pa gru khar sa srung dpung snron btang ba dang / de bzhin mtha' mtshams la sgo khag lnga yod pa so sor sa srung bkod sgrig byas nas 'go 'doms tog dmag dpon zer ba de skabs bsko gzhag dang 'brel mdzo gsang gnyis la phyin chad mtha' mtshams khag nas btang shor mi chog pa bcas kyi bkod 'doms drag pos mnan te lho rdzong du phyir log byas skad 'dugalhar tsho pa so dgu ni ching gong ma'i dus su bod sdod am ban lam lugs 'dzugs skabs bod zi zung sbrel gyi sde khongs su bzhag cing / thad ka'i 'go khrid am ban yin pa red ces rgan po'i ngag lam las thos kyang tsho khul sa gnas su zi phyogs nas khral bsdu khrims gnon byed mkhan rgyun bzhugs med cing / tsho pa so dgur sngar nas rtsa ba'i spyi khyab hor sbra chen tshang yin/ hor tsho so dgu chags yul ni shar nas ri chab dpa' gsum (ri bo che/ chab mdo/dpa' shod )gyi sa mtshams su gnas pa dang / lho nas sho pa mdo khongs dang /'bri gung sba ba la sa mtshams 'khel ba/ nub nas byang rigs sde bzhi'i khongs dang sa mtshams yin pa/ byang nas mtsho sngon zhing chen dang sa mtshams/dbus su ra gar sog gsum dang 'brel ba yin pa bcas sa rgya che la thon khungs phun sum tshogs shing / yangs shing rgya che'i rang byung gi rtswa thang dang /zhing sa gshin po yod la/ spyi'i cha nas tsho smad tsho khag bcu bzhi sa ma 'brog dang / de byings tsho stod tsho khag nyi shu rtsa lnga 'brog rkyang yin pa/ thon skyed gtso bo 'brog las dang / zhing las/ gzhan yang zhor las rngon rgyag dang sman rtswa bsngogs 'thu yang byed pa/ sha mar/ ko lpags sogs phyir tshong phon 'bor che tsam bya rgyu yod/ tsho sde mi ser them dud khri phrag lhag tsam yod pa rnams chags yul kha 'thor du gnas shing / dpon 'go mang bar brten lugs mthun gyi sgrig khrims gcig gyur de tsam med pa'i dbang gis dpon dang dpon dbar 125

gyi 'gal ba dang / tsho khag dang tsho khag dbar gyi 'gal ba mang tsam yod me ma zad/ pho sod dpung pa su sbom du gyur nas 'bu ches chung bzos byed pa dang /tsho tshung nus/ med rnams ni chags thabs bral ba bcas kyi phan tshun 'gal ba dang 'thab rtsod kyis rnyog 'dzing ha cang chen po yod cing / skabs der khyung po khul du zi bod dmag 'khrug dus yun gang 'tshams shig song rjes shing yos (1915)lor/ lu'u cun dmag dpung steng chen nas sa shor phyir bros skabs tsho khag mang che bas bod dmag la mgo sgur nas bsdad pa dang / dkar ru dpon dang / lding blon mi nyung ba zhig gis mu mthud lu'u cun dmag dpung dang kha ma bral bar ri bo che brgyud chab mdor mnyam skyod byas rkyen lu'u cun dmag dpung g.yul las pham rjes mdo spyi byams pa bstan dar nas dkar ru dpon ngo ma nam 'tsho'i ring bsam yas su rgyang 'bud btang ba dang / g.yo shod lding dpon rdza yul du rgyang 'bud btang / lding blon mi grangs 18kyi sna rtse bregs te rang yul du phyin log btang 'dug me 'brug lor mkhan drung zhig steng chen du btang 'byor gyis hor tsho so dgu sa sde mi gsum gzhung deb tu bkod nas bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi khongs su bcug thog lu'u cun dmag gis tsho pa so dgu'i thog nas yul dmag bsdus pa'i go lag gri mda' rnams rtsis len byas pa las/ gzhan yang khral khrims rgyugs phyogs skor la skabs der zhib phra bkod sgrig ma byas par phyir log byas/de rjes me sbrul (1917)lor bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis lho rdzong nas mkhan chung gra gas pa rnam rgyal hor tsho so dgu'i thog hor spyi dang po bsko gzhag byas par las bya rtse drung 2dang / sku srung ru dpon 1 lding dpon 1 srung dmag 50yod pa rnams khyung po steng chen du 'byor skabs tsho pa so dgu'i dpon lding tshang ma 'du 'dzoms kyis dang po yul srol phebs bsu dang sdod sgrig 'thus tshang zhus pa dang / de nas gong 'og so so'i mdun spyi'i mjal 126

phyag dang mjal rten phul ba ma zad/ de mtshams dpon sger so sor nas kyang mjal rten phul/ hor spyi ngo las kyi lte ba'i sdod yul steng chen du byas/skabs der hor spyi mkhan chung grags pa rnam rgyal nas khrims 'dzin gyi byed sgo dang po btsugs pa'i skabs su bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi rtsa tshig khyab bsgrags byas pa'i 'go brdzod du ‘‘kun gsal 'chi med lam du srid pa'i sgron me zung gi ma ngon par 'dzin pa snang ba longs su spyod pa'i gnam 'og sa steng skye rgu spyi dang / bye brag tu gser ldan rgyal po'i chab 'bangs lam lugs ’’zer ba sogs 'khod pa rnams bka' bsgrags dang 'brel ‘‘slad phyin bod chos ldan zhing gi lam lugs ltar ri klung skam gsher la gnas pa'i ri dwags che phrar mi 'jigs srog gi skyabs sbyin gnang ba dang / yul gru tshang mar mchog dman mtha' dgabade bar gnas pa'i ched du phan tshun dbar dgra jag rkun 'phrog nam yang byed mi chog gal te khrims dang 'gal ba'i gang byung tshul min gyi bya spyod drag zhan su thad nas byung ba srid tshe rgyal khrims drag pos lus longs thog nyes pa mig lar 'dom pa gcod rgyu yin ’’zhes pa sogs bsgrags par hor tsho so dgu'i dpon lding rnams nas khal len zhus pa'i spyi sgrig gan rgya blangs/sngar nas tsho sde nang khongs dpon lding yin pa so so la slar yang bod kyis go gnas sprod skabs hor sbra chen tshang de sngon tsho sde so dgu'i spyi khyab yin pa de bod dus ṭathu 'brog shog tsho khag gcig gi dpon la bsgyur te che hū'i go gnas sprad pa dang / rdo shul stod smad gnyis de sngon be cang yin pa tsho sde'i mtha' mtshams su/ gnas par brten gzhan gyis brtsi bkur che ba'i ched du be'u go gnas rang 'jags sprad/ dkar ru dpon ngo ma nyes tshabs la gzhigs pa'i rgyang 'bud btang bar brten dkar ru'i 'go 'dzin skyangs bkra shis bsod rnams la be'u'i go gnas sprad/ de byings be'u dang / be cang / lding dpon yin pa so so la go gnas rang 'jags sprad pa bcas gong gsal khyon bsdoms 127

che hu dang / be'u/ be cang bcas dpon rgan gzhon 39dang lding dpon 33yod pa red/ dkar ru'i dpon gzhis ma lag dang bcas sa gzhung bzhes btang nas hor spyi'i thab rten khongs su bsgyur te zhing g.yog dkar ru mi ser nas rgyugs dgos pa bzos/sa rta (1918)lo hor tsho dgu'i ker leb sgur gsum (mi sa phyugs )zhib gzhung bkod pa'i sa zhing nas thog phud 'bru dang / phyugs zog mo rigs la ga mar/ pho rigs rta drel bong bu dang bcas par ga dngul zhes gzhung 'khral 'bab deb bzos te lo ltar 'jal sgrub zhu dgos pa ma zad/ skabs der mi dang sems can tshang ma nas am ṭam zer ba ṭam dkar re ji5nga bsdus/gong gsal mkhan drung desari bsdus pa'i go lag de rnams grags rnam gyis tsho pa so sor phyir sprod byas thog 'chi med she 'bri la bsgyur te khral nag rgyun 'byar gyis lo ltar she mar yang 'jal sgrub byed dgos pa de la mi ser nas ‘‘me she ’’zhes zer srol yod 'dug gzhan yang yul gyi 'bo bre rgya gsum sngon ma gcig mthun med pa de rjes su sa rta gas ra bzos zer ba'i yi ge yod pa'i 'bo bre rgya gsum gyi ngos la hor spyi'i las tham 'byar ma shog kha so sor bkram pa de dag la gcig mthun gyi rtsa ba'i tshad gzhi 'dzin dgos pa dang / byang lam sa tshigs bkod sgrig bzos par brten rta zam rgyun bzung gis yar mar 'grul skyod rnams la bka' lam dgongs don rta khal mi gsum dang / sdod sgrig rta thab lag g.yog rtswa shing bcas kyi zhabs zhu byed dgos la/ hor spyi ngo las srung dmag dang bcas par rgyun g.yog rgyugs mkhan steng chen du ‘‘nyin rgyugs zhabs zhu ’’zer ba smad tsho bcu bzhi'i shog khag res bskor gyis mtshams 'dzin med par nar gtong yang byed dgos pa sogs kyi lam srol bzos/grags rnam gyis de snga chu glang (1913)lo zi bod dmag 'khrug gis tsho smad khyung po khul du dgon pa mer bsregs gtor brlags song ba bon dgon 128

dkar legs dgon dang / steng chen dgon/ dga' ldan mang rong dgon/sgang sne dgon bcas so sor dgon pa gsar bzhengs byed sgo'i mthun rkyen gang la de 'tshams re sprad nas mi nyams gong 'phel nyams pa sor chud mdzad pa dang / spyi tshogs thog tu sgrig lam gtor bshig byed mkhan nam sho sbag rgyan 'dzugs dang / chang 'thung ra bzi shod mkhan gyi gras la nyes chad du steng chen bum khra lha khang de snga mer bsregs btang shul du lha khang thog brtsegs gnyis ldan sbug tu ka ring gnyis dang mtha' bskor lcags ri dang bar mtshams su tsha khang yod pa zhig gsar bzo byed du bcug de'i rten gtso gu ru pad+ma 'byung gnas sku tshad thog gnyis ma gcig gsar bzhengs bcas byas te mgon bla bka' rgyud zhag gcod dgon par kha 'dzin du sprad/ bum khra lha khang la phyis bo rtsi lha khang zhes zer/ nyin cig glo bur du hor spyi grags rnam steng chen ri khrod la lta bskor bskyod cing / ri khrod bla ma kun dga' rgyal mtshan dngangs 'tshab kyis lam seng phebs sgrig zhus kyang / grags rnam gyis phebs sgrig zhu yul du ma bsdad par dus rgyun bla ma'i bzhugs khang chung chung zhig yod pa de'i nang du bsdad/bla ma kun dga' rgyal mtshan ni grags rnam gyi 'jigs zil ma bzod pa lta bus ci bshad ljoridi tshor ma byung stabs phyag gnyis kas gsol ja zhal dkar gang 'degs phul zhu skabs sku gzan gyi sne mo sa la lhung shor ba phrag pa'i thog tu yar gzar skabs gzim khang nang gi shar ngos su dkar khung chung chung zhig yod pa de'i nang nas nyi thig rgyugs pa'i steng du sku gzan de bkal ba lta bur bsdad pas/ grags rnam yid ma ches par lag pas nyi thig yar bcad mar bcad thengs kha shas byas rung / nyi thig ni stong pa rang las dngos po gzhan med par brten gzhi nas yid chenu/ kyang skabs der bzang ngan ci yang ma bshad par phyir log byas/ grags rna ma ri khrod du bskyod don ni bla ma kun 129

dga' rgyal mtshan ngo bcar ma zhus par bsnyad 'dogs shig byed rgyu red 'dug kyang / grags rnam nas bla ma'i mtshan rtags mthong bar brten ri khrod tshang la de snga mi dmangs kyis dad 'bul zhus pa'i sa zhing mi nyung ba zhig yod pa de dag rang mos kyis mi ser nas zhing g.yog ar po rgyug gi yod pa de dag la sus kyang rtsod gleng mi chog par mchod thebs su rang 'jags chog pa'i bka' gtan khungs btsan zhig kyang sprad pa dang / steng chen dgon gyi sgar khang sprul sku la tsho smad bon dgon yongs kyi 'go 'dzin bsko gzhag bcas byas pa red/ steng chen du lu'u cun dmag gis dkar rgyu dpon gyi kha rjes su 'brangs te nag ru dpon bde lam sdod thabs med pa zhig bzos par brten bka' blon bla ma byams pa bstan dar sar lho rdzong du nag ru dpon blon mgo btags zhu bcar skabs lu'u cun dmag dang / dkar ru mnyam sdeb kyis nag ru'i khang pa mer bsregs rtsa med btang ba de dag bskyar bzo'i ched bka' blas nag rur nye 'gram shing nag gar yod nas shing cha gcod 'dren chog pa dang /tsho smad bcu bzhi nas ar po skul gtong chog pa ma zad/ nag ru'i mi ser yang gtor brlags gang 'tsham song tshab tu nag ru dang sa 'brel yin pa'i bha ru lding zhabs mi ser dud grangs 155yod pa de dag kyang nag rur 'tsho snon sprad 'dugahor spyi grags rnam dus steng chen du hor spyi'i sdod khang thog brtsegs gnyis ldan g.yas g.yon la gzim chung dang / gzim 'gag dbus kyi mdun phyogs su lhan rgyas khang la sogs steng shod khang mig mang la rgya khyon che zhing / las shag khag 3 srung dmag stod khang bcas gsar rgyag byas/(rjes su hor spyi brje 'phos gsar 'byor rim pa'i sdod khang byed rgyu yin pa de la khang gnyer mi gcig bzhag par gla phogs mi ser nas sprod dgos kyi yod la/130

wor yug tu gnas dud tshang tshang mas lo ltar dkar rtsi gtong ba dang /gangs 'phyag pa/ thegs sa rgyag pa sogs khang gnyer gyi ngag bkod ltar las ka byed dgoskyusdo red/)hor spyi ngo las srung dmag dang bcas pa tsho stod la bskyod nas sngon ma'i pyi khyab sdod yul lte ba sbra chen du dgon sde'i 'go khrid rgyas 'dzoms kyis tshogs 'du nyin shas 'tshogs thog slad phyin bod gzhung lugs gnyis kyi bka' khrims la rtsi srung zhu dgos pa las/ nga che kho btsan gyis yul spyi'i bde rtsar gnod gzhi'i 'gal rkyen su thad nas nam yang byed mi chog pa bcas kyi mjug gnon byas pa dang / bon dgon klu phug dgon gyi gling grwa pa zer ba zhig yodapa des bar lam grwa rgod mi gsum g.yog la bkol te dgra jag rku 'phrog mi nyung ba zhig byas yod pas hor spyis de snga dgon pa'i nang du jas/ tshang bzung mkhan byed gtso gling grwa pa 'dzin bzung dang 'brel grwa chas bshus nas lus thog tu khrims lcag tsha nan 300btang ste dgon pa'i skyid sdug nas phyir 'bud byas thog de'i 'dzin dngos gzhung bzhes btang ste dgon pa'i tshogs brten khongs su sbyo ra 'jags sprad/ grwa rgod gsum por lus sdom ma nyams yod par brten dgon pa'i skyid sdug rang 'jags su bzhag nas sngon 'gal bshags sbyong byed nga/ dang / phyin chad de ltar mi byed pa'i khas len gan rgya blangs/ klu phug sprul sku la tsho stod bon dgon yongs kyi 'go 'dzin bslo/ gzhag bcas byas te hor spyi ngo las tsho smad du phyir log byas/tsho n+d+ra/da khul du mi ngan kun la grags pa'i nyes chen gras la khrims gcod gtong skabs ‘‘da khram mi’zer ba'i khrims rwa der g.yas g.yon du sku srung dmag mi go lag rang 'grigs 20tsam re ru bstar bsgrigs shing / rgyab phyogs gnyis su tsho smad dpon lding so sos thob thang gi las zhwa las gos gyon te sbang bsgrigs byed dgos pa dang / de nas hor spyi ngo las yong skabs dang po sku 131

srung dmag gis dar 'phyar dung 'bud kyis sa lam zhu ba dang / dpon lding so sos zhwa mo lag tu 'dzin nas phyag 'bul zhus mtshams/ hor spyi grags rnam rang nyid khrims rwa'i sbug gi mdun phyogs khri steng du baji da rjes/ g.yas g.yon du las bya rnams go rim bzhin gdan la 'khod pa sogs brjid nyams che ba'i khrims rwa 'tshogs thog grags rnam nas thogatshomar khong sar nang bcar zhu mkhan mi nyung ba nas skyabs rten sngon phul byung ba'i dngos po rnams bkram ston byas te do bdag so sor phyir bslog sprod pa dang / gyod ya phan tshun la rtsa ba'i bden don yod med lhan rgyas khang nas rgyu dngos rjes 'brangs su ma so/nga ba'i zhib 'jug dbye 'byed byas rjes nyes can la khrims gcod gtong skabs shog khungs kyi dpon de zur du bslangs te zhwa 'bud mgo sgur gyis rgyu rma tshan sgrogs sbyang byas pa rnams nyan 'jog zhu dgos pa dang / de nas rim bzhin khrims gcod dngos lag bstar byed kyi yod cing / dper na krog rdis mgo prer ba zhig yod pa des rnam kun kho rang dpa' bo yin zer zhing / dang po lha phab nas mgo bskor gtong ba dang / de nas rta nor brkus 'ded byed pa ma zad/ ra lug bshas bzos dang ca lag che phra gang thob rku 'khyer byed kyi yod pa ra 'phrod rim par byung yang / hor spyi grags rnam gyis kho par phyin chad lam nor ldog shis byed rgyu yod na snyam dang po lus thog tu rta lcag 300gzhus nas bzhag pa dang / gnyis pa 'bru skyed las khungs nas bod dngul rngage da shag do ya gcig brkus pa 'i nyes khrims la lag g.yas pa bcad/gsum pa da dung mtshams 'jog mi byed par slar yang khal g.yag kha shas brkus 'ded byas par brten mtha' mar nyes khrims rkang lag gsum dus gcig la bcad rung ma shi bar pud bgrod byas nas 'tsho ba skyel gyi 'dug pa nga rang chung dus mthong myong yod/ yang ko lo sna 'bo zer ba zhig yod pa des gzhan nor mang po brkus par nyes khrims rta lcag 150btang thog kho pa'i rkang 132

pa ko dmar gyis btum ste bar du tshwa bul blugs nas nyi mar skam pa rjes su kho pa gzha' bor gyur pa red/ rkun po klad rgyag mgo zer bar nyes tshabs la gzhigs pa'i mig 'bras gnyis ka bton/ gzhan yang nyes can kha shas khrims lcag gi 'og tu bsad/ grags rnam ni khrims kyi la rgya gtso bzung las dga' nye phyogs ris mi byed mkhan zhig yin pa dper na/ khyung po bde gong ga lug zer ba ni de sngon grags rnam la rogs phan byed mkhan zhig yin rung /kho pas gzham/ dngos mang po ham 'phrog byas pa ra 'phrod par brten lus steng du rta lcag thengs kha shas btang ba dang / rkang lcag rgyab ste btson la bcug pa dang / dgong mo grags rnam gyi gzim chung du 'khrid nas ja chang dang 'tsho ba legs par sprad de ‘‘nga rang sngon ma tho pa mdor gnas babs ma bde ba'i skabasakhyod kyis rogs ram phan thogs yag po byung bas da res ngas khyod la drin gsob dgos nges kyang / khyod rang nas de sngon gzhan gyi rgyu nor ham 'phrog byas 'dug pa'i skor da lam do bdag mang po zhig nas bde sdug zhu gi 'dug na/ rtsa ba'i dngos por tshab sprod ma byas na khrims dang mi mthun pas khyod kyi 'jal bshags sprod byed gyis ’’zer nas gri dang / bod mda'/ rta sga/srab smad rang 'grigs sogs ca dngos mang po zhig kho par ster/ phyi nyin khrims sa 'tshogs thog ‘‘nyes can bde gong ga lug la gyod khag mang po'i 'dod blo tshim pa'i khrims gcod gtong dbos na mi gcig gi lus phung gis 'deng bar dka' bas dngos por tshab 'jal sprod len byed dgos ’’zhes bsgrags pa dang / bde gang ga lug nas bdag gi mes po'i dus nas yod pa'i dngos po gri dang mang/'a/ rta sga srab smad bcas khyad nor 'di rnams yin zhes zhus te khrims thog tu bzhag de dag khrim sa sa nas do bdag so sor sprad de gleng med dpyad mtshams bzos nas ga lug btson grol btang / yang dper na/ grags rnam gyi a khu yin pa mi gcig steng chen du yong nas shing 133

tog dang / rgun chang phul te nga rang dpa' shod du ma nyes kha g.yog bkal nas chags thabs med lugs mang po zhus/ grags rnam nas a khu'i kha gtad ched 'gugs kyis a khu dang phan tshun gdong bsher ra sprag gtong du 'jug skabs a khus sngon zhus thams cad la bden pa med par gyur cing / a khus kha gtad kyi ca lag mang po brkus 'khyer byas pa dngos ra gsal 'phrod byung rkyen nyin shas mtshams grags rnam nas a khur kha lag gzab rgyas sprad de khyod rang blo pham ma byed ces slob gso bskyon/ de'i phyi nyin khrims rwa tshogs nas a khu'i rkang pa g.yas pa bcad/ de nas sman dang rlung bcos byas kyang ma phan par a khu grong pa sogs grags rnam la phyogs lhung med pa'i khrims gzhung yod pa dang / chos lugs grub mtha' gang yin so so la khyad med srung skyob byed kyi yod pa red ces lo rgyus shes mkhan rgan rabs khag cig gis de ltar shod srol 'dug la/ hor spyi grags rnam dus yul gyi bde rtsar gnod pa'i phan tshun dgra rgyag dang jag rkun/ yul gyi gshed mar khrims gcod bya thabs nan pos lcags dmar rkam gcun gyis tshar gcod byas par brten skabs der yul spyir rgan mo gser khur yin kyang lam thob pa zhig byung ba red ces grags/lcags sprel (1920)hor spyi mkhan chung grags pa rnam rgyal steng chen du nad 'das gyur na'ang khong 'tsho sdod skabs gzhung bsam che la khrims gzhung drang gshis/ grags rnam gyis bzos pa'i gyod don dpyad khra sogs yig rigs la rjes su bod gzhung ser skya su 'dra zhig gis kyang brdal bshigs med pa cha 'jog byed kyi yod pa red/me sbrul (1917)lor bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis hor tsho so dgu'i 'go 'doms bsko gtong byas pa'i hor spyi dang po mkhan chung grags pa rnam rgyal nas/ lcags sbrul (1941)lo stag brag bar hor spyi rim pa brgyad song zhing / chu rta (1942)lor rdzong khag drug la bsgyur te spyi 'doms byang spyi'i 134

khongs su gtogs dgos pa bzos pa dang / rdzong rer bod gzhung ser skya gnyis re gtong lam bzos pa/ sngon ma khams bod gzhung lam lte ba lho rgyud nas yin pa de hor spyi'i dus su byang lam thog bsgyur bar brten yar mar dpon dmag 'gro mkhan rgyun chad med pa rnams la sa tshigs so so nas sdod sgrig dang / rta thab lag g.yog rtswa shing / rta khal mi gsum sgrub rgyugs dgos pa ma zad/ sa gnas khag la dmag dpung gi phogs khang dang / 'bru skyed/ tshwa sho btsugs pa dang / lhag tu byang rgyud sa srung zhes pa tsho smad khul du dmag sgar rgyun sdod bzhag pa bcas la brten mi ser nas khral 'ul skul 'ded khag mang la sne mang 'dres 'dzing gi khral rigs sgrub rgyugs byed dgos kyi yod/ ‘‘gzhung nas gzhung don dngos 'brel yin nges las de min mi ser thog don med khral 'ul bskul 'ded kyi 'phar brdabs mi chog ’’ces pa'i bka' rtsa rim par sprod kyi yod kyang / sa gnas sne sdod zhi drag dpon rigs kyis gzhung don kha khyer thog nas sger don sgrub shugs che ba'i dbang gis mi ser rnamyo/sa snum zad mar me lta bu'i rtsa med du 'gro la nye ba'i skabs der lcags stag (1950)lor bcings 'grol thob ste mes rgyal khyim tshang chen po'i nang du slar yang log thub pa byung bas tsho khul rdzong 'go bcu la steng chen don gcod las khungs ang dang po btsugs pa dang / rdzong so sor bcings 'grol u yon lhan khang dbu brnyes pa bcas so/135

ngos rang de snga star rdzong rdzong sgod byed ring mthong thos myong ba'i gnas tshul 'ga' zhigasnar skyid dbang 'dus tshe ring /rab byung bcu drug pa'i shing sprel (1944)lor ngos rang star rdzong bsam grub rab brtan (spyi ming du dpal 'bar )gyi rdzong dpon du bsko gtong bzhin gong lo'i bod zla 8pa nang sa gnas su 'byor zhing / sa byi (1948)lo bar khyon rdzong dpon lo bzhi byas pa yin/ star rdzong gi chags tshul ni mdo smad phyogs kyi 'gro lam byang lam dang / byang lam bar ma lho lam gsum gi nang tshan lho lam gyi gzhung lam lte ba yin pa ma zad/ khams phyogs kyi rdzong sne dang po de'ang yin/sa gnas de'i khor yug rgya khyon dang gnas yul ni/ nub tu lha ri 'go bar o rgyan rta mda' dang / rnam rgyal sgang // rngod dro gad/ a langs mdo dang / a la bca' gong / a la 'gag tshwa chu kha bcas rgya tshugs bdun dang /shar gong la dang / nub gong la/ la chung gser nya bcas la che chung gsum/shar gong la'i rdo rje phred lam rgyud dbyar zla 5pa'i nang gangs rud kyi nyen kha che bas de sngon lo rgyus thog mi zog la gnod skyon byung lugs shod srol 'dugashar du sho mdo bar lha rtsed dang ba ri nang rgya tshugs gnyis dang / po te la dang / ba ri zi mig gong la/ brag la bcas la gsum/ lhor spo bo chu mdo sa gnas bar rgya tshugs bzhi tsam dang / spo bo dung la zer ba'i la/ byang du rgyal ston rdzong bar rgya tshogs lnga tsam dang / la gnyis tsam bcas yod pa dang /136

gong gsal sa gnas de tsho'i la chu 'phrang gsum mtho la g.yang gzar zhing /rdza rong sogs bgrod lam dka' tshegs shin tu che ba yod pas de khul dpal 'bar mi ser dang / 'brel yod mi ser bcas0kyi mi zog tshang ma'i dka' sdug myong yul zhig red//sta ra rdzong mnga' khongs su sa stag zhib gzhung rtsa 'dzin byed pa'i gzhung sger chos gsum bsgril na khyon rkang 'don 370lhag tsam yod khongs nas dpal 'bar bla brang gtso bor byas pa'i chos gzhis khag dang / sger pa spo zhong dpo na dang / lcags ra dpon bcas phud/ gzhung rgyugaṭasdo pa phu yu la lding dpon dang / smad shod lding / lcags ra lding / sa shod lding bcas dang /rngod pa lding khag gsum bcas lding khag 7yod/ dpal 'bar bla brang 'don 16skor dang sger pa dpon khag 2bsdoms 'don 6tsam bcas phud pa'i 'phros gzhung rgyugs rkang 'don 350tsam gyis lo ltar 'char can gyi khral lam thog sa rdzong rta khal mi gsum dang / sdod sgrig rtsa shing / lo gnangs sga khral/chibs ra'i dkar rtsegs dod dngul srang 60dang ther chen 30 brag shun dang zha nye 'degs khal 40bcas kyi dod dngul srang 15 dmag phogs bsdu dam khongs bcu zur ngo skyod/ phogs gnyer khapa/ gi spus 'don sogs dang / nang khral rdzong la gte 'bru zhes rgyal po sa yi bca' khral rkang 'don re nas 'bru ru'i khal 6re dang / dbyar mar zhes mar khal 30tsam/ 'bud shing 'degs rgya 603skor dang / rtswa rgya ma gong dang 'dra ba/ rta thab gnyis nar gtong /zhal g.yog gla cha rkang re nas 'bru bre re/ sngo rtswa rnga 'dren/ gan zhing son khal 28skor gyi g.yog bya/ rnam kun chu 'khor brngod 'thag las sogs byed dgos pa'i thog da dung mdo spyi sa dbang phebs skabs tshugs zhag 'phar ma yang sgrigs dgos pa dang / de bzhin dmag sgar che khag rigs 'byor skabs rta khal mi gsum gyi rdzong skyel yin phyin gong gsal lha ri 'go bar du rgya tshugs 137

7dang / rgyal ston bar rgya tshugs 5tsam/ spo bo chu mdo bar rgya tshugs 4tsam/tho mdo bar rgya tshugs 2bcas 'gro dgos/star rdzong mnga' khongs nas yul dmag mi grangs 100tham pa rnam kun btang chog ang gsar byed dgos shing / lo rgyus thog sho star lho gsum gzhung sde rnying khungs dang dgra 'thab khag la dasi 'a snying che ba'i snyan grags yod pa zhig yin zhes zer srol 'dug cing / de snga dbyin ji'i btsan 'dzul dmag 'khrug skabs byas rjes bzhag myong mkhan dmag mi rgan gras re zung yang bsdad 'dug star rdzong mnga' khongs dgon khag gras/ dpal 'bar dgon la bde mchog grwa tshang dang gsang 'dus grwa tshang gnyis yod pa so sor grwa grangs 200re dang / bla brang gcig ste dpal 'bar bla brang yin pa dang / de min dgon khag gras lcags rwa dgon dang / ba zhong dgon/ khrang khar dgon/lha rtse dgon/ chos rdzong dgon bcas so sor grwa grangs 60nas 30bar sna tshogs yod pa/ ri khrod gras nyi shar ri khrod/ rgya lo ri khrod/ 'dam phu ri khrod/ra ma thang / mo dgon ri 'go nang zer bar btsun ma 40skor dang / sa shod khul dpon dgon rdza dgon zer ba bon chos ma gtogs mang che ba dge lugs pa yin 'dug dpal 'bar sprul sku na rim sdom sa/tsang yin 'dug rung / sku thog gcig gis rtogs ldan grub chen gyi rtul zhugs 'dzin cing rigs ma bsten nas gdung spel gnang 'dug pa de'i sku brnyan zhig dpal 'bar bla brang gi mchod shom nang mjal rgyu 'dug pa de'i snang tshul ni sku gsham dkar po/sku 'gag dbu lcang yod la/ sna brgyan khra gsum ma/ chos gos snam sbyar/paṇa zhwa sna ring / phyag mtshan rdo rje dang / ga pa la bsnams pa sogs ya ma gzugs shig 'dug de'i shugs rkyen gdung sras pad+ma zer ba zhig 'dug pa des kyang phyogs phebs gnang skabs rab byung cha lugs 'dzin kyang chod chang 'bral med bzhes kyi 'dug138

rngo khul rgya mtsho gling bla brang gi dgon par grwa grangs 60skor dang / a rig dgon bcas yod/dpal 'bar khul gyi thon khungs ni gla rtsi dang / gla spu/ sha ba'i khrag rwa/pags rigs/ dbyar rtsa dgun 'bu/ — dbyar gro dang / be rmug sogs thon khungs che tsam 'dug gzhung sger chos gsum khongs mi ser rnams skabs der zhing pa mang che ba dang zhing 'brog 'dres ma gang 'tsham las mi 'dugadapal 'bar gyi mi ser rnams rnam kun nas khral khrims la brtsi bkur/ tshul mthun slom chung gi sdod pa ma gtogs/ yul phan tshun la dgra jag tshul min byed rigs mi 'dugang rang star rdzong du shing sprel (1944)lo 'byor te rdzong rnying skyar srib pa'i ngo tshab gnyer dgra 'dul gyi sa nas rdzong rtsis len skabs sgo khra them gsher gyi rtsis sprod len bya thabs mi 'dug cing / de'i rgyu mtshan gang lags she na/de gong chu rta/ chu lug shing sprel bcas lo 3nang dpal 'bar khul du lo nyes bstud mar byung thog sems can la hon nad sogs sdug thog sdug brtsegs rim byung gi rkyen pas mi ser mang po dbus gtsang dwags kong sogs lho byang gang sar yul 'khyams su 'gro dgos byung 'dug pa ma zad/ skabs der mdo smad phogs khang gi dmag phogs dgos 'bru spus gzigs gnang rgyu'i ‘‘spus 'don zhes mi’ja 'bru thang cung zher sbag rer 'bru khal 4re 'bul dgos pa dang / spus 'grems byed skabs sho star lho gsum rdzong khag gsum 'don rgya che chung dang / sa rdzong lam 'khel nye 'gyangs ring thung / mi ser 'khyer 'khos bzang zhan sogs la ma ltos par cha snyom gyis rdzong 'go rer ja sgam 80re bkram 'dug pa dang / ja rnams chab mdo brgyud yong ba zhig yin stabs thog mar lho rdzong nas ja yag pa rnams bdams zin pa dang / de rjes sho pa mdo nas drag 'dems byas 'phros bdams snyigs ja sgam 80tham pa star rdzong mi 139 ri

ser 'don rgya chung shos dang 'khos zhan nyams thag thog 'khri 'khel byung thogaphogs khang nas 'bru 'bab rnam grangs tshang 'phral du bsdu len gyis dmag phogs rgyab chog ang gsar dgos lugs nan brjod bcas byas par brten 'bru khalasu2000tsam sngon nas bsdus zin 'dug de 'phros 'bul rgyu lta ci/mi ser phal cher za brten dang bral bsatshobade sdug zhu bar mi 'gro thabs med kyi skabs der star rdzong mi ser rnams kyi bde sdug 'tsho tshig lta mir rang nyid kyi mgo skal du babs yod stabs mi ser nas 'thus mi mang po 'gro ma dgos par gla cha chung khyad du rang ngo ma chab mdor 'gro zhor dang chabs cig tu ‘‘spus 'don ’’skor snga phyi'i yong rkyen zhib phra mngo/ spyir zhus par brten mdo spyi g.yu thog dang / phos/sa/ dpon mkhan chung thub bstan sangs rgyas dang / rim bzhi rong brag pa ba cas nas kyang gnas tshul dngos 'brel de 'dra yin na/ khyod tsho'i ‘‘spus 'don ’’'bru 'bab rnams lo 3ring bka' 'gyang sa gam/nga 'thus bka' phebs ma zad/ da dung rim pas bsam gzhigasatshobyas 'thus kyi dgongs bzhes kyang gnang byung bas de 'phral chab mdo nas phyir log gis yong rkyen rnams/ zhib mol byas pas mi ser lhag bsdad rnams sems ngal lhing 'jags kyisashaṃ bskyar du yul 'khyams 'gro mtshams chod tsam byung song / rdzong rnying skyar srib gnyer pas ‘‘'di lo sa shod lding khag sa rgya che shos khul du rgan byis ma 'pher ba khang srung tsam las sdod mi med stabs sa zhing 'debs thabs bral bas/ 'di lo'i ring sa shod khul dang / de min sa zhing 'debs las ma thub pa rnams rdzong gsar rnying gnyis nas btab na sa bon rnams rdzong rnying rang nas btang chog ’’ces brjod byung yang / rang nas kho par de ltar byas na 'grig gi ma red/ slad phyin ston thog ma byung na sog rtsa gyong gun smos med thog ji yong ma nges pa dang / gal te ston 'bras yag po byung na mi ser rnams blo ya/sa dang sdug nad theg min ma zad/ bka' khrims las 'bras gang la'ang 140

mi 'gro bas mi 'grig la/ khyod rang nas kyang ngo lkog gang sar sa zhing 'debs bdag bya rtsis byas na 'grig min bshad thog de 'phral mi ser cung 'khyer 'khos drag rigs them dud bdun nas yod 'don 'bru khal 700skor bun blangs kyis do bdag khyad med nga rang nas 'gan blangs te lag bsdus ja rin 'bru 'bab thog nas 'bru khal 2000tham pa bcas son rtsar sprad thog sa zhing 'debs las thad tshang mas 'phyar ba gru 'degs byed du bcug pas lo der sngar ma byung ba'i lo legs byung gshis mi rnams dmigs bsal yul 'gugs sogs zhu ma dgos par rim pas phyir 'khor thub pa dang / son rtsa 'bru khal 2700'ded skul ma dgos par gtsang sel byed thub pa byung ba ma zad/ ‘‘srus 'don ’’'bru 'bab rnams kyang 'di lo 'bul thub na gzhung sger gnyis kar phan khyad che lugs mol bsdur byas par tshang mas blo mos byung bas/lo rjes ma shar 'phral phogs khang la rtsis rgyag zhu thub pa byung song /ngos rang star rdzong du 'byor nas zla gcig tsam song mtshams nyin cig lha sa nas a drung zhig 'byor gdong bka' rgya'i nang deng skabs sa smad khul gyi grwa btsun mi grangs 20skor nas lam bar dang / lha khul du rku 'phrog sogs tshul min byas 'dug pas de tsho sa gnas su 'byor mtshams 'dzin bzung do dam nan che dgos lugs gsal 'dug a drung gis brjod gsal bka' rgya'i nang don grwa btsun de dag da lta 'byor nyer yod pas 'dzin bzung dgos lugs brjod byung / mi de tsho dngos 'brel yin min dris par a drung gis ‘‘mi de tshos kha sngon yar lam 'phrog bcom byas pas ma tshad mar lam yang 'phrog bcom byed kyi 'dug te bag nor 'khrul med mi’ces zer byung / de 'phral yul mi bsdu bskong gis tshang ma 'dzin bzung byas te 'dri brtsad byed skabs mang che bas ngos len byas rung / de'i nang nas lo rgan pa lo 30yas mas slebs mi bzhis khas len ma byas par brten mi rer rta lcag 200skor btang 141

thog do dam byas pa dang / de byings rnams nyin 3tsam nas phyir slog gis ‘‘khyod tsho pha yul du tshul mthun byas te 'byor 'dug na mi bzhi phyir slog btang chog ’’ces bsgrags nas kho tshor za gos gang tsam sprad de de 'phros zhib bsher byed skabs dngos khongs su snam rigs dang / brag yer pa'i mchod rdzas gras kha shas/ zhwa mo sna tshogs 70skor/ gri shub med/ me mda' ring mda' rnying pa skyon yod 1bcas 'dug pa gzhung len byas thog 'di dag ji ltar zhu 'gab che min skor a drung phyir log gdong snyan 'bul zhus/ de nas nyin 20skor song mtshams mi bzhi po do dam khongs nas bros byol du song 'dugashing bya (1945)lor 'du khongs rtsis rgyag skabs rkang 12tsam zhig gi rkang 'gro lag 'don khri sgrub tshang ma spyi thog gyong khur gyis sa zhing rnams mi ser nang khul kha shas nang 'debs nyar byas 'dug pas ngos nas de rnams phyir len gyis kha shas sa snon du sprad pa dang / kha shas khral gso khung 'jug byas te sa zhing bun nyar byed mir nyes chad du khral khungs gsar 'dzugs byas pa rnams la son rtsa dang / za 'bru// sgo zog sdod shes pa sprod du bcug pa dang / khag gcig slog sprod byed bcug pa yin/'du khongs rtsis rgyag byed skabs yig rnying shog dril chen po zhig 'dug pa de dag la zhib 'jug byed skabs rdzong dang / gtso drag lding dpon bcas kyi mi ming sna tshogs dang / yi ge 'dra min sna tshogs la rang rang so sos rang mtshams kyis mchan bkod byas 'dug pa'i nang rta khal mang bar 70nas 80skor dang / nyung mthar 20skor song tshul rnams mi ser byings la g.yas 'gebs g.yon 'gebs byas pa mang dag cig 'dug pa de rnams rtsis rgyag dang / brda 'ded byed thabs bral ba zhig 'dug yi ge dang / mi ming mang che ba gtso drag dang / lding dpon rim can yin 'dug pas skabs der 'du khongs tshang 'dzoms sar da lam ring gtso drag dang / lding rgan bcas par 142
