zhib brtsad dang nyes bkod yang pa byas te slad phyin de rigs byas mi chog pa'i mtha' 'doms gan rgya blangs te yig rnying shog dril bzhi po mer bsregs btang ba ma zad/ mi ser thog slad phyin ngo lkog gang sar de rigs byed mi byung tshe skabs 'phral snyan seng zhu ba las/ ngan mthun rku 'brel byas rigs thon na tshang mar lus longs nyes bkod gcod nges nan bshad byas pa des mi ser nyams dman rnams la phan thogs phran bu byung song /mdo spyi sa dbang yar phyir phebs skabs dang / de mtshungs dmag sgar khag 'gro skyod skabs mi ser nas sgrig cha khyon che zhu dgos kyi gdan lcog sogs dgon pa dang / bla brang khag sogs yod khungs nas btang ste de dag la mi ser nas khong tshor gla cha 'bru dngul phon che sprod dgos stabs mi ser la 'khri 'khel che ba ma zad/ bor brlag bcas byung na tshab skyin yang sprod dgos pa da nga / rdzong khang dang / mi ser gyi khang pas ma ldeng pa'i 'phros bla brang dang /dgon par g.yar dgos pa'i rkyen gyis stabs bde med gshis/ slar mdo spyi ngo las bzhugs 'pher gyi sgrig khang gsar rgyag byed skabs mi ser thog rkang rer ka gdung 'pher ba shing cha ngo grangs 12re dang / spang leb 16re/ lcam grangs 10skor/ 'ul mi ngo rgyugs tsam las de min mi ser nas 'bru dngul sogs lag gron gtong ma dgos par rdzong khang rnying pa'i shing cha dang / sa stong dgon par spus btsong btang ba'i rin thog nas btang ste khungs sgrigs thub pa byas pa yin/ de bzhin nga rang sdod ring mi ser thog sgrig cha che khag gi gla cha che rigs 'khri 'khel mi yong ba gtso 'don byas pa dang / rnam kun lam son (lam yig )khag la do dam gang che byas shing / thengs shig nga tsho'i drel pa rta drel rtswa sos nas phyir log skabs rta drel rnams stong par btang ste kho paskyusdo mi ser thog rta 'ul gcig bskul nas bzhon 'dug pa ma zad/ rta slog cig kyang mnyam 'khrid byas 'dug de 'phral mi ser lding rgan/ ar 'ul 143

bcas tshang mas mthong sar rang gi drel pa der rta lcag 50skor btang stabs de nas bzung g.yog rigs nas dgos med rta khal skul rgyur tshod 'dzin thub pa byung song / lo gnyis par go thos byung gsal de sngon rdzong thog khro dag9re bo'i ngo tshab gnyer pa zhig gis khral bsdu'i rdzong 'bo'i zhabs bkas mtshams su shing 'chol bcug lugs thos don lta zhib skabs shing 'chol sor phyed do lhag tsam zhig bcug 'dug cing / shor 'jal 'bo bsdur rgyag skabs bre do lhag tsam he bag rgyugs 'dug pas/ de 'phral lding rgan kha shas bos te shing 'chol de bton bcug pa yin/ de lo'i khral bsdu'i skabs snga lo dang bsdur na 'bru khal 80lhag tsam gyi khyad par 'dugame phag (1947)lo tā la sku phreng 14pa bcu gsum keg skabs dmigs bsal ri klung rgya sdem gyi bka' rgya 'byor don ma nga' khul tshang mar mtha' 'doms gan len zin rjes sa shod khul gyi mi ser bza' mi gnyis bzlos gyar byung ste bud med de'i zhu dgongs su mo'i bza' zlas rngon rgyag khrims 'gal byas lugs zhus par dngos 'brel yin mi na do bdag la nan 9rabri byas thogabartsad zhib kyis rngon pa 'dzin bzung byed mi gtong skabs phyog/sa gcig na sa yul mi gtso drag kha shas brgyud skyabs rten btsugs te zhu brgyud 'tshol ba dang //phyogs gzhan zhig nas rngon pa 9radzin bzung du 'gro mi rjes 'ded btang thogarngon zhib byed pa 'os min yin pas rdzong gi sgo gshags te ngon pa 'phrog rgyu yin zhes 'jigs skul sbir grags sogs bzos rung / gang ltar rngon pa mi gcig 'dzin bzung byas pa kho par tsha 'dri rta lcag 100thamatshopa btang rjes kho pa'i zhu khongs nas sa shod lding dpon don dbyangs zer ba'ang yod ces zer ba dang / lding dpon kho pa de ga rang du yod stabs khyod nas rngon rgyag byas min 'dri skabs de sngon brgyab myong yod pa las/ da lta rngon rgyag med tshul zhu brdzus ma gtogs don du kho rang yod stabs rngon rgyag mi chog pa'i mtha' 144

'doms gan 'bul 'jug snon gsham 'og mgo 'og lus chug bkod bshad bya rgyu ltar bzhag da dung ngan pa khyu 'dres kyis khyod rang lding dpon ngo mas de ltar byed pa 'os min yi na zhes bsgrags thog dran brten rta lcag tsha thag chod 200tham pa btang ba yin/ de 'phrasmu zhu brgyud bya mi gtso rgan bcas mang pos da nas bzung dngos shugs gang sar rngon rgyag mi byed pa'i 'gan 'bul chog pa dang / sngon chad 'gal char bka' nyes ci gsung sgrub 'thus zhu ngor snga 'phros nyes pa rnams gtsang sgrub zhu gan zur len gyis da pal 'bar dgon par bka' 'gyur nyin lnga'i thebs rtsa dang / de min dgon khag bzhi so sor bka' 'gyur nyin re'i thebs rtsa re/ de byings dgon pa dang / ri khrod khag gi sgrub btsun bcas par mchod 'bul dang bsnyen bkur zhu rgyu'i khungs so sor shoka lho zur 'don gyis dgon khag so sos nyes 'bab khungs sgrig byung (raphra'/ haṃ bag g.yo 'gebs med pa'i snyan seng dgos lus/sa bkod 'doms byas don ltar/ zla shas song mtshams nyes 'bab rnams gtsang bsgrubs byas zin pas de skor thag gcod gnang rogs zhu gi 'dug cing / des na slad phyim/ gzhung sa'i bka' don gan 'doms phyogs 'gal byas pas mi tshad rdzong sdong ngo g.yog nyung shas thog mi mang dpung sdeb de rigs dus nam yang mi byed pa'i 'gan khag gdeng thub byung bas/ snga 'phros gan 'doms kyis 'thus pa byas te/ rdzong 'phos te phyir log byed khar rngon rgyag skor thag gcod byas thogagan rgya'i nang don phyin chad spang blangs khrims khur dgos stabs gan rgya ngo ma rdzong thog rim nga/'i sprod khongs yod pas khyod tshos khrims mthun byed dgos zhes brjod pa yin/ de skor nyes pa gong gsal las/ sger gyi nyes chad co ba nas btang med/shing bya (1945)bod zla 6tshes 7zhogs pa dar rgyas dgon pa'i tshong pa 'dra ba'i mi bzhi dang / rta drel bsdoms dgu yod pa zhig rdzong mdun gzhung 145

lam brgyud phyin song / de nas yun ring ma song bar chab mdo nas bka' rgya skyel mkhan ding ri dmag zhig 'byor byung zhing / bka' skogs nang bka' shag gi bka' rgya gcig dang sbrags mdo spyi dza sag g.yu thog pa'i bka' rgya zhig 'dug cing / mdo spyi'i bka' rgya'i nang bka' shag gi bka' rgya ngo ma zur du yod pa ltar/ ser byes mkhan zur ngag dbang rgya mtsho ngo ga yog 4bo/ lag rang 'grigs dang / rta drel 9bcas lha ldan nas zla 3tshes shar du bros byol song 'dug pa kho pa tsho da phan sa gnas de khul brgyud song zin yod tshe dogs can mi rta'i kha grangs dang / kha ris ngo mdog zla tshes de nyin sa phyogs gang du bskyod skor gnas tshul zhib lhongs kyi snyan 'bul 'phral gtong dgos pa las/snang chung lhod g.yeng gtan nas med pa dgos rgyu zhes 'khod 'dug bka' shag gi bka' rgya'i nang ser byes mkhan zur ngag dbang rgya mtsho'i spun gzhon pa phyag mdzod hor phrug zer ba dang / pad+ma rdo rje/ rdob rdob 'bar tshag zer ba bcas ngo g.yog bzhi dang / go lag rang 'grigs/ rta rkyang po ze ring cha 1dang / rkyang po 2 wol ba 1 khal drel rag mo cha 1dang / rgya mo 2bcas bsdoms rta drel 9bcas yod lugs 'khod pa gong gsal 'grul pa de tsho bzo dbyibs byas na 'dra po 'dug rung / kho tsho zla 3pa nang bros byol song ba zhig yin dus da bar de mur sdod blos bzod thabs bral bas rgya gar rgya na/ga sa gnas gang du song yang slebs tshod red/ bka' shag gi bka' rgya zla 3tshes 16ces 'khod pa da bar 'gor 'gyangs byung 'dug gang ltar bka' don 'gal med mi de tshor brtag dpyad zhib nan zhig ma byas thabs med la song /nga tshos gros bsdur byas te rdzong gi drung yig bu bdud 'dul ngo g.yog gnyis sngon la thon thog kho pa tsho rjes zin na ngos 'phrad byas te phyogs cig nas gang 'dra yin min myang zhib bya rgyu dang / phyogs gzhan zhig nas lha rtse khul nas yul dmag mi grangs 200skor bsdu bskong byas te gra sgrig byed par sngon la 146

btang don/ drung yig ngo g.yog gnyis 'gro skabs ser byes mkhan zur ngo g.yog bzhi dpal 'bar rdzong nas le dbar 3tsam gyi sar 'phrang chung zhig yol tsam gyi lam kha'i gsham du tshwa phog brgyab ste bsdad yod pas/ drung yig bu bdud 'dul gyis ‘‘khyed rnam pa gang du byon mkhan yin nam ’’zhes dris lan du kho pa tshos ‘‘nga tsho dar rgyas dgon pa'i tshong pa yin/ pha yul la log 'gro mi yin ’’zhes zer ba ma gtogs gzhan gyi skang/ cha mi shod par me mda' pud mo'i 'og tu mnan nasga sdod pa dang / rta la'ang lag lcag brgyab yod 'dug g.yog po pad+ma rdo rje zer ba des khyed rang gang du phebs mkhan yin nam zhes tshur dris lan du/ nga tsho rdzong ngo las khral bsdur skyod mi yin/ de ring phyi po chags song rung ma song na mi ser gyis sgug bsdad yod pa red ces ba'ad 'dug yang pad+ma rdo rjes ‘‘dpal 'bar rdzong gang du red dam der rdzong gi drung yig dbang phyug lags kyi bu bdud 'dul zer ba bsdad yod med gsung rgyu yod dam ’’zhes bris 'dug bu bdud 'dul gyis ‘‘bu bdud 'dul zer ba nga yin/ dpal rdzong dang / nga'i nang dgon pa'i shar gyi grong der yin pas der brtsad gcod ma gnang ba gang yin nam ’’zhes bshad par kho tshos ‘‘nga tsho da lam ma gtogs de snga yong myong red/ nga tshor chag rtsam dang rta dre' gyi rmig lcags bcas nyo dgos yod pas snyi mo rdo dgon gyi gnyer chen lags kyis ngas mngags byung ze bu bdud 'dul la gsungs na khos rog/sa pa zhu gi red ces gsungs byung / nga tshos khyod rang bzhugs yul ma shes pa red/gong du zhus pa ltar chag rtsam dang / rta drel tshang mar rmig lcags bcas dgos pa dam don gnang rogs ’’zhes bshad 'dug bu bdud 'dul gyis ‘‘do cub ngas lha rtser bsdad thog chag rtsam dang rmig lcags bcas gra sgrig zhus te phe bas sgug zhus chog do nub la rtsar rtswa yag po yod pas der bzhugs na dga' ’’zhes bshad de thon 'dug nga tshos dpal 'bar rdzong nye 'khor nas 147

mi grangs 100skor bsdus te do nub bam/ sang nyin gal te kho tshos phyir log rgyab byung na 'phrang 'gag de srung bkag yag po byas/ te bsad bzung gang thub bya rgyu bkod sgrig byas pa yin/ bu bdud 'dul gyi bsam par rdzong ngo g.yog ga/nyis gsum las yong mkhan med pas kho tsho'i dogs zon che lugs la bltas na gang 'dra byas yong snyam pas po ta la'i sked pa khar nga yong min rgyang so lta skabasagayog po tshe dbang lha rgyal zer bas sngon la mthong ste/ ‘‘bu bdud 'dul da gin pho gsar grwa gzhon de'i ma tsam de nas yong gi 'dug ’’ces brostan 'dug lam seng spang khar mgo zug brgyab ste dbugs bsgoms stabs rngul chu thon par brten pad+ma rdo rje der slebs nas gang byas byung zhes bshad 'dug bu bdud 'dul gyis ‘‘da gin sa gsher gyi rkyen pas grang sing gi nad langs te shi grabs byas byung ’’zhes bshad pa dang / pad+ma rdo rjes lam seng kho pa'i 'bral spang nang nas gro mo dge bshes rin po che'i rin chen ril bu rdog 3bster nas gcig za ru bcug 'dug da gin mjal dus zhu rgyu byung ma song /lag rtags stong min tsam yin zhes rgya gar nas thon pa'i a chor spu ma che ba 1dang / yi rtsi che ba 1sprad 'dug bu bdud 'dul gyis kho pa de nub lha rtser mnyam du 'khrid rtsis byas 'dug kyang kho pas ‘‘sang nyin mjal yong ’’zhes bshad de phyir log byas 'dug nga rang g.yog po gnyis bcas rjes su thon yong dus mkhan po ngo g.yo ga tsho la rtswa'i na gshongs su gur phub ste bsdad 'dug pa dang / rta drel rnams rta lcags brgyab ste bkram bzhag 'dug nga la rtsar slebs pa dang pad+ma rdo rjes rta rkyang po zhig khrid de mar yong ba dang 'phrad byung / kho pas lam seng ngo shes kyi sgo nas zhwa mo phud cing / ngas ‘‘khyed rang su yin nam/ mthong myong yod pa zhig red 'dug ’ces bshad pa yin/ kho pas ‘‘nga mkhar rdo bla brang gi zhabs grasayin/ ming pad+ma rdo rje zer gyi yod ’’ces bshad byung / ‘‘gang du 'gro 148

mkhan ’’zhes 'dri skabs kho pas ‘‘sa tham la tshong la 'gro mkhan yin/ rta drel rnams byang lam brgyud thon song / nga rang snga lo rgya gar du tshong la 'gro rtsis dang 'doms nas rjes su lus te rta rkyang byas te 'gro blos ma bzod par da lam dar dgon tshong dpon khong tsho dang mnyam du lam grogs btsal te yong pa yin/ rta drel rnams chab mdor 'dzoms dus byas pa yin ’’zhes bshad byung /ngas kyang ngo shes 'phrad pas dga' snang skyes khul byas te do nub nga tsho mnyam du 'gro dgos zhes khrid rtsis byas rung kho pas slebs ma byung / nga tsho lha rtser 'byor 'phral yul dmag bsdu bskong byas par de nub mi grangs 200skor 'dzoms byung zhing / 'grul pa de tshor 'jam 'dri byas pa mi shod pa thag gis chod/ lam seng 'dzin bzung byed par kho tsho mi bzhir me mda' ring thung 2re yod 'dug pas nga tsho'i go lag re zung dang / bod mda'/ gri mdung kha shas kyis ya lan sprong/ thabs bral stabs bla ma chos srung la rgyab brten bcol rgyu las ma 'os pas skabs 'phral lha rtser dgon gyi grwa pa brgyad gras srung mar 'phrin bcol dang 'brel/ ‘‘ser byes mkhan zur ngag dbang rgya mtsho ngo ma yin min gyi rtags ston stsol mi’zhes zan ril dkrug skabs lam seng 'phar mchong dmigs bsal gyis rtags thon la ser byes mkhan zur ngo ma yin zhes pa thon byung / yang bskyar ‘‘zhi ba'i thabs la khug gam drag po'i thabs lam sprod dgos rtags thon stsol ’’zhes pare drag po'i thabs lam sprod dgos zhes pa tho'o byung bas/ de nub grwa grangs 30skor gyis mtshan gang srung mar 'phrin bcol zhu ru bcug ste ja thug gzab rgyas btang ba dang / yul dmag mi grangs 200skor la bod mda' 20dang / gri mdung 50skor las go lag mi 'dug stabs mi grangs phyogs bgos kyis skabs der bod zla 6tshes shar yin stabs char chu rgyas sgang yin pas lha rtse'i 'phrang 'gag0bsrung du bcug pa dang /nga tshos sang zhogs kho pa tsho lha rtser 'obyor skabs bka' shag dang / mdo spyi'i 149

bka' rgya'i dgongs don gsel dkrol byas te phyogs gcig nas 'jam mkhas kyi sgo nas le gang 'grigs yong thabs byas rung nyan sems gtan nas mi 'dug phyogs gzhan zhig nas 'jigs skul bshad de ‘‘da lta nga tshos rang gzhan gnyis sdug ma dgos pa'i gang drag byas par nyan 'jog ma byas na/ da ring nga tsho'i sa gnas su yul dmag mi grangs 200skor gyis bsrung bkag yod pas 'di nas thar mi srid pa ma zad/ gal te 'di nas thar kyang smad phyogs rdzong khag dang / dmag sgar mang po'i bsrung 'gag nas thar re bral bas ma 'gyod pa byed dgos ’’zhes bshad thog kho pa tsho 'phrang 'gag nang tshud pa dang me mda'i brda sprod byas stabs ri sna yas mas gnyis nas rbab rdo dang /shing gdung bsgril ba/ bod mda' 'ga' brgyab pa'i sgras skabs shig ring sa gnas der zing long chen po byas song yang / ser byes mkhan zur ngo g.yog bzhis brag 'og cig tu ngang tsam yib nas go skabs rnyed 'phral bros thar 'dug yin na'ang khal drel rag mo gcig me mdas bsad pa dang / dre'u gcig rmas 'dug za nyal chas/ gur dang / lag sgam rgyab gcig bcas do grangs 11tsam lag son byung stabs bka' don ma 'gal tsam rang sa nos bsrung bkag de lhag bya thabs mi 'dug snyam ste de nyin dgong dro bar bsrung ste/kho tsho'i dngos po thob pa nas ja mar rtsam pa dang / gtsang rum kha gdan gnyis bcas mi ser spyir bster/ de 'phros tho bkod byas te mkhan zur ngo g.yog gi 'dra par dang / ser byes mkhan po gsar bsko skabs kyi 'char gzhi phyag rtags 'byar ma ngo ma bcas snyan khongs bcug thog chab mdo nas 'byor ba'i a drung rta shad kho pa lam seng phyir log btang ba yin/ de dang chabs cig sho mdo dang / lho rdzong / spo bo rdzong khag bcas so sor bka' rgya nang gsal dang phyogs mthun grwa rigs bzhi bcas 'di ga sa gnas nas bros shor song ba/ de nas thabs rnam gang 'os dgos skor gnas tshul btang ba yin/150

zla 6tshes 9nyin rta shad a drung kho pa ba ri nang zer ba nas thon te brag la zer ba'i lam du skyod skabs rta shad dmag a drung kho pa sngon la skyod pa dang / ba ri nang rta slog pa rjes la yong gi yod pas ser byes mkhan po ngo g.yog gis rgyang ring nas mthong stabs ser byes mkhan zur ngo g.yog tsho'i bsam par dpal 'bar rdzong gi g.yog po red bsam ste rjes ma der dmigs te me mda' rgyab thog ba ri nang gi rta slog pa de de gar bsad rkyen rta shad dmag kho pa ri brgyud kyis bros 'dug de rjes kho pa tshos rta slog pa khams mi yin pa shes stabs phung po'i 'gram du grwa pa'i sham thabs bzo bya'i ther bub 2dang / me mda'i mdel gang tsam zhig bzhag 'dug zer ba go thos byung / gang ltar ser byes mkhre/ na po ngo g.yog bzhi thad kar chab mdor 'gro rtsis byas 'dug gnam mtsho la rtsar 'grul pa zhig la gnas tshul 'dri skabs kho pas ser byes mkhan po bkag mi red ces chab mdo'i gu ru zam khar dmag mi kha shas yod skad dang /de min sbir grags yod skad thos rkyen gnam mtsho la rtsa'i gla mda' zer ba nas mkhan ngo/sa g.yog po gsum la khyod tsho kha byang la bltas te rgya sder 'go bcol byed par bros dgos pa'i mngags cha byas thog mkhan zur ngag dbang rgya mtsho rang nyid kyi gyon chas rnams 'phud nas sprang chas spras te 'gro skabs zam srung dmag mis lhod g.yeng byung skor dang / chab mdor 'byor nas nyin shas bsdad thog dar dgon tshong rigs tshos bsrung skyel byas skor go thos byung /zla 6tshes 10nyin nga rang gi zla gras blo gros zer ba dngos rigs phran yod rnams rtsis 'bul zhu ba sbrags/ zhib phra'i gnas tshul snyan 'bul zhu bar ched btang kho pa chab mdor yod skabs ri bo che'i nye 'gram rngo shod nas zer ba'i sa gam/sa shig tu sa srung ga dang dmag dang / cha dang / nga dang bcas kyi 'go dmag 400skor dang / g.yog po mi gsum bcas 'thab ra 'phrod de g.yog po gnyis rgya sde'i nang bros shor ba dang / phyag mdzod hor phrug zer ba bsad 151

pa'i mgo lag de ser byes mkhan po'i mgo lag min ’’zhes 'byor 'dugagayog po mi gnyis rgya sde'i nang bros shor ba mdo spyi dza sag g.yu thog gis gsan 'phral gzhung sa'i mtshan don la dgongs te lam seng mdo las skyar srib pa ched rdzong gdong sa 'gor phyag bris pa sbrags/ mi rta go lag bcas bslu byed gser dang / ras sa mdog tha na kha shas bskur gnang mdzad pa ltar rgya sde'i sa 'gos g.yog po mi 2dang / go lag rta bcas phyir sprod zhus pa mnyam khrid kyis chab mdor 'byor 'dug skabs der chab mdor sbir skad la star rdzong snar skyid pas ser byes mkhan po'i lag nas ger dngul mang po blangs te bros btang ba red ces zer ba de rta shad dmag kho pas bzos pa zhig gtan 'khel red snyam/ de 'phral mdo spyis g.yog po 2der tsha 'dri zhus thog star rdzong gis btang pa'i dngos thor he bag yod med dang / star rdzong sa gnas nas ngo cha khrod stangs skor nan 'dri mdzad skabs kho pa gnyis kyi zhu khongs su star rdzong gis phul ba'i dngos thor he bag mi 'dug me mdel grangs 50skor tshang min nga tsho rang gi ma nges pa min nam snyam pa/ sa gnas su tsha 'jam gang thub byas skor zhus 'dug mkhan zur ngag dbang rgya mtsho dang khong gsum gla mda' nas kha gyes skor dang / khong gsum bros —'gro skabs dmag mi dang 'thab lugs/ da lta'i mgo lag de phyag mdzod hor phrug gi mgo lag yin skor/ dpal 'bar rdzong gi nga tsho'i za nyal rnams blangs song ba ma gtogs lag sne gser sa gzugs bcad 'phros dang / leb lcug 8brgya lor ṭam rdo 1000skor phyag mdzod kyi rta bro'i nang yod pas mgo lag dang bzhon rta bcas rtsis 'bul zhu mir gong gsal gser dngul rnams brtsad gcod yod pa zhus stabs dgongs dwangs lta bus phran nas mdo spyir snyan 'bul zla gras btang ba kho pa'i gdong bka' lan dang bcas phyir slog gnang 'dug gong gsal gnas tshul khag gzhan rnams mdo las skyar srib pa ngo mas gsungs pa ma gtogs gzhan nas go brgyu da gtam 'chal rigs min/ (rtsom sgrig pa'i 152

sbrags mchan/ gong skone 'di ga'i 'don thengs 12nang bkod pa'i bu bdud 'dul gyi gsung tshul dang zla dus sogs phran bu mi 'dra yang 'dir dpyad gzhi yin pas do bdag gis bris gnang ba'i bka' mol rang sor bzhag ste bkod yod/)me phag (1947)lor mdo spyi gsar pa sa dbang lha klu yar phebs ska/bas star rdzong khongs ba zhong dgon gyi grwa rigs dgra 'dul zer bas kho pa'i rgyu dngos btsan 'phrog byas lugs dang / gzhan gcig ni gzhung rgyugs khang khyim don dbyangs zer bas kho pa'i sa brten mkhar dngos rdzong gis btsan 'phrog gzhan sprod byas byung zhes phebs lam phyag 'tshal snyan 'bul zhus 'dug pa/ de skor bka' rtsad skabs ngas grwa rigs dgra 'dul zer bas rnam kun dgom pa'i 'dul khrims rtsi med kyi brdal mkhe ha len gang 'dod ltar 'gro skyod byas skor dgon pa'i las snes rgyu rkyen zhus skor dang / phyos/sa mtshungs tshong pa dang lab rtsod byung rkyen brdal dngul ṭam rdo 15gzhung bzhes btang lugs/ gzhan zhig khang khyim don dbyangs kho pa bu spun gnyis nas de sngon rdzong rnying skyar srib pa'i 'bru mar gang tsam brkus rkyen skabs der sa brten phyed tsam blangs te khral bzo khungs 'jug byas lugs snyan sgron zhus stabs de'i sang nyin phebs khar snyan 'bul zhu mi gong gsal skya ser gnyis la khrims sa/cod rta lcag 50re gtong gnang thog slad phyin sa gnas rdzong sdod kyi khral khrims gang cir brtsi bkur tshul mthun dgos pa'i bka' 'doms gnang song yang / de nub dgong dro lha rtse bzhag sar slebs skabs bka' mgron byang chub lags nas nga la ba zhong dgon gyi grwa dgra 'dul zer bar brdal dngul ṭam rdo 15phyir sprod byed dgos gsungs byung / de rjes kho pa grwa dgra 'dul la dngul 'bab len par yong dgos skul dam snga rjes btang rung / ma yong rnga4'i thog kho pa'i spun pho gsar zhig yong ste snga phyir go nyan ma byas rkyen kho par khrims sar gtod med dran rten yin zhes rta lcag brgya skor btang thog/153

dngul 'bab rnams mdo phogs hor khang bsod nams dpal 'bar chab phebs gdong bka' mgron byang chub lags su phyag bris dang sbrags bskur ba yin /de snga star rdzong rim can dbyar mar bsdu skyod skabs gsol dod ces lug shed bzang re 'bul len byed srol lam ngan zhig 'dug pa de dang /gzhan zhig ni star rdzong sa gnas su khral skul mkhan a drung yan gyis rta khal sdod sgrig smos med thog ja'i rgyag tshwa yang mi ser nas gtong dgos pa'i lam ngan mu 'byams su gnas mus de gnyis slad phyin mi chog pa'i bde sdug snyan zhus khag 2so sor sa dbang lha klus bka' 'go gtsang btsan stsal ba khungs so sor ngo bshus rdzong tham sbyar ma re dang sbrags bka' 'go ngo ma bdag nyar yag po byed dgos pa dang / mig ston byed dgos byung na ngo bshus rdzong tham 'byar mas 'thus nges bshad pa yin/ thengs shig tha dang dmag sgar gyi dbyar dgun gyon dod bsdu mi lding dpon 1dang / bcu dpon 1 dmag dkyus 2bcas 'byor byung ba kho pa tsho'i gdong khal rgyab 30tsam 'dug pas/ khal rgyab 10'phar skul byas 'dugatshabs che ba zhig la dos ljid ches rkyen ba ri nang nas star rdzong sa gnas lha rtse zer ba'i bar nyin tshugs gcig gi sar sho mdo ba'i khal ma sems can 3tsam sked pa chag skyon byung 'dug pa ma zad/ khal ma mang che ba chad lus byung 'dug der brten lding bcu gnyis la dos rnams bzo bcos kyis dpyad don bzhin 'degs khal tshad long bzo dgos pa dang / khal ma kha shas 'phar rigs nga tshos 'drong thabs byas 'thus skor nyin 3'jam mkhas kyi go bsres bshad rung nyan 'jog med par nga tsho dmag sgar gyi rgyu dngos gal che rdzong dang / mi ser nas rtsis len dgos pa dang rta'u dgos lugs brjod 'dugargan pos ji 'dra 'gab min dris byung zhing ngas rgan por rta 'ul gra sgrig gis gtong dgos/ rdzong gi ngo tshab dang mi ser thun cho/nga nas dmag dos rnams 154

rtsis len byas te khang pa zhig tu bcug ste dam chas byas pa yin/ dmag mi rnams thon thog o rgyan ta mda' zer bar nyin 3sgug nas dos rnarma sa 'phral skyel dgos pa'i lan yang yang 'byor byung / de lan khyod tshos rtsis sprad pa ltar nga tshos rtsis len byas zin pa yin/ dos rnams gzhung sa dang chab mdo bka' shag so sor snyan seng zhus te sku tshab gdan zhus kyis rtsis 'bul zhu rgyu ma gtogs/ khyod tshor rtsis sprod bya thabs med nges brjod rkyen lding bcu 2phyir log thog dgongs sel yin khul gyi don du dos rnams gtong dgos nan brjod byed kyi 'dug mthar dose phal che bsngogs bsher skabs khom do ya re'i nang ja sgam 2re dang / tsag tsig dos long tsam yod stabs mi gnyis kyi pang du theg tshad tsam 'dug cing / skabs der mi ser la 'phar brdabs byung bas gun mthud dngul srang 600lag sprod byed bcug pa dang / khal ma 'phar song la yul srol bdal gla sprod rgyur gan 'jog byas te thag gcod byas pa yin/yang me phag lo ding ri dmag sgar 'khor zhag (ragro rgyu'i chab mdo dang /lagong rngan mda' bcas nas btang ba'i mda' yig snga rjes rim pa dza drag gis btang 'byor nang star rdzong nas rgyal ston brgyud ces lam yig nang gsal bkod yod bzhin du sma ri dang / lho rdzong / sho mdo bcas nas gzhung lam brgyud 'gro rgyu'i rta khal sogs gra sgrig dgos lugs gsal 'dug cing /nga tshos go thos la 'bri ru mnga' zhabs dang / rgyal ston pa bcas kyis bang mi ched btang byas lugs go thos ltar sgug sdod skabs dmag sgar ma 'byor gong rgyal ston pa dang / 'bri ru'i bang mi gnyis phyir log skabs nga tshos bzung nas sanas tshul dris par lam 'gyur zhu bar phyin lugs ngos len byas song bar brten gnas skabs do dam byas te nyar ba yin/ de rjes dmag sgar 'byor 'phral gzhung lam brgyud de 'gro rtsis byed kyi 'dug nga tshos zhu rten dang sbrags mda' yig sngon stsal ltar rgyal ston brgyud phebs rogs ces nan 155

bstud byas kyang nyan 'jog med stabs nga rang ngo mas ru brgya dang 'phrod mol byed skabaso gzhung sa'i go lag gal che 'gan blos bzod min la brten rtsis len dgos lugs brjod byung / de'i lan du khyod tshos thugs 'gan ma bzod ripa bzhin du nga tshos kyang de bas 'gan blos mi bzod pa gzhung lam brgyud lam thag ring ba dang / sa rong lam 'phrang dog pa/ lhag par du rgyal star dbar lam phyogs skor rgya bod shan sbyar gyi rtsa tshig khang dang / sbug tham/ srid tham/bka' tham khag mang por rta khal lam phyogs gtan 'bebs dgongs don ma zad/ de bzhin da lam bka' lam la'ang rgyal ston brgyud 'gro phyogs zhal gsal yod par brten gong gsal rgyu mtshan de dag gis 'gan blos bzod thabs med pas/ galda te gzhung go lag rdzas mdel rnams rtsis len byed dgos byung kyang rtsis ma blangs thabs bral la brten rtsis len byas chogagazhung lam brgyud rta khal sne gcig mi gtong thag gcod yin nges ma zad/rgyal ston dang / 'bri ru'i bang mi gnyis po de yang da lta 'di gar do dam byas yod ces mi gnyis ngo sprags byas stabs mthar dmag sgar rgyal ston brgyud mi 'gro thabs med byung song / dmag sgar thon rjes bang mi gnyis phyir slog byas thog rgyal ston pa dang / 'bri ru gnyis la yi ge btang don ‘‘khyod tshos sa 'og dar 'thag gi bya spyod der brten star rdzong mi ser la 'phar brdabs chen po byung bas bde sdug mi gsol thabs med kyang / rdzong 'go sa 'brel la brten gun gsab nang mol bya rtsis yod na ngang sgug bya rgyur yig lan 'phral gtong dgos ’’zhes btang ba yin/ de snga kong po rgya dma' nas yun nan bar lho brgyud gzhung lam gsar bzo bya rtsis kyis kong rdzong khag dang / spo bo/ sho star lho gsum bcas thun mong du bzhag pa'i gan rgyar rgya bod shan sbyar 'go mchan yod pa'i yig khag gal che mang po yod pa bcas ngos rang star rdzong rdzong sdod byed ring gi gnas tshul dmigs bsal 'ga' zhig skor gang dran de tsam mo/156

sa glang (1949)lor de snga'i bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis byang rgyud khul du dmag phogs 'bum 'bru 'dren gsog bgyis pa'i skor/ngag dbang blo bzang /bod zhi bas bcings 'grol thob nye ste/ sa glang (1949)lor de snga'i bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis bcings 'grol dmag dpung bod la dpung bskyod bya rgyur drag shugs kyi thog nas bkag 'gog byed ched dmag rgyags mthun rkyen 'bru ru'i khal 'bum gcig byang rgyud nag chu dang / hor sbra chen sa gnas so sor 'dren gsog byas shing / 'bru 'bab thad gtsang khul gzhis rtse dang / pa snam/ 'dus byung / dbang ldan/ rgyal rtse/ srad rin rtse/phun gling / lha rtse/ ngam ring / shel dkar/ e nyin mkhar/ rnam gling /rgya mtsho/ lha bu/ gling dkar/ rin spungs bcas kyi zhib 'phar bkar steng nas 'don 'dren dang / 'bru 'bab 'dren khal thad gong gsal rdzong gzhis rnams kyi thog gam pa dang / mar rkyang / snye mo bcas kyi khal yod thog 'bebs 'dren bgyid skabs 'bum 'bru 'bebs 'dren do dam pa nga'i shag tshang dge rgan rtse mgron bshes gnyen byams chen dang / shod drung skyar srib pa/rdzong gzhis khag gi bkar 'bru bskyar gshor dang / 'bum 'bru 'don sprod do dam pa gcig lcogs rong yul lha gzhis sdod rtse drung sgo mang thub bstan blo 157

bzang dang / shod drung shud khud pa/ byang khul sa gnas so sor 'bru 'bab rtsis le na bkar 'jug do dam pa rtse mgron don sgrub rgyal po dang / shod drung tsha rdi na/na pa bcas so sor bsko gzhag thog 'bum 'bru 'bebs 'dren do dam sbrel por gsham 'og las byed du gzhis rtser bca' sdod cha dang dmag sgar nas dmag mi lding 'og gcig kyang rtsis sprod byas/ skabs der deng dus lta bu'i 'phrul 'khor dang / 'grim 'grul stabs bde gtam/ nas med pas sa gnas nye 'gyang gang sar rta drel dang / khal bong / khal g.ya ga sogs kyi sgal thog kho nar bskyel 'dren bya dgos la brten 'bum 'bru 'dren khal skor bka' shag nas 'bum 'bru 'bebs 'dren do dam sbrel por sprad pa'i bka' tham lag rtsi 'bru don du ‘‘da lam rgyal bstan chab srid srungatshodamag gi phogs dmigs bstan don gal che yul gnyan la brten gzhung sger chos bcas bka' gtan btsan dmigs che chung la ma ltos pa'i rgyugs pa leb 'dur gyi khal 'phyags bskul gtong dgos rgyu ’ zhes gsal ba ltar 'bum 'bru do dam pas stod phyogs rdzong gzhis khag dang / mar rkyang / snye mo bcas kyi khal tho rang rang rdzong gzhis brgyud tho len byas pa dang / de min gzhis rtse nga/nga /srad rin rtse/ gam pa/ pa snam/ 'dus byung / dbang ldan/ rgyal rtse/ rnam gling / rgya mtsho/ lha bu/ gling dkar/ rin spungs bcas la 'bum 'bru do dam ngo ma ngo tshab phyogs bgos kyis sa gnas so sor khal tho 'god len thoga'abru 'bab yangs can bar 'bebs 'dren byed phyogs skor rdzong gzhis so so'i ngo tshab dang / gtso drag mnga' khul mi ser gyi spyi 'thus do chod bcas gzhis rtser bskong tshogs kyis gang 'gab ci legs gros sdur gyis mos mthun byung ba brgyud 'bum 'bru 'bebs 'dren do dam ser skya sbrel pos bka' shag la 'char phul phyag rtags don bzhin rdzong gzhis so so'i khal 'bor thon khungs che chung dang / thag nye 'brel mtshungs la gzhigs pa'i stod smad bar 158

gsum du dbye ste stod phyogs lha ngam phun gsum dang / shel dkar/ e nyin mkhar bcas kyi bkar steng nas ‘radon sprod byas rigs lha phun ko sa bar rdzong gzhis so so'i rang khongs khal yod thog dbor 'dren dang / de nas stag gru ko sa bar chu thog ko bar 'bebs 'dren gyis ko gla gong gsal rdzong gzhis khag gi khal 'bor la gzhigs nas bsdu sprod bgyis pa dang / bar tsho ba/zhis rtse dang / srad rin rtse/ pa snam/ 'dus byung / dbang ldan/ rgyal rtse bcas kyi bkar steng nas 'don sprod byas rigs rang so so'i khal yod thog 'od yug 'dzoms thang bar chu rang skol bskyel 'dren thog gong gsal stod phyogs rdzong gzhis kyi rabru 'bor stag gru ko sar chu thog 'bebs 'dren bgyis rigs 'od yug 'dzoms thang sa gnas bar gong gsal gzhis rgyal/ pa 'dus dbang gsum/ srad rin rtse bcas kyi khal 'bor thog cha gses 'bebs 'dren byas pa/ smad cha shangs yug rdzong khag bzhi dang / rin spungs bcas kyi bkar steng nas 'don sprod byas rigs gong bzhin rang khungs so so'i khal yod nas 'od yug 'dzoms thang bar 'bebs 'dren thog gong gsal gtsang rdzong khag gi bkarari steng nas 'don 'dren bgyis pa'i 'bru 'bab bcas 'od yug 'dzoms thang sa gnas nas yangs can bar shangs yug rdzong gzhis rnam gling dang / lha bu/ rgya mtsho/ gling dkar/ rin spungs/ mar rkyang / snye mo bcas kyis yangs can bar 'bebs 'dren bgyis pa/ yangs can nas/nag chu dang / hor sbra chen so sor 'bru 'bor ji 'bebs kyi khal ma byang spyi mkhan rim sbrel pos byang rigs sde bzhi'i khal thog 'bebs 'dren byas/skabs der tā la'i bla ma gro mor yod stabs gro mo bka' shag nas gro mor thugs mkho 'bru ru'i khal lnga stong tham pa 'bebs 'bul dgos rgyu'i 'bum 'bru 'be+ebs 'dren do dam par bka' rgya 'byor don 'bru 'bab shel dkar bkar steng nas 'don 'dren gyis gam gting phag ri brgyud 'bebs 'bul 159

byas pa bcas 'bum 'bru 'bebs 'dren skor gyi gzhi rtsa'i gnas tshul de ltar lags kyang / skabs der 'grim 'grul mi bde ba'i thog 'bru 'bor shin tu che bas khal 'khri gzhung sger chos bcas 'go dmangs tshang mar ngal brdabs ci che yong rgyu ma zad/ las don byed po 'bum 'bru 'be+ebs 'dren do dam pa la'ang khal 'khri 'go dmangs rnams nas sa gnas so sor sne len gzab rgyas dang 'brel sa gnas kyi mjal zhu smos med thog skyabs rten 'bul len brdabs bsigs shugs kyis yong nges dang / lhag par gsham 'og las don byed po dmag sgar lding dmag song stabs de bas 'dod brngams kyis mi ser la 'phar brdabs mi yo nga ba mi srid/ 'on kyang mi ser 'go dmangs nas dmigs bsal bde sdug rgyu rkyen zhu rigs med bzhin par skabs der gzhis rtse spyi rdzong tha'i ji zom phud pa dang / mkhan chung thon pa byams pa mkhas grub yin yang / tha'i ji zom phud pa ni rgyal rtser ser lcog tu 'byed khra 'god par bskyod skabs 'das grongs kyis ngo tshab yin stabs gzhis rdzong gi 'gan dbang gtso bo mkhan chung thon pa rang nas byed kyi yod cing / spyi rdzong mkhan chung thon pa byams pa mkhas grub dang / 'bum 'bru 'bebs 'dren do dam pa'i dbar dang thog mthun lam mi gshin pa'i gnas tshul med pa ma zad/lhag par du 'bum 'bru 'bebs 'dren do dam pa rtse mgron bshes byams dang /spyi rdzong mkhan chung thon pa gnyis dbar phar tshur thugs spro gtong res sogs dga' po nye po byas song yang / mthar mi mthun pa'i 'gal zla byung ste 'khrug gzhi 'di 'dra zhig byung song ba ste/ dmag phogs 'bum 'bru 'dren khal gzhung sger chos bcas bka' gtan btsan dmigs che chung la ma ltos pa'i rgyugs pa leb 'dur la brten khre/ la 'khri gzhung sger chos bcas 'go dmangs tshang mas 'bum 'bru 'be+ebs 'dren do dam par gus gus sbyar sbyar rang shugs kyis byed dgos stabs de dag spyi rdzong mkhan chung thon pa'i mig nang ma 160

'gro ba'i phrag dog lta bus thog ma'i 'gal rkyen yong gzhi ni/ gzhis rtse khul 'bum 'bru'i las don byed skabs gzhis byes 'khur mnyam len gyi spyi rdzong ngo tshab tu khang gnyer klu lding pa bsod nams tshe ring btang bar mthong phyogs dogs 'char ji byung ma nges shing / gang ltar nyin gcig spyi rdzong mkhan chung thon pas rang nyid kyi las shag tu khang gnyer klu lding pa ched 'gugs kyis dmigs bsal gnad don 'di yin med par khyod kyis 'bum 'bru do dam pa dang nga tsho'i dbar dkrug shing rgyag gi yod lugs kyi gshe gshe dang 'brel khang gnyer klu lding pa'i mgo skra nas 'jus te nyes brdung btang bar brten klu lding pa mgo skra zing zing thog mar lam rtse mgroske bshes byams sar shar rgyag yong ste ngu 'bod dang 'brel ‘‘sku ngo thon pas bka' bkyon phyag 'beb gnang ’’lugs bshad thog ‘‘ngas sku ngo rnam pa'i dbar phung dkrug bya rgyu gang yang ma byung bas sku ngo rdzong dgongs pa dwangs thabs kyi gnas tshul zhu gnang yod pa ’’zhes brjod par brten nyin gcig spyi rdzong mkhan chung thon pa'i sar rtse mgron bshes byams bab gses zhu bar song yang / gang ltar phyi tshul gnad don de 'dra zhig gi thog nas rim bzhin 'gal ba je rnor song ste gtsang rdzong spyi dang /lhag par gzhis rtse rdzong 'og gzhung bla sa gsum gyi mi ser 'go dmangs nas snyan seng zhu rigs gang yang med bzhin par spyi rdzong mkhan chung thon pas rang dgar bka' shag la snyan zhu brdzus ma zhig phul zhing / skabs der gzhis rtse 'du khongs nas ma ṇi dung sgrub kyi dbu bzhugs su gro mo dge bshes rin po che rgyal rtse nas gzhis rtser gdan zhu byas don gzhis rtse'i nye 'dabs lha sngar rdzong gi phyag mdzod gnyis kyang phebs bsur bskyod pa'i nyin der spyi rdzong mkhan chung thon pas rang nyid kyi las shag tu zom phud phyag mdzod kyi ngo tshab zla gras rtsa gnyer 'chi med chos dbang zer ba 'gugs 'bod kyis kha sa phyag mdzod gnyis nas bka' shag tu snyan zhu zhig 'bul dgos yod kyang de dag 'bul 161

ro/ ma byung mi 'dug pas da nyin snyan zhu 'di 'bul rgyu yin pas lhan tham khyer shog ces brjod de nang don 'di yin gsal bshad gang yang ma byas pa'i snyan zhu zhig btang yod pa de ni spyi rdzong mkhan chung thon pas rdzong gi las drung re zung dang / gzhung khongs gtso drag 'tsho dpon 'ga' shas la ngan bskul gyis gzhis rtse gzhung bla sa gsum mnga' 'du spyi mgrin gyi 'go dmangs thun mong nas phul tshul bde sdug zhu shog rtags 'byar zhig dang / gzhung rgyugs mi ser gyi khral rigs 'go 'doms rta spyi las drung bzhugs zur rgyal pos phul lugs zhu shog rtags 'byar gcig spyi rdzong tha'i mkhan ngo ma ngo tshab thun mong nas phus lugs snyan zhu gcig bcas bzos pa'i nang don du 'bum 'bru do dam pas mi ser thog brdabs bsigs mnar gcod ci che btang tshul dang / bla khongs khru ma drug cur khal tho 'god len ma byas par bzod yang bzhag lugs/gzhung don thog gzhis byes go bstun ma bgyis pas rang bzhin brgya kha gcig gcod byas tshul sogs bka' shag la dbu bskor snyan zhu brdzus ma de 'dra zhig phul bar brten bka' shag nas/ mi ser 'go dmangs sogs kyi bde sdug dngos 'brel yin shag la brtsis te de 'phral gzhis rtse spyi rdzong tha'i mkhan sbrel por bka' rgya btang don la 'bum 'bru 'bebs 'dren do dam pas chab 'bangs mi ser thog brdabs mnar ji byung khyod sbrel nas brtsad zhib kyis 'di byas snyan zhu gtong dgos zhes bka' rgya btang 'byor byung ba dang / de dus thon pa mkhan chung spyi rdzong rang 'jags thog tha'i ji zom phud pa nad 'das tshab tha'i ji bon shod par bsko gzhag gis gzhis rtser phebs 'byor yod pas spyi rdzong tha'i mkhan sbrel pos gzhis rdzong mnga' khongs dang / srad rin rtse shangs yug rdzong khag bzhi/ rin spungs bcas kyi rdzong gzhis khag la las drung ched btang gis brdabs bsigs ji byung zhib tshags chen po'i brtsad zhib byas dang byed mur don snying snyan zhu de ni spyi rdzong mkhan chung thon 162

pa byams pa mkhas grub kyis sa 'og dar thag thog nas bka' shag la dbu bskor snyan brdzus phul ba 'bum 'bru do dam pas gnas tshul gsal rtogs byung stabanu/ 'bum 'bru do dam sbrel pos de 'phral bka' shag tu snyan zhu phul don la/ ‘‘nye lam gzhis rtse gzhung bla sa gsum mnga' 'du spyi mgrin gyi 'go dmangs dang / rta spyi las drung bzhugs zur rgyal pos phul lugs bde sdug zhu shog thog spyi rdzong tha'i mkhan ngo ma ngo tshab thun mong nas phul tshul gyi snyan zhu de'i nang 'bum 'bru do dam pas mi ser thog brdabs mnar ji snyed btang tshul dang / gzhung don thog gzhis byes go bstun ma byas lugs/ bla khongs khru ma drug cur khal tho 'god len ma bgyis par bzhag lugs bcas snyan seng zhus don 'di thad/ spyi rdzong mkhan chung thon pa byams pa mkhas grub nas mi bden brdzun sgrigs kyis dbu bskor g.yo snyan gang min zhus 'dug rung / bla tshodapon mchog nas phyogs gcig zhu bar bden 'dzin gsan dgongs ma mdzad par brdabs mnar ji byung gzhis rtse spyi rdzong tha'i mkhan sbrel pos brtsad zhib dgos rgyu phebs don drang 'brel zhib brtsad byas tshe chu dwangs nya gsal lha dgongs gsal po dwangs nges yod lags kyang / 'di thad spyi rdzong mkhan chung thon pa byams pa mkhas grub nas gus tshor dga' min phrag dog gis bla dpon dbu bskor snyan brdzus phul nges ma gtogs do bdag gzhung bla sa gsum gyi 'go dmangs dang / rta spyi las drung bzhugs zur rgyal pos phul ba'i bde sdug zhu shog dang / spyi rdzong tha'i mkhan ngo ma ngo tshab thun mong gi snyan zhu dngos 'brel gtan nas min nges dang / lar nas gus tshos gzhis rtse khul gzhung don skor spyi rdzong la gzhis byes go sdur ma bgyis pa med rung mkhan chung thon pas gzhung don la phan pa'i legs slob gnang rgyu med khar/ rnam kun gzhung don phyag mdzod kho nar 'gan dkris kyis lhan rgyas su phebs rgyu nyin skar thog dbyar dus chu dang gling kha kho nar phebs te dus 'da' bar brten 'phral 163

'phral go sdur zhu yul dka' ba'i rang bzhin dang / bla khongs khru ma drug cu ni lag rtsa'i springs yul du ma gsal khar/ byang brgyud rta zam 'khri 'gan lci bas bka' dgongs phyogs 'gal khal tho 'god len ma bzod par bzhag dgos/ byung bzhin par mkhan chung thon pas gus tshor mi dkar zhwa nag ched bzos la brten mi ser thog brtsad zhib bya rgyu spyi rdzong tha'i ji bon shod pa'i thog de min drang 'brel che ba zhig bsko gzhag yong ba zhu rgyu ma zad/ gzhung bla sa gsum mnga' 'du spyi mgrin gyi 'go dmangs dang / rta spyi'i bde sdug dngos 'brel yin min thad bkras lhun dza sag bla ma dang / (dza bla 'brug rgyal blo bzang rin chen yin ) rta spyi las drung bzhugs zur rgyal po dang / spyi rdzong tha'i mkhan ngo ma ngo tshab thun mong gi snyan zhu yin min las sbrel zom phud pa'i ngo tshab phyag mdzod bcas la bka' brtsad thugs rje che ba zhes dang / ‘‘snyespar nas mkhan chung thon pas spyi rdzong du 'byor ba nas bzung mnga' khongs mi ser spyi dang / bye brag gzhis rtse khul gyi lag shes bzo rigs dang / gro 'thagachang ma/ dmar khe ba/ tha na tshal rigs tshong mkhan sogs la sngar med gsar spros kyi khra'/ 'phar brdabs bsigs ci cher btang ba dang / lhag par bla dpon dbu bskor g.yo zhus kyis gzhung gun btang ba'i khungs skyel dag 'bud zhu rgyu yod lags na zhu lam dgag med kyi snyan seng rim gsol zhus chog pa ’zhes snyan zhu phul bar brten de lan du bka' shag nas spyi rdzong tha'i ji bon shod par slar yang bka' rgya btang don la ‘‘'bum 'bru do dam pas mi ser thog brdabs mnar ji byung skor brtsad zhib bya rgyu khyod nas drang 'brel dgos lugs thog snyan brdzus yin min skor bkras lhun dza sag bla ma dang /las sbrel zom phud pa'i ngo tshab/ rta spyi las drung bcas la 'dri brtsad kyis 'di byas snyan 'bul dgos rgyu ’ zhes bka' rgya btang ba dang / phyogs mtshungs 'bum 'bru 'be+ebs 'dren do dam sbrel por bka' rgya btang don la/164

‘‘khyod tshos mi ser thog brdabs mnar ji byung skor brtsad zhib bya rgyu spyi rdzong tha'i ji bon shod pa rang nas drang 'brel zhib brtsad dang 'brel snyan brdzus yin min skor khungs so sor 'dri brtsad kyis 'di byas snyan 'bul dgos rgyu'i bkod rgya song zhing / des na khyod sbrel gyi snyan zhur spyi rdzong mkhan chung thon pas mi ser thog brdabs mnar ji snyed btang ba'i gnas tshul dang / dbu bskor g.yo zhus kyis gzhung gun btang ba'i khungs skyel dag 'bud byung bstun mjug gnon yan song med pa bya rgyu ’ zhes 'byor don de 'phral 'bum 'bru do dam pas spyi rdzong mkhan chung thon pas mi ser thog 'phar brdabs btang rigs skor dang / gzhis rdzong bco brgyad bkar 'jug gi 'bru 'bab rulaskyon med bzhin par lo mang rul sum yod tshul yul thang rin gong nas bcog cha byas te spus tshong zhus 'thus kyi don du rang don sgrub phyogs gzhung gun btang lugs bcas kyi skor snyan zhu phul ba red/ 'on kyang spyi rdzong tha'i ji bon shod pas snyan brdzus yin min skor spro 'dri bgyis rgyu'i thad mkhan chung thon pa las sbrel du song byed dka' byed gtad ngo 'dzin zom 'jogs kyis phar 'gyangs ci che btang rkyen skabs der 'bum 'bru do dam pa gnyis nas las bgos kyis rtse mgron bshes byams gzhis rtse khul gzhung don dang / gyod don skor gzhis rtser bsdad pa dang / shod drung skyar srib pa stod khul 'bum 'bru 'don 'dren du bskyod de nyin gcig rtse mgron bshes byams gzhis rdzong lhan khang du bcar te spyi rdzong tha'i ji bon shod pa'i mdun du kha btags shig btang ste ‘‘snya/na brdzus yin min skor bka' dgongs gzhir bzung bka' brtsad gnang rgyu nar 'gyangs ma song ba'i skyabs 'jug yod pa ’ zhes zhus par de 'phral mkhan chung thon pas ‘‘khyod tshos mi ser thog brdabs mnar ji btang brtsad zhib zhu shog bsdu len bya dang bya mus la rim bzhin mtha' gsal yong gi red/ ngas snyan brdzun phul lugs skor sku ngo phyag sbrel tha'i jir bka' 165

brtsad gnang rogs zhu mus ma gtogs bkag 'gog zhu gi min ’ zhes ngar shugs chen pos brjod stabs de lan rtse mgron bshes gnyen byams chen nas ‘‘da ga rang red/ sku ngo tha'i ji shel dkar po'i mchod rten yin zhu yas gang yang med/ nga tshos mi ser thog brdabs bsigs ji byung khyod tshos 'dri brtsad gnang yog red/ khyed rang gis mi ser thog sngar med gsar spros kyi brdabs bsigs dang / bla dpon dbu bskor g.yo zhus kyis ga/zhung gun btang ba'i skor nga tshos khungs skyel dag 'bud zhu rgyu'i snyan 'bul zhus yod stabs da cha khyed nas nga tshor gsungs yas dang / nga tshos khyed kyi bka' gsung dang len zhu yas bsda da med/ nga rang tsho ring min lha sar bka' shag tu bcar te pus mo g.yas btsugs g.yon btsugs kyi sbyang bshad zhu rgyu ma gtogs las med ’ ces bshad de phan tshun ngar ngar phad phad kyi 'khrug rtsod shor stabs phyag mdzod las drung sogs nas bar tshang gis 'khrug mtshams chod rjes tha'i ji bon shod pas ‘‘ngas phan tshun tshang ma gzhung zhabs zhen dkar phyogs gcig la brten phying hrul gnam 'phyar ma dgos pa'i bsam shes byed kyi yod kyang da cha khungs so sor 'dri brtsad 'phral la byas chog ’ ces brjod de skad cha 'dri rgyu sngar bzhin nyin 'gyangs zhag 'bud gtong stangs ma shes pas khungs so sor spro 'dri byas don bkras lhun dza blar bka' 'dri zhus lan du bla khongs mi ser nas brdabs bsigs byung lugs rkang rtsis las khungs brgyud snyan seng zhu rigs ma byung stabs bla khongs mi ser 'go dmangs nas snyan zhu phul rigs med ces pa'i zhu shog gnang ba dang / phyogs mtshungs rta spyi las drung bzhusas zur rgyal pos kyang mi ser nas bde sdug zhu rigs med lugs kyi zhu shog sprad pa/ lhag par tha'i ji zom phud de nyid kyi ngo tshab phyag mdzod nas ‘‘gzhung bla sa gsum gyi 'go dmangs su thad nas brdabs bsigs byung lugs lhan sger gang sar snyan seng zhu rigs ma byung stabs spyi rdzong tha'i mkhan ngo ma ngo tshab 166

thun mong nas kyang snyan 'bul zhus rigs med kyang / ngos kha sngon dge bsheru bsam grub rin po che'i phebs bsur ba car nyin sku ngo mkhan chung thon pa'i las shag tu rtsa gnyer 'chi med chos dbang ched 'bod mdzad de lhan tham khyer shog gsungs te don gnas ji yin ngo sprod med pa'i snyan zhu zhig gtong gnang mdzad 'dug pa de dag yin gyi red ’ ces bcas khungs so so nas zhu shog de ltar phul yod kyang / spyi rdzong tha'i ji bon shod pas bka' shag la snyan 'bul skabs zhu shog gzhan gnyis la 'gebs srung thub thabs ma ma chis rung / rta spyi las drung bzhugs zur rgyal po'i zhu shog de bzhin snyan khongs ma btang par dgos dbang sbug nyar byas pa 'bum 'bru do dam pas gsang brda shes chor gyis lam seng bka' shag la snyan zhu phul te rta spyi'i zhu shog snyan khongs phul yod tshod mi 'dug pas de dag nges par phyir bzhes thugs rje che ba zhes zhus don tha'i bon la bka' rgya 'byor te phyir 'bul zhu dgos byung yod cing / da dung mtshams 'dir gleng bar 'os pa zhig la spyi rdzong mkhan chung thon pas snyan brdzun grabs gshoms skabs gzhan la ngan 'brel dang / thon pa'i phyag mdzod kyis mkhan chung thon par nang don dge bskyon brjod pa/ de min gnas tshul gzhan gnyis bcas kyi skor te/ bkar 'bru 'don sprod do dam rtse drung thub bstan blo bzang dang / shod drung shud phud pa gnyis kyi las 'gan thad rdzong gzhis so sor bkar 'bru ji yod bskyar gshor bya rgyu dang / 'bum 'bru 'don sprod bya rgyu ma gtogs de min bya ba shugs che ba med rkyen khong gnyis kyang nang don 'bum 'bru 'bebs 'dren do dam pa gnyis la mig tsha ko long phrag dog yod stabs me tsha ba'i thog la shing gshag pa'i dpe ltar khong gnyis nas kyang spyi rdzong mkhan chung thon par shog sbug rūng tshang gis ngan bskulakhyas pa ma zad/ lhag par snyan 'bul zhu phyogs nang don jus bkod snyan zin shod dru nga shud phud pa 'jam dbyangs mkhas grub nas gtso bo byas 167

pa'i skor dang / thon pa'i phyag mdzod ni bsam sding rdo rje phag mo'i yab snye mo dkyil ru ba zer ba de yin zhing / khong shes yon 'jon thang ldan pa'i thog bab lhing brtan gsum zhig yin gshis mkhan chung thon pas snyan zhu 'bul gtan 'khel rjes phyag mdzod la snyan zin mig ston thog go bsdur bgyis pas phyag mdzod dkyil rus mi ser 'go dmangs kyis snyan seng zhu rigs ma byung stabs snyan zhu de 'dra 'bul gnang mdzad tshe yag po e yong / lar nas nga rang tsho yang gtsang gam pa la yan gyi spyi rdzong red/ rang skyon rang gis mthong dka' bas mi tshos kyang skyon brjod lab gleng ji yong cha rtogs ma mchis zhes sogs dge skyon yo bsrang gi rnam 'gyur bstan par mkhan chung thon pa khong khro za ste nga rang tshor skyon brjod bya rgyu ga re yod ces brjod pa'i 'dod tshul la cha 'jog ma bgyis pa byas lugs bcas thon pa'i zla gras kyi ngag sgrog nas rim bzhin phyir gyar byung song ba dang / de 'brel mkhan chung thon pa dang / rtse mgron bshes byams gzhis rdzong lhan sar gyod rtsod byung stabs gzhis rtse sman grong zer ba'i nang sdod kha che nyi tsam zer ba zhig yod pa kho pa ni rnam kun sku drag ga sa gar dbu bskor zhu ba dang / tshong zog mig ston byed par 'gro yi yod cing / kho pas gzhis zhol khul mi 'ga' re'i sar 'bum 'bru do dam rtse mgron gyis spyi rdzong mkhan chung thon pa bya dka' byed gtad bzos tshul gyi gtam gleng bshad yod tshod 'dug par brten mkhan chung thon pas go tshor gyis kha che nyi tsam rdzong du thon pa'i las shag tu bkugs thog ‘‘khyod nas nga la dma' 'bebs btang 'dug pas rtse mgron bshes byams kyis nga la brtsi med byas pa ma red/ gzhung sa'i las khungs la ltos med byas pa red ’ ces brjod de kho par nyes brdung btang rkyen kho pas gsham du ‘‘a tsi/ spyi rdzong thon pas 'bum 'bru do dam pa glag ma 'khel stabs nga la nyes gtag btang byung ’ zhes rgyab bshad byas pa'i gtam gleng byung song ba ltar mkhan chung thon pas de dang 168

de 'dra'i mi la nyes brdung gtong rgyu de ni khong rang gi sngon 'gro'i cha rkyen gyi rangagashis zhig rang yin/ de 'brel 'bum 'bru do dam pas bka' shag la phul snyan nang spyi rdzong mkhan chung thon pas rnam kun gzhung don ngo tshab kho nar 'gan dkris kyis ngo ma las khungs su phebs rgyu nyin skar thog dbyar dus chu dang gling khar phebs rkyen 'phral 'phral legs sdur zhu yul dka' ba'i rang bzhin yod lugs zhus yod stabs de skor mkhan drung 'bum thang chos 'phel thub bstan gyis thon par nang yig btang 'byor byung skad kyis gang ltar skabs shig gling gtong mtshams 'jog mngon gsal dod po byung song ba bcas mdor bsdus na spyi rdzong mkhan chung thon pa byams pa mkhas grub kyis snyan brdzun phul ba'i gnas tshul lam tsam ra 'phrod byung ba yin na'ang/'bum 'bru 'bebs 'dren do dam pa gnyis nas slar yang bka' shag la snyan zhu phul don du spyi rdzong thon pa mkhan chung dang gus tsho'i dbar bden brdzun shan 'byed kyi bka' zhib tsha chun che ba zhig rang bsko gzhag thugs rje che ba zhes zhus don zhib sa rtse mkhan mgron che ba pha lha thub bstan 'od ldan dang /shod sne mgron mkhan chung thub bstan legs smon gnyis la bsko gzhag thog spyi rdzong thon pa mkhan chung dang / 'bum 'bru 'bebs 'dren do dam sbrel por snga 'phros so so'i gzhung don las 'gan ngo tshab do chod 'dzugs 'jog gis ngo ma rnams zla tshes dus bkag thog zhib sar 'aribyor ba dgos rgyu'i bka' shag nas bka' rgya btang don lha sar bcar dgos byung yod cing / skabs der thon pa mkhan chung nas mi ser gyi 'thus mi yin khul du gzhung 'og khongs nas tsho dpon chu spel don rdor dang tsho dpon bkras dbang zer ba gnyis kyi thob/ sa skya ba sa/ par khrid khrid yin stabs sa skya ba'i gtso drag be shar tshe dbang zer ba bcas mnyam khrid kyis kho pa rnams lha sar sdod gnas thon pa'i bla brang rnying par gnas g.yar thog sdod yun ring sne len gzab rgyas dang 'brel nyin 169

gcig thugs spro btang thog thon pa'i nye ltos dza sag rgyas btags pas 'thus mi tshor slob ston byas skad byung song / zhib sa rtse bde yangs shar du tshugs te phan tshun so sor zhu ba thengs 'ga' shas re blangs thog phar tsam ring 'gor rjes bod zhi bas bcings 'grol thob nye'i gnas tshul la bltas bsam/ de min thon pa sde dpon mi drag sku nye ltos bcas hrag stabs thabs shes spras pa ji yin gang ltar nyin gcig do bdag tshang ma zhib sar bskong ste ‘‘gyod don rjes su rim bzhin thag gcod bya rgyur snga 'phros khyod rang tshang ma gzhung don las 'gan lci bar brten sa gnas su myur thon gyis gzhung don 'thus shor med pa dgos rgyu mi zhes bka' phab nas kha mchu bden rdzun mtha' gsal mthil rdol gyi dbye gcod ma byung bar sa gnas su phyir log bla dgos byung rjes gnas tshul de mur yal ba bcas 170

bod dbus gtsang khul gyi pho mo'i rgyan gos dang de snga'i sku drag shod drung ji yod skor/sreg shing blo bzangadon grub/gcig desnga'i bod kyi sku drag sogs 'byor ldan pa cho'i pho mo'i rgyan gos skor/bod mi rigs kyi skye bo pho mo'i rgyan gos dang cha chas la sogs pa gna' dus nas dar zhing / gong 'phel du phyin pa zhig yin pa smos ci dgos/ bod kyi btsan po'i rgyal blon na rim gyi deb ther nang rgyal po dang btsun mo/ blon po bcas la sogs pa rim pa bstar chags kyi pho mo'i rgyan gos rin thang bral ba ha ca nga mang po zhig dar lugs 'khod kyang de dag gi tha snyad ming tshig sogs re re bzhin zhib gsal med par’brten 'dir lo rgyus kyi dpyad gzhi tsam du rang gi mthong thos myong grub kyi rigs gsal bshad rags tsam zhu bar 'dod cing / de yang gna' bo'i gtam dpe'am kha rgyun lta bur ‘‘pho rna g.yu can la dgra lha 'khor ’mizhes zer srol yod la/ sngar chos rgyal nor bzang zhes pa'i gtam rgyud kyi gzhung las yid 'phrog gi gtsug rgyan nor bu'i phreng ba zhes pa sogs rin po che'i rgyan chas du ma yod pa'i skor gsal ba dang / de bzhin glingage sar rgyal po'i sgrung yig nang seng lcam 'brug mo la sogs pa'i mtshar 171

sdug ldan pa'i bud med kyi rgyan gos rin thang bral ba du ma yod pa'i skor bshad sro la zab mo yod pa de tsho ni ri mo'i gzugs su bkod pa'i lhari me tog gi rgyan dang rin po che'i nor bu'i phreng ba sogs la dpe blangs te mdzes chas kyis brgyan nas tshor ba dngos nang rim bzhin dar ba zhig yin/ mdor na mi rigs su 'dra zhig yin na'ang de'i chab srid dang / dpal 'byor/ dmag don/ de bzhin skye bo pho mo'i rgyan chas sogs ni lo rgyus 'phel rgyas 'gro ba'i nang rim bzhin 'phel rgyas su phyin pa'i lo rgyus yod nges pa ltar rang re bod mi rigs kyi pho mo'i chas gos kyi thad la cha mtshon na/gcig bod btsan po'i skabs kyi rgyal blon gyi chas sogs bod kyi chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i dbu la la thod dkar po gangs ri ltar gyis brgyan pa dang mgul la bod rib/sa kyi skrun dngos ngo mtshar che zhing gser las grub pa'i mgul ga'u bzo bkod phun sum tshogs la phra sna tshogs kyis phyug pa/ snyan cog gnyis la kong na pad 'dogs nor gzugs g.yu khras gang ba res brgyan pa/bza' 'og gi gos dar las grub pa'i na bza' phod kha ma ('cham chas 'dra cib )zhabs lham 'ja' chen sna ker sogs rgyal chas rnams bzhes te rgyal po rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa mtha' 'khor du btsun mo gnyis te/ rgya bza' dang bal bza' rang lugs dar gos kyi na bza' bzhes pa dbu skra spyi bor bcings par gser gyi me tog sogs rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ de bzhin btsun mo sku gzhon si gsum ste ru yung bza' dang /zhang zhung bza'/ mong bza' khri lcam bcas kyi rgyan gos bzhes tshul phal cher g.yu dang byu ru spel ma'i spa phrug sgor sgor gyi rgyan srol gtod pa dpal bsam yas kyi ldebs ris sogs nas gsal por mtshon/ 'on kyang glang dar mas bod kyi chab srid bzung nas sngar gyi yab mes chos rgyal rim pa'i bzhed srol bzang po mtha' dag med par bzos pas gna' bo'i pho mo'i rgyan chas gyon 172

'dogs kyi thad la'ang gna' srol nyams rgud nges can song ba gor ma chags/gnyis/ ‘‘rin chen rgyan cha/mi’ tā la'i bla ma lnga pa chen po'i gsung las ‘‘gong ma se chen gyis chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa rin po cher bod chol kha gsum phul ba nas bzung bod 'di bskyar du gcig gyur chen po zhig byung ba ma zad/skabs der skya bo zhwa lnga las tshan bcu gsum gyis mtshon pa'i chen po'i sgrig srol ltar rtse gos/ las zhwa/ ya rabs che btsun la 'os pa dar zhing / khyad par du'ang gnam bskos kyi rgyal po phag mo grub pa dang / gus gung dang / tā dbon gu shri lung las kyi mngon par mtho ba byang pa rig ldan/ khrom ge sar gyi mag pa rgyal mkhar rtse pa/ sger rigs rin chen spungs pa la sogs pa'i sde dpon khungs btsun rnams kyi dus sngar chos rgyal rim byung gi sku rgyan gser ga/sog sna/ sog kor/ rna rgyangs/ shal dkar dmar/ rtse gos/ rtse ber/gtsug zhwa ze ring rgyan spros su byas pa'i chas ngo mtshar can shin tu dar/ pho sna g.yu can la dgra lha 'khor zhes srid pa chags pa'i lha dgu/ rje yi mgur lha bcu gsum sogs kyis mtshon pa'i bod kyi lha mthu bo che rnams chas 'di la dga' ba yod tshod snang zhes gsungs 'dug de rjes sde srid gtsang pas kyang rgyun ma nub par srol bskyangs na'ang lcags sbrul sde gzar zhes pa nas bzung de dag slar yang ming gi lhag ma med pa lta bur gyur/ de rjes sa skyong 'phrin las rgya mtsho'i dus chas sna tshogs dar te 'ga' zhig gis sngar gyi sog lugs de ga babs chags zer/ 'ga' zhig gis stod khog sog po dang / smad khog bod pa byas pa de 'dra sog por med ces zer/ de'i dus rta nag ga 'o rlon pa zhes lo rgyus la mkhas pa zhig yod pa de bos te/ lo rgyus la zhib dpyad kyis sne'u gdong rtse dang / la stod byang pa'i lugs la rtse gos yod/ gzhis rgyal gnyis kyi lugs la ral gu sngon po go gcod pas de dang bstun nas sgrig te rin chen rgyan cha 35yod cing / rin rgyan gyi gyon stangs thad dper na/ rtse 173

gos ni 'cham chas kyi bzo lta 'dra ba phur rtse sbom la phur rtsa phra ba de'ang gos rgyu rnying gyi gyon pa legs par gyon/ mdun du phor shubs btags/ ko lham rdog gcig ma gyon dgos/ rin rgyan gras/ mgul la gser gyi ga'u tshar du mngar ba dang / 'phreng shal dkar dmar zhes gna' rabs kyi spos shel che chung mdzog mgo tsam dang / dmar shal ni byur rnying dkrug ma che chung pham rtsig trem gyi phreng ba sogs 'dogs dgos pa dang / g.yas g.yon la sog kor dang sog rna da dung bod g.yu gzhi gcig sgrig pa'i rna rgyangs sogs 'dogs pa dang mgo bor rtse zhwa ze ring sogs ma nor ma 'chug par gyon 'dogs byed dgos pa red/ gsum/ ‘‘rgya lu chas/’’ de snga'i gzhung zhabs skya bo'i gyon chas ‘‘rgya lu chas ’mizhes pa de ni shod drung tsho'i gna' srol las gos yin pa ma zad/ bod kyi rgyal po lo gsar (bod zla 1tshes 2)sogs mdzad sgo gal che'i skabs su bka' blon skya bo rna mas nas kyang rgya lu chas gyon gyi yod/ chas gos de ni/sngar rgya gar du rgyal po in+d+ra bho ti zhes bya ba de'i cha byad dper blangs pa zhig yin zhing / bod du rang gi yul thon thon rdzas kyi khyad chos la gzhigs te rgyu cha snam bu laru/ bzos yod la/ dus rabs gong 'phel phyin pa'i mtshon dngos hor stagre/ shun la sogs/ pa'i gos chen rgyu rnying las rgyas bzo bya sa pa dang / zhwa mo ar kon zhes pa de snye mo khul nas bzo gi yod/ rgya lu chas zhes pa der bkra shis rtags brgyad dang / rgyal srid sna bdun gyi dpe dbyibs tshang yod pa/de yang rna g.yas g.yon la 'dogs byed gser las grub pa'i kong sna pad 'dogs zhes par bod g.yu'i khra bkod kyis dbyibs rdzi par dang / pa ṭa/bya khyung / shing lo/ me tog sogs kyis brgyan cing / dkyil mtsho zhes pa g.yu byur bstar sgrig byas yod/ hor stag shun dang rgyan bzhi rgyu rnying las grub pa'i pho stod/ de'i phu thung g.yas g.yon la si shan gyi g.yung drung lag 'khyud la rgya 174

bsal can gyi skabs su nges par du g.yu byur spel ma'i spa phrug gi steng du mu tig thug khog gyon dgos/ mu tig spa phrug sgang la mu tig thug khog gyon na mi 'grig dper na nga tsho'i drag thog tu bod kyi mdzad sgo che khag gam go bag gtong len skabs gan9ra ma lta bu dang / rgyan bzang mas nges par du g.yu byur spel ma'i spa phrug gi steng la mu tig thug khog gyon gyi yod/ gzhan yang de snga'i bod sa gnas srid gzhung skabs klu sbug sgar sgrig dang rdzong rgyab zhar 'phen sogs la ya sor khri pa'i rgyan bzang ma dang dpal lha'i gzab gsol sogs la rgyan cha de rnams bed spyod gtong gi yod/ lhag par du bar skabs shig nas sde dpon che khag gi mna' ma dang mag pa gtong len skabs rgyan gos ci rigs gra rgyas su song stabs skra rdzus lan tse yang bcos bzos byas te bya pho rog gi gshog pa 'dra ba de chags pa red/ lo rgyus ltar na thog mar lan rtse ni sog yul nas dar ba red ces 'khod 'dug gtsang mo'i chas ni sa/tsang gam pa la yan gyi bud med spa sgor zhes smyug ma'i gzhu 'dra ba bkug pa la ras dmar gyis dkris pa de mgo skra nyis lhas la btags thog g.yu byur spel ma'i spa phrug dang spa lung zhes rim brtsegs kyis 'dogs srol yod pa dang / gtsang chas kyi gzhi 'dzin sa yag shos lo rgyus ring po yod pa'i sa skya'i bdag khri rim pa'i bdag mo tshos mnab rgyu'i spa sgor la mtshon na rin po che sna tshogaskyusdo bkram pa'i stegs bu lta bu'i ltebs la spa phrug dang spa lung 'dogs dgos la sa/zab mchor skabs de'i steng mu tig gi spa ldem mam spo sil zhes pa dra ba dra byed lta bur khrul khrul du dpyang pa/ dpral ba'i g.yas g.yon du gser gyi a kor chung chung re dang / rgyab tu nor bu dga' 'khyil dang gser dngul tshag ma'i sba khug khab shubs sogs 'dogs dgos/ mgul du gser gyi ga'u gzi byur spel ma'i bkag bcad dang / ske phreng byur ru'i 'dzoms bkag thog mu tig gi yar 'then gser gyi mo sgor dang dra bkag rgyas phrul rang 'grig mdun ngos 176

sked pa'i mtshams rin po che sna tshogs kyi sdig ra glo phreng khu/nga 'dogs dgos /lo rgyus ldan pa'i gna' rabs kyi spo the/la grags pa can gyi sko thag la g.yu byur mu tig gi 'dzoms rgyan dang / yar 'then mo sgor mu tig dra bkag sogs kyi rgyan cha dang / gyon chas thad la'ang dbus chas dang 'dra ba'i gos rgya se rgyu rnying las grub pa'i steng brtsegs rgyan spros kyis phyug pa/ rgya 'dra'i phur yod//gra'u tse'i 'og 'jug si shan tshos sna tshogs kyi phar phyin brgyab pa'i zon lham sogs gyon dgos/ gtsang mo'i spa sgor dang dbus mo'i lan rtse zer ba mgo sku g.yas g.yon la 'dogs dgos stabs mtshan mo mal sar yang gyon srol yod pa/ de tsho rang nyid kyi dran thog la'ang dngos su mthong byung / rgyal rtse bsam sding gi mi ngo sgrol ma lags kyis spa sgor 'bud rgyu yod pa bzos lugs bshad srol 'dug cing / 'jun pa'i lcam chung gis dbus mo'i lan rtse krong krong yang mtshan mo 'bud rgyu yod pa zhig gsar bcos byas par ‘‘rwa khog lam par ’’zhes ming 'dogs byas pa yong grags su gyur/ des na spa phrug ces rgyan cha skad grags can de tsho gna' snga mo rgyun ldan rang bzhin gyis gyon spyod byed kyi yod 'dra'ang phyis bed spyod gtong yul gtso bo lo gsar dang / mdzad sgo khagardzong rgyab zhar 'phen/ smon lam tshogs mchod/ sa zla'i dus chen/ 'dzam gling spyi bsang / 'bras spungs dang nor gling zho ston/ dpal lha'i ri khrod/gzhan yang sger gyi gnyen sgrig bag ston sogs la gyon spyod byed kyi yod/lnga/ 'jig rten sgo bag khab len gyi skor/ ring nas byams brtse'i spyan dkyus 'dor ba med pa'i pha ma gnyis nas rang gi gces 'dzin bu phrug gi mi tshe'i 'dun thabs la dgongs bzhed smra med mdzad rgyu ni 'jig rten chos nyid 'gog tu med pa zhig yin pas sgo bag 'tshol zhib grub mtshams do bdag bu dang / bu mo phan tshun thugs mthun sor bzhag gis nang tshang gros gtan 'khel rjes bod rtag rten la mnga' brnyes zhes pa'i dpe ltar gza' skar 177

'byung 'phrod mchog tu dge bar bstun phyogs so so'i pha ma lha na 'dzoms thog gnyen dpang (dpang mi )dang 'brel ba'i gnyen yig 'jog pa dang / sgo bag len yul gyi khyim tshang pha ma tshor nu rin pang dod zhes pa'i dngul yang sprod len byed srol yod/sngar sku drag sogs khyim tshang drag rigs kyi dngos gzhi gnyen yig dang gnyen dpang gi nang don skor/ mkhas dbang bka' drung nor nang tshe ring dbang 'dus kyi gsung las/ ‘‘skabs don 'jig rten khyim gyi rtse dga' la longs su spyod pa rnams ni skyes pa thabs dang / bud med shes rab kyi rang bzhin zung du 'jug pa las/ rang rigs kyi myu gu gtsang ma rgyun mthud du spel ba'i cho ga 'di kho na srid pa'i phun tshogs kyi snying por rloms pa de yang rgya dkar nag ne pa la/ bod gangs can sogs kyis mtshon yul dang yul chen thams cad du bzang po'i srol dar ba bzhin 'dir yang phan tshun rigs su mnyam pa/ (khyim ming ) rigs sras (ming ) thugs mdun mchis 'brang (bza' zla )du (ming )khab tu bzhes par thog mar gnyis ka'i thugs mos gtso bor gyur rjes bslu med bla lhar mo lung rtsis gsum gyi gtan 'bebs dang bcas slong sbyin mdzad sgo'i rim pa sngon du grub pa dang 'khrungs sa dngos gzhi (kun 'dzin ) ces pa zla tshes gza' skar 'byung 'phrod dge ba'i nyin/ ji ltar mi'am ci'i dbang phyug gi sras mo yid 'phrog ma sa skyong nor bzang gi khab tu bzhes pa bzhin ster cha skyeṭashrī tho zur gsal dang bcas bsu bzhes mdzad rgyur/ bkris dga' ston gyi sgo 'phar dngos su dbye ba 'di nas bzung bgres pa rnams nas sras stangs dpyal la byams brtse'i spyan ras phyogs su ma lhungs pa'i tshul spyod la ngang gis 'jug cing / tshul min shugs kyis 'doms pa'i gcun khyab mdzad 'os sha tshar gtam snyan med zer ba ltar 'jam tsub skabs gang ran mdzes mtshon med pa dbu 'don bka' slob stsal rgyu/ sras (ming )178

nas kyang yab yum la thugs mthun bkur sti zol med kyi sgo nas mdor na bka' ci gnang dang du len pa ma zad/ mchis 'brang la thugs brtse gcig gtod min pa'i grogs zur bsten dang myos byed rtsed 'jor bag med du spyod pa sogs skyid sdu ga gi blo rtse gang la mi gtad pa'i sun 'byin yid gcod du 'gyur pa'i smad 'os ma rabs kyi spyod ngan rigs rnam pa kun tu mi mdzad cing / sras mo (ming )nas kyang yab yum zung spyi bkur thog bdag po rigs sras la skyes rgyal dman gyi brtsi mkhas gus brtse lhod med las/ rang tshugs ma thub pa dang nga rtags su bkod pa'i spyod rengs sogs thugs zhi dkrug pa'i rigs dang / zhabs 'don thams cad la nye ring byams skyong 'dor ba'i rigs gleng lhag med pa tshul ldan bsngags 'os kyi spyod pa lhur bzhes mdzad rgyu bcas mdor na tshang mas 'jig rten ya rabs kyi lugs bzang dam tshig gtsang zhing / bgres slob gzhon nyan mthun pa mched bzhi'i ngang tshul la gzhol ba ma gtogs/ 'dod 'khyer tha dad sogs rang drin rang la chung du 'jus pa'i tshul min rigs yi ge'i lam las bsgrags min la ma ltos par zhar yang mi mdzad pa sogs phyogs gnyis gas gzu gnas kyi yang rtser son zhing /bdag skyid la gzhan smon pa'i yul gcig pur gyur pa bkris lugs legs 'ba' zhig gis sku tshe hril mthar 'khyol nges mdzad rgyu/ legs pa'i phyogs la dgongs dbyangs ma gros gcig tu mthun pa'i ched rgya btsan pos bsdom pa 'di las mi 'da' zhes 'gyur med rdo rje'i phyag rgya bab par yab yum sras bcas bskor ba'i phyag dam/ gnyen khag gi dpang thi'u/ thugs mdun/yab tshang dang bcas pa'i phyag dam/ gnyen khag gi dpang thi'u ’ zhes gsal ba sogs ni phyi rabs gzhon nu tshos nges par du gnyen sgrig bya ba'i thad la rang rigs kyi srol rgyun skor gyi dpyad gzhi tsam mo/'khrungs sa dngos gzhi ni gza' skar tshes cha legs par gtan 'khel 179

zin mtshams gnyen ston rgyus mnga' yod pa'i spyi khyab pa gnyis gsum gdan zhu byed cing / khang khyim phyi nang bar gsum du byi dor legs par byed pa dang /tshoms chen dang / gzim chung khag nang mchod rdzas dang zhal thang khri gdan sogs legs par bshams/ gnyen ston ring gi sku mgron dang rten 'byung mjal dar 'bul mi sogs khungs so sor zhabs tog pa go sgrig legs par byed/ tshes cha dang bstun bag ma bsu len pa mi grangs lnga drug gang rung gzab mchor sku ga'u dang / sog byil/ zhwa sog gos rdza mdog gi gyon pa/rgya gri phur shubs/ 'ja' lham rgya smug dang / sku tshab gnyer phyag gang rung gi gyon pa dza ser gser zam ris dang / zhwa 'bog rgya gri phor shubs/ 'ja' lham bcas gyon dgos pa dang / rta sga sga 'khor zhe sgrig gzab mchor gang legs spras te mjal dar dang / srid pa ho sogs bsgrengs bzhin rta bzhon nas bag ma'i khyim du bskyod/ rgyal sgo'i sgo 'gram bsu chang zhu mi yod pa nas phud gtor dang 'brel chibs las bshol te nang du phebs/ bag ma'i khyim tshang yab yum ston 'khor rnams rgyan gos gzab bzhes rang rang bab bstun bzhugs gral du 'khod rjes gsol 'bras 'degs 'bul sogs mdzad sgo rags tsam grub rjes bag ma skyel bsu mkhan la sogs par gsol ba zhabs tog legs par zhus/ sang zhogs snga langs gza' skar 'phrod sbyor stabs bstun gyis bag mar g.yu byur spa phrug dang / ga'u/ a kor/ dzul gyi ske phreng /yar 'then/ spyi bo'i thag pa/ lan rtse/ mu tig gi nor bu dga' 'khyil/ mu tig thug khog sdig ra glo phreng / sba khug khab shubs sogs cha tshang dang / rgya 'dra tshon khra'i na bza'i steng rgya se'i steng brtsegs/ dga' dbye'i sna lnga/ si shan tshos tshogs kyi phar phyin rgyab pa'i zon lham bcas cha tshang sgrog 'bul dang 'brel bag ma rta thog tu 'khyol 'phral sku tshab pas bag ma'i mgul la mda' dar sgrog pa dang lus phying dkar gyis gtums dgos/ bag ma'i yab tshang 180

thog steng bkris khra ring dang bsangs mchod khrod du ma yum gyis gzab mchor thog las tu mda' dar thogs te g.yang 'gugs dang / tshe ring nad med yong ba'i smom/ 'dun byed/ de nas bag ma dang bsu skyel rnams gzhas chen gyi sgra'i khrod nas rim bzhin bskyod de bag ma 'gro yul khyim tshang gi yang steng bkra shis khra ring 'grems pa dang / rgya brngan lha bsang gi dud sprin nam mkhar phyur ba/bsu chang thog mtha' bar zhu mi bu bu mo tshos rang rang gi rgyan gos legs par gyon/ byur bur gtams pa'i gro bso phye mar dang / dngul gyi khrungs rkyan dang / khrungs phor bcas star khyim gyi sgo rtsar sku tshab pa des/ oṃ susti zhes shis brjod kyi bshad pa dang / gzhas chen thengs gnyis pa btang zin rjes sgo rwa'i nang gi chibs stegs 'bab rten 'bru do 20skor dang / gos yug gi dgu tshan steng gos tshon khra'i kha sgor ma'i steng gro'i g.yung drung bris pa'i thog tu bag ma rta las bshol/ (yul lung 'gar sgo bshad dang 'beb bshad/ ka bshad/gdan bshad sogs re re bzhin la bshad pa tshigs bcad mang tsam rgyag srol yod/) de nas rim phebs tshoms chen bzhugs gral g.yon phyogs su khyim tshang gi yab yum dang / g.yas phyogs su bab/ ma dang bskyel mi rnams bzhugs gral legs par 'khod/ sku tshab yar bzhengs nas slar yang / oṃ susti/ bde legs su gyur cig ces/ e ma bag gro sku khams bzang / gtan du bde ba thob par shog zhes dang / yang lo brgya thub cing ston brgya mthong ba dang / tshe ring nad med bde skyid phun sum tshogs sogs brjod de bzhugs gral du 'khod pa dang / gsol ja bzhes 'bras 'degs 'bul rjes/ khyim tshang gi mjal dar dang 'bul tshan bstar/ de nas gzhas chen dang 'brel rgyan bzang gzhon nu ma gnyis kyis rgyan gos yongs su rdzogs pa gyon te stangs dpyal gnyis dang yab yum bag ma bsu skyel dang bcas par chang gis byur bur bkang ba'i dngul phor stegs pa phud gtor grub mtshams gom gsum 181

phyir bshig thog ga ler phyag 'bul zhus rjes gzhas chen thengs gsum pa btang ste nyin de'i mdzad sgo grol/ de'i sang nyin bu mo'i yab tshang ston 'khor dang bcas pa'i mjal dar dang / 'bul tshan bstar te mdzad sgo grol/de nyin phyi khag nas mjal dar 'bul mi phebs 'phral stangs zhal zung bag gral la bzhugs nas mjal dar bzhes dgos pa phud/ de byings na bza' bde chas spras te gzim chung du rang rang rol rtsed la ci dgar spyod cing /de'i phyi nyin nas (nyin grangs 5nas 7sogs rgyas bsdus sna tshogs )sku mgron yongs la gsol ston gzab rgyas dang 'brel dga' skyid kyi dpal la rol/grol ston chen mo'i dgong dro sngar ltar bzhugs gral du 'khod/ bu mo'i khyim tshang gi yab yum la mjal dar nang mdzod srid na ring ba re/ bag ma skyel mir cha/jal dar a she re sgron te rdo gcal dkyil du lha bsangs kyi dud sprin khrigs pa'i khrod du shis tshig dang bcas gro bso phye mar dang / rgyan bzang mas khrungs btegs phud gtor legs grub mtshams bkra shis lha gsol dang 'brel mdzad sgo grol srol bcas so/gnyis / de snga'i bod sa gnasasrid gzhung gi sku drag shodakhrungangamasger pango yod gang dran ming tho/ (1)dbus khul/ sde dpon dga' bzhi ba/ sde dpon thon pa/ sde dpon bsam grub pho brang pa/ sde dpon che shos lha rgya ri ba/ yab gzhis lha klu dga' tshal ba/ yab gzhis phun la/ nga / yab gzhis glang mdun/ yab gzhis g.yu thog yab gzhis stag 'tsher/ mi drag rnying khungs gras/ hor khang pa/bshad sgra ba/ mkhe smad pa/ zur khang pa/ pha lha ba/ lcang lo can bcas dang / sger zhol khang pa/ sger gsar byung ba/ sger byang ngos pa/ sger zas 182

zhim pa/ sger tshe gsum phun khang pa/ sger rag rtsib pa/ sger ldan bya tshang pa/sger dge rgyas pa/ sger lcags shar ba/ sger rgyal grong nang bso ba/ sger bde mkhar ba/ sger bsod nams sgang pa ba/ sger lha sding pa/ sger bde zur ba/ sger gsum mdo ba/ sger rta ra mdo pa/ sger bshad zur ba/ sber hor khang zur pa/ sger gnam dpon pa/ sger mkhar sna ba/ sger lcags sprag pa/ sger rdo grong pa/ sger lha lung zur lci ba/ sger de zhim pa/ sger gong dkar rgya mtsho/ sger nor rgyas pa/ sger lhun rab pa/ sger spo shod pa/(2) lho kha khul/ sger snang byung pa/ sger shag byang pa/ sger shag byang zur pa/ sger dkar byung pa/ sger 'bum thang pa/ sger lce bde ba/sger bkras khang pa/ sger ldum khang pa/ sger ldum ra ba/ sger mkhar ldan pa/sger bkra shis dpal rab ba/ sger sgo mo gzhon tshang pa/ sger phu lung pa/sger rnam sras gling pa/ sger ldum bu ba/ sger la thog zur mkhar ba/ sger bhum pa ba/ sger yang rtse ba/ sger sgong po khang gsar ba/ sger tsha ru shar ma ba/ sger zom phud pa/ sger gling dbon pa/ sger sgog mkhar ba/ sger mkhar gdong pa/ sger tsha gur zhags pa/ sger zhe bo ba/ sger rta mdo ba/sger zhwa sgab pa/ sger gnam dpon pa/ sger 'khyam stod pa//dro3) snye mo khul/ sger 'jun pa ba dang / sger 'jun zur ba/ sger bkras gshong pa/ sger dgon thang pa/ sger rmar lam pa/ sger rdo dgon pa/sger byang thang bkras gling /(4) rgyal rtse khul/ sger rab sgang pa/ sger 'bras phud pa/ sger sbrang stod pa / sger skyid sbug pa/ sger nya smon pa/ sger ka bzhi ba/ sger lcog bkras pa/ sger ka shod pa/ sger sgra bya ba/ sger lcog spe ba/ sger skyid zur ba/ sger khro dga' bo/ sger phreng ring ba/ sger brag 'jun pa/ sger brag gdong bkras gling pa/ sger mkhar kha rgya mtsho ba/ sger brag thon pa/ sger 183

bsam gling pa/ sger snyan grong pa/ sger mdo bde ba/ sger 'byor rgyas pa/sger pad tshal ba/ sger spel bzhi ba/ sger ni zhabs pa/ sger thang smad pa/sger thang spe ba/ sger nu ma ba/ sger bon grong shod pa/ sger snang dkar ba/sger thang nang pa/ sger khyung ram pa/ sger bsam zur ba/ sger mda' thang pa/(5) gzhis rtse khul/ sger bkras mthong pa/ sger bkras zur pa/sger nor rgyas nang pa/ sger rta nag lding bya ba/ sger lung shar ba/ sger smon skyid pa/ sger ra sa rgya rgan pa/(6) sras rin rdzong khongs/ sger rnga 'bo tsha bde ba/ sger tsha bde bde chen pa/ sger dod rapa pa/(7) dbang ldan khul/ sger ba mtsho ba/ sger sgo yang pa/ sger cha lu ba/ sger cha zur ba/(8) rong rin spungs khul/ sger dga' bde ba/ sger bde smon pa/sger rgya ma mkhar 'tsho ba/ sger rong brag pa/ sger 'o lon pa/ sger skyid smad pa/ sger snar skyid pa/ sger pad gling pa/(9) shangs rnam gling rdzong dang rgya mcho khul/ sger thang dpon pa/sger mu shad bya rigs pa/ sger gla ya bya rigs pa/ sger skyar srib pa/ sger mi ru ba/ sger 'bri yul ba/ sger sreg shing pa/ sger snye lung pa/ sger brag dkar ba/ sger kho nang pa/ sger chum bkras gling pa/ sger sa lung pa/ sger smon skyid gling pa/ sger chab tshom pa/ sger chab spel ba/ sger grong stod shar pa/(10) stod khulaglong dga' dang shel gting / ngam gsum khul/ sger sman stod pa/ sger ru thog rgyal po/ sger shel dkar gling pa/ sger rgyal mkhar nang pa/ sger gram mtsho bkras bde ba/ sger bkwa shis gling pa/ sger 184

lcags sbrul (1941)lo stod mnga' nis khul du ha sag rigs khag gcig thon pa'i skor/mnga' ris sa gnasasrid gros lo rgyus bsdu rub tshogs chung nas/mnga' ris sgar dpon gong 'og gnyis su phye ba'i gong ma bka' shod ngo tshab phyag mdzod dge 'dun brtson 'grus dang / 'og ma sngon lung pa rdo rje rnam rgyal gnyis sgar dpon las 'khur skabs lcags sbrul 1941lo'i zla 4pa'i nang tsam la rang rgyal gyi grangs nyung mi rigs kyi nang tshan ha sag rigs dud tshang 800skor yod pa'i dpung chen zhig shin cang brgyud stod mnga' ris sa khul gyi byang phyogs nas thon te lam 'khel mang tshogs rnams la thub tshod btang nas mi gsod pa dang / rgyu zog 'phrog bcom sogs byi bya ngan byed kyin du nub phyogs su kha gtad nas bros yong gi yod cing / skabs der sgar dponaganyis kyis ha sag 'gog pa dang mang tshogs kyi rgyu srog srung ched yin khul du mnga' ris sa khul yongs la dmag skul brda tho btang nas mi ser yul dmag brgya phrag kha shas skong bsdu byas pa dang / sgar dpon ngo tshab bcas ha sag gi mdun phyogs su brdzangs shing / de dus phran phun tshogs (mnga' ris sa gnas srid gros kyi kru'u zhi gzhon pa )kyi pha rgan 'das po bstan 'dzim/ dngos grub kyang dmag khongs su zhugs dgos byung yod/ dang thog ha sag de 186

tshos rang dmag gi stobs shugs tshod dpag ma thub pas dogs pa skyes te 'gro lam lho phyogs su kha bsgyur dgos byung 'dug kyang mthar sngon gyi kha phyogs de rang brgyud yong skabs slar yang sgar dpon gnyis dang / rdzong dpon/gser dpon/ gzhung tshong / dpon khag drug bla brang khag bcas dang /yang bskyar mi ser dmag 400skor ha sag gi mdun phyogs su 'gog srung ched du thog chen (deng sang spu hreng rdzong khongs hor chus khongs yin )bar phyin nas de gar sgar dpon gnyis dang / dpon rigs khag dmag dmangs rnams bcas dmag sgar gzhis chags/ rta dmag hrag sgrug bcu phrag kha shas re bgos nas la sgo khag la so blta nyul zhib byed par btang / de tsho'i khongs nas khag gcig ha sag gi yan lag khag gcig dang 'phrad nas phan tshun 'dzings res thug par rang phyogs la rgyal kha gang 'tshams thob cing / ha sag gi mi kha shas bsad pa dang / kha shas nyams rmas btang / kho tsho'i lag nas rgyu dngos 'bor chen thob/ skabs der mnga' ris sa khul gyi 'go gtso sgar dpon gnyis kyis gtsos pa'i dpon rigs nyung shas kyi dbang cha'i 'og gang bshad de sgrub dgos pas/ dgra lag nas thob pa'i rgyu zog rnams tshang ma sgar dpon gnyis kyis gtsang bsdu byas/ der brten mi ser yul dmag rnams sems shugs chag pas dmag 'thab nus pa'ang je chung du song stabs/ nyin zhig phran gyi pha dam pas gtsos pa'i rta hrag 20tsam ma yum la sgor so blta/ra 'gro skabs ha sag gi yan lag dpung chen po dang thug nas 'thab skabs sa bab dang dpung che chung sogs kyi rkyen pas rang dmag gi srog la nyes skyon byung med kyang stabs ma legs par rta dang rgyags chas tshang ma ha sab / gi lag tu shor ngas nyin de'i dgong mo nas rkang thang du lto phor pa gang yang med par nyin mtshan gsum gyi ring sgar dpon yod sa'i dmag sgar du phyir log thub pa byung ste/ sgar dpon gnyis la kho cho'i gnas tshul rnams snyan seng zhu skabs sh+lau 187

sgar dpon gnyis kyis gshe gshe drag po btang / sgar dpon gnyis dang /dmag sgar bcas de gar sdod blos ma bzod par skabs 'phral gur rgyal mtsho bar phyir bros dang po byas/ de sngon la sgo khag la so blta nyul zhib tu btang ba'i rang dmag rnams dmag sgar du gcig sdud byed dgos pa'i bka' phab thog rta pa kha shas ska rags la thel tse brgyab nas nyin mtshan med par 'gro dgos pa'i bka' bkod btang / ha sag rnams kyang ring min gzhis dang bcas pa sgar dpon yod khul rang dmag gi gzhis sgar 'gram du rim bzhin 'byor/ skabs der ha sag sngon gras nams dang dmag 'thab chu tshod gnyis lhag tsam byas pa dang / dus mtshungs de sngon la sgo khag la btang ba'i rang dmag rnams kyang rim bzhin de gar 'byor bar brten skabs gcig ring rang dmag dang / ha sag rgyal pham dbye shan mi chod pa'i zang zing gi rnam pa'i 'og yang bskyar rta dmag 3nyul zhib tu btang bas de'i nang rta ngang pa bzhon pa'i rang dmag bsod nams zer ba rta kha khyer nas bya thabs med par glo bur ha sag gi sgar nang slebs shing / kho tshos kyang skabs 'phral 'dzin bzung byas/ de dus bsod nams la spobs pa skyed de kho ni dmag rgyag ma dgos par 'ching 'grig skad cha byed par yongs khul gyi lag brda sna tshogs byas par ha sag nang nas dpon po yin bzo zhig gis kyang lag brda byas te khyed kyi dpon po tshur tsam skad gtong shog ngas kyang phar tsam yong nas ya gi'i thang dkyil du skad cha byas na yag po yod pa'i brda sprad thog de 'phral bsod nams glod nas sgar dpon yod sar tshur btang / phar btang byed pa las skabs shig ring phan tshun dmag byings rnams 'jam thing nger bsdad pa dang / sgar dpon gnyis dang ha sag 'go dpon bcas thang dkyil du chu tshod 3tsam lag brda'i skad cha byas mthar ha sag rnams gzhung lam brgyud nas 'gro chog pa dang / ha sag yan lag gis/ gang byung 'phrog bcom mi byed rgyu 188

byas yod kyang don dngos thog ha sag gis gang byed las thabs shes byung mi 'dug de nas dmag sgar yang lha chu'i bar phyir bros thengs gnyis pa byas/de'i dbong mo rang la mi ser dmag mang che ba rang rang gi yul du phyir logasgar dpon gnyis dang dpon rigs khag gcig mi ser dmag nyung shas las med pa rnams sgar dbyar sa bar nyin mtshan med par bros thengs gsum pa byas/ sgar dpon gnyis sgar dbyar sa'i khang par 'dzul nas bsdad par ha sag gis nyes skyon ma bzos tsam byung yod kyang ha sag yan lag rtsa mda' khul sogs ga sa gar btang nas bcom 'phrog de bas che ba byas yod pa red/ha sag gi gzhis dang bcas pa de dus kyi 'gro lam lte ba ni dgung brgyud nas bar dga' dang / mon 'tsher/ sgar dbyar sa/ dgun sa/ bkra shis sgang / bde mchog bcas brgyud sa mtshams brgal nas la dwags phyogs su song zhing / ha sag sngon gras bkra shis sgang dang rjes ma rnams sgar dgun sa bar thag pa brkyangs ba nang bzhin 'gro bzhin pa'i skabs der/ bod zla 7pa tsam 'a bod bka' shag srid gzhung gis ga dang dmag khag gcig lha sa nas btang yod pa de lam bar 'grims 'grul stabs bde med pa'i dbang gis snga rjes rim 'dzar thog yong bzhin yod pas sgar dbyar sar sngon bskyod dmag 20tsam 'byor yod pa de'i nang brgya dpon gcig yod pa skabs der sngon 'byor dmag 20rnams dang sgar dpon bcas yang bskyar ha sag gi rjes bsnyegs byas nas sgar dgun sa nas byi'u zhes pa'i sa cha bar yod pa'i ha sag rnams la 'jab rgol drag po'i 'og pham nyes tshad med btang bas kho tsho rgyu dngos phyugs zog rnams blos btang nas sngon 'gro'i phyogs su ma bros dka' med byung 'dug rang dmag nyi shu tham pa de byi'u zhes pa'i sa der 'byor skabs ha sag kho tsho gcig la gcig brgyud kyis brda btang ste sngon ma rnams dang stobs shugs gcig sdud kyis 'thab skabs rang dmag dpa' bo tshos 189

lag 'dzing yun ring byas mthar brgya dpon ha sag gis bzung nas dmar gsod btang ste phung po chu la bskyur ba dang / de min bod dmag dang / sgar dpon gyi g.yog gcig bcas yid skyo ba'i ngang dmar gsod btang 'dug pa ma zad/ skabs der sgar dpon gyi g.yog po'i rta sgro'i nang sgar tham yod pa de yang skabs shig ring ha sag gi lag tu shor skad 'dug de dus sgar dpon gnyis ni ri mtho sar rdo ra zhig gi nang du bsdad nas bkod jus gtong gi yod pa de ltar rang dmag la pham nyes byung rkyen sgar dpon gnyis sgar dbyar sar phyir log mi byed dka' med byung zhing / bod dmag rjes ma ni gcig nas skabs der 'grims 'grul gyi dka' ngal che bar rgyu zog la mgo 'khor ba sogs kyi rkyen pas skabs 'phral g.yul sar 'byor thub med/ ba/nas tshul de 'dra'i 'og ha sag rnams rang rgyal gyi sa mtshams brgal zin nas la dwags la mgo btags zhus tshar 'dug bod dmag rjes ma rnams la ha sag gi rgyu dngos 'bor chen thob yod na'ang nga dung lam 'khel mang tshogs rnams la rku 'phrogadang / nyes brdung / bud med la btsan g.yem byas pa sogs pa bya ngan sna tshogs kyis lo der mnga' ris mang tshogs rnams ‘‘'gyel ba'i steng du rdog brjis ’’ster ba'i dpe ltar dka' sdug tshad med byung yod/bod dmag sngon 'byor dpa' bo rnams dang / ha sag gnyis byi'u zhes pa'i sa der gong gsal dmag 'thab zing slong gi skabs su ha sag gi phyugs zog mang po zhib/ bdag med du gyar bas/ de gong 'phrog bcom phog pa'i mang tshogs mang po zhig gis rgyu tshab rgyu yis yong re bcangs te mang tshogs khag gis ha sag gi ra lug stong phrag kha shas dang / 'bri g.yag stong lhag tsam/ rta dang rnga mong bcu phrag kha shas bsdu rub kyis 'tsho nyar byas yod pa de dag kyang rjes su sgar dpon gnyis nas ched mngags mi btang ste tshang ma sgar dpon gyis bsdus pa ma zad/ mi ser la chad pa ma phog tsam byung ba las dus tshod nges 190
sa pa ma zad po brgyab kyaḥ
