phung po dur 'jug byed stangs skor bod rigs kyi goms srol 'ga' zhigaye shes 'phrin las/rang re'i bod ljongs su spyir na phung po dur 'jug byed stangs la sku gdung du 'jog pa dang / zhugs 'bul gtong ba/ gtsang chur dbyugs pa/sa sbas gtong ba/ rdza chas nang sba ba / sa 'og tu sba ba/ dur khrod du bskyal nas bya gtor byed pa bcas kyi byed srol khag drug tsam yod pa/ de'ang bod kyi chos lugs nang shi ba'i rjes su phung po sa rdo lta bu yin zhes gsungs yod/'on kyang bod kyi phung po dur 'jug byed srol de dag ni rjes 'jug byed mi tshos gshin po'i ched du dur 'jug byed pa'i bsam pa'i 'du shes dang yul lung du goms gshis su chags pa'i dbang gis byung zhing gnas pa zhig yin la/sangs rgyas chos lugs dang 'brel ba zab mo yod pa zhig kyang yin/dang po/ gdung rten du 'jog pa ni/ tā la'i bla ma dang / paṇa chen er te ni/ dga' ldan khri rin po che/ srid skyong gnang mkhan rgyal sprul dang khri gdan zur/ gzhan yang grags can bla sprul dang dge bshes mkhas can sogs yin/ khong rnams gshegs rjes sku phung gtsang mar bkrus thog tshwa sgam nang bzhugs su gsol ba dang / zla shas song mtshams sku gdung de dmar gdung ngo ma gzungs zhugs su byas nas gser gdung dang / dngul gdung sogs bzhengs nas de'i nang rten du 'jog pa dper na/ tā la'i bla ma rim byon gyi gser gdung dang / dga' ldan khri pa rim byon gyi dngul gdung sogs 192

lta bu deng sang mjal rgyu yod pa bzhin no/gnyis pa/ zhugs 'bul byed pa ni/ bla sprul khag dang / dge bshes khyad pa ra can khag sku drag dang 'byor ldan mi drag 'ga' zhig bcas 'das pa'i rjes 'jug tu byed cing / de ni shing gshag pa sder ge sgrig pa bzhin gru bzhir bzhag pa'i steng du phung por dar gos g.yogs nas 'jog pa'am/yang na dur sgrom rdo rtsig ma brtsegs pa'i nang phung po bzhag cing / 'og nas me spar ba'i steng mar khu blug bzhin par cho ga btang ste rnam shes lha'i zhing khams su 'dren pa'i dmigs pa byed pa dang / zhugs 'bul zin pa'i rus thal la sa bsres kyis su ts+tsha brgyab nas tsha khang nang 'jog pa'am/ ri mtho sa'i brag phug tu 'jog pa sogs byed (bon po'i lugs la mang che ba mer sreg byed kyi yod/)gsum pa/ gtsang chur dbyugs pa ni/ phung po chu 'gram du bskyal nas dum bu dum bur gtub ste nya la sogs pa'i chu nang gi srog chags rnams la ster zhing / de gtso bo chu dwangs bas gshin po'i rig pa gsal po yong gshis/gshin pos phyi ma'i lam ma 'chol bar 'gro shes zer la/ chur dbyugs na gtsang la chu nang gi srog chags la sbyin pa'i rgyur yang 'gro ba'i dge mtshan yod cing de ni dur khrod med pa'i rong sa khag la gtso bor byed/bzhi pa/ phung po rdza ma'i nang bzhag nas kha bkag pa/ de ni phru gu chung ngu shi ba'i phung po rdza ma'i nang blug ste kham star sogs shing 'bras skam po sna tshogs dang / ka ra bu ram sogs mnyam blugs kyis rdza kha rlung ma shor bar 'dag pas bkag pa'i rdza ma de ri mtho po'i brag gseb bam/ ri mtho sar skyel zhing de ni brag ri'am ri mtho sar skyel bas gshin po'i rnam shes yar rgyugs te lha dang / mi'i 'gro bar skye ba'i khyad chos yod ces shod srol dang /yang pha ma la lar phru gu yang yang shi ba dang / ha cang gces spras byed pa'i phru 193

gu shi rjes gong bzhin rdza ma'i nang blug pa de khang pa'i thog khang ngam/ shod mdzod kyi zur zhig tu bkal nas 'jog pa'am/ yang na pha ma nyal sa'i 'og la 'jog gi yod/ mon gyi sa cha 'ga' shas sam mtha' mtshams kyi sa gnas 'ga' shas su mi rgan pa'i phung po yang shing zom nang blug ste thog khang ngam/ yang na shod mdzod du 'jog pa yang yod/ de ni g.yang mi shor ba'am gshin po'i rnam shes khyim de rang la 'khor bas sa/shin po khyim tshang de rang la slar yang skye ba len tshul gyi khyad chos yod ces shod srol yod/lnga pa/ phung po sa 'og tu sba ba de ni mdze nad dang / sa nad/ lha 'brum gyi nad sogs phog nas shi ba'am/ mtshon cha'i 'og tu shi ba'i phung po rnams sa 'og tu sbas kyi yod/ de ni bya thabs zad pa'i bya ba sdug shos shig tu brtsi gi yod pa red/gong gsal nad ngan de rigs phog nas shi ba'am/ mtshon 'og tu shi ba'i phung po bya gtor sogs byas na rma kha phye ba zhes nad ngan de tsho khyab gdal du 'gro ba sogs yul lung la gnod ces shod srol yod/phung po sa 'og la sbas na sha rus la 'bu srin mang po brgyab nas sha rus zad pa dang 'bu thi/ 'gro bas nyes pa che zer ba dang / gnyis nas rnam shes thur rgyugs su 'gro bas ngan 'gro sogaṭashaṃ su skye ba las bde 'gror mi skye zer srol yod/ drug pa/ phung po bya gtor byed dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan gang yin skor/de ni mtho dman drag zhan med pa/ mi mang che bas yongs khyab rang bzhin du byed pa'i goms srol zhig yin zhing / de'i skor la phyi rgyal gyi grogs po dang rgyal nang gi blo mthun mi nyung ba zhig la gzhigs stangs 'dra min sna tshogs pa zhig 'dug pas rang nas goms gshis de dag yong dgos don skor cung zad smra bar 'dod cing / bod rigs kyis mi shi ba'i rjes su phung po dur khrod 194

gre/nas bzang sa zhig la bskyal nas lha rab phung po'i mdun du smon lam 'don mkhan dge 'dun pa gdan 'dren zhus nas zhal 'don smon lam gsung dgos pa dang / nyi ma ma shar tsam la bsangs btang ste bya rgod gdan 'dren pa ngang / bsur btang ste dri sa gshin por sbyin pa gtong ba sogs byas mthar sha dum bur gtub pa rnams nga/nga / nang cha dang khrag rus sogs tsam pa bsres pa bcas bya rgod la ster ba'i srol ni ha lam bod yongs la snga rabs nas dar khyab byung yod/ de'ang sngon rgya gar bsel ba tshal zhes pa'i dur khrod du phung po skyel ba dang / yang dur khrod la bskyal te khyi spyang la ster ba sogs kyi byed srol yod la/ lhag par shākya thub pas gsungs pa'i bka' 'gyur gyi 'khor lo sdom pa'i rgyud nang / yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi dang gnas sum cu so bzhi/dur khrod chen po brgyad ces gsungs yod pas dur khrod ni bka' 'gyur nang gsal zhing / lhag par du spyi lo 1000yas ma sa tsam la bod du pha dam pa sangs rgyas byon pa nas bzung dur khrod dang / phung po dur khrod du skyel srol dar che tsam byung ste bod bsil bur thor ba'i dus nas bzung rim bzhin 'pher+ṣa/ rgyas su song ba 'dra/phung po dur khrod du bskyal nas bya gtor byed pa de ni zhi byed pa'i chos nang phung po gzam/ gyur gyi gdam ngag ces pa de dang 'brel ba yod pa zhig yin zhing / phung po gzan gyur gyi gdam ngag zhes pa de pha dam pa sangs rgyas kyis gsal bar bstan yod la/ dur khrod brgya rtsa dang / chu mig brgya rtsa sgrim dgos pa'ang bayad yod/ des na phung po bya rgod kyi khar gzan du gyur bar byed pa'i srol de phung po gzan gyur gyi chos la thug cing / bya gtor byas na gtsangal lhag ma ma lus rnga4 / phung po zos pa'i bya rgod de nam mkha'i dbyings mthon po dang ri mthon por sdod pas gshin po'i rnam shes gyen gyur 'gro bas bde 'gror skye ba/ phung po zos pa'i bya brun yang ri mtho sar skyel bas gtsang 195
4 (dus kyi

gsang sngags chos rdzong gi lo rgyus dang / rdzong des rdza yul khul du dbang bsgrur byas rim rags tsam gleng ba/aurgyan tshe brtan/gsang sngags chos rdzong ni lo rgyus yun ring tsam yod pa'i mtha' mtshams khul zhig yin/ der 'bru rigs dang sman rgyu sna tshogs/ shing sna'i rigs/ pags rigs/ ri dwags/ gcan gzan sogs thon khungs phun sum tshosas po yod/ snga dus rdzong de'i ming la ‘‘nag 'bum rdzong ’’zhes zer srol yod 'dug de'i chags yul ni rdza yul gnas chen gangs brag gi g.yas zur 'gog yul lung gsum zhes pa'i sa gnas su chags yod/rab byung bco lnga pa'i me glang (1877)lo tsam nas kun gling rta tshag rje drung ngag dbang dpal ldan gyis srid skyong mdzad skabs rnga sgang gi sa cha kha shas gsang rdzong gi khongs su gtogs rung thab gsos dod 'bul zhus na 'thus lugs bshad rgyun 'dug sngon dus rdzong dpon shod drung gcig las med kyang sde rgya che zhing mi ser glen rmongs/ sde tsho kha thor/ khrims thag ring ba/ za yong che ba bcas la brten rjes su rtse drung gcig kha snon bsko gzhag byas te shod drung la rdzong sde dang / rtse drung la khang gsar zhes pa'i kha rgyun chags nas gsang rdzong ser skya sbrel por gyur cing / mi rabs 'ga'i sngon du yab gzhis lha klu bas rdzong dpon bzung skabs ngo g.yog mi grangs tshad las brgal ba dang 197

mi ser la brdab gsig che tsam so/nga stabs 'gog yu/la lung gsum nas spyi 'thus tshur lung pad ma tshul khri ma sa btang nas mdo spyi'i sar zhu gtug byas mthar 〈chu bya bka' khra 〉zer ba zhig stsal don du rdzong ya rer ngo g.yog drug re las brgal mi chog pa dang / rang sde rang dpon byed mi chog pa sogs 'khod lugs thos myong / de rjes de mongag dbang dge legs rgyal mtshan nas rdzong khang nyams gso byas tshun gaṭasdong sngags chos rdzong zer ba'i ming de rdzong yongs su grags shing / de nas rdzong khang mes 'tshigs rjes gzhung deb tu ‘‘ga'u rdzong ’’zhes 'khod pa dang / gzhan yang yig rigs dang / 'bru khang /'degs rgya/ 'bo che chung / /bar bre/ khrims chas sogs rtsa med song ba'i 'o rgyus shing glang 'bab deb nang du gas la yang bar skabs rdzong rim pas sger don kho na sgrub pa las rdzong khang la do 'khur bdag gces med rkyen zhig ral du gyur/ de rjes rab byung bco lnga pa'i sa rta (1918)lo tsam la de snga'i bod sa gnas srid gzhung nas rdzong khang nyams gso byed mkhan gnyer rgan zer ba'i dpon ngan zhig btang 'byor byung ba des 'gog yul lung gsum pho mo khyad med bco brgyad drug cu'i ming tho bkod de lo gnyis lhag tsam ring gla med lto med kyis ar khral rgyugs dgos pas mi ser gyong gun dang dka' ngal tshad med myong dgos byung 'dug de nas yang lo gcig tsam song rjes ra ga shag sras dang / rtse gnyer 'bum thang byams pa mthar phyin gnyis btang 'byor thog rdzong sdod rtse drung thub bstan ngas/ dbang dang shod drung che ge mo bcas zung sbrel gyis yul lung gtso drag mi sna bsdu paskong byas te rdza yul khul yongs sa zhib sa tho 'god skabs/ mdzo pho mo dang / 'bri g.yag ba glang / ra lug sosas sgo phyugs dang / gzhan yang li dang star shing / sbrang rtsi/ shog shing sog/sa thon khungs yod tshad zhib phra'i tho bkod byas par mi ser nas sa bre 'jal dang / rdo rgya 'degs byas song zhes 'khang ra byas lugs bshad rgyun 198

'dug gong gi tho bkod dgongs dospo dpya khral 'jal dgos pa'i shing glang 'bab deb zer ba'i yig cha zhig gtan 'bebs bzos pa'i nang sa zhing la 'bru regs dang / pho phyugs la dngu'// mo phyugs la mar bcas sgrub dgos pa ma zad/ sngar med gsar bzos mdo sgar dngul/ bzang drug spos/sman/ gla sgor/ khri legs/ 'bul/ zha nye bdal dod/ lo bzhi bal stan/sga brtsegs/ thur mda'/ sa dbang mjal zhu sogs lo ltar dngul sgril gyis 'jasnyel dgos pa dang / tsha rong dang / gling dkar/ rdza yu la bcas su lding da pon gcig rgyun sdod kyis mi ser la brdab gsig ha cang che zhing / rdza yul bas rgyal po lo khral zhes pa stag lpags mgo rus sder bzhi cha tshang 1dang /pags rkyang 1 dbang po lag pa/ chu srin sder mo bcas dang / 'gi la bas sbrang tsi 'degs khal 60 lhung pa bas shog bu do po 6 tsha rong rta lug zhes pa se ras snam bzhi ma 6 sba slo 13 rgya pags 1 dar dkar bcas sgrub dgos/ shing glang 'bab deb zer ba'i yig cha de 1959lor rdza yul khra thang la khar rdzong gi sku tshab tshe ring nyi mar phul yod/ dmangs gtso bcos sgyur ma btang bar du shing glang 'bab deb gzhir bzung gis dpya khral bsdus pa red/de snga'i rdzong sdod ser skya gnyis la sdod sgrib/ byed sgo'i slo/ra/ rtse drung zhes pa de sdom gtsang zhig dngo/sa nges kyang / nga tsho'i dus skabs rtse drung thub bstan ngag dbang phud de min rdzong rim pa'i rtse drung la bza' zla med mkhan med pas sku ngo rer lcam re dang / sras pho mo/ mgron gnyer/ ma byan/ gnyer pa/ chibs dpon/ drel pa/ tshong dpon sogs rdzong ya rer mi grangs 13tsam re yod cing / sku ngo la kha gdan re/ lcam la phying dmar/ mgron gnyer la phying dkar/ gzim chung rer rgyab yol/ gnam yol/ sgo yol/mi rer 'bol gdan cha re/ mgar las dgos mkho'i sol ba/ mgar g.yoganub rer zhun me mar srang 10re/ shing khral/ sgron shing khral/ lag g.yog mi 199

3re/ rta g.yog 2re/ stong gla zhes pa mi gnyis re'i gla 'bab/ thab chas cha tshang / phar tshur 'gro 'ong gi mgron rta/ sngon 'gros par zhu rten/ g.yog por chang rin sogs sa gnas rdzong dpon nas ming 'dra min gyi khral skul brdab gsig che khar/ gzhan yang mdo smad phogs khang gi gnyer pa dang /gsang rdzong rang gi rdzong gzhug ma sgril ba'i rdzong rnying pa dang / bcu zur 'go pa/ tshwa sho/ mdo spyi'i tshong pa/ tog sa srung dmag sogs khral 'ul skul mkhan mi sna ha cang mang ba de tshos mi ser la brdab gsig tshad med btang rkyen dgra lha zhes pa'i lhung pa sa khul rbad de bud stong du song ba dang / 'brog sgang dang / sga ci sgang sogs kyi khral dud mi nyung ba zhig yul gyar du mi 'gro thabs med byung ba mang la/ zhi drag khral rigs ma sos stabs rang khongs dgon khag dang / bla sprul khag nas skyed lci'i bu lon yang mi len thabs med byung ste phyi yi char pa dang nang gi thigs pa'i dpe ltar mi ser chags thabs bral ba'i gnas su gyar na'ang / da dung dpon ngan bza' rngams can de tshos ‘‘mi yi sgal pa leb leb song tsang ga tshad bkal na'ang theg gi red/ lug gi bal breg pa bzhin 'di lo breg na sang lor skye gi red ’’ces bshad srol yod/zhi drag khral rigs sne mang khar/ nang khul lding gtso'i bza' rngams/ gzhan yang skyed lci'i bu lon sogs kyis rkyen pas khral pa mi ser mang dag stong la nye bar gyur cing / 'u thug nyams thag ngang zhi brag rkang 'gro lag 'don gyi khral rigs sgrub 'jal zhu mus su slar yang me phag (1947)lo smad du rdzong rnying sa mkhar ba dang / rtse drung mkhyen rab dngos grub gnyis nas de sngon rdzong sdod ring gi kha gdan gla cha srang phrug (ṭam bcu'i sgor )lnga brgya chad 'dug pa de dag 'phral sgrub dgos lugs brjod byung zhing / skabs der gtso rgan blo bzang bstan 'dzin dang / nor mgon/ rang nyid bcas mi gsum nas mar rgya 12zhu rten du phul nas sku ngo rnam gnyis rdzong bzhugs skabs sgrig zhu'i kha 200

gdan re theg dgon nas zad gron gla cha sprod rgyur g.yar blangs 'ding 'bul zhu nges lags na/ dpon pha ma dang / sde bu phrug lta bu'i lar rgyar dgongs nas kha gdan la gla 'bab nyis brtsegs 'jal sgrub zhu ma dgos pa'i skyabs 'jug zhus pa yin/ rdzong rnying gnyis nas ‘‘nged gnyis gong sa rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa'i mdun sa nas rnga sgang chu bgos man dang / rdza mthil wa long yan gyi sa gnas su khral bsdu khrims gnon gyi dbang cha gnang ba zhig la kha gdan gyi bab 'os tsam yang med pa red dam/ lar nas bla mas dril bu gar bzhag las/ dril bus bla ma gar bzhag min cing / gal te khyod tshos srang phrug 500'jal 'dod med na khyod rang gsum gyi lus steng rta lcag brgya re gtong gi yin ’ zhes bshad ma thag g.yog po tshos lcag tshan gra sgrig byas pa'i tshul de nye 'khor thab g.yog tshos 'du ra mang tshogs la bshad 'phral sngon la mi 9dang/ de nas mang tshogs rim 'byor gyis rdzong khang mi yis gang ste gyen rgol byas pas rta lcag gtong rtsis kyi dbang cha shor ba ma zad/ de nyin nas sgrig cha yongs rdzogs 'then nas dpon 'bangs kyi 'du shes med par gyur pa dang /'gog yul lung gsum gyi mi drag rnams thar pa thang gi gsham du nyin mtshan bdun tshogs 'dzoms kyis mdo spyi'i sar zhu gtugs bya rgyur gtan 'khel zhing / 'gro mi su bzang chos skyong mdun bka' lung zhus par gtso rgan blo bzang bstan 'dzin dang / dgra 'dul gnyis bzang phebs ltar khong gnyis dang las rogs mi gsum bcas kyi 'gro song spom sprod dud res srang phrug 20re dang / 'bras mdung 10re/ ja mar sha rtsam bcas bsdus pa dang/theg dgon nas dngul gang 'tshams snga g.yar gyis chab mdor bcar te phan tshun gyod don gtugs bsher mthar 'gog yul lung gsum gyi bden mtha' gsal nye'i mtshams rdzong las thog rtse drung thub bstan legs bshad nas che btsan srid skyong stag brag ltag 'khur gyis gyod gzhi'i gdong len byas shing /201

'on kyang bden don gyi yongs su stongs pa'e dbang gis rtse dru nga gi go thob gnas dbyung btang ba dang / gsang rdzong gsar pa bsko gzhag ma grub bar thub legs kyi ngo tshab cig bzhag pa red/ rdzong rnying sa mkhar ba dang mkhyen rab dngos grub gnyis nas chab 'bangs thog brdab gsig tshad med btang bar nyes pa gser srang lnga bcu re dang / spyi 'thus blo bzang bstan 'dzin nas 'bangs gyen log byas par nyes pa lus steng rta lcag brgya tham pa btang nas slad sngar yod chu bya bka' khra dgongs do na sor gnas dgos rgyu'i dpyad khrar bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi 'go mcha na sprad/ de rjes rdzong zhabatrasdo zur thub legs dang / lcang zur sras gnyis tsha rong khul du khral bsdur 'gro rtsirngasdo kyis 'brog sgang sa gnas su 'byor yang tsha rong brag snar bcings 9regrol dmag phon che 'byor ba dang / brag g.yas zhal ngo rang ske bcad lugs thos 'phral khong gnyis phyir log gis 9ragog yul lung gsum gyi khral rigs sngar bzhin bsdus/ lcang sras dang thub legs rdzong thog skabs rdzong tham chu la shor ba dang / sa yoms kyis rdzong khang yang zhig ral du song bas rdzong gnyis grong gseb tu sdod dgos byung ba red/bcings 'grol dpon dmag tsha rong brag snar phebs 'byor rjes gling dkar 'o bab sa gnas kyi mdzo shing dbang grags zer ba bang mir btang 'byor gdong ‘‘lung tshan so so'i 'go gtso dang / bla dgon khag mgo btags zhu bar bcar dgos pa rdzodang / 'gog yul yul lung gsum nas 'bru dang /mar/ 'bras do 20 phag khog 20 sur pan do po 5bcas bsdus nas mnyam 'khyer gyis yul lung mi drag rnams 'di ba/ si ling pu'u ru yong dgos zhes tham ga dmar po brgyab pa'i yi ge zhig btang 'byor byung zhing / skabs der phyag mdzod bu thos ‘‘tham ga dmar po ni sbug dam dang srid dam la ma gtogs brgyab chos/ gi ma red/ da ni dus tshod bzang po mi yong ba thag gis chod/ de 202

bas nga tshos thabs shes gang drag gis khral rigs bsdu khyer byas nas mgo btags zhu mi 'phral du bcar na legs lugs bshad sam skabs der tog sa srung gi bod dmag kha shas 'byor ba de tsho gung khran tang gis nga tshor lam gron ja mar dang / rtsam pa/ dngul sogs mang po sprod pa las ca dngos khab skud tsam yang 'phrog ge mi 'dug tsha rong gi dgon sde sogs la yang gnod 'tshe btang ma song zhes bshad/ skabs der rdzong dpon thub legs dang lcang sras gnyis la mi ser nas ngo rgol byas ma song yang gra sgrig dang rta khal gtong mkhan med par lha sa phyogs su thon zhing / yang zhag gsum thog lcang sras phyir log gis mi ser zhig sar bsdad 'dug par kho bos rta gzan dang dar bcas phul ba yin/ khong gis ‘‘deng skabs khul 'di yongs su rgya mis khengs 'dug pas da ni rdza yul brgyud rgya gar du 'gro gi yin ’ zhes zer gyi 'dugakho bos gung khran tang gis sdug sbyong gtong ba'i gnas tshul go rgyu mi 'dug pas nga tsho mnyam du mgo btags zhus na mi legs sam zhes bshad kyang brag g.yas zhal ngo rang shi brgyab pa sogs la skrag nas rgya gar du thon song / nyin de nas bzung gsang rdzong ser skya sbrel po zhes pa'i lo rgyus mjug bsgril ba red/de nas 'gog yul dgon sde mnyam 'dzoms gros bsdur gyis tsha rong du ko'u thon krang mdun mgo btags zhu mi theg dgon bla ma dbang phyug dang /'gu chen tshul khrims chos 'phel gnyis gtong rgyu byas shing / gling da kar du yod pa'i si ling pu'u ru nga rang 'gro rgyur thab/ bcad nas lo gcig gi khral 'bab 'bru khal 700dang / 'bras khal 20 sur pan do 2 phag sha khog 5bcas bsdus te khal ma 100lhag tsam la bkal nas lag do mi 3dang bcas chab zhing brgyud bskyod par zhag 17thog gling da7/ra du 'byor zhing / de ra si ling pu'i sku tshab pha'e krang 1dang dmag mi 3 drung yig 1 skad sgyur 1bcas 'dug pa'i sar bcar skabs nga tshor dga' bsu tshad med gnang nas 203

gsol ston bshams thog bya dga' mtshon byed khab chags 5dang / da gru'i stod ldeng 2 ja 'khor drug 1bcas gnang nas ‘‘khyod tsho dogs skrag byed mi dgos/ bcings 'grol dmag ni mi ser gyi bde sdug la lta rtogs byed mkhan zhig yin la rjes su mi ser gyi las khungs 'dzugs rogs kyang byed kyi red/nga tsho'i 'go khrid ma'o kru'u zhi zer ba 'di red ’’ces ma'o kru'u zhi'i sku par chung chung kha shas gnang byung / nga'i rogs pa skal chos chang gis bzi nas nga tsho'i lung par mar gyi thon khungs ha cang yag po yod lugs bshad song bar sku tshab pha'e krang gis da lam thengs gcig ring mar khal 400tham pa tshong rogs zhes mar rin nā yang dkar po 800tham pa dang gong du phul ba'i 'bru khal rer ṭ+wā yang 2re dang / 'bras khal rer ṭ+wā yang 3re/ phag khog rer ṭ+wā yang 25re/sur pan do rer nā yang 15re bcas gnang zhing / nga tsho phan tshun mdza' brtse dam zab ngang rang yul du phyir log gis dwo yang rer srang drug cu re brtsis te de sngon theg dgon nas g.yar ba'i dngul bun thog sprad pa dang / gong gsal mar khal 400'bul bar mi gnyis ched rdzong byas/ nga tsho rang yul du 'byor skabs bla ma dbang phyug dang / tshul chos gnyis kyang 'byor 'dug khong gnyis nas nga tshos gung khran tang la dogs skrag byed dgos don mi 'dugakhong tshos dgon sder gnod 'tshe btang mi chog pa dang / mi dmangs la phan bde skrun rgyu/ yul goms gshis lugs la brtsi 'jog dgos pa sogs kyi ma'o kru'u zhi'i mtshan 'khod tham ka dmar po brgyab pa'i rtsa tshig yi ge mang po gnang byung ba ma zad/ nga tshor yang lam dngul 'deng nges gnang byung zhes bshad song /bar skabs shig ring nga tsho'i sa gnas su sngar gyi rdzong dpon med pa dang /bcings 'grol dmag mi yang slebs 'byor ma zin stabs khul de'i mi kha shas kyis gung khran tang gis mi ser la sdug po mi gtong ba de ni yag po red ces 204

brjod 'dug kyang / kha shas kyis gung khran tang gis mi ser dang yul lung cha rgyus lon rim bzhin je sdug tu 'gro ba dang / bla dpon dang tshong rigs mi drag grangs kyis mi langs pa btson du bcug pa dang / rdung rdeg gtong ba/dmar gsod gtong ba/ dgon pa'i chos rtsa yang rtsa gtor gtong gi red ces pa'i dkrog gtam shod mkhan yang 'dug der brten 1951lo bar dngos don myo rtogs par som nyi dang skrag snang ngang bsdad pa red/ 1957lo'i zla 7pa'i yas mas su bcings 'grol dmag gis 'gro ba dgon brgyud rdza chung shang khyu sa gnas sogs su de sngon sa yom gyis lam zam chad pa rnams rnying bcos gsar bzo byed mur gzhis ka thang nas rdza yul bar dmag dang rta yis gang ba zhig phebs 'byor byung zhing / skabs der rdza chung shang khyu sa gnas su ka'o thon krang dang wang kreng we/ tsha rong a 'phel bcas nas gsang rdzong khul yongs kyi bla sprul mi drag lding gtso bcas bsdus te nyin 7ring tshogs 'du 'tshogs nas rdzong gi las khungs gcig dang / yan lag las khungs 4gsar 'dzugs kyis kru'u zhi gzhon pa dang / rgyun las u yon mi grangs 27bsko gzhag dang 'brel rang 'khri'i las 'gan yang sprad gnang song / de tshun rkange 'gro lag 'don gyi khral rigs yongs rdzogs bcings 'grol thob pa dang /lhag par bu lon mang ba dang sa zhing med mkhan la de bas bcings 'grol thob/1959lo'i spyi zla 5tshes 1nyin nas bcings 'grol las khungs yongs rdzogs phyir 'then gyis phyogs gcig nas 'khrug slong zhi 'jags btang ba dang /cig shos nas mi dmangs bskul slong byas te sa zhing bcos sgyur dang gral rim dbye ba sogs kyi srid jus lag len bstar ba nas bzung mi dmangs yongs la bcings 'grol chen po thob ste rang khyim rang bdag gi nyi ma shar ba bcas so/205

ha rten che grags kyi lo rgyus mdor bsdus dang 'brel yod zi bod sa mtshams 'khrugs 'dum skor gyi gnas tshul 'ga' zhigachagemado saganasasrid grosakyi kru'u zhi gzhon pa khyo) rdemyong pal ma dang 'dzi pa bu 'gro don tshe rga/nyisanas/gcig ha rten tshe grags kyi lo rgyus mdor bsdus/ha rten tshe dbang grags pa ni ri bo che rdzong khongaṭasdo ngom stod chu srib ra rdig ha tswan tshang mes nyi 'bum gyi bu yin zhing / bod rab byung bco lnga pa'i chu rta (spyi lo 1882)lor skyes/ khong ni blo rig gsal la spyang grung ldan pa zhig yin gshis/ chung dus bod kyi yig rtsis rig gnas la sbyang brtson byas te sbyang 'bras kyang mi dman tsam thon pa dang / bod kyi snga rabs mkhas grub mang po'i rnam thar dang / lhag par gling ge sar gyi sgrung deb sogs la lta klog bya rgyu blo mos che zhing / de'i nang don zab rigs phyis su blo thog la'ang bzung yod/ratre lo bco lnga'i thog ri che'i zhabs drung bla brang gi mdzod pa bsko gzhag gnang ba ltar rang 'khri'i snyepas 'gan khral bsdu khrims gnon dang 'du sa tshogs la gtong sgo/ zi bod sa tshigs yar mar 'gro 'ong la bzhugs sgrig bsu skyel zhu sgo sogs la 'thus legs byung ba ma zad/ skabs der ri bo che khongs karma 206

sger ru dang zur mang bar dang / karma dang nang chen bar/ karma dang chab mdo bar bcas kyi sa cha'i skor gyi 'gal ba dang / kar sge nang khul gyi 'gal ba sogs gyod sna drug cu re lnga tsam 'dum sgrig thag gcod byas pa dang / kar sger sde zhib mthil phyin ha lam lo 'khor min tsam 'gor/ de nas ri cher phyir log skabs ri che zhabs drung rin po che dang / gnyer las byed tshang mas/ khyed lo na chung yang las kar byas 'bras chen po thob 'dug ces bstod bsngags kyang thob/ rang lo bcu bdun thog gong ma'i sku tshab lha sar phebs skabs mjal zhu phebs bsur chab mdor bcar nas 'thus shor med pa'i zhabs zhu legs par sgrub/ ri che zhabs bla'i spyi mdzod lo gsum gyi nang r+ṣa/sa don khag legs grub kyi sgo nas dus tshod tshang bas dgongs zhu byas/ skabs der ri che zhabs drung sprul sku blo bzang tshul khrims chog/ nas zhabs bla'i spyi chos la blta dgos gsung don bzhin khong (tshe grags )dang a mgon mgon po chos gling bzang po rgyal mtshan/ gzhung mgron mgon po/ chos gling dngos grub phun tshogs bcas kyis zhab—sa bla'i spyi chos 'a 'gan khur byas/ k+ṣ-iyang ri che zhabs drung bla brang dang yang dgon bla brang gnyis nang rtsod gyod gzhi byung bar sger ru spyi nas bar 'dum gyi zhu ba drang 'brel phul bar yang bla'i dbang 'dzin phyogs khag nas blo bab ma byas khar/ sho pa mdo'i rgya'i phogs dpon la dang thog lkog brngan gyis myo/gu bar byas te gyod zhu byas pa dang / rim bzhin 'phagos mchog kun dga' rnam rgyal dang / smar rgya grags pa/ gtsang pa stag lha tshe dbang sogs sho pa mdo ru gyod zhu khrims sgug byas stabs nyin shas song mtshams zhabs drung blo bzang tshul khrimes dang / mdzod zur tshe grags/gzhung mgron mgon po sogs kyang sho pa mdo ru bskyod cing / sho mdo'i phogs dpon gyi zhib dpyod khang du zhabs 'phags rnam gnyis gtsos gyod ya khag gdong bsher zhu len skabs zhabs bla'i phyogs su bden don mi chung tsam yod 207

gshis/ gtsang pa stag lha tshe dbang dang / mdzod zur tshe grags gnyis nyin mang por bshad gleng byed skabs/ mdzod tshes ri che'i bla khag gnyis ri che dgon sde'i chab srid dang / dpal 'byor/ bdag dbang tshang mar 'dra mnyam yin pa las/ gcig log gcig sdod min pa sogs kyi gnas lugs rgyu rkyen gang ci'i thad nas drangs par bden don khungs 'khyol ra 'phrod byung bas yang bla'i phyogs kyi sa/tsang pa stag lha tshe dbang nas gnas lugs rgyu mtshan gang ci'i skor la mdzod tshe'i ya lan ma 'phrod par ci bya bral bar gyur skabs/sho pa mdo'i phogs dpon nas phyogs lhung gi thag gcod byed bde med rkyen bsdigs skul gyis zhabs bla'i mdzod zur tshe grags ske la lcags thag bskon nas zhag shas bkag nyar thog ha lam ske breg rgyu yin tshul bshad kyang khong gis nyams snang med par zhu shugs je cher btang / bden don gyi dngos ra 'phrod kyang go mi chod cing / phyogs lhung dbang gis gcig yod gcig med bzo nyen che khar/ da dung ci byed ma nges pas gzhung mgron mgon po sogs der yod zhabs bla'i mi sna rnams 'u thug nas da cha gnas tshul mi legs pa byung tshe mi gcis kyang phyir log rgyu ma byung yang dmar 'dzing bzo rgyu las gzhan thabs shes mi 'dug zer ba dang / nang gros byas don bzhin zhabs drung rin rba che dang / gzhung mgron mgon po bcas nas sho pa mdo'i phogs dpon sar bcar te nga tsho'i bden don gyi dngos ra 'phrod kyang khrims thog tu sbyar ba dang / khong tsho'i khungs lung med pa'i g.yo rdzun gyi zhu don de khungs 'khyol med na'ang khyed nas rgyal khrims drang bden min pa'i rgyab skyor byas pa der nga tsho sems pham po byung zhing / gong ma'i khrims lugs la bden don gtsor bzung yin phyir/ slar yang bsam gzhigs gnang nas drang bden gyi bka' khrims thag gcod gnang rgyu'i re ba bton pa dang / nyin shas song rjes mdzod tshe glod grol btang nas yang bskyar gtug bsher thengs mang byas mthar zla 208

shas song rjes sho mdo'i phogs dpon gyis drangs bden ma yin pa'i chod khra zhig btsan shed kyis sgrog sbyang byas par/ zhabs drung rin po che dang /mdzod zur tshe grags gnyis nas khas len ming rtags ma bkod par khra log brgyab ste ri cher phyir log byas/de nas sa bya (1909)lo tsam la zhabs bla'i mi sna lhan 'dzoms kyi gros don ngazhin chos gling dngos grub phun tshogs lha sar khrims gtugs zhu bar phyin pa dang / mdzod zur tshe grags nas ri cher zhabs bla'i 'gan khur gyis gzhis su bsdad/ chos gling dngos grub phun tshogs dang skal bzang dar rgyas spun ma /ched lha ldan du 'byor te bde sdug rgyu rkyen zhu bskul tsam las zhu don ma 'khyol mur/ lu'u cun dmag dpung lha sar 'byor zhing / dngos grub phun tshogs nas gtsug lag khang du jo bo yid bzhin nor bu rten dang brten pa srung skyob ched rang srog blos btang gis lo ngo gsum tsam dmag 'thab byas mthar/lha sar lu'u cun dmag pham rjes/ sde pa lha rgya ri dang / sde dge bran 'bud phur pa 'phrin las/ chos gling dngos grub phun tshogs gsum dpa' po yang rtser son pa'i byas rjes yod lugs gzhung nas tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum par snyan zhu phul ba'i phyir lan du gzigs bzos mi dman pa gnang rgyu dang /ri che bla khag gnyis bar rtsod gzhi ri che nas lu'u cun dmag mthar skrod thub rjes gyod gzhi thag gcod chog rgyu zhes phebs/ de nas phyir log skabs chos gling dngos phun la lam bar zas dug phog rkyen tshe yi 'du byed rdzogs/sa sprel (spyi lo 1908lo )tsam la kra'o er phung dmag dpung chab mdor 'byor skabs rje drung rin po che dang / zhabs drung rin po ches gtsos bla khag gnyis kyi las sne che rigs gros bsdur gyis ri che gtsug lag khang dang / sku 'bum gsum/ bla brang gnyis/ grwa tshang gsum sogasatsho la gnod skyon nyen kha mi 'byung ched/ srang gsum sgor mo chig stong dang / ra lug 1000bcas ri che'i 209

sde dgon mnga' 'bangs yongs nas bsdus te bla khag las sne kha shas dang /phyugs lug 'ded mkhan dang bcas kyis 'bul tshan skyel bar phyin/ phyir lan la yang blar dmigs bsal gyi gzigs bzos yod tshul sogs kyi bab la gzhigs na/ mgar ra bla ma dang / smar rgya grags pa gnyis nas lkog tu kra'o er phung la ri che zhabs drung blo bzang tshul khrims dang / mdzod zur tshe gragasaganyis kyis gong mar ngo rgol gyi bya ba byas yod tshul zur yig dkrugs shing gi snyan khra phul lugs lkog tu gleng mkhan byung bas/ zhabs bla'i phyosas rnams dogs gzhir gyur/ de rjes yang bskyar chab mdor kra'o er phung dang /phing ta ren la zhabs bla'i bla phyag gnyis nas de snga gong mar rgyab gtod dang /bod phyogs la phan yod kyi bya spyod mngon gsal byas yod pa ma zad/ chos gling dngos grub phun tshogs kyis lha sa naru/ gong ma'i dpon dmag mang po bsad pa'i 'a/ga dmar yin tshul gyi zhib phra'i nang zhu snyan khra lkog tu phul 'dug pas/ rang dgar sdod phod med lugs kyi gnas tshul zhig yang bla'i khongs mi mdzod zur tshe grags kyi dga' nye 'ga' nas shod mkhan byung bar brten/zhabs bla ltos bcas tshang ma yid blong blong por gyur/skabs der mdzod zur tshe gragaṭashaṃ rang gi bza' zla bro nad kyis zin tshul thos 'phral ngom gzhung rang gzhis su myo/gyogs myur bskyo da / rje drung 'phrin las byams pa 'byung gnas dang / zhabs drung blo bzang tshul khrims gnyisasruchung ngu'i dus nas thugs mthun tshad med yod khar/ 〈rin chen gter mdzod 〉chen mo'i dbang lung mnyam zhu bgyis pa'i dacha/ tshis/ kyang yod la/ rje drung 'phrin las byams pa 'byung gnas kyi yab gzhis zla nag mi rabs rim brgyud zhabs bla'i khral med dar rgan yin thog yab tshe ring rnam rgyal zhabs bla'i rtse gnyer 'gan khur pa dang / srog shing lta bu yang yin gshis phing te ren ri bo cher 'byor nye'i skabs su zhabs drung rin po che nas rje drung rin po 210

che'i tsha mo'i bza' zla rje drung mdun ci drag gang 'gab blo 'dri zhu bar gsang stabs kyis mngags te stabs bstun gyi zhu yig phul bar 'dzin dril chung ngu zhig yo da pa de nyid rje drung nas spyan gzigs tshar mtshams mer bsregs nas bka' lan la ‘‘khyed la yig lan 'bul rgyu bskur dgos kyi mi 'dug 'go dmag nye gyur 'di ru 'byor rgyu yin zhing / zhabs drung rin po cher rang nas bsam pa mi zhan pa chos dam lhad med yin kyang / phyi nang gnas tshul gang ci'i thad nas ngas phan thogs pa khag po red/ phing ta ren sar rin po che nyid thad kar ngo bcar gnang na nyen kha yong min ngas zhu tshod mi this/ pa 'dug pas/ mchog nyid nas dgongs gzhigs gzab nan thog spang blang go ma ldog pa 'phral du mdzad dgos kyi red ’ ces gsungs/bang mi gong gsal phyir 'byor gyis zhabs drung rin po cheratshorje drung mchog nas gsung tshul chad lhag med pa snyan seng phul bar/ zhabs drung blo bzang tshul khrims kyis phyag thal mo thugs kar sbyar nas rje drung rin po cher bslu ba med kyang smar mgar gnyis nas lkog g.yo gra sgrig byas pa'i bzo blta red na/ myur du bros dgos gsungs nas/ mdzod zur tshe grags sogs rang khongs kyi mi drag rnams la gros 'dri'i go skabs ma byung bas tshe grags la gtso bo nyid kyi sku srog la srung skyob dogs zon dgos pa dang / ri che spyi dang zhabs bla'i bstan srid skor nyid kyis ji 'gab gzigs dgos rgyu'i phyag bris 'phral gtong mdzad nas/ de nub sa srib mtshams su zhabs drung blo bzang tshul khrims/ gsang yum dpal mo (skabs der pho chas byas par grags/) kha bu bdud 'dul/ ma thangatshe ring bkra shis/ mgar ra o rgyan rdo rje/ rdza dmar grags yas/ nag gra sgrol ma bcas dpon g.yog bdun gsang stabs su mtshan bros kyis lha sar phebs thub pa byung ba dang / de nas mi ring bar phing ta ren ri cher 'byor nas zhabs drung bla brang du rang gzhis rang bzung lta bu'i 211

sdod gnas bgyis te/ de'i sngon tsam du stag lung grwa tshang gi grwa rgan 'ga' zhig nas zhal thang byin can khag dang / hor sbug kha shas brku 'khyer byas pa phud/ de byings rtse shod kyi rten gsum/ mchod rdzas/ 'bru rigs sogs rgyu dngos tshang ma 'phrog pa ma zad/ mgar ra bla ma dang lu'u cun dmag khag gcig gdan sa gnyis pa gsham khyim du bskyod nas gong bzhin phyi nang 'dzin dngos 'bri g.yag rta lug bcas zhabs bla'i rgyu dngos yongs rdzogs kyang btsan 'phrog gis ri cher drangs pa dang / gzhan yang chos gling bzang po rgyal mtshan dang / bu dngos grub phun tshogs gnyis gshegs shul kun dga' dbang rgyal gyi ri cher yod pa'i rgyu dngos tshong rtsa/ 'bri g.yag tshang ma lu'u cun dmag dang mgar bla nas rtsis len byas/ de bzhin ha rten mdzod zur tshe grags kyi khyim gzhis ngodz+wa gzhung du mgar bla dang / phing ta ren gnyis kyis dmag mi 300tsam khang me rgyag pa dang / rgyu nor gzhung bzhes byed par mngags gtong byed skabs rje drung byams pa 'byung gnas kyis dam pa'i rnam thar 'dzin nas mdzod zur tshe grags gcig bu mi ngan nag can yin yang /de min pha dang spun mched yang bla'i phyogs yin la/ de sngon yang bla'i mdzod gnyer las sne phan thogs yod pa'i mi kha shas kyang byung myong yod/ bud med phru gu la nyes pa gang yang med pas de 'dra'i khrel med bab col gyi las ka 'di 'dra byed rgyu med ces nan gsungs mdzad pas/ mgar bla'i sku tshapa dang lu'u cun dmag bcas bya thabs bral nas phyir log byas par grags/ gnas tshul de dag la brten ri che bla khag gnyis kyi gyod gzhi'i 'gal ba je cher song zhing /skabs der mdzod zur tshe grags khong ngom chu srib stod smad kyi nags gseng rdza brag rnams su dga' nye thams cad la brten nas zla shas ring nyen yol yib bros byas te sdod dgos pa byung / ri che'i bstan srid spyi sger la blta rgyu lta ci rang srog la'ang nyen khar thug gtso bo zhabs drung rin po che mchog dbu thon 212

yong min gyi skad cha tsam yang mi go ba dang bza' zla bu phrug mdza' bshes rnams dang re zhig bral/ zhabs bla'i khongs mi sde 'bangs thams cad da phrug thang dkyil du lus pa lta bu'i dgra 'og tu tshud/ phing ta ren dang / mgar bla'i phyogs khag la kha gtad bcag nas rgyal kha thob pa'i 'bad brtson cher bskyed byed dgos kyang re zhig de khul mu mthud sdod thabs bral bas/ de nas phyi nang sus kyang mi shes par g.yog po gcig rang 'khrid de ri che zhabs bla'i sger khongs chos gling gdong ru'i nang rtse ke nor bu gling du mchog sprul sku 'phreng gnyis pa dkon mchog 'gyur med bstan pa'i nyi ma'i mdun du bcar nas nang chen sdem shog gi yon bdag rtsa che zhig yin khul la brdzus te ming brjes/mgo la skra zhwa gyon/ lus kyi chas gos bsgyur nas de gar lo shas ring sdod ring /mchog sprul rin po che'i drung nas dbang bka' mang du zhus nas sdod mur chu byi (1912)lo tsam la lha sa nas bzung lu'u cun dmag dpung mthar skrod thog lhordzong du mdo smad spyi 'doms bka' blon bla ma byams pa bstan dar phebs 'byor byung 'phral ri che zhabs bla'i gzhis su sdod mkhan la zhabs bla'i mi sna do chod lho rdzong du yong dgos pa'i bka' rgya phebs gshis/ zhabs bla'i mi drag rnams nas mdzod tsher bang chen thog gsang yig btang ba rtse ke mchog sprul rin po che dang mdzod tshe lhan rgyas mdun phul bas/ khong rnam gnyis nas mdzong tshe lho rdzong du bcar rgyu thag bcad don bzhin khong dang g.yog kar tshe gnyis shar bskyod kyis rang gzhis ngom ra rngig tu zhag gsum yib sdod byas/de nas rma tsha la sogs brgyud nas lho rdzong du bde 'byor byung nas bka' bla ngo mjal zhus thog sde dge dang / mdo smad phyogs kyi gnas tshul go thos byung tshul rnams snyan seng rags tsam zhus pa dang sbrags ‘‘nga tsho zhabs drung bla brang nas gzhung sar dad zhen gyis zhabs drung skyabs bcar zhus pa dang / gzhis yod ser skya las byed rnams nas kyang gzhung la dad zhen 'gyur med byas par 213

brten/ phing ta ren dang mgar bla dpon dmag bcas nas snga phyi 'khon lan gting nag gis zhabs bla bla rabs brgyad ring gi sku gsung thugs rten dang /phyi na nga rgyu dngos yod rigs tshang ma gzhung bzhes btang ba ma zad zhabs bla 'i khongs gtogs dgon 'brog sde dang bcas pa'i rgyu nor dngos rigs rnams kyang bcom 'phrog byas pa sob/sa sdug mnar cha gas re bral gshis/ gzhung gnas nas gang cir skyabs 'jug thuspru/sa rje gang che gnang rogs zhes zhus yod par bka(ra bla nas ‘‘khyod tsho'i zhabs drung lha ldan du bcar ba dang /khyod tsho gzhis sdod ser skya las byed tshang mas kyang gzhung sar dad zhen 'gyur med byas par gzhung sa nas gzigs bzos gnang 'os che lugs ’ dang bcas skyabs 'jug gnang rgyu'i bka' bzang yang thob/ de rjes shing stag (1914)lo 'jug tsam la/ bka' blon bla ma byams pa bstan dar nas mdzod zur tshe grags 'dzi zam kha'i dmag sar bskyod nas cha rgyus babs kyis der yod 'go dmag la zhabs 'degs zhu dgos bshad don ltar/ tshe grags lho rdzong nas rdog thon gyis rim bzhin 'dzi zam khar bde 'byor byung naji shrī ru dpon g.yu lhar gong gsal bka' bla'i ngag bkod byas lugs gnas tshul rnams zhib bshad byas par/ ru dpon g.yu lha nas kyang dga' tshor chen po— byas/ zhabs bla'i khongs mi der yod dang / gzhan yang sa gnas so sor yod pa'i zhabs bla'i mdzod gnyer tshos mdzod zur tshe grags 'dzi zam khar 'byor zin pa go thos byung bas dga' spro dpag med skyes shing / 'tsho chas khyer nas 'dzi zam khar rim ljoribyor ngo thug skabs shi gson 'phrad pa bzhin dga' spro dpag med byas/ gong gsal phing ta ren ri cher 'byor nas zhabs bla'i gdan sa yas mas la 'phrog bcom byas pa nas bzung / ri che gtsug lag khang mer bsreg mi gtong ba'i blu yon sger ru spyir cha gses kyi bab thob sprod dgos pa'i thog la stag lung grwa tshang mer bsreg mi gtong ba'i blu yon zer 214

ba lo ltar sems can ngo grangs 150nas 200bar mgar bla nas bsdu len byas pa ma zad/ shog lnga gnas brtan dgon/ ljig dgon rnying ri khrod/ chos 'khor btsun dgon bcas la zhabs bla'i rgyu bcol yod pa rtsis 'bul ma byung tshe de rnams mer bsreg gtong rgyu'i bsdig ra tsha nan byas pas gnas ba rtan ma chog gling sprul sku gtsos mi ngo bcar ma nus kyang yig thog nas rgyu rkyen zhu 'bul byas mthar dngul chad mang po bcad/bod dmag 'dzi zam du ma 'byor gong lu'u cun bskor g.yeng dmag 'dzigazhung 'bri stod kha sogs la bskyod nas rtse gra'i 'brog khag gi rgyu dngos sems ca na rnams bcom 'phrog dang / mi la rmas skyon tshabs chen bzos/bod dam/ga me ru dkyil mkhar la 'byor ba thos 'phral/ gsham khyim thang mjug nags dang / phra phug gnas su yod pa'i rtse gra'i rdzi pa tshos 'u thug bzod bral gyis gdung ma bsgrigs pa dang / rbab rdo bsgrigs pa/ bod mda' khur nasatshobod dmag yod ces 'ur sgrog byas pas lu'u cun dmag 'phrog bcom 'a/ yong ma phod par grags/shing yos (1915) lo tsam la yang bla'i mdzod zur mi sar mthar phyin dang / rtse gnyer gnyis nas 'dzi zam sa srung 'go 'doms ru dpon g.yu lhas mi ser la brdab ma nar chen po btang lugs mda' dpon phu lung par snyan zhu phul bas/ ru dpon g.yu lha 'go dmag rdo shul phra mo leb tu phyir 'then byas te 'dzi zam sa srung du ding ri dmag sum brgya'i bkod 'doms par mda' dpon phu lung pa dang / bod la mgo btags zhus pa'i lu'u cun dmag bdun cu bskorari gyi 'go 'doms brtse drung khyung chung dang / lu'u cun mgo btags dmagalhongs rma pe krang / wang po se bcas 'dzi zam du 'byor zin pa dang /ser rtsa nas nang chen gru ya brgyud (gru ya sa ming )bod dmag lnga brgya'i bkod 'doms par mda' dpon thang dpon rnam rgyal dbang 'dus lci lcags zam 215

khar 'byor nas sa srung byas/ de nas bka' blon bla ma byams pa bstan dar gyis rang sa bsrungs nas sdod dgos pa dang / tshur rgol byung na phar yang lan sprod rgyu las dmag 'dzing mi chog pa'i bka' rgya btang don star 'dzi zam sa gnas srung ba las phar rgol ma byas/bod me 'brug (1916)lo trem la mdzod zur tshe grags sa gnas kyi 'go dpon la dgongs zhus kyis ri che'i gnas bskor ba mang tsam zhig dang mnyam du lha ldan du bskyod nas zhabs drung blo bzang tshul khrims dang mjal 'dzoms byung bas shi gson 'phrad pa lta bu'i dga' spro dang bcas gzhis byes skyid sdug gi gsung 'phros zhib rgyas gnang / nyin shas mtshams nas tsa ri sogs la gnas bskor bskyod/ zla gcig tsam nas lha sar phyir log 'byor/ stag lung grwa tshang gi sprul sku mgar bla'i tsha bo yin yang / dang por btang snyoms su bzhag na'ang rjes su rang mgo thon bzo med rkyen lha sar phebs pa dang / ma grong bo dga' rgyas sogs gnas bskor ba mang tsam yod 'dug skabs der zhabs drung dang grwa sprul (stag grwa'i sprul sku ) mdzod zur tshe grags/ ma grong bo dga' rgyas sogs lha sar yod pas zhabs bla'i mi ngo rnams gzhis byes la sa don la gros bsdur gyis zhabs drung gi blo rogs su grwa sprul lha ldan du bzhugs rgyu dang / ma grong bo dga' rgyas gnya' ri khug la gzhis gnyer du sdod rgyu/mdzod tshe phyir log gis zhabs bla'i gzhis sdod mdzod gnyer rnams dang lhan du ri che spyi dang / zhabs bla'i bstan srid la blta rgyu bcas byas/ mdzod tshe phyir log byed khar tā la'i bla ma bcu gsum la mjal kha zhus tri/nga / gsol ja bzhes 'bras gnang rjes ‘‘khyod tsho zhabs bla ltos bcas nas bstan pa mchod sbyin gyi mnga' bdag gzhung sa chen por lhag bsam dad zhen 'gyur med kyi zhabs 'degs zhus par brten byas pa rjes med du mi 'gro ba gzhung sa'i thugs rjes 'dzin chog ’’ces bka' bzang thob pas/ mdzod tshe yar langs 216

te phyag sasum 'tshal nas pus mo btsugs te gzhung la lhag bsam gyi zhabs 'degs zhus lugs rob tsam dang / zhabs bla'i bde sdug gi gnas tshul skor tshig nyung don bsdus kyi snyan seng zhus par/ tā la'i bla ma bcu gsum pas ‘‘khyod tsho zhabs drung bla brang yid la nges song ’’zhes gsungs/ de rjes mdzod tshe lha sa nas rdog thon gyis rim bzhin 'dzi zam khar bde 'byor gyi mda' dpon phu lung ba dang / rtse drung khyung chung sogs dang 'dzoms nas gleng mol dang 'brel rang 'khri'i las 'gan sgrub bzhin du gnas/ de nas ri che zhabs bla'i khongs stag sgo ba'i mi 'ga' zhig gis mgar bla dmag bcas 'dzi zam du 'jab rgosmu la 'gro rgyu yin pa'i gsang ba rtogs pas glug bu gar dbang dang /pad 'byung bkra shis gnyis 'dzi zam gsang brda skyel bar 'byor te gnas tshul zhus 'phral/ mda' dpon phu lung pa 'go dmag 150skor dang / rtse drung khyung chung dang dmag 30skor bcas nyin srib (nyin nang dang 'dzi srib )khag bgos byas nas g.yul sar bskyod/ dus mtshungs mgar bla 'go dmag kyang gsham khyim thang nas yong bas/ phu lung bas me mda' kha shas brgyab nas mi rta 3tsam bsad ces grags/ gsham khyim mdun ri 'brang rgyas rtse nas rtse drung khyung chung dmag gis me mda' brgyab pas/ gsham khyim gzim phug sge'u khung nang mde'u thon nas mgar bla'i mtshan phebs bu dkar phyag mdzod bsad pa dang / de nas bod dmag rnams de nyin nyi ma bzhud tsam ril 'dzi zam du phyir log byas/ sa rub pa dang mnyam du mgar bla 'go dmag nas zhabs blari gdan sa gnyis pa bzo bkod khyad par 'phags pa gsham khyim pho brang la me brgyab nas/ ri cher log phyi nyin 'dzi zam nas bod dmag gis bskyar du dpung 'jug byed skabs mgar bla 'go dmag bros zin cing /gsham khyim pho brang phal cher mes 'tshigs tshar yod/me sprubrug lo zla 12tshes 29nyin mdzod zur tshe grags la nad gzhi phog ste 217

dgongs zhus kyis rdo shul gang gzhung du rang gi bza' zla'i sar phyin rjes/ me sbrul (1917)lo'i bod zla dang po'i tshes gcig nyin bod kyi lo gsar gyi tho rengs tsam la mgar bla dang lu'u cun dmag na/sa 'jab rgol byed par yong zhing / mda' dpon phu lung bas khong gi a phrug 'dzi pa'i dmag 20skor la me mda' bskur nas gdong len du mngags don ltar/ nyin der mgar bla 'go dmag dang 'thab 'dzings byas stabs mgar bla 'go dmag phyir bros 'go tshugs skabs 'dzi zam nas mda' dpon phu lung bas/ sog po'i dge rgan dmag kha shas khrid de rta bzhon nas myur skyod kyis khal 'dzi'i ri ngos nas spyi le sa/cig tsam las mi 'gyangs pa'i sa nas phu lung bas/ mgar bla shog ces bos thog khong gnyis me mda' thengs mang rgyag res byas kyang phan tshun gnyis kar 'chi rmas byung med/ de nas phu lung dmag bcas 'dzi zam rnying par phyir log rjes bod dmag gis ru brgya 'gan yod thams cad bsdus te do nub rtse drung khyung chung 'go dmag 'dzi zam rnying pa'i nyin phyogs dmag sgar dang phu lung 'go dmag srib phyogs dmag sgar sngar ltar bzung nas lo gsar gtong rgyu dang / zhal ngo byams mchog dmag lding 'og gcig bcas so par bskyod de le shor med pa so nyul dgos zhes bka' btang ba bzhin byas kyang / zhal ngo byams mchog snang med kyis stag kha brgyud song bas/ lu'u cun dmag dpung nas sa rub mtshams su dang thog nyin phyogs rtse drung khyung chung dmag sgar la 'jab rgol byas nas bod dam ga 'ga' shas shi bas/ rtse drung khyung chung ngar te gdong mchong byas pas lu'u cun dmag gis bsad/ mda' dpon phu lung bas lu'u cun dmag dang 'thab 'dzings drag pos phan tshun dmag mi mang trem bsad res byas mthar mda' dpon phu lung bas gri bton te zam 'og dar thog lu'u cun dmag rjes 'ded byed skabs khong gi brla g.yas par me mda' thebs nas rmas skyon tshabs chen byung bas dmag phyir 'then byas shing /218

de nas tho rengs khar rta la bzhon thog g.yas g.yon nas skyor/ rtse drung khyung chung gi sku phung de dre'u zhig la bkal nas 'dzi zam nas dmag sa shor nas dmag yongs rdzogs bros pas gug rtser 'byor skabs/ chu pha ri nas zhal ngo byams mchog yong ba dang 'phrad cing / mda' dpon phu lung bas byams mchog tshur bkug nas ‘‘khyod dang nga gnyis kyis gzhung sar phan ma thogs pa red ’mices me mda' brgyab nas de gar bsad/ de skabs gug rtser mdzod tshe dang mda' dpon phu lung ba thug pas mda' dpon gyis rang nyid la rmas skyon byung bas gnas skabs rme ru dkyil mkhar la 'gro rgyu dang / ‘‘khyod rang (mdzod tshe )rdo shul rgyud la dogs zom/ gyis bsdad na 'grig ’’lugs brjod don lta ra mdzod tshe rdo shul du gnas spos byas pa dang / mda' dpon phu lung ba me ru dkyil mkhar du 'byor rjes zla gcig ma zin tsam nas gshegs stabs ru brgya dmab/ bcas rdo shul rta mdar hor spyi mkhan chung grags pa rnams rgyal gyis bsdu rub byas nas sa bzung / de nas mgar bla dang lu'u cun dmag nyi ma shar kul bod dmag bros pa shes nas sgar gyi dngos chas lus rigs rnams ba sdus nas ri cher phyir log byas/ de skabs sprudzi zam du bod kyi sa srung med stabs zhag 'ga' shas mtshams mgar bla dmag nyi shu tsam gyis lcags zam khul ljig stod 'gur bab mdor stag lung grwa tshang gi chos gzhis 'bab ( rabru yod pa rnams 'phrog bcom byed par yong yang rta khal ma 'grig pas de nub stag grwa'i 'gur mdo'i rdzong nang du bsdad/ gnas tshul de lcags zam sa srung thang mda' rnam rgyal nas thos 'phral 'gur mdo grong du mtshan mo dpung 'jug gis mtha' bskor nas 'thab 'dzing byas mthar mgar bla dpon dmag bcas pa ri cher phyir log bros/ de rjes kyang mgar blas zhabs bla'i mi ser gyi bca' dngos 'phrog 'khyer byas rkyen bod dmag dang 'thab 'dzings thengs 'ga' byung yod pa dang / 'di skabs 'dzi gzhung du bod dmag gtan sdod 219

med pas mdzod tshe de nyid rdo shul rta mdar bod kyi dpon rigs yod saza) bsdad/ me sbrul lo smad tsam la mda' dpon khyung ram 'go dmag dang / mdzod tshe bcas 'dzi zam du 'byor/ de rjes lcags zam nas thang mda' 'go dmag kyang rim 'byor gyis mda' 'og gnyis ri che phyogs su dpung skyod skabs lu'u cun dmag mang tsam 'dzi zam du yong yang bod dmag mthong 'phral phyir bros byas/ dmag spyi mkhan chung grags pa rnam rgyal srung dmag bcas a mgon mi thung mgul ba rag khar sgar btab nas mda' dpon rnams der (redzoms te bkod 'doms byas pa dang / mdzod zu ra tshe gragab/ kyang de gar bcar nas blo rogs so gas zhus/ phing ta ren dang mgar bla 'go dmag gis kyang ri che dgon gyi rgyab ri'i rtser me skyogs dang sung dmag btsugs pa dang / gtsug lag khang gi bar khang dbu rtse sogs lu'u cun dmag gis bzung thog stag lung grwa tshang mer bsreg gtong rgyu'i gra sgrig byed pa'i ngor ri che dgon nyin mtshan med par bsrung kyang / bod phyogs mkhan mda' rnams nas dmag bkod gros mol skabs thang mda' rnam/ rgyal gyis ri che'i rgyab ri'i rtser yod lu'u cun dmag dang 'dzings rgyu re zhig bzhag nas/ khyung ram 'go dmag gis nyin phyogs rgyab ri'i ri sked nas ri cher rgyag rgyu dang / bkras mthong 'go dmag gis srib phyogs mdun ri brgyud nas bskyod rgyu/ thang mda' go dmag gis khas len gdong mchong byas te stag sgo grong nas ri che'i dgon nang du dpung 'jug gis mgar bla dang phing ta ren bsad bzung gang thub kyi thog nas lu'u cun dmag mthar skrod gtong rgyu bcas kyi gros 'go bton par tshang mas mos mthun byas pa dang / spyi 'dom/sa mkhan chung grags rnam nas nyin gnyis ring ngal gso brgyab ste nyin gsum thog nas gong gsal 'char gzhi ltar bya rgyu'i bkod khyab byas don bzhin nyin gnyis rdzogs pa'i tho rengs 220

mtshams su gong don ltar bod dmag gis phyogs yongs nas ri che dgon bskor zhing / thang mda' 'go dmag dang / a gro bsod tshe sogs 'dzi pa'i a phrug rnams nam langs skabs stag sgo grong du mchong ste lu'u cun dmag dang dza drag dmag 'thab byas mthar bod dmag ri che'i dgon nang du 'dzul thub pa byung bas/ lu'u cun dmag dang mgar bla bcas 'u thug nas phyir bros byed dgos byung stabs stag lung grwa tshang mer bsreg gtong long byung med la/ rje drung rin po che 4/nga gdan 'dren zhu long ma byung bar bros pa dang/ thang mda' rnam rgyal dbang 'dus gtsug lag khang gi sgo chen 'gram du langs nas gtsug 'a/ga khang srung skyob ched phyi nang gi mi su yang nang du 'gror ma bcugari che dgon nas mgar bla dang / phing ta ren dmag bcas bod dmag gis phyir 'angu da btang rjes/ mdzod zur tshe grags rje drung rin po che'i mdun du zhabs bcar gyis phyag gsum 'tshal ba dang / 'jal dar phul te phyag dbang zhus nanu ‘‘rin po che nyid dbu thon par kha zhe gnyis med kyis dga' spro che zhing / rin po che nyid la bslu ba med pa nga tshos dad zhen zhu bzhin yod ’’lugs so gas zhus pas/ rje drung rin po che nas ‘‘da res nged rang gnyis gzhis byes thug pas khyed la gsol chas shig 'bul dgos kyang 'dir ci yang mi 'dug dam tshig kyang nyams med ’’ces gsungs par/ dga' spro chen po byung zheng dad zhen tshad med skyes nas de rjes kyang skyabs yul du bzung 'dugade nas sa rta ( 1918)lo bod dmag gis ri che'i sa blangs rjes rim bzhin chab mdo ru dpung bskyod pyas/ de nas bka' blon bla ma byams pa bstan dar chab mdo spyi khyab tu 'byor skabs/ bkris sgang la rje drung rin po che dang bla khag gnyis kyi gtso 'gan rnams mjal zhur bcar skabs bka' bla nas ‘‘khyod tsho ri che ba mi ngan khag gcig gis gzhung sar ngo rgol byas pa'i nag nyes chen po bsags 'dug ’ ces bshad yod 'dug mdzod tshe zur du 221

bcar nas nang ma'i zhib mol skabs bka' bla nas ‘‘gzhung sa'i zhi drag dpon rigs la khyod nas sngar ltar zhabs zhu dgos pa dang / mgar bla'i phyogs gtogs yib sdod yod med sogs gzhung phan gyi bya ba lhod med 'gan khur dgos rgyu dang / ri khongs gtan 'khel ma byung bar ri che zhabs bla'i sngar yod 'dzin dbang ji yod bed spyod nyams gso dang / dus mchod rigs 'tshogs dgos rgyu sogs bkod khyab byas don ltar tshe grags nas 'gan khur byas/ de nas lha ldan du zhabs drung rin po che'i mdun ri che'i sa gnas lon tshul skor sogs kyi gnas tshul zhus par bkris chos 'grub dang rogs pa gcig bang mir ched gtong byas don lha sar 'byor nas zhabs drungartsarin po che'i mjal kha zhu skabs zhabs drung rin po che nas ‘‘gtsug lag khang dbu thon yod dam/ rje drung rin po che dbu thon yod dam ’ zhes gsungs par/ bang mi gnyis nas gtsug lag khang dang rje drung rin po che dbu thon lugs dang /ri che'i sa gnas len tshul dang / de skabs ri che'i gnas tshul bcas 'khod pa'i zhu rgya phul bas zhabs drung rin po che thugs rab tu dgyes shing ‘‘gtsug lag khang dbu thon pa dang / rje drung rin po che dbu thon na/ nga tsho ri bo che mgo thon pa red ces bshad chog ’’ces gsungs yod/lo 'dir rtse ke mchog sprul dkon mchog 'gyur med kyis ri che zhabs bla bskyar gso gnang rgyur dngos chas g.yag rgyab 50tham pa dang / rta drel kha shas dang bcas ri cher phebs thog mdzod zur tshe grags dang mnyam du zhabs bla'i pho brang bkra shis rab bstan de snga lu'u cun dmag gis gtor skyon btang ba de dag zhig gso rgya che rgyun bsrings mdzad mus su zhabs drung blo bzang tshul khrims lha sar sku gshegs pas khri tshab mchog sprul dbo/na mchog 'gyur med dang / mdzod tshe/ bla phyag lhan rgyas nas zhabs bla'i 'gan 'khur thog las rogs su zla nang mdzod zur grags pa chos ldan/ skya ba mardod zur rin chen 222

lha rgyal/ zla tshang rnam rgyal dgra 'dul sogs yod pa dang / de nas zhabs drung sprul sku'i sku gdung ri cher gdan zhus kyis gser gdung bzhengs/mdzod tshes phyogs gcig nas rtsis dpon pha lha bar rgyu rkyen zhib zhu dang 'grel des gtsos bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi dpon dmag rnams la zhabs zhu dang /zhabs bla'i pho brang dang lha sku sogs la zhig gso/ zhabs drung rin po che'i dgongs rdzogs bsgrub rgyu sogs gang cir 'thus shor med par bsgrubs/ ri che bla brang sanyis kyi gyod don zhib 'jug ma thub gong mdo spyi bka' blon byams pa bstan dar gshegs pa dang / rtsis dpon pha lha ba yang lha sar phyir log byaṭashrī/sa rta (1918)lor bod sa gnas srid gzhung nas ri che bla brang gnyis kyi gyod don zhib 'jug byed par ri che bla gnyer dang po rtse drung las tshan blo bzang dge legs re cher btang 'byor gyis ri che'i khongs gtogs mtho 'bring ser skya rgan dar tshang mar 'dri brtsad zhib 'jug byas te mdo spyi gnyis pa sa dbang khri/ smon la/ 'grig min 'char gzhi dgongs skor zhus nas mdo spyi sa khris chog mchan thob rjes/ ri che khul gyi sa mi zhib 'jug dngos su 'go tshugs shing / rdo don zhabs bla'i sngar yod 'dzin dbang rang 'jags dang /de bzhin stag lung grwa tshang la'ang sngar srol gang yod kyi 'byed deb sprad pa dang / mdzod tshes sa gnas rgyus mnga'i bab kyi 'dzi zam la rgyun sdod dang /dkyil mkhar sogs sa mtshams nas ri che'i sa gnas ma lon bar/ mda' dpon phu lung ba dang / gzhis rtse'i ru dpon g.yu lha sogs la gzhogs 'degs kyis zhabs zhu sgrub pa'i byas rjes su/ srid bka' lhan rgyas la snyan zhu phul don ltar sdom 'gag ra tsha dang / zo bcas gnas khag gsum gyi bogs 'bru bsdu len dang / lam bar skyel 'dren gyi bogs 'bab phul nas ji srid bar bdag 'dzin gtan 'jags sprad/ sngar ri chab bar ha rten pha rabs 223

kyis 'dum 'grigs byas rjes su ri che bla khas/ gnyis nas ra rna spro lu'i zhing kha gtan 'jags gnang ba bcas la srid bka'i 'go mchan dang 'brel mdo spyi rim pas rgyab gnyer yang byas yod / yang bla dang mgar blas sa gnas srid gzhung la ngo rgol byas rkyen/ mkhar dbang gzhung bzhes kyis sprul sku rnam gnyis la gsol phogs 'bul rgyu sogs kyi dpyad mtshams btang / mdo spyi sa khri dang bla gnyer blo dge'i zhib 'angug gtan 'bebs zin rjes ‘‘ri spyi las rab khang ’’zhes rngasga btsugs/de rjes mdzod zur tshe grags nas skabs 'gar bod sa gnas srid gzhung dang / skabs 'gar mdo spyi'i mdun slong yig zhus na sa bar khams khul sogs la slong mo byas te ri che'i sa/tsug lag khang dang / sku 'bum rnam gsum sogs lo ltar nyams gso byas/ yang (lo dus nges gsal med )mtsho sngon zhing chen khongs sde khag nyer lnga'i nang gses a khro 'ba' 'go dgon pas mtsho sngon khral bsdu'i sku tshab dang rtsod gzhi thug nas mi bdun bsad rkyen/mtsho sngon nas dmag drangs te 'ba' 'go dgon pa gtor rgyu dang / a khro sde dgon gnyis nas kyang yang lan sprod shag gis nyen kha'i gnas su gyar skabs bod sa gnas srid ba/zhung la bar 'dum yong ba'i re zhu phul bas bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis ri che zhabs bla'i mdzod zur tshe grags dang / chab mngo/ dgon pa'i gnyer chen gnyis bar 'dum byed par 'gro dgos pa'i bkod rgya btang 'byor ltar/ ri che zhabs bla'i mdzod zur tshe grags ngo 'khor bdun dang /chab dgon gnyer chen ngo 'khor rkye rgu mdor bskyod de zi ling gi zhi drag dpon rigs la drag po'i gnon shugs dpung 'dzings mi dgos pa'i bar mol byas par zi phyogs nas mthar mos mthun byung gshis/ 'ba' 'go dgon du bskyod nas dgon gyi dbang cha 'dzin mkhan las snes gtsos grwa rga na bsam yod rnams dang gros bsdur gyis dgon gyi 'thus mi bcas skye mdor ched skyod 224

'ib mol byas mthar 'ba' dgon nas mtsho sngon srid gzhung la srang gsum gor mo chig brgya drug cu rer brtsis pa'i dngul rdo tshad brgya tham pa dang /'phrul mda' bcu gsum sprad 'thus las/ lag dmar rtsis sprod sogs mi la nyes chad mi gcod pa'i thog phyin chad gting nad mi byed par sngar mus ltar gnas rgyu thag ba/cod byas pas/ dgon pa dang mi ser la 'phar brdabs ma dgos pa'i phan thos/sa ci che byung ba ma zad/ mtsho sngon la sprod rgyu'i gong gsal dngul 'bor nas rdo tshad 50tham pa nyer lnga'i dgon khag yod tshad kyis sgrub mjal dang / rdo tshad nyer lnga a khro dpon sde dang / nyer lnga 'ba' 'go dgon pas bsgrub rgyu bcas byas par tshang mas blo babs 'dod mthun gyis dang len byas thog 'ba' 'go dgon par nyams chag ma 'khel bas dgon nga/pon 'bangs bcas nas mdzod zur tshe grags la thugs rje legs 'bul dang bcas khong rim bzhin ri cher phyir lo ga 'byor 'phral/ ri spyi bla gnyer brgyud bod kyi gong rim la gnas tshul snyan zhu phul bas bka' lan bsngags brjod kyang thob/ rīchu sprel (1932)lo tsam du mtsho sngon zhing chen khongs zur mang rnam rgyal rtse dgon dang / de nas spyi le kha shas sar gnas pa'i dga' ldan dgon pa zhes pa gnyis kyi bar mi mthun rtsod gzhi byung rkyen gyis zi bod 'khrug gzhi byung bar mdzod zur tshe grags nas 'dum sgrig byas/(de skor zhib phra gsham du bkod yod/)chu bya (1933)lor bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi ri cher bca' sdod mda' dpon rnam sras gling pa dpal 'byor 'jigs med 'og ja dang dmag sgar dang / sa gnas su gsar 'byor ca dang ding ri dmag sgar gnyis kyi dmag mi don ma go 'ga' shas nas don med dkrog rkyen bzos te lag 'dzings dang rdo gzhu res byas rkyen rim bzhin rtsod 'dzings je cher song nas 225

mthar dmag sgar phan tshun gnyis ka'i dmag mi mang por rmas skyon bzos pa'i gnas tshul byung bas/ ja mda' rnam sras gling pa dang / phyogs so so'i ru brgya lding dpon nas bkag sdom byas mthar de nyin phan tshun bkag thub tsam byung yod/ de skabs ca mda' lha sding sras chab mdor yod pas ca dang dmag sgar nas gong don skor snyan seng zhus par ca mdas ca dang ding ri'i ljorigo dmagatshodang / ja mdar gyod ga/zhi de nyen kha med pa'i lhing 'jas/sa yong bar byed dgos pa'i yi ge btang don/ ja mdas zhabs bla'i mdzod zur tshe grags la ca mda'i yi ge 'byor lugs dang / gyod don de khong nas nang 'dum byed dgos pa'i re 'dun bton pa dang / de bzhin ca dang ding ri'i ru brgya lding gsum yong nas kyang gyod gzhi de nang 'dum dgos pa'i re ba bton pa/sa/ mdzod tshes phyogs gnyis ka'i re 'dun dang len gyis ja dang phyogs kyi gyod ya ru dpon 'brug rgyal dang / ru tshapa zla ba/ brgya dpon dpal ldan bzang po/ lding dpon mig dmar sogs dang / ca dang phyogs kyi gyod ya ding ri ru rgan dang brgya dpon don grub/ zhal ngo rnam rgyal tshe reng sogs dang zhib mol zla phyed tsam byas mthar dmag sgar phan tshun mtshan gsor+ṣa 'bul res dang / rmas dmag rnams la rmas skyon che chung la gzhigs pa'i smam/ rin dmag sgar gnyis kyi spyi khang nas sprod res byed rgyu bcas byas te bar 'dum legs 'grigs byung yod/ lcags 'brug (1940)lor zhabs drung rin po che (zhabs drung sku phreng bcu pa ri che bong dkar du 'khrungs zhes pa de yin tshod )mchog dang / las byed gras mdzod zur tshe grags dang mdzod zur grags pa rgyal mtshan (tshe grags rang gi bu che ba ) mgron gnyer ngag dbang bstan 'dzin sogs sku 'khor 40skor lha sar chibs bskyong/ kyiṭashrī (nged rang ha rten dpal rnam dang 'dzi pa bu 'gro don tshe ring gnyis kyang zhabs khongs su yod )nag chu brgyud 226

stag lung dgon du phebs skabs stag lung ya thang gi gdan sa khri/ pa ga zi'i lha sras tshonabs drung rin po che dang / ma sprul rinarnapo che sogs kyi phebs bsu gzab rgyas dang bcas stag lung gi gtsug 9rag khang du zhabs sor 'khod/zhabs dru nga rin po che re zhig stag lung dgon du bzhugs nas stag lung dgon gyi khri/ chen zhabs drung thub bstan byang chub chos kyi nyi ma'i drung nas rang lugs rgyal dbang stag lung pa'i zab chos kyi dbang khrid gsan bzhin bzhugs/ de byings mdzod tshes gtsos las byed ser skya rnams lha sar bskyod nas sngar lam 'dzin bdag sde dpon mdo mkhar ba'i gzim shag tu sne len sdod sgrig dang bcas de gar bsdad thog mdzod zur tshe grags dmag spyi dza sag mdun bcar nas zhabs drung rin po che sngar srol rgyal dbang yab sras mdun gtsug phud 'bul ba dang / go gnas gdan thob/ bdag dbang bcas zhu bar phebs kyi yod lugs sogs gnas tshul zhib zhus dang 'brel/ srid skyong rwa sgreng rin po che'i mdun du bcar skabs srid skyong rwa sgeng rin po ches mdzod zur tshe grags la gzim chung nang gdan thog tu sdod gsungs nas rma dun ja gnang ba dang mnyes tshor chen po gnang bas snya na zhu thad kar 'bul chog pa byung zhing / khong gis ‘‘nga tsho'i zhabs drung sprul sku rgyal dbang yab sras ma dun sngar lam mjal phyag dang / gtsug phud 'ubul ba/ no min han ho thog thu'i go gnas dang gdan thob bdag dbang zhu srol bzhin bcar yo da kyang zhabs bla ni dgra shul dbul phongs yin thog sprul sku sku na phra zhing / las byed rgan byis/ 'byor 'khos zhan pa sogs dka' ngal che bar brten/ thugs rjes gzigs te gong gsol don smin gyis lha sar yun ring bzhugs ma dgos pa ’zhenu/ pa'i skyabs 'jug zhus par/ srid skyong rwa sgreng rin po ches ‘‘khyod tsho zhabs bla stos bcas nas gzhung sar dad zhen zhus par brten/ bla brang 'byor (nan dka' ngal yod tshe nam rgyun ho thog thu la gtsug phud rab byung 227

gnang rgyu dus chen rnam bzhi las gnang srol med kyang / khyod tsho gza' skar nam legs la zhabs bskul zhus na/ don smin bgyis chog ’’ces pa'i bka' bzang thob pas/ phyogs gcig nas bka' shag la sngar yod zhabs bla'i bka' gtan la rgyab snon 'go tham zhus pa dang / phyogs gzhan zhig nas rtse yig tshang brgyud sngar srol zhabs drung sprul sku rim phebs la ho thog thu'i go gnas dang bdag dbang she bam zhu lam sogs kyi gra sgrig las don khag phal cher zin rjes/ stag lung nas zhabs sprusnyel rin po che lha sar gdan zhus kyis srid skyong rwa sgreng rin po che'i drung nas gza' skar 9rabyung 'phrod dge ba dang bstun dbu phud 'bul bzhes dang / rab byung sdom bzhes gnang bar ‘‘'jam dpal 'jigs meng/ skal bzang snyan gragaru/ ’’zhes pa'i mtshan gyi cod paṇa rtsal thob sogs kyi mdzad myo/ khag gra rten legs 'grigs byung / de nas nyin shas mtshams gza' skar dge bstun bzhes brda dang bcas zhabs drung sprul sku rin po che no min han ho thog thu'i na bza' bzhes shing / chibs par gser tog dang chibs dom ze khebs/ long khebs so gas spras te sku 'khor dpon g.yog bcu skor tsam nor gling pho brang du phebs nas/ tā la'i bla mar sku phyag dang bcas maṇ+ḍal rten gsum 'bul gnang mdzad pa dang / no min han ho thog thu'i gdan thob thog 'bod pa dang / zhabs gras rnams kyang 'os mthun gdan gzhung bzhin 'khod thog gsol ja bzhes 'bras / dkar spro/shing thog bcas stsal bzhes grub rjes/ zhabs drung rin po cher tā la'i bla mas ljags mdud dang de bzhin zhabs 'bring thams cad la'angapaljags mdud gnang / de ltar sngar srol gzhung deb dargongs don ltar gyi mdzad rim zin rjes 'byor thon sbrags ma'i mdzad sgo khag grub nas zhal gyes zhus/ de nas bzung ri che zhabs drung 'jam dpal 'jigs med skal bzang snyan grags la no min han ho thog thu'i go nas sku phreng snga ma ltar gyi mtshan gnas thob pa ma 228

zad/ sngar gong ma bdag po chen po dang / rgyal dbang yab sras na rim nas rtsal ba'i she bam bka' gtan rim pa'i dgongs don chos gzhis/ dgon sde dang / rgya che'i sa yul bcas 'dzin zhing bdag pa yongs rdzogs rang 'jags kyi bka' gtan yang stsal thob byung yod/ de nas srid skyong rwa sgreng rin po che'i sku mdun du thon phyag zhu bcar skabs srid skyong rwa sgreng rin po ches mnyes tshor chen pos mdun ja gnang ba dang / bka' mol zhib lhugs mdzad/ de nas sngar khongs ser byes sgom sde khang tshan la chos zhugs mdzad sgor phebs shing / ser byes grwa tshang dang sgom sde khang tshan la mang ja/ sku 'gyed sogs mdzad sgo bag legs par zin nas/ lcags 'brug dbyug zla'i tshes 22nyin lha ldan nas phebs rdog thon te bod zla 12tshes 24nyin ri bo che'i gdan sar phebs skabs/ sngar lam ltar rje 'phags gnyis kyis gtsos bla sprul che gras khag dang / rdzong dang dmag sgar gyi sku tshab/ mdzod gnyer mi sna che gras khagari khongs kyi mang tshogs bcas kyi phebs bsu gzab rgyas dang bcas pho brang bkris rab brtan du zhabs sor bkod/ de ltar mdzod zur tshe grags nas ri che zhabs drung (sku phreng bcu pa ) 'jam dpal 'jigs med skal bzang snyan grags kyi sku dus su'ang zhabs 'degs zal thon zhus/lcags stag (1950)lo chab mdo bcings 'grol gtong skabs mdzod tshes sa gnas su phebs pa'i mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag gi bkod 'thab par sa gnas bab kyi rgyab skyor dbor 'dren dang / 'bru dang sha sogs zas rigs kyi rgyab skyor yang zhus/ chub mdo nas wang kru'u ren sogs skabs de'i dbu khrid kyis brda tho gtong gnang bzhin/ tshe grags khong dang / bu dpal rnam/ yang bla'i ngo tshab wang tsha rdo rje tshe ring bcas chab mdor bcar zhing / wang kru'u ren dang o'o si krang sogs dbu khrid rnam pas ri bo che dpon sde nas da phan bcings 'grol dmag la rogs ram yag po byed kyi yod 229

pa dang / slad phyin yang de ltar yag po sgrub dgos pa'i bka' slob gnang /de nas tshe grags can ri cher phyir lo galo de'i bod zla 12kyi zla mjug tsam la mdo smad thengs dang po'i rgyas 'dzomyo/sa tshogs 'du 'tshogs shing / mdo smad khul gyi rdzong 'go yo nga sa rdzogs 'dzoms nas mdo smad bcings 'grol u yon lhan khang dbu brnyes pa dang kru'u ren wang chi me dang / kru'u ren gzhon pa 'phags pa lha dge legs rnam rgyal/ nga phod ngag dbang khyorijigs med/ brag g.yab blo ldan shes rab/ ho'u nyis rang / sde dge skal bzang dbang 'dus/ sde dge btsun mo 'jam dbyangs dpal cho/ sogs/ dang / ri che rje drung sogs u yon mang tsam 'dems bsko byung bar tshang ma'i mos mthun dang da ga' bsu thob / de skabs chab mdor sdod ring sprul sku rnam sasum dang / mdzod zur tshe grags/ bla brang gnyis kyi 'go byed/ sge ru gtso drag bcas 'gan khur tshang mas de snga sa gnas srid gzhung nas ri che yang bla'i snong bcud 'dzin dbang gzhung bzhes btang ba rnams rang 'jags yong ba'i snyan zhu tang srid las khungs la phul bas rjes su don smin byung /lcags yoṭasdo (1951)lor mdo khul rdzong sgo so sor rgyab skyor u yon lhan khang 'dzugs skabs mdzod zur tshe grags kru'u ren gzhon pa'i khongs bdams bskos byung nas chab mdo bcings 'grol u yon lhan khang na nga las don sgrub/sa khyi ( 1958)lo'i mjub/ tsam du chu bzhi sgang drug jag dmag lho rong du 'byor rjes/ dkon tshes (chab mdo bcings 'grol u lhan gyi kru'u ren gzhon gras ) tshe dbang lha rgyal ri cher ched btang gis rjes 'phags rnam gsum dang / tshe grags bcas chab mdor phebs tshul gyi gnas tshul phul 'byor byung bas tshang mas ri che'i bsta na dgon mgo thon thabs dang / so so'i mdun lam bcas la bsam gzhigs gdam kha byas te chab mdor 'gro rgyur 230

thag bcad nas de nub snga rting thog ri che nas rdog thon rim phebs kyis mthar 'gu ro thang dkar steng du phebs 'byor byung zhing / de gar zing hru'u ci phebs nas rje drung dang tshe grags gnyis la ‘‘khyed gnyis rgyal gces kyi lhag bsam bzang pos 'di ru 'byor ba ni jag pa la dmag lan cig brgyab pa dang khyad re/da ’’yin gsungs nga/ dang / ‘‘chapa mdor kha dpar brgyab zin pas sang nyin khyed rnam pa bsu bar rlangs 'khor chung chung btang yong ba yo da pas chab cha/dor phebs dgos kyi red’ ces gsungs don bzhin/ phyi nyin chab mdor phebs 'byor rjes 'thab phyogs gcig gyur pu'u la zhabs bcar gyis rang yu la gyi gnas tshul go thos byung tshul snyan seng zhus/ de nangog zla shas mtshams sngar lam phogs thob rim pa bskyar gso gnang ba dang / tshe grags dang khong gi bu dpal rnam (rang nyid ) gnyis la chab mdo dmag don do dam u yon lhan khang gi tshang si hri tshang si las 'gan dang / khang pa sdod chas 'tsho ba'i bkod sgrig bcas gnang /sbyi lo ( 1962)lor mdzod zur tshe grags dgung grangs 82thog chab mdor gshegs / khong gshegs skabs sa gnas u yon lhan khang gi tang srid dbu khrid rnams kyis shul lus khyim mi rnams la sems gso 'tshams 'dri dang ja dang dngul bcas gnang nas ‘‘khyed tsho ni thog mtha' bar gsum du tang 'a/ blo dkar byed mkhan yin pas tang gis khyed tsho brjed srid kyi ma red ’’ces sogs sems gso bka' slob kyang gnang ba bcas/ de ltar ri che mdzod zur tshe grags kyi lo rgyus mdor bsdus 'di ni skabs de'i mthong pos dang khong 'tsho bzhugs skabs kyi gsung sgros bcas phyogs sgrig gis rags tsam bkod pa yin/231

gnyis/ zi bod sa mtshams 'khrug 'dum skor gyi gnas tshul 'ga' zhig1 zi bod g.yul 'khrug gi thog ma'i yong rkyen/'dan khog khul nas bod zi sa mtshams kyi rtsod gzhi rgya che tsam yod mus thog chu sprel (1932)lo tsam la mtsho sngon khongs zur mang rnam rgyal rtse dang /khul de nas spyi le kha shas las mi 'gyangs pa'i sar gnas pa'i dga' ldan dgon (sngar gdan sa dga' ldan nas mkhan po gtong srol )gyi dbar 'gal ba'i don rkyen te dga' dgon gyi chos gzhis khongs son ru'i khal nyer gcig lhag tsam 'gro ba'i bla ma gzhung zhing zer ba bar lam rnam rgyal rtses gnon shugs kyis 'phrog pa dang / gzhan yang rtswa thang dang / ban rgyun sogs kyi don rkyen mu mthud byung bzhin yod la/ rnam rtse nang khul du'ang gling pa grwa tshang dang zur mang be hu mthun min la brten bya btang sprul sku'i phyag mdzod thub bstan dang / dga' ldan phyag mdzod blo bzang rnam rgyal gnyis lkog tu mna' mthun bzos te gsang gros dang gsang 'phrin gtong res byed pa sogs kyi gnas tshul de rigs la brten/ dga' phyag blo bzang rnam rgyal nas/re nag lha mchog zer ba'i khram pa gcig la lkog brngan sprad de bya btang mdzod pa thub bstan nas nyul zhib byas pa'i gsang brda'i go skabs dang bstun rnam rtse gar dbang be hu'e dpon po dkar lu zhes pa de zur mang dgon gyi sgo 'phyor nang du me mda' brgyab nas lkog bsad byas te bros pa dang / rnam rtse gar dbang phyogs khag gis do na de rtsad gcod dang 'brel dogs gnas yod pa'i dga' ldan dgon gyi phyogs su gnon shugs sngar bas je cher btang bas dga' ldan dgon gyi sprul sku dang / phyag mdzod blo bzang rnam rgyal sogs 232

'gan khur kha shas chab mdor ched phebs kyis bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi mdospya sa dbang nga phod (nga phong/ sngon ma )mdun du snga phyi thengs 'ga' shas bcar nas rgyab skyor rogs ram thugs rjes 'dzin pa dang / slad phyin bod gzhung la mgo btags skyabs bcar gyis ‘‘skyid sdug gang byung gzhung sa mchog nas 'dzin rgyuldi ’’skyabs 'jug zhus par mdo spyi nga phod pas re 'bras don smin rim bzhin bgyid chog pa'i bka' lan thob pas/ dga' dzan dgon pa yang spobs pa je mthor song nas zur mang nas de snga btsan 'phrog byas pa'i bla ma gzhung zhing zer ba'i lo tog rnams grwa mang song nas brnga bsdu byas te dga' ldan dgon du dbor 'dren byas pa dang / rnam rgyal rtse'i mi drag grong 'go a bstan zer bar rdung rdzog dang 'dzin bzung yang byas par grags/ phyogs mtshungs zur mang rnam rgyal rtse'i phyogs khag nas kyang mtsho sngon zhi drag dpon rigamu/ la dga' zur don rkyen zhu gtug rim par byas te dga' ldan dgon pa sdod bde med pa bzos pa sogs kyi rkyen pas dga' dgon gyi skyabs bcol sngon zhus bzhin mdo spyi nga phod pa'i bka' lan la bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis dmag dpung gtong rgyu thag pacad par grags/2 bod dmag gis skye mdo bar daphung 'jug byas pa /rab byung bcu drug lcags lug (1931)bod zla 12tsam la bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi bka' ltar/ ta dang brgya dpon mgon po'i 'og dmag brgya tsam karma jing thang nas bskyod de zur mang sdom re mdo'i (sdom re mdo ni ri zur sa mtshams tshwa zhing chen po yod pa da lta zur mang khongs su yod )nye 'gram yog ra rgas zhes par bsdad pa dang / mtsho sngon khongs nang chen rdzong gi sdom re mdo'i tshwa zhing bdag gnyer yin zhes dpon dmag drag chas spras pa mi grangs bcu lhag tsam yod nga/ra phan tshun dogs zon ngang nyin shas gnas 233

ma/thar/ bod dmag gis mtsho sngon tshwa zhing srung mkhan nas nyul ma patang byung zhes glo bur me mda' brgyab nas zi dmag gnyis gsum tsam bsad pa dang khang pa 'ga' shas mer bsregs pas tshwa zhing srung da mag rnams bros/ ta dang mda' dpon bshad zur 'gyur med rdo rje 'go dmag zur mang rnam rgyal rtser rim 'byor gyes sdod skabs mdo spyis ta mda' bshad zur la re zhig dmag rgyag mi dgos pa'i bka' rgya btang don ltar zla shas der bsdad cing / de'i ring skye rgu dgon pa dang / bra bo be hu'e bang mi seng se/ dbang phyuban mgo btags zhu mi ta mda' bshad zur ma dun du 'byor ba da nga / de bzhin dim chi nyer lnga'i khongs dgon sde 'ga' shas nas kyang mgo btags zhu bar 'byor yod tshod/ ri che'i rdzong dpon skal bzang tshul khrims/ kyis ri 'og 'dems dmag 137zhabs gras kha shas bcas gong lo'i bod zla 12tshes 29nyin ri che nas ngom zam karma gdong gru brgyud rim bgrod kyis rnam rtser zhag 20skor bsdad rjes bka' rgya ltar ri bla 'go dmag nang chen sgar la (nang chen sgar ni nang chen rgyal po'i sdod gnas yin pa )rgyab srung du yong / ta dang brgya dpon lha dbang dang drung yig dbang phyug 'go dmag 200skor lcags zam/ brgyud nang chen sgar du 'byor skabs nang chen bla dpon nas bod kyi dam ga ni rgyal bstan la sman pa dang / zhabs 'degs zhu ba'i dmag dpung zhig tu ngos 'dzin byas te 'go dmag la dga' bsu zhu ba dang sne len sdod sgrig gis sha mar 'bru bcas kyi mjal zhu dang / rta g.yog thab g.yog rta khal mi gsum gyi 'u lag bcas zhabs zhu rgyas par zhus pa dang / nang sgar nas dpung bskyod kyis dpal me dargon du 'byor skabs ser sbreng dang 'bud dkrol rol chas sne len gzab rgyas kyis dga' bsu dang bcas te gar 'byor nas dmag sgar btab ste de'i phyi nyin nas nang chen rdzong du nyin bcu lhag tsam dpung 'jug/ byas par bod dmag gnyis la rmas skyon las gzhan tshur rgol 'gog 234

ri srung ma thub mthar/ zi dmag 'ga' shas bsad 'phros zi ling gi 'go dmag rdza chu'i kur te gru brgal te skye mdo phyogs su mtshan bros byas/chu sprel (1932)bod zla 5na nga tsam la mdo spyi'i bka' dgongs lta ra/bod kyi 'go dmag rnams rim bzhin rdza chu'i kur te gru brgal te ta dang ri che'i dmag gsar sogs rag shag rlung shes dgon du 'byor ba dang / ta mda' bshad zur 'gyur med rdo rje dmag der yod bcas kyang zur mang nas rtsi chu brgyud rlung shes dgon du 'byor/ de bzhin stod phyogs nas cha spel mda' dpon 'go dmag 500skor dang / hor spyi'i 'og tsho dmag 500bcas rlung shes su 'byor nas bog rog dkar la brgyud rong po dpal thad du dpung skyod byarnga// de rjes spo dmag sogs khams dmag kyang rim bzhin 'byor/ ta dang dmag dang ri che bla gnyer skal tshul 'go dmag spo dmag bcas bar gyi rong po shang la brgyud dpung skyod byed skabs/ zi ling so dmag gis la rtse nas me mda' brgyab ste bkag kyang ta mda' bshad zur ba dang / ri bla skal tshul 'go dmag gis 'thab 'khrug byas pas bod dmag rgyal te zi ling so dmag chams bros rjes bod dmag rong po shang la brgal nas dpal thang du bshad zur 'go dmag dang / cha spel 'go dmag skal tshul 'go dmag sogs ma/nyam du 'dzoms te de gar sgar btab nas bsdad/ de'i cung snga tsam du smad kyi 'dan khog nas mkhan chung zla bas sho star lho gsum dang / ri che'i dmag rnying bsdoms 500tsam khrid nas ben chen dgon brgyud za chu'i 'gram sgar btab ste stod smad bar gsum nas skye mdor dus gcig tu 'thab rgyu'i a drung gtong res byas don ltar/ mkhan chung zla bas sho star lho gsum nas dmag hrag bsdus 20khra cha/go dgon du mngags kyang de dag gis dogs zon ma byas stabs glo bur zi dmag 'byor nas dmag 'thab byas pas/ bod dmag gis zi dmag mang po bsad kyang mang sne nyung gis ma brten par bod dmag mi 235

gnyis thar ba ma gtogs gzhan bco brgyad bsad mthar zi dmag skye mdor phyir log byas pa dang / sho star lho gsum gyi dmag de gnyis kyang rang sgar la 'byor nas gnas tshul zhus/ phyi nyin phyogs yongs nas skye mdor bskyod rgyu byas don ltar rim bzhin dpung skyod skabs la so khag tu bod dmag khag bgos phar rgol byas pas re zhig bod dmag rgyal te zi phyogs kyi dmag thams cad gser skyem la brgal nas skye rgu grong du bros/ bod dmag gis kyang mu mthud rgol bzhin par gser skyem la brgal nas re zhig gser skyem la'i ri rgyud bod dmag gis bzung zhing / cha spel 'go dmaka gis la gong ma nas bskyod de skye mdo'i phu ru sgar btab/ bshad zur dang skal tshul 'go dmag bis skye mdo'i lho phyogs khra mgo dgon gyi rgyab ri'i rgyud du bskyod de nye sngo na sho star lho gsum dmag bco brgyad zi dmag gi bsad pa de khra/ mgo dgon pas zi dmag bskungs 'dub/ ces bshad nas dgon pa'i chos rdzas dang / grwa chas/sha mar 'bru sogs 'tsho ba'i dgos mkho'i rigs phon chen 'phrog nge skabs skye mdor yod pa'i zi phyogs 'go dmag gis skye mdo'i mang tshogs khrid nas mtshan mo'i dus su so khang khag mang po brgyab pa dang / bod dmag gis nyin mo gtor skyon btang rigs ma tshan mor nyams gso byed bzhin yod pa red/chu sprel bod zla 6pa tsam la skye mdo'i lho stod stag ldan zer ba'i ri rtse sho star lho gsum dang ri che'i dmag rnying gi 'go gtso mkhan chung zla ba 'go dmag gis bzung ba dang / lho phyogs mdun ri'i rtse ta dang 'go dmag dang ri che'i yul dmag gsar pa/ spo bo'i yul dmag bcas kyi 'go gtso mda' dpon bshad zur 'gyur med rdo rje dang / ri bla skal bzang tshul khrims bcas kyis bzung ba/ nub byang skye rgu'i stod rgyud du gzim chung dmag dang / rgyab dpung du tsho dmag 'go gtso mda' dpon cha spel ba bcas kyis bzung nas gza' 'khor re re'i mtshams su bshad zur mdun du dmag dpon rnams 236

tshogs 'du thengs re 'tshogs kyi yod 'dug de skabs bod dpung gis nyin gsum re'i mtshams dmag thengs re tsam rgyag gi yod pa dang / skabs 'gar zi dmag gi so khang nang du'ang bod dmag gis mchong rgyugs byas te 'thab pa'am/ mtshan 'dzings yang thengs kha shas byas nas ha lam skye rgu'i grong zur stag ldan grong bar bod dmag slebs par grags/de nas bod zla 7pa trem la phan tshun me mda' rgyag mtshams bzhag ste 'dum 'grig byed 'char gyis phan tshun so so'i dmag sgar nas 'os 'tsham sar dbyug pa ring po'i rtser yi ge sgrogs nas 'dzugs dus dmag mi btang ste blangs thog yig lan yang gong bzhin byas te gtong ba/ de ltar byas nas nyin bcu lhag tsam bsdad/ 3 skye mdo nas pod dmag phyir 'then dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan dang zi dmag nas bod dmag rjes 'ded byas pa/ skye mdo nas bod dmag phyir 'then byed dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan gtso bo ni/gcig nas bod dmag gis de sngon khra mgo dgon pa'i dngos chas 'khrog gtor dang / skye rgu dgon par me skyogs brgyab pa/ mi ser thog rta khal sdod sgrig sogs brdab bsig che bar brten ser skya mang tshogs dang kha bral ba/gnyis nas skye mdo'i zi dmag gis g.yo sgyu 'khrab nas dmag rnams mtshan mo skye rgu la rgan rgyab la gtong zhing / phyi nyin zhogs pa rgyab dpung mang po 'byor gyi yod khul gyi g.yo sgyu 'khrab pa/ gzhan yang bod kyi 'bo dmag rnams gcig sgril rang med pas dmag sgar gcig gis dmag 'dzings skabs dmag sgar gzhan gyis ltad mo blta ba dang / tsho dmag dang / spo dmag sogs khams dmag rnams la mi ser nas bsdus pa'i drag chas yag po med pa sogs kyi phyi 237

nang rgyu rkyen 'og 'bri chu shar rgyud nas bod kyi dmag dpung phyir 'then byas par brten skye mdo nas kyang bod dpung phyir 'then byed dgos byung zhing /bod zla 8pa'i tshes shar gyi nyin zhig tho rengs tsam la bshad zur dang zla ba lags/ skal tshul bcas phyir log byas rjes/ ri che'i dmag gsar dpal thang / rag shul/ kur te gru brgyud nang sgar du 'byor ba dang / bshad zur 'go dmag phal che ba rdza chu'i kur te gru brgal te lcags zam kha bar phyir bros byas pa dang / dmag rjes lus pa 'ga' zhig zur mang khul nas zi dmag gis bzung / cha spel 'go dmag zur mang nas phyi ra skyod skabs zi dmag gis rjes zin nas gzim chung ru dpo na gtsos 'go dmag mang tsam gson bzung shor 'phros cha spel mda' dpon ngom zam brgyud nas ri cher 'byor/ de rjes slo/ ra yang ngom zam srung bar bskyod nas/ zam pa mer bsregs te chu'i tshu rol tu sgar btab ste bsdad/ de skabs ri bla skal tshul ngo g.yog kha shas ri cher sngo na du song ba dang / mkhan chung zla bas sho star lho gsum dang / ri che'i yul dmas/ gsar rnying bcas la bka' phab ste nang chen sgor nas 'thab 'dzing byed rtsis yod rung / khung po be hus nang chen sgar dang / ri bo che dmag dbar mi 'khe/ la ched mkhan zla ‘‘lcags zam khar phebs palhadang nga rang rgyal blon gyis zi dmag nas mi tshor ba'i 'gan len bya rgyu dang / (khung po be hu ni sngar mkhan chung zla ba lcags zam bla gnyer byed skabs smon 'dris chen po zhig red/) gal te lcags zam khul du zi phyogs nas dmag rgyag bzo 'dug tshe sngon brda yod pa byed yong ’’zhes bshad don ltar mkhan zla 'go dam/ga lcags zam khar bskyod de sdod rgyu yin yang bros rgyu yin khul gyis rta dre'u la sga rgyab cing (ragro shom byed pas/ de 'khral bshad zur 'go dmag rim bskyod kyis ri cher re zhig bsdad nas mthar rdo shul khra mo leb dang khyung po steng chen gyi sa bzung ste bsdad/ bshad zur lcags zam nas thon rjes/ mkhan zlas rta dre'u sga 238
