bshus te shi yang sa mi shor ba byed zer nas bsdad/ de nas ri che'i dmag gsar ri cher then rjes rang khyim du slog bod dmag tshur 'then rjes zi dmag dang / zur mang rnam rgyal rtse pas dga' ldan dgon par sngon 'khon gyi nyen kha yong rgyu'i skabs der dga' ldan bla sprul phyag mdzod las 'dzin grwa hrag 100skor bod phyogs su bros nas ngom pa sgang gi nye mtshams ri khongs myo/da' rag sogs la gyar te bsdad/ dga' ldan dgon shul nas sku rten rtsa che 'ga' dang / dngos chas khab/ gcig zur mang rnam rgyal rtse pas 'phrog 'khyer byas par grags/ de bzhin bod kyi 'dan khog sa srung mtsho sgo bar zi dmag gis glo bur tshur rgol byed skabs/ mtsho sgo mda' dpon 'go dmag nas mang sne nyung brten ma thub pas sa gnas nas zur dgos byung yang zi dmag phon chen bsad pa yongs grags ltar dang / de ltar bod kyi dmag dpung skye mdo nas phyir 'then byas kyang gang ltar bod kyi sa mtshams brtan srung gis zi dmag gcig kyang yong mi thub par bkag pa red/ 4 ha rten che grags kyis zi bod zhi gros byas pa/bod dmag skye mdo khul nas phyir 'then byas rjes zur mang du yod pa'i zi ling gi 'go dmag khag gcig ri bo che zhabs bla'i sger khongs rtse ke nor bu gling du 'byor te mchog sprul dkon mchog 'gyur med zur mang du gdan drangs nas bkag nyar byas thog zi phyogs nas ‘‘nga tsho'i dmag dpung bod phyogs su bskyod nas dgon sde dang mi ser rtsa brlag gtong rgyu yin pas/ khyod nas bsam tshul ga 'dra yod ’’ces yang yang sdig 'dri byas par rtse dgon mchog sprul dkon mchog 'gyur med nas zi bod zhi gros kyis lhing 'jags byung nas/ phan tshun gnyis ka'i dgon sde dpon 'bangs la phan thogs yong nges ma zad/ dpon po khyod la(rang mtshan snyan thob kyi red ces sogs gnas 239

lugs zhib phra gsungs mthar ‘‘'o na khyod la thabs shes yod dam ’’zhes bka' 'dri zhus par mchog sprul nas ‘‘rang gi bsam tshul la ri bo cher nga yi grogs po dang yon bdag zhabs bla'i mdzod zur ha rten tshe grags zhes pa 'jon thang che la thabs shes mkhas pa/ sngar a khro be hu'e khongs 'ba' 'go dgon pas skye mdo'i mtsho sngon rdzong sdod kyi mi bdun khral bsdu'i skabs lkog bsad byas skor nang 'khrug skabs 'dum 'grig byed par skye mdor bskyod nas dpon 'bangs bar 'dum 'grig lhing 'jags thub pa byung ba'i zhabs 'degs zhus yod pa dang / bod gzhung nas kyang kho par 'brel ba dam zab thog yid ches byed kyi yod pas/ da res zi bod zhi ba'i gros mol yong thabs byed dgos zhes ri bo cher mdzod zur tshe grags sar bang mi btang nas 'grigs sam ’’zhes gsungs par/ zi dpon nas ‘‘khyod ni mi bsam pa bzang po zhis/ red 'dug bla ma khyod rang gi dgon par phyir phebs la gong don thabs shes mdzad na 'grigs kyi red ’’ces zhus don bzhin rtse ke mchog sprul dkon mchog 'gyur med rang dgon du phyir log phebs 'phral ri cher mdzod zur tshe grags sar bang mi ched gtong gis gong don zhib phra dang sbrags ‘‘khyod nas bod kyi dpon rigs la zhus na zi bod zhi mol yong bzo 'dug ’ ces 'khod pa'i nang yig stsal ba ri che zhabs bla'i mdzod zur tshe grags la 'byor rjes khong nas ri che'i rdzong dpon skal tshul la gnas tshul snyan seng zhus pa ma zad/ nye skor du yod pa'i rta mda' bshad zur la'ang gnas tshul snyan seng zhus pa'i lan du/ ‘‘bod zi zhi drag ji 'gab gong rim la snyan seng dgongs skor zhu dgos shing / snga 'phrod khyod nas rtse ke mchog sprul la lan gsal zhu rgyu'i yi ge'i nang don du bod zi zhi gros 'dum 'grig byed rgyur zi phyogs nas g.yo skor min pa'i dngos 'brel yin tshe bod phyogs nas dgongs bzhes gnang rgyu yin pas gnas skabs gros mol ma 'thor ba'i 'bad brtson dgos pa dang / zi phyogs nas tshur rgol gyi 240

spyod ngan spel rtsis yod med dang zhi drag phugs bsam ji yod sogs gnas tshul 'ib phra khyod rang brgyud nas 'phral 'phral snyan seng 'bul dgos ’’zhes byung rdon ba'i/na tshe grags nas rtse ke mchog sprul la zhu lan phul/ de nas bod chu spre' zla 9pa'i zla mjug trem la ri che'i mda' rdzong gong gsal gnyis nas byang sbyi/ mkhan drung dngos gzhi thub bstan kun mkhyen dang chab mdo bcas la snyan seng phul yod 'dug de rjes byang spyis a drung ched btang gis zhabs bla'i myo/dzod zurari tshe grags mtsho sngon sa khu95 gyi gtso che'i dpon rigs sar mgyos/ru/ myur bskyod nas thug 'phrad kyis zhib mol yong ba'i thabs shes byed dgos pa dang dus mtshungs pha rol po'i gnas tshul myang zhib dgos nga/ bcas kyi bka' rgya btang 'byor gyi don ltar/ chu sprel bod zla 10pa nang mdzod zur ha rten tshe grags ngo g.yog bdun ngom gzhung brgyud sprel tsha khar 'byor bas thog myo/ra zi ling gi sa srung dang 'phrad skabs bod kyi 'dum 'grig gros mol byed rnga/ra yong lugs bshad pas/ nga tsho'i dpon po shar mdar yod pas der 'gro dgosatshozer nas zi dmag gnyis dang sbrags/ sha mdar bskyod 'byor gyis zi dpon sar song nas mjal rten dang bcas bod kyis mngag gtong byas pa ma yin par rang blo'i lhag bsam gyis yong ba yin khul thog nas nga ni ri bo che zhabs bla'i mdzod zur tshe grags zer ba de yin/ nye sngon nga rang la rtse'i dgom/ mchog sprul dkon mchog 'gyur med nas phyag bris gnang don la dpon po khyod la bod zi dbar drag pos g.yul 'khrug ma dgos pa'i zhi mol la thugamu/ 'dod yod pa dang / de 'brel bod gzhung la'ang bla dgon dpon 'bangs nyams chag mi 'byung ched/ bod zi zhi ba'i 'grig 'dum gnang rgyu'i re 'dun zhu dgos gsungs 'dug pas/ ngas bod kyi sa gnas rdzong dang zhi drag dpon rigs de dag brgyud rim pa gong mar mchog gling sprul sku'i phyag bris kyi snying don zhus pa yin yang / der bod phyogs nas bod zi jus mtha' 241

rgyal pham ji byung las zhi gros mi yong gsungs byung bas/ rang nas bla dgon dpon sde tshang mar nyams chag mi 'byung ched zhi gros yong ba'i nan zhu byas mthar bod sa/zhung gi blo la bab tsam byung nas bod kyi zhi gros 'grig 'dum yo/nga min zi phyos/sa 'a/ zhus na 'grig ces bka' lan thob par brten/ da lam bod kyi bde rtsar bsams nas 'di gar sku bcar zhus pa yi na gshis/ bod zi gnyitra/ sngar phan rtsod gleng rgya che med pa'i mthun sgril yag tsam yod na'ang /nyung shas nas bod zi lhing 'jags yong ba'i bsam blo ma btang bar dbyen spyor dkrug shing gi dbang du song nas drag po'i gdong gtug byung ba ni bkra mi shis pa dang / mi rnams blo pham dgos pa'i gnas su gyar zhing / bya spyod ngan pa de rigs bskyur nas phan tshun zhi mol gyi bya rim brgyud/ phu bde mda' skyid yong bar dgongs pa zab bzhes gnang rogs zhes bshad par/ nang chen rdzong gi zi dpon (rma ying krang ngam sngon ma'i zur mang gi sa sgo )nas khyod rang la mi ser gyi sdod gnas gra sgrig byed kyi yod pas de gar zhag shas sdod dang la na gas la yod pa byas yong zhes bsha da/ tshe grags la sne len mi dman tsam byung bas de gar bsdad/ gzhan yang nang chen rgyal tshab be hu 'brong pa skal bzang rdo rje dang sdom pa be hu mthu stobs mkhan po 0//nyis ri nang bar gyi 'brel ba'i sro/la rgyun ltar nang rdzong rang gi sdod ga nas su/ 'tsho ba'i dngos po sogs sne len gzab rgyas byas thog da lam khyod kyis zi bod dbar dang khad nye'i bla dgon mang tshogs nyams chag brdab mnar mi 'byung ched lhag bsam zol med kyi sgo nas 'dir phebs par dga' spro ha cang che/ nga tshos kyang zhi gros yong thabs la re ba shin tu che lugs sogs kyi nang mol rim bzhin byas/gong gsal 'brong sdom be hu gnyis dang / tshe grags ni sngar 'brel grogs po blos 'the/ la yin stabs da cha zi ling srid gzhung nas zhi ba'i 'dum 'grig byed rgyur dngos 'brel 'dod blo yod dam/ de min dpung sno5/ rjes 'byor sogs 242

dgos mkho'i dbang gis gnas skabs dus tshod nar 'gyangs gtong rgyu'i ched du yin min sogs thabs mkhas kyi sgo nas 'dri gleng yang yang byas pas/ khong gnyis nas bshad par da lta zi phyogs nas dngos 'brel zhi 'dum re ba yod nges smus mgo skor gyi bya spyod spu tsam med lugs skor gnad don zhib phra dang /zi ling du'ang bde 'jags de tsam med lugs sogs bshad/ de nas zhag shas mtshams zi dpom nas 'bo da mi ched btang byung bas tshe grags zi dpon sar bskyod cing / zi dpon nas gsol ston sne len dang 'brel brjod don sngar nga tsho'i skye mdo'i spyi khyab la a khro 'bab 'go dgon pas nang zing bslangs pa nga tshos drag po'i gnon shugs kyis lhing 'jags gtong rtsis skabs khyod dus thog tu skye mdor yong nas bsam dkar gyi bar 'dum byas te mtsho sngon srid gzhung dang / skye mdo'i spyi khyab la zhu bshags dang ci gsung bka' sgrub zhu rgyu byasatshopa sogs/ kyi gnas tshul ngas thob/ myong yod// da lta yang zi bod 'khrug rtsod bar khyod lhag bsam bzang po'i zhi gros zhu bar ched 'byor byung bar nga tsho dga' spro chen po byung / 'di na sa zi ling du dgongs skor zhus te bka' lanartem 'byor bar bod la da mag dpung mi gtong rgyu'i gtan 'bebs byas chog bod phyogs nas dngos 'brel zhi gros byed 'dod yod tshe sku tshab do chod yong dgos rgyu'i gnas lugs snyan seng khyod nas zhu dgos pa ma zad/bod nas tshur rgo la byed bzo mchis tshe khyod nas nga tshor gnas tshul gsal po shod dgos pa dang / snga 'phros khyod rang sbrel tsha kha ru mi ser gyi sdod sgrig bya rgyu skyospon pas gnas skabs de gar bzhugs nas khyod la ri che'i khongs nas/ rtse dgon mchog sprul gtsos las rogs dgos na'ang 'bod na 'grig cing /'di nas kyang nang chen gtsos nyer lnga'i 'thus tshab bkod sgrig gis mngab / gtong byas yong zhes zer don bzhin tshe grags sprel tsha kha ru bsdad thog de 'phral ri che'i mad 'a rdzong brgyud byang spyi sar khong rang bod zi zhi gros sne mthud 243

byed par gtong gnang ltar nang rdzong du 'apyor lug sa dang / zi phyogs dpon rigs la ngo 'phrad kyis bod zi phan tshun bar zhi 'dum yong thabs kyi gros mol rtsa don skor sogs 'khod pa'i snyan zhu phul ba dang / dus mtshungs rtse ke mchog sprul rin po che'i drung du'ang bang mi ched btang gis bod zi zhi 'dum bya rgyu'i gros mol gnas tshul skor dang / rin po che mchog nyid kyang zhi gros bya yul du 'phral phebs gnang thub na don snying gal che yod lugs kyi zhu yig phul bar brten/ rtse ke mchog sprul rin po che yang de gar phebs pa dang / nyer lnga'i khongs nas 'brong pa be hu skal bzang rdo rje/ sdom pa be hu mthu stobarngage4 mgon po/ rong po be hu dbang grags bcas kyang snga sting thog de gar 'byor/de nas mtsho sngon gyi nyer lnga'i zhi drag spyi 'doms rma zhang ye hri da pon dmag nang rdzong du (rabyor ba dang / de bzhin bod phyogs nas mda' tshab zur khang zur pa dbang chen tshe brtan dang / rtse drung las tshan ngag dbang blo gros/ru brgya 'go dmag bcas karma yo rdzong du 'byor/ mtsho sngon don gcod sku tshab rma zhang ye hri yang sbrel tsha kha ru 'byor zhing / de skabs mdzod zur tshe grags ngo g.yog kha shas sbrel tsha khar rma zhang ye hri'i sar bskyod nas bod gzhung nas bskur ba'i stag gzig pags pa sogs phul thog khong gis ‘‘nga rang ni bod zi gnyis dbar lhag bsam rnam dag gi zhi gros 'grig 'dum yong ba'i re 'dun zhu bar yong ba yin pas mtsho sngon nas gnad don thag gcod chog pa'i dpon po mchog nyid phebs rgyu'i go thos byung zhing / da lam dngos su phebs thub pa 'dir snying thag pa nas dga' spro che/ bod kyi gros don sku tshab kyang karma yo rdzong la phebs 'byor zin yod pas/ bod zi gros mol dbu 'dzugs kyis srid gzhung gnyis kyi chab 'bangs mi ser gyi bde rtsar dgongs bzhes zab mo gnang nas zhi gros 'dum 'grigs yong ba dgos gal che ’’lugs kyi rgyu mtshan zhib phra zhus pa dang 'brel bod zi phyogs gnyis kyi sku tshab lhan 'dzoms 244

gnang rgyu'i dus tshod kyang bzos don ltar/ chu sprel zla 11pa'i zla mjug tsam la ma tsho sngon sku tshab rma zhang ye hri ngo mas srung dmag 30skor bcas ban tshang rgas su 'byor ba dang / phyogs mtshungs bod kyi sku tshab zu ra khang zur pa dbang chen tshe brtan dang / rtse drung ngag dbang blo gros gnyis srung dmag ma khrid par ngo g.yog kha shas de gar bskyod 'byor gyis/ bod zi sku tshab thengs dang po phan tshun thug nas 'tshams 'dri mdzad res kyi lhan 'dzoms skabs rtse ke mchog sprusnyel dkon mchog 'gyur med nas sku tshab gnyis mdun mjal dar re 'bul gnang dang 'brel bod zi phyogs gnyis gyong gun dang / sde 'bangs la brdabs mnar mi 'byung ched phan tshun dgongs pa che bzhes gnang nas zhi gros 'grig thabs kyi re 'dun sngon du zhus don bzhin da lam bod zi sku tshab lhan 'dzoms kyis bstan dgon dang chab 'bangs mi ser gyi bde rtsar dgongs te zhi ba'i gros mol byas nas 'grig 'dum yong ba gnang gal che lugs/ kyi rgyu mtshan mang po zhig zhu gnang mdzad rjes/ mdzod zur tshe grags nas bod zi gnyis dbar sngar rtsod gleng rgya cher ched cing skabs 'gar rtsod glengakha shas byung yod kyang phan tshun brtsi 'jog dang bzod sgom gyi thog nas gnad don rgya che ru mi gtong bar stabs bde'i thag gcod byas te bod zi chab 'bangs/ blo bde yi rangs ngang gnas pa de lta ra lags kyang / 'di lo stabs mi legs pa'i ga yul 'khrug byung ba 'di ni bla dgon dpon 'bangs tshang mar gyong gun las khe phan spu tsam med pas sems pham mi byed ka med du gyur cing /rang nyid mi sna chung yang nang chen dang zur mang sogs la sa mtshams 'brel ba yod stabs/ bod zi srid gzhung gnyis dang / ri nang khyim mtshes bla dgon dpon sde'i dbar gnad don ga 'dra byung na'ang zhi gros 'grigs thabs kho na yong ba'i 'bad brtson lhag bsam lhad med zhu sems che gshis sngar a khro dgon sde dbar 'khrug rtsod 'grig 'dum zhu bar skye rgu mdor bcar nas 245

dpon 'bangs dbar rtsod med lhing 9rajags byung ba'i zhabs 'degs zhus pa'i srol bzang gi rten 'brel yang yod pas/ da lam yang bod zi phan tshun gnyis nas zhi 'dum yong bar dgongs pa zab bzhes gnang rogs zhes zhus/de bzhin nang chen be hu rnams nas kyang de mtshungs re ba bton par grags/de nyin bod zi'i zhi gros/ 'grig 'dum skor phan tshun nas lugs mthu na gyi bsam gzhigs bya rgyur rnam 'gyur rags tsam bstan thog gza' 'khor rer sku tshab gnyis 'dum sar gros bsdur thengs re bya rgyu byas te phyogs so sor logade nas bod zi sku tshab rnams gza' 'khor gcig gam gnyis zin min tsam la lhan 'dzoms gros mol thengs re byas/ bod phyogs sku tshab zur khang nas rtse ke mchog sprul rin po che dang / mdzod tshe gnyis la zi phyogs rgya dpon dang / be hu khag gi bsam tshul dang 'dum don las ka byed stangs sogs zhib phra gsal rtogs thub pa dgos skor zhib mngags byas nas khong rang sdod gnas su phyir log byas/ 'dum sar rtse ke mchog sprul rin po che dang mdzod zur tshe grags/nang chen be hu khag rnams 'dum don gros mol byas te phyogs so so'i khongs la nang don snyan seng zhu gi yod 'dug mchog sprul rin po che gal che'i gros bsdur skabs las dgon sde'i chos lugs kyi byed sgo'i gdan zhu khag la phebs nas tshogs zhugs mi gnang bar grags/ de mus su zla shas zhi gros byas mthar bod zi'i sku tshab rnam gnyis 'dzoms skabs dngos gzhi'i gyod rtsa sa cha/tshams dang / 'khrug zing gi rtsa ba dga' zur dgon pa gnyis kyi don rkyen skor nga min khyod lan/ bod dmag bsad rmas bzung gsum go lag 'phrog bcom gyi skor/ de bzhin bod phyogs nas skye mdo bar dmag dpung btang nas zi dmag bsad rmas dang mi ser 'phrog bcom sogs kyi skor bshad gleng byas shing / skabs 'gar sku tshab gnyis kha rtsod rgyag pa dang / skabs 'gar 'jam gros byas mthar mtsho sngon sku tshab rma zhang ye hri dang / bod kyi sku tshab 246

zur khang zur pa gnyis kyis phyogs so so nas 'char zin re bton par rma zhang ye hri khong khro langs te bod phyogs nas zhi ba'i 'grig 'dum bya rgyur don dngos thog lhag bsam gtan nas med gshis khungs med kyi sa rtsod dang / nyer lnga'i khongs gtogs bsnyon med dga' zur gnyis kyi don gnad la dngos su the byus/ nang chen nas skye mdo bar drag po'i dmag dpung btang nas nang chen rdzong btsan 'phrog mang tshogs la khral 'ul rdung rdeg 'phrog bcom tshad med btang ba/ dmag dmangs mang po bsad rmas thog skye rgu dgon par yang me skyogs brgyab pa sogs kyi tshabs che'i bya spyod de rigs zur bzhag gis bden don spu tsam med pa'i g.yo rdzun mgo skor gtong lugs dang / bod zi drag po'i dpung 'dzing gis thag gcod byed rgyu las bod phyogs nas bton pa'i 'char zin la mos mthun byed thabs med tshul bshad par grags/ de lan zur khang zur pa dbang chen tshe brtan nas kyang mi 'jigs pa'i nyams dang bcas ngas lhag bsam drang bden gyis bton pa'i 'char zin 'di ni bod zi zhi gros 'grig thabs gtso bzung byas pa zhig las/ zi phyogs kyi 'char zin ltar min ces bshad thog don du bod phyogs la mtsho sngon nas sa mtshams du phan tshun me mda' rgyag mtshams bzhag nas zhi gros kyi 'go btsugs te skye mdo nas bod dmag phyir 'then byed skabs lugs dang 'gal ba'i mgo skor rgyab ded kyis dmag dpung btang nas bod kyi 'go dmag bsad rmas bzung gsum byas pa ma zad/ mi chos las 'das pa'i bya spyod cig la bod dmag khag gcig 'dzin bzung thebs rjes bsad pa dang / sde dge 'dan khog nas bod kyi sa srung mda' dpon mtsho sgo bar glo bur 'jab rgol gyi dpung 'jug byas pa/ gdan sa chen po dga' ldan pa'i dgon pa'i chos rgyud 'dzin cing snga lam mkhan po gdan zhus kyi7 bsko lam yod pa zur mang dga' ldan dgon pa chags re bral te yul phud pa sogs kyi skor rgyu mtshan gsal bshad mang dag 247

byas pa ma zad/ ngas bod zi zhi 'dum yong bar lhag bsam gyi 'char zin bton na'ang / khyod tsho zi phyogs nas phyi tshul tsam las do na du 'grig 'dum gyi bsam gzhigs med khar drag po'i gdong gtug bya rgyu'i 'jigs snang bskul ba yin na/ nga tshos kyang de lan des 'jal las gcib/ 'og gcig 'dzul gyi brnyas bcos khur srid kyi ma red ces bshad pa sogs tshig sgo je tsub tu btang bas/ rma zhang ye hris khro nyams ston te kha rtsod bskyar rgyag byas nas gros mol 'thor la nye ba'i skabs der/ rtse ke mchog sprul rin po che dgongs pa 'khrug nas zi phyogs la lan rgyag rtsis gnang skabs mdzod zur tshe grags nas mchog sprul nyid la gsung gleng gnang rgyu med pa'i go brda phul rjes/mdzod zur tshe grags yar langs te zur khang zur pa dang / rma zhang ye hri gnyis kyi mdun kha btags re phul nas gral dkyil du pus mo sar btsugs/mgrin pa gzengs su gtod de skad shugs chen pos da lam bod zi'i sku tshab rnam gnyis nas rang 'dod kho na'i tshig 'go gnon res mdzad pa las/ bod ljongs dang mtsho sngon gyi chab 'og bde rtsar thugs bsam gtan nas mi bzhes shing / phan tshun la nyag mdzo gzengs kyi bzod sgom mi mdzad par zhi gros 'thor du bcug na/ bod zi rgyal pham ci yong mi shes kyang / gang ltar sa mtshams kyi dgon sde chab 'bangs rnams brdab mnar 'og gtor brlag 'chi god kyi 'jigs skrag dang / brel zing dka' sdug bsam yul las 'daru/ pa yong nges ma zad bod zi srid gzhung sa/nyis la yang tshabs che'i gyong rgun phog nges las ma 'das na/ bod zi'i sa mtshams dgon sde chab 'bangs rtsa 'thor gyis sa stong gyur na/ bod zi 'khrug rtsod kyi 'bras bu ci yod/ bod zi sku tshab rnam gnyis nas thugs dbongs bkyel che'i sgo nas phan tshun brtsi 'jog dang /bzod bsgom gyis don gnad gang ci'i skor la gros mol yag po gnang na/ zhi gros mi 'grigs pa'i rgyu mtshan gtan nas med cing / der brten bod zi'i sku 248

tshab gnyis nas gros mthun 'jog thabs kyi dgongs bzhes yag po gnang dgos rgyu sogs tshig drang don zab kyi bar mol zhus gshis/ sku tshab sa/nyis sems cung zad lhod du babs mur 'brong sdom be hu gnyis nas kyang sku tshab gnyis kyi mdun kha btags dang bcas pus mo btsugs te mdzod tshe'i zhu bar rgyab skyor lta bu'i gros sne ma 'thor ba'i zhu ba nan du phul bar grags/ de nas rma zhang ye hris bod zi 'thab 'dzing 'di skor khyod tshos snga phyi bar gsum du bsam bzang gi zhi 'dum yong rgyu'i re 'dun byed pa dngos 'brel legs gnas/ ma zad/ ngas kyang 'grigs thabs gtsor bzung byas kyang bod phyogs / nas drang bden min pa'i gros gzhi bton pa der ngas mos mthun byed thub kyi ma red ces zer ba dang / zur khang nas kyang bod zi zhi gros 'grig 'dum yong bar 'bad brtson gtsor bzung gis don tshan kha shas thog stabs bde sprad kyang zi phyogs nas bsam shes med khar skyon cha 'tshol rgyu 'dir ngas kyang mos ma/thun thub kyi ma red/ da cha 'grig 'dum yong min gtso bo mtsho sngon sku tshab na sa ya nga nas yang du bsam gzhigs bya rgyu der rags las yod/ ngos snga 'phros gong rim sar 'gro rgyu yin pas de bar mdzod zur tshe grags dang be hu rnams kyis zhi gros kyi sne mthud thub tshe gong rim la snyan seng zhu rgyu dang / gal te 'grigs min nyen khar gyur tshe gnad don thag ma chod bar bod phyogs nas dmag don 'khrug rkyen mi 'byung ba rang nas 'gan khur rgyu yin/ de bzhin zi phyogs nas 'gal 'dzol mi yong ba rma zhang ye hris 'gan khur dgos kyi red ces bshad/ rma zhang ye hris kyang rtse dgon mchog sprul dang / mdzod zur tshe grags gtsos be hu rnams kyi zhi 'dum yong thabs skor bod phyogs nas bshad pa ltar min pa'i gnyis phan gyi 'char zin byung na bsam gzhigs gros bsdur bya rgyu dang / gal te 'grigs thabs med pa'i gnad don byung tshe thag ma chod bar phar rgol mi yong ba'i 'gan khur chog ces bshad nas rang rang so so'i 249

bzhugs gnas la phebs/ de nas zur khang phyir log byed khar mdzod tshes de ring zhi gros ma 'thor tsam zhig byung yod kyang rtsa ba'i don gnad skor dang de min gnad don gzhan thams cad skor la ji 'gab bka' 'dri zhus lan du/zur khang gis da cha ngos rang byang spyi'i mdun 'gro khar khyod la brda sprod byed rtsis yod/ rtsa ba'i zhi gros 'grigs thabs dgos nges yin pa ni khyod kyi shes gsal ltar red/ rtsod gzhi'i gnad don gtso phal rnams la rgya dang / gzhung zhen ma nyams pa'i sgo nas khyod kyis gang 'gab babs lta byas na 'grigs shing /nang chen be hu khag gis khyod la yid ches byed pa ma zad/ rma/ zhang ye hris kyang khyod la yid ches gang 'tshams byed kyi yod stabs zhi 'dum gnad don gzab ngang gtan 'khel dgos pa dang / nye sngon ngos nas bton pa'i 'a char zin der bzo bcos ji dgos khyod rang nas byas na 'grig gi red/ nga ri bo cher 'byor 'phral byang spyir khyod nas gros sne mthud thabs byed kyi yod lugs dang /gros sne mthud thub min skor snya na seng ma byung bar phan tshun ngan dgra mi byed rgyu'i kha dan byas yod lugs sogs zhu rgyu yin pas/ don du khyod nas 'grig 'dum yong thabs 'bad brtson dgos lugs skor sogs mngags nas zur khang ri cher bskyod/ 'di skabs bod zi'i zhi gros 'thor ba red ces rgya khyab tu gleng bas tshang ma 'jigs snang skye ba zhig byung song / 5 bod zi gros sne bskyar du mthud de 'dum 'grig byung ba/mdzod zur tshe grags sprel tshwa khar rma zhang ye hri yi sar bskyod de thog mar 'tshams 'dri'i skad cha kha shas bshad pa brgyud mdzod tshes ye hri'i rnam 'gyur la dpyad na/ snga nyin zur khang dang gros sne mthud ma thub par 'thor nyen gyi gnas tshul der gting nas 'gyod pa yod bzo 'dug snyam nas thad kar rgya dpon khyod kyi dgongs par bod zi dbar gyi rtsod gzhi 'di don du 'grigs 250

'dum dgos pa red dam/ ma 'grig pa dgos pa red ces nang khul yin khul gyis bshad par zi dpon nas nga rang zi ling mkhar nas yong ba yin kyang bod pas rtsod gzhi 'grigs pa'i skad cha shod kyi mi 'dug ces bshad/ mdzod tshes dpon po khyed kyis bshad par bod pas mi nyan pa 'dug bod pas bshad par khyod kyis mi nyan pa 'dug pas/ ngas bod zi zhi gros 'grigs thabs skor la gros gzhi zhig phul na 'grig gam zhes bshad par/ rma zhang ye hri bod kyis nyan na 'grigs kyang dang thog nga rang gnyis mna' 'jog dgos kyi red ces bshad pas/ mdzod tshe'i bsam par khong gnyis chos lugs mi gcig pa'i dbang gis mna' bzhag byed 'dod rtsa ba nas byung med kyang / mna' ma bzhag na rma zhang ye hris yid ches byed bzo mi 'dug snyam ste mdzod tshes dpon po khyed ni nyi zla sogs la skyabs su 'gro mkhan yin pa dang / kho bo ni dkon mchog la skyabs su bzung nas sangs rgyas chos lugs la dad pa byed mkhan yin pas/ lam dang dmigs yul tha dad yin yang ma shi bar du phan tshun mi bslu ba'i mna' mthun byas na zhes bshad par rma zhang ye hris kyang de ltar byas na 'grig gi red/ 'on kyang mna' 'jog tshul ni nga tsho hu'e rigs kyi lugs ltar byed dgos zhes zer don ltar phyi nyin nyi ma dpang por btsugs te mna' bzhag tshar rjes ye hris zur khang ni khram pa rang red/ khos bshad pa'i skad cha la cha 'jog byed rgyu mi 'dug de bas khyod nas zi bod dbar gyi zhi gros skor la 'a char zin zhig bris shog dang gros mol byed chog ces bshad stabs tshe grags phyir log gis rtse ke mchog sprul mdunari bcar te kha sang rma zhang ye hri dang mna' 'jog dgos byung lugs dang zi phyogs nas 'grig 'dum bya rgyur mos pa che ba'i gting tshod lon tshul/ nye sngon zur khang gis bton pa'i 'char zin la bzo bcos ma byas tshe 'grig 'dum yong thabs dka' ba'i skor sogs gnas lugs zhib tu zhus par rtse ke mchog sprul nas da lta bod zi zhi gros 251

'grig na bstan 'gro la phan chen po thogs pas/ zi dpon dang mna' bzhag kyang skyon med cing / khyod kyis zhi gros 'grig pa byed thub na bstan pa dang 'gro ba la phan thogs chen po yong rgyu dang / gal te bod zi zhi gros 'thor ma/ bstan 'gro'i bde rtsar nyams nyes yong rgyu yin pas blo gros shugs bskyed kyi sgo nas zhi 'dum 'grig thabs hur brtson byed dgos zhes gsungs/ de nas mdzod tshes bod kyi zhi gros 'dum 'grig bya rgyu'i yig cha bzo skabs sngon du zur khang pas bton pa'i 'char zin de'i rjod byed tshig ge yi ge gong 'og rbad de dkrugs nas brjod don gang ci'i thad bod sa gnas srid gzhung la 'char zin snga ma las kyang phan thogs che thabs shig bzos thog mtsho sngon khong be hu rnams la 'jam bshad blo 'gug gis mos mthun 'byung thabs byas pas kho tsho yang der blo bab byung 'dug de nas sbrel tsha khar rma zhang ye hri'i sar bcar nas ngas lhag bsam zol med kyi sgo nas phan tshun gnyis lo drang bzhag gi 'dum 'grig 'char zin 'di bzos yod pas/ bod phyogs nas gsan bzhes gnang min ji ltar yang nga tshos u nan zhu rgyu yin zhing / khyed nas dgongs pa zab bzhes kyis de don la zhal bzhes gretan 'khel gnang rogs gnang zhes zhus pas/ rma zhang ye hri nas khyod kyi yi ge 'dir ngas zhib lta byed chog ces bshad/ rma zhangarmo ye hris 'dum zin bltas rjes tshe grags thug 'phrad skabs 'dzum dmul bzhin du khyod nas zi bod zhi gros 'dum rgyu 'dir lhag bsam zol med kyis 'dum zin bton 'dug pas nga blo bab byung / ngas zi ling du dgongs skor zhu dgos kyang don du 'gyur ldog mi gtong / 'on kyang bod phyogs nas nyan e yong zhes zer/ tshe grags nas bod phyogs su 'di don la sor gnas yong ba'i thabs shes gang drag gi re 'dun nan zhu byed kyi yin zhes zhus pas/ 'o na khyod rang bod phyogs su mos mthun yod med 'dri bar song la/ mos mthun 'dug na khyod dang mnyam du bod kyi don gcod sku tshab 252

yong ma/sa nga dang ngo 'dzoms kyis ched khra 'di don la ming rtags 'god rgyu yin pas/dus tshod nyin bdun nang tshun lan gsal yod pa byed dgos/ de'i ring phar rgol med pa'i 'gan rang nas khur chog de las 'gyangs na ngas 'gan mi khungari zhes zer bas/ mdzod tshe sa thag ring bas nyin bdun thog 'khor thabs med lugs bshad par/ nyin bcu'i dus tshod sprod rgyu yang de bar bod kyis tshur rgol byed 'char yod tshe khyod nas nga tshor gsang brda sprod dgos pa dang / gal te de las ldog na dang thog ri bo che'i dgon sde brlag nges yin pa de ni khyod kyi 'gan red ces bshad/ de nas tshe grags ban tshang sgas su phyir log 'byor skabs/ rtse ke mchog sprul rin po che yang der phebs yod pas/bod zi phan tshun gnyis kyi gnas tshul la dpags na zhi gros 'grig rgyu'i re ba yod gshis/ tshe grags kyis dga' gdeng spobs gsum gyi sgo nas mchog sprul rin po cher gnas tshul rnams zhib tu zhus shing / khong gis btomyo/ pa'i 'char zin der rtse ke mchog sprul nas zhib gzigs grub rjes zi rgyas gyod khe dus mi nyan pham dus nyan e yong na dngos 'brel yin pa 'dug gam gsungs par/tshe grags nas ngas kha dan tshig thag bcad tshar bas phyis 'gyur ba byed bzo gtan nas mi 'dug ces zhus pas/ mchog sprul rin po ches dgyes shing 'dzum pa'i sgo nas 'di ni sde dgon ser skya skye 'gro mang por sman pa'i bya ba rlabs chen zhig yin stabs khyod kyi 'di phyi'i don chen zhig 'grub pa red/ kha sngon gros sne 'thor bzo'i skabs ngas zi phyogs la lan 'debs rtsis byed skabs/ khyod nas lan 'debs mi nyan pa'i brda dang bcas rnam 'gyur bzang po'i ngang gtam shod ma khas pa'i rtsal la brten nas bod zi dpon khag khong khro 3 zhing blo lhod bag phebs byung ste gros sne mthud rgyu'i thabs shes thub pa ni khyod rang dngos 'brel mkhas pa red 'dug ces sogs bstod ra gnang ba myo/ zad/ khyod byang spyi'i mdun myur bskyod thog bod zi'i zhi gros 'grig min 253

gyi dge skyon nyen kha dang zhi gros 'char zin snga phyi tshad bsdur mdzad rgyu sogs kyi gnad don rnams zhib zhu gyis dang / bod phyogs nas gsan bzhes gnang nges red ces gsungs/ de'i phyi nyin mdzod tshe ngo 'khor rnams phyi log gis nyin gsum mtshams ri bo cher 'byor/ nye sngon zur khang zur pa dbang chen tshe brtan sngon 'byor gyis byang spyi dngos gzhi thub bstan kun mkhyen la bod zi zhi gros 'thor lugs dang / mdzod tshes bskyar mthud byed bzhin yod kyang 'grig bzo med pa'i snyan seng phul bar brten skabs der bod zi'i gros sne 'thor ba'i 'ur zing chen po rgyag gi yod pa dpen na/ ri bo che nas sa la gong bar (sa la ni ri che rdzong nas bkra shang gser skyem grong bar rgyang thag spyi le bcu tsam gyis sa ) du tshe grags la a drung bdun 'phrad pa de dag dmag don bkod sgrigs kho na'i phyir yin pa red/ tshe grags ri cher 'byor ma thag byang spyis gzim dpon zhig 'bod mi btang bar sku mdun du bcar skabs gros sne mthud thub min gyi skor dris par tshe grags nas rma zhang ye hri la khong rang nas bton pa'i zhi gros 'char zin de phul nas zi rgya'i dpon la slar yang zhi gros sne mthud pa'i gnas lugs zhib phra zhus pas/ byang spyi shin tu dgyes bzhin zhi gros 'char zin 'di snga ma las kyang yag pa 'dug 'on kyang zi phyogs nas sngar gtam rjes 'gyur byed mi yong ngam zhes gsungs/ tshe grags kyis zi phyogs nas 'gyur ldog gtong sa med pa'i skor zhus mthar byang spyis khyod kyis don chen yag po sgrub 'dug ces bshad/ phyi nyin byang spyi'i mdun bcar skabs rtsod gzhi'i rtsa don skor zhib tu zhus rjes byang spyis khyod nas gzhung sems la rgya 'gyur med kyis rgya dpon rma zhang ye hri dang nyer lnga'i be hu khag blo sne bkug ste bod zi zhi gros sne mthud thub pa 'di ni gzhung sar zhabs 'degs 'bur thon gyi las ka bzang po 'grub pa red ces bsngags brjod kyang byas/de nas byang spyis bod sa gnas srid gzhung la dgongs skor snyan zhu rta shad 254

btang thog bka' lan ma 'khor bar phar dgra tshur gnod kyi gnas tshul mi 'byung ba dgos skor rma zhang ye hrir yi ge dang sbrags tshe grags khyed rang sang nyin thom/ te rgya dpon rma zhang ye hrir gtugs nas bod zi zhi gros 'dum 'grigs kyi gros gzhi'i yig cha 'dir zi phyogs nas dngos 'brel mos mthun byas tshe/ bod phyogs nas kyang bstan 'gro'i bde rtsar bsam gzhigs kyis mos mthun bya rgyu yin 'dug pas/ dus tshod nges gtan thog bod zi zhi gros sku tshab tshogs pa gang mgyogs lhan 'dzoms kyi thog nas gros mthun la dngos su mtshan/ rtags 'god rgyu ma zad/ rim bzhin bod zi'i 'brel ba yar rgyas gtong rgyu'i bka' lan thob lugs sogs gang 'gab bshad de don du gros sne ma 'thor ba'i thabs shes dgos zhes mngag bya byas/ de'i phyi nyin te chu bya bod zla dang po'i tshes shar la tshe grags ngo 'khor ri che nas rdog thon gyis nyin gsum thog sprel tsha kha ru 'byor 'phral mtsho sngon don gcod sku tshab rma zhang ye hri'i mdun bcar nas byang spyi'i yi ge sprad pa dang sbrags da lam nga rang byang spyi'i mdun bcar te nye sngon rang nas bton pa'i zhi gros yig zin phul ba dang 'brel/ sa mtshams kyi gnad don skor sogs bod zi zhi gros kyi gros gzhi'i rtsa don rnams re re bzhin gsed 'grol dang / bod zi chab 'bangs kyi bde rtsar dgongs pa zab bzhes kyis zhi gros 'grig 'dum mdzad thabs gnang dgos pa'i skor nan zhu phul ba ma zad/ zi phyogs dpon po nyid nas bod zi'i zhi gros 'grig 'dum la mos mthun gnang rgyu'i khas len yang thob pa 'di ni dge mtshan bzang po yin lugs sogs zhus par/ byang spyi'i bka' lan la ngas chab 'bangs kyi bde rtsar dmigs nas khyod kyi zhi gros yig cha 'dir mos mthun byed chog kyang bod gzhung la dgongs skor zhu dgos/ 'on kyang gros don 'dir mos mthun byas par 'gyur ldog mi gtong rgyu dang bod gzhung nas bka' lan phebs 'phral bod zi phan tshun sku tshab tshogs pa zhal 'dzoms thog 255

bod zi'i 'dum yig 'jog rgyu yin pas/ de bar phyogs so so'i gong nas 'og bar tshang mas kha dan 'gal rigs mi 'byung ba'i 'gan khur dgos pa'i bka' slob gnas tshul sogs bshad par/ rma/ zhang ye hri nas da res khyod rang la 'gro don byung 'dug byang spyis zhi gros yig cha 'dir mos mthun byas pa ni bsam gzhigs byed stangs yag po red/ zi ling nas kyang bka' lan myur du 'khor grabs yod pas de bar bod nas tshur rgol ma byas na ngas 'gyur ldob/ gtan nas mi byed/ phan tshun bka' lan ma 'khor bar rtse ke nor gling mchog sprul dang khyod rang gnyis gtsos zi bod zhi gros byed mi rnams sdod sgrig bya yul la spyi bder bzhugs shig gal te bod phyogs nas gnas tshul byung tshe shag po khyod rang nas nga la 'phral brda gtong dgos zhes bshad nas de nub sne len zab rgyas byas/ phyi nyin tshe grags ban tshang rgas su phyir log gis rtse ke mchog sprul rin po che dang / chos gling yul dpon kun dga' dbang rgyal sogs la bod zi'i gtso 'gan bzhes mkhan rnam gnyis kyi dgongs phyogs dang gsung mol byung lugs skor gyi gnas tshul rnams zhib tu zhus par rtse ke mchog sprul rin po che dgyes nyarma sa chen po'i sgo nas/ da lam khyod nas rgyal bstan spyi dang khyad par bod zi sa mtshams mang tshogs tshang ma'i srog lus bde thang /tha na rta khal la rgyab chad shi brlag gi sdug bsngal/myong ma dgos pa sogs rang re gnyis kyi 'di phyi'i don chen 'grub pa yin zhes gsungs/ de 'brel nyer lnga'i be hu khag nas kyang da res khyod kyis zi bod dgon sde mang tshogs la phan 'bras chen po thob pa'i don chen sgrub 'dug ces sogs bsngags brjod dang 'brel dga' tshor chen po byas/ de nas bod dang mtsho sngon srid gzhung gnyis nas bka' lan ma 'khor bar mchog sprul rin po che skabs 'gar chos lugs kyi gnang sgor phebs pa las/ mdzod zur tshe grags dang / be hu khag sogs der yod tshang ma skabs 'gar rta rgyugs pa dang / skabs 'gar me mda' cha 256

kha blta ba/ sho sbag rgyag pa/ skabs 'gar shed dang lus rtsal 'gran pa sogs rtsed dgar rol/de nas chu bya bod zla dang po'i zla smad nang tsam la byang spyi'i ye ge zhig 'byor don la/ bod gzhung nas zhi gros dngos su ljorigrigs 'dum chog pa'i bka' lan 'khor byung bar brten khyod nas mtsho sngon phyogs kyi dgongs skor lan gsal 'byor yod med dang / rma zhang ye hri'i bsam tshul sogs kyi gnas tshul rtog zhib dang 'brel bod zi'i sku tshab 'dzoms dus skor bcas snyan seng yod pa byed dgos lugs sogs 'khod/ de nas zhag shas song rjes sprel tsha kha nas rma zhang ye hris mdzod tshe thug 'phrad du yong dgos pa'i yi ge 'byor don ltar/ phye nyin mdzod tshe rma zhang ye hri'i sar bcar skabs rma zhang ye hre dga' spro dang bcasasad cha mtsho sngon nas zi bod zhi gros 'grigs 'dum chog pa'i bka' lan 'khor byung bas/ rang nas byang spyir yi ge 'bul dgos pa dang /ring min zi bod sku tshab 'phral 'dzoms kyis 'dum yig la mtshan rtags 'god pa'i mdzad sgo tshugs rgyu yin pas de lugs snyan seng 'bul dgos zhes bshad pas/ mdzod tshe ban tshang rgas su phyir log byas 'phral byang spyi'i mdun rma zhang ye hri'i yi ge dang / de skabs kyi gnas tshul/ 'dum yig la mtshan rtags 'god rgyur sku tshab mnyam 'dzoms kyi mdzad sgo tshugs rgyu ma zad/mtha' myo/tshams 'brel yod dgon sde khag gi ngo tshab mi sna yang yong dgos pa bcas kyi skor zhu bar mdzod tshe'i g.yog po tshe dbang ched gtong byas/ de nas bod zla 2pa'i tshes 20nang bod kyi don gcod sku tshab zur khang zur pa dbang chen tshe brtan dang / rtse drung ngag dbang blo gros ngo 'khor srung dmag bcas dang / chab mdo dgon pa'i gnyer chen blo bzang tshe ring / dpa' shod gnyer chen gra lnga rgyas (brag g.yab kyi sku tshab yod skad )bcas rim bzhin 'byor ba dang / de bzhin zi phyogaspu nyer lnga'i zhi drag spyi 'doms gros don sku 257

tshab rma zhang ye hri ngo 'khor yang 'byor te phan tshun lhan 'dzoms thog nas mdzod tsher da res bod zi zhi gros 'di skabs khyod nas phyogs gnyis kar lhag bsam drang bden gyi sgo nas zhi gros 'char zin bton par phyogs gnyis nas mos mthun gyis 'grigs 'dum byung ba 'di ni byas rjes gzengs su thon pa zhig yin zhing / nye sngon khyod nas bton pa'i gros 'char nang don sor bzhag gi chod khra nyin gsum bzhi'i nang tshun thon pa byed dgos zhes phebs don ltar/bod yig gi 'gro stangs gzhir bzung 'god bya rtsod gzhi'i don tshan gtso che ba bdun te/ gcig sngar bod zi g.yul 'khrug ma lang gong gi 'dan ma sogs sa mtshams sngar lam gang yin sor bzhag las/ phyogs gnyis kyis 'gyur ldog mi gtong rgyu/ gnyis/ g.yul 'khrug skabs bod kyi 'go dmag 'dzin bzung thebs rigs phyir sprod bya rgyu/ gsum/ phan tshun dmag sa nas bsad rmas byung rigs la stong sprod len mi byed rgyu/ bzhi/ zur mang dga' ldan dgon pa'i gtong gzhis mchod thebs ban rgyun sogs sngar lam rang 'jags thog slad phyin dga' zur gcig phan gcig grogs las sngar 'khon zhe 'dzin mi chog khar/ zi khongs dga' ldan dgon pa'i bla sprul mdzod pa las 'dzin nas bod phyogs la mgo btags skyabs bcar dang / mtsho sngon srid gzhung la ngo rgol byas par zi phyogs nas bzod sgom byed pa las nyes chad mi gcod rgyu/lnga/ bod dmag skye mdor dpung skyod skabs dgon sder 'phrog bcom dang gtor brlag gi gyong gun byung rigs la skyin tshab mi sprod rgyu/ drug bod zi g.yul 'khrug skabs drag chas dngos rdzas de dus thob shor ji byung las ba/sar du bskyin tshab sprod res mi byed rgyu/ bdun/ bod rgya g.yul 'khrug gi 'byung rtsa nga min khyod len mi shod pa'i thog phyin chad mthun sgril yong ched phyogs su thad nas zhu bshags mi 'bul rgyu bcas bkod nas nyin gsum mtshams phul bas/ bod zi don gcod sku tshab phyogs gnyis kas thugs babs mos mthun 258

gyi chod skrar dngos su bsgyur nas bod rgya shan sbyar gyi yi ge 'dra bzhi bzos te bod dang mtsho sngon sku tshab so so'i mtshan rtags bkod pa dang / de'i nang gal che'i gnad don 'dan khog sa mtshams skor gong gi chod khra gzhir bzung phan tshun sku tshab 'dan mar lhan rgyas thog nas thag gcod dbye 'byed bya rgyu byas don ltar de rjes zur khang zur pa dza sag dbang chen tshe brtan mdo spyi'i skabs 'dan khog la dngos su bskyod nas/ bod zi lhan rgyas thog sa mtshams kyi zhib phra'i gnad don thag gcod byas pa red/ gzhan yang bar dpang khag theg gras rtse ke nor bu gling gi mchog sprul dkon mchog 'gyur med dang /— ri che zhabs bla'i mdzod zur tshe dbang grags pa/ chab mdo dgon pa'i gnyer chen blo bzang tshe ring / dpa' shod gnyer chen grang lnga rgyas/ brag g.yab sku tshab/ de bzhin nyer lnga'i khongs nas rgyal tshab be hu skal bzang rdo rje/ sdom pa mthu stobs mgon po/ rong po dbang grags bcas nas kyang ming rtags thog the'u brgyab yod pa ma zad/ bod zi'i mthun sgril yar rgyas yun gnas yong ba dang sa mtshams nas rtsod gleng mi 'byung ched gal te zi ling phyogs nas 'gal tshe sde khag nyer lnga bod la sprod rgyu dang / bod phyogs nas 'gal tshe/ ri/chab dpa' gsum mtsho sngon la sprod rgyu bcas byas tshul gyi shod rgyun gcig kyang 'dug rdo don gong gsal chod khra khag bzhi po de dag lha sa dang / zi ling /chab mdo/ skye mdo bcas sa gnas khag bzhir 'jog rgyu yin pa red/ de nas nyin 'ga' shas la thugs spro tshugs pa'i skabs der rma zhang ye hris gtsos zi phyogs sku tshab la bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi sku tshab nas bod zi zhi 'dum byung ba'i legs ston la kha btags a she dang / stag lpags/ gzig lpags sogs gcan gzan gyi pags rigs/ dngul do/ bod phrug thig ma do kha shas bcas phul ba dang / bod phyogs la mtsho sngon sku tshab nas rta khal nyi shu'i skor gyi 'bul ba dang / mdzod tsher gzigs bzos su/ rma kru'u zhi'i 'dra dpar 259

nga/nga / bod rgya yig rigs gnyis thog bod zi zhi gros skabs thabs nus gang yod kyis 'dum 'grig las dom/ dmis/sa bsal sgrub pa'i rgyu mtshan bkod pa'i gzengs bstod dang / rgya bod shan sbyar gyi yi ge'i 'bru don la ‘‘ri che'i be hu tshe dbang skyabs nas zi bod zhi gronu skabs byas rjes mi dman pa phul ba'i gzengs bzos rtags ma gnang ba yin ’ cenu/ 'khod pa'i dngul gyi rtags ma/ nyer lnga'i zhi drag spyi 'doms mtsho sngon zhing chen chen po'i bka' mngag rma 'ang ye hri sger gyi ming thog ma/sa tshwa g.yag rgyab brgya tham pa bcas sprad/ de bzhin rtse ke mchog sprul la'ang rma kru'u zhi'i dpar dang / dar cha/ dngul gyi rtags ma sogs gzengs bzos su/ phul yod 'dug de nas bod kyi 'go dmag 'dzin bzung0thebs rigs sa gnas kyi gnas tshul la gzhigs te zur mang da nga / ban tshang sgas nas rtsis sprod len byas shing / de dag la ban tshang sgas nas phrug dkar gas ra btsem gyi phyu pa sogs gyon chas kha gsar gra sgrig dang / bza' cha phogs 'bru sogs phun sum tshogs pa sprad/ dgyes ston nyin rjes ma'i thog bod zi zhi gros sku tshab bod phyogs nas zur khang zur nga/ dbang chen tshe brtan/ rtse drung ngag dbang blo gros/ ru dpon dbang rgyal/ de bzhin zi phyogs nas rma zhang ye hri dang / brgya dpon kha shas ('di skabs rtse ke mchog sprul nas zi dpon dang chos lugs grub mtha' mi gcig pas mnyam du sku dpar bskyon gyi min gsungs/) gzhan yang ri che'i mdzod zur tshe grags/chab mdo mgon pa'i gnyer chen blo bzang tshe ring / dpa' shod gnyer gra lnga rgyas/ brag g.yab sku tshab sprul sku rin chen snying po/ chos gling kun dga' dbang rgyal/ de bzhin nyer lnga'i khongs nas rgyal tshab be hu skal bzang rdo rje/sdom pa be hu mthu stobs mgon po/ rong po be hu dbang grags bcas dran rten gyi 'dra dang/ra bskyon te bod zi zhi gros 'dum 'grig mdzad sgo mjug sgril ba red/260

de nas bod zi zhi jigros sku tshab khag so sor zhal gyes te mtsho sngon sku tshab rma zhang ye hri ngo 'khor sbrel tsha kha brgyud phyir log byas pa dang / bod kyi sku tshab zur khang zur pa dang / rtse drung ngag dbang blo gros sogs ru brgya sku srung zi phyogs naru/ glod grol thob pa'i bod kyi 'go dmag bcas phyir log byas/ de bzhin rtse ke mchog sprul rin po ches gtsos chos gling bla dpon sku 'khor dang 'brel yod mi sna tshang ma rim bzhin rang gnas so sor phyir phebs/ mdzod zur tshe grags ngo 'khor ri bo cher 'byor 'phral byang spyi'i mdun bcar te bod zi zhi gros/ 'grig 'dum las don sgrub lugs ji bzhin snyan seng zhus par byang spyi dang / der yo da bod kyi sku drag ser skya thams cad re 'dod khengs shing /byang spyis ‘‘khyod nas gzhung sar lhag bsam la zhen 'gyur med kyi sgo nas bod zi'i zhi dzotsho/sa 'di'i nang byas rjes ha cang yag po bzhag yod pa ma zad/ rtsod gzhi'i don tshan gnad che 'gar zur khang zur pas bton pa'i 'char zin las kyang legs pa 'dug pas gzhung phan gyi legs skyes 'bur thon phul ba zhig yin pas gzhung nas gzengs bzos thob rgyu yin ’’lugs sogs zhib par bshad rjes/ byang spyis kha btags a she dang / bod phrug thig ma tshon mdog sna tshogs bub kha shas/ 'bu ras bzhi yug gsum bcas kyi gzigs bzos kyang sprad thog slang/ kyang sngar bzhin gzhung don snying bcangs kyis zhabs 'degs spyi dang / lhas/ par sa mtshams kyi don gnad skor gzhung bsam 'gyur med lhod g.yengs med par sgrub dgos lugs kyang bshad/ byang spyi lha sar thon gdong mdzod tshes tā la'i sku phreng bcu gsum pa la sngar srol kha btags nang mdzod dang / maṇ+ḍal rten dod dngul ṭam srang lnga/ zi ling nas gzigs bzos su sprad pa'i rma pu'u h+phang gi 'dra par dang / zi bod zhi gros la zhabs 'degs bzang po sgrub lugs 'khod pa'i gzengs rtags yi ge bcas dang sbrags bod zi zhi gros 'dum 'grig gi las don sgrub stangs skor gyi gal 261

che'i gnad don rags tsam bkod pa'i byen zhu zhig kyang phul/chu bya bod zla gsum pa'i nang byang spyi mkhan drung dngos gzhi thub bstan kun mkhyen las bya sku drag rnams byang lam brgyud lha sar bskyod cing / byang spyi lha 'byor gyis sngon phul snyan zhu'i tā la'i bcu gsum pa'i bka' lan phyir phebs su ‘‘byang spyi mkhan drung dngos gzhi brgyud snyan seng byung don/ khyod nas bod zi zhi gros skabs nang chen be hu rnams blo sne nang bkug dang / zi ling ngo tshab rma zhang ye hri la'ang thabs shes gang drag gi sgo nas bsam pa'i gting dpog thub pa byung 'phral byang spyir skabs 'phral snyan zhu 'bul sgo sogs snga phyir byas pa mi dman pa byung ba yid la nges/ gzhan yang slad phyin ris med bstan pa mchod sbyin gyi mnga' bdag gzhung sa dga' ldan pho brang pa chen po'i bka' drin snying bcangs thog sngar bzhin lhag bsam 'bad pa lhur len gyis zhabs 'degs zhu dgos pa dang / lhag par sa mtshams khag digi gnas tshul rtog zhib kyis dus thog snyan seng dgos pa bcas yid 'dom gyis mi’zhes 'khod pa'i bka' yig dang / ljags mdud/ ljags sa'i phyag par rdog gsum/ na bza' tshal bu/ bos zar bab yug gsum/ g.yung lag ris yug bcas kyi gnang cha stsal 'byor byung / de bzhin rtse ke mchog sprul rin po cher yang bod zi zhi 'dum sne mthud thub par gzigs bzos bka' rgya dang dngos po'i gnang cha ji yod kyang 'dir nges gsal ma dran/rtse ke mchog sprul dkon mchog 'gyur med ni zi khron zhing chen khongs sde dge rdzong 'og sman shod du rab byung bco lnga pa'i lcags lug (1871)lor 'khrungs shing / rab byung bcu drug pa'i sa yos (1939)lor dgung grangs 68thog tu sku gshegs/ khong ni 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po dang /kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho lhan nas gter chen mchog gyur gling pa'i sku phreng gnyis par ngos 'dzin gnang nas ri che zhabs bla'i khongs chos gling nang / rtse 262

ke nor bu gling dgon gyi khri la mnga' gsol/ mkhyen kong rnam gnyis gtsos yongs ḍari/dzin dam pa du ma'i drung nas gzhung bshad dang / snga 'gyur rnying ma'i bka' gter phal mo che'i dbang khrid man ngag rdzogs par gsan bzhes dang /rang dgon du mchog gling gi gter pod 23gtsos pod 30tsam gyi par shing gsar bzo sogs chos lugs kyi mdzad pa rgya cher bskyangs pa ma zang/ ri che zhabs drung sprul sku blo bzang tshul khrims lha sar sku gshegs rjes/ zhabs drung 'jam dpal 'jigs med khri la ma 'khod bar lo bcu gsum ring zhabs drung gi khri tshab mdzad ring phing tā ren dang / mgar blas de snga gtor brlag btang ba'i zhabs bla bskyar gso sogs mdzad pa dang / chu sprel lor bod zi g.yul 'khrug skabs zhi 'dum sne mthud mdzad pa ma zad/ zhabs bla'i mdzod zur tshe grags kyi phyag rogs mdzad nas chu bya bod zi zhi 'dum mtha' 'khyol mdzad pa sogs bar khams khul gyi bla ma grags can zhig yin pa bcas so/drobod zi 'khrug 'dum skor gyi lo rgyus deb 'di rang gnyis kyi shes tshul dang / mdzod zur tshe grags 'tsho bzhugs skabs kyi gsung sgros/ bod zi g.yul 'khrug skabs kyi dmangs khrod shod tshul bcas 'tshol bsdu byas pa rags bsdus tsam mo/) 263

chu 'brug ( 1952)lo nas gzhis rtse khul bkras bla'i mi ser rnams kyis chu glang rgya bod dpyad mtshams gzhir bzung khral rigs sgrub rgyugs byed lam skor/gzhis rtse sa gnasachasad kros/ phun rgyal/bod rab byung bcu drug pa'i chu 'brug (1952)lor rang nyid bkras lhun bla brang gi 'tsho dpon las 'khur byed mus skabs bla brang rtse gzim 'gag tu drung ja stabs bstun ngo bcar dgos pa'i parda tho 'byor byung don de 'phral bcar skabs mgron che nas bka' sgyur gnang don ‘‘'char 'bul phyag rtags dgongs don zhol bla brang rta gtong 'go pa khyod rang thog bsko gzhag bstsal ba yin na/ da nas bzung chu glang (sngar kun gling rta tshag bstan pa'i mgon po srid skyong skabs bod rab byung bcu gsum pa'i chu glang 1793lo ) rgya bod dpyad mtshams gzhir bzung gzhung bla'i rta khal rgyugs phyogs skor sngar srol ltar phan tshun gtan 'bebs byas zin cing / de skor nang sgang nas 'tsho zhib las khungs brgyud zhib cha'i bkol mngags gnang rgyu yin na las 'gan thad 'phral myur lag bstar byed dgos ’’zhes gsungs gi 'dug de rjes 'tsho zhib las khungs brgyud bka' phebs don ‘‘gzhis rtse zhol du chu glang rgya bod dpyad 264

don bzhin rdzong skyel rta khal gtan 'jags lam yis/ nang gsal gyi grangs tshad gzhir bzung nas rang 'bab rnams chab 'bangs mi ser thog skabs mtshams batshoskul gtong gis sa gnas srid gzhung gi khral skul mi snar gtong dgos pa phud/ sa/tso bo bod la zhi ba'i bcings 'grol thob rjes krung dbyang nas bod la gtong gnang mdzad pa'i rgya rigs spun zla'i 'go khrid las byed pa nga/nga / bod kyi mtha' mtshams srung mi bcings 'grol 'go dmangs sos/sa gzhis rtse sa gnas su phebs 'byor la lho byang stod smad gang sar bod rgya che'i ngal rtsol mi dmangs kyi ma 'ongs pa'i bde skyid gsar bskrun gnang rgyu'i ched du zhi drag gi mi sna dmag dpung ji rnyed cig phebs dang / phebs bzhim/ yin na de dag la nga tsho tshang mas krung go gung khran tang gi bka' drin snying dbus su bcangs nas kho tsho phebs gdong sdod gnas dang sne len zhu rgyus mtshon rtswa shing thugs mkho nyo sgrub sogs rang rang yul bab kyi rgyus mnga' rogs ram zhu rgyu kho tsho'i bka' don bzhin dwangs bas lhur len byed dgos pa ma zad/ rta khal mang nyung ji 'dra zhig dgos rung yul srol gla 'bab zhu sprod kyis lam yig sogs nang sgang nas skabs mtshams so sor zur du bstsal rgyu yin na le thogs med pa bskul gtong byed dgos pa ni nga tsho'i phrag par babs pa'i las 'gan zhig yin gshis/ rta khal thad rta gtong 'go pa rang nas mgo thog g.yam sel byed dgos pa dang / de bzhin gtsang khul gyi rdzong gzhis bod 'brog 'khos dman rnams dang / gzhis rtse grong rdal gyi bzo tshong las rigs 'khos zhan la 'tsho ba'i ros/sa ram dang / thon skyed yar rgyas gong 'phel yong ched 'bru dngul skyob gso dang skyed med 'bru dngul bun gtong gnang rgyu sogs bod kyi gang ci'e 'dzugs skrun la rogs ram gnang bya'i las don je rnyed cig nga tsho'i mdun du g.yas gzhogs g.yon 'degs rogs ram mu mthud zhu rgyur lhags bsdad yod na de'i skor 'tsho zhib las tshan zhol sde dga' spag tshe ring sri thar 265

de nyid thog zur du bkol mngags gnang rgyu yin na/ khyed gnyis thun mong nas sa gnas srid gzhung gi ngo tshab gzhis rtse rdzong skya ser dang / rdzong gi ngo tshab/ rta 'tsho sogs dang phan tshun gros bsdur byas nas gzhis rtse sa gnas su phebs dang phebs bzhin yod pa'i krung dbyang nas bod la btang gnang ba'i rgya rigs 'go khrid las byed pas mtshon bcings 'grol 'go dmag rnams la sne len zan shing / rta khal sogs nyer mkho spus tshong zhu rgyu dang / sa babs rgyus mnga' rogs ram zhu rgyu sogs 〈gros mthun 〉don tshan bcu bdun gyi 'bru don 'gal med nga tshos brtsi srung mu mthud zhus te don tshan re re bzhin lag len bstar dgos kyi red ’’ces nang sgang nas bka' de 'dra zhig phebs byung /de rjes gzhis rtse grong rdal nang nga tsho gzhung bla'i 'go khrid rnams don chen de'i skor gros bsdur gyis da phyin rdzong skyel rta khal mi gsum 'khri rgyugs bya rgyu'i thad chu glang rgya bod dpyad mtshams gzhir bzung lag bstar bya rgyu red na/ de snga gzhung phyogs nas bzos pa'i chu phag (1923)bka' rtse zhes pa de lag bstar ma byas gong gi snga dus kyi gtan tshigs rim pa'i 'bru don ltar gzhung bla gnyis kyi rtsa 'dzin byed dgos pa ni gzhung khongs stod khul rdzong gzhis nas lo re'i yong 'bab sgrig 'bul zhu sgo'i skor gtan 'jags lam yig tan tig nges gsal da lta zhu rgyu med kyang / phal cher lam yig khag dgu tsam yod cing /de'i nang nas lam yig gcig gi nang rdzong skyel rta 'ul bco lnga dang / khal ma lnga bcu tham pa yan grangs tshad longs na bla brang mi ser nas rta khal bzhi zur 'khri rgyugs bya dgos pa dang / grangs tshad de yan ma longs na gzhung rgyugs mi ser dang / gzhung khongs sger chos mi ser nas sgrub rgyugs dgos pa/ de bzhin sa gnas srid gzhung nas yang yang btang ba'i zhi drag las don gyi dgos mkhor 'char 'phar sbug tham dang / srid tham/ bka' tham khag gsum/ gzhan yang sa gnas spyi khyab re gnyis kyi ngos lam bcas kyi nang 266

gsal ba'i rdzong skyel rta khal mi gsum dang / sa tshigs rta khal sdod sgrig sogs kyi thad chu glang rgya bod dpyad don bzhin las bla brang phyogs nas rta khal de dag la the sgrub rtsa ba nas bya ma dgos par gzhung rgyugs mi ser dang /gzhung rgyugs sger chos mi ser nas mgo thog g.yam sel byed dgos kyang /krung dbyang nas bod la btang gnang ba'i rgya rigs dang spun zla'i mi rigs khag gi 'go khrid dang / las byed pa/ bcings 'grol 'go dmag bcas gzhisartse nas lho byang stod smad gang sar phebs bskyod la yul srol gla 'bab skabs mtshams zhu len gyis rta khal gtong rgyu dang / bcings 'grol dmag gi nyer mkho bza' rtsam lam bzo'i bza' rtsam brngod 'thag las skyel 'dren bya rgyu/ bzan shing / yul lung 'dzugs skrun la mkho ba'i nyer mkho khag thabs shes nyo sgrub zhu phyogs skor la nga tsho gzhung bla'i 'go 'tsho rnams phan tshun nang gros rtsod gleng rim byas kyi snying por gzhis rtse sa gnas 'di dag ni bod ljongs khul gyi rdzong gzhis sa gnas gzhan dang mi 'dra bar lho mtha' mtshams gro mo/ nub mnga' ris sogs mtha' mtshams khag la mi sna 'gro skyod byed dus gzhir rtse ni brgyud dgos nges kyi 'du 'gag 'du 'dzoms kyi lte gnas shig yin gshis da phyin gong du gsal ba'i rta khal mi gsum gyi mtshon sa gnas rgyus mnga'i rogs ram zhu sgo che phra ga 'dra zhig thon rung 〈gros mthun 〉don tshan bcu bdun nang gi 'bru don ltar nga tshos 'gal med brtsi srung lag bstar gyis rta khal sogs slad kyi sgrub cha tshang ma gzhung bla phyed 'khyer byas nas skabs mtshams so sor rang 'bab 'khri cha ji 'khel phan tshun gnyis kas le thogs med pa gtong rgyu byas pa yin/ bod ljongs nang khul la phan tshun 'gro bskyod byed skabs sa khad nye 'gyangs gang 'dra yod rung / rta dang khal ma/ mi sogs kyi skyel 'dren kho na bya rgyu las/ deng skabs lta bu'i gnam gru dang /rlangs 'khor thog nas dngos zog 'dren skyel shar gtong thub pa'i cha rkyen 267

bzang po 'di 'dra med stabs skyel 'dren thad chab 'bangs mi ser la ha cang dka' ngal shin tu che rung de skabs byed thabs dben/ mi ser nas de snga'i khral 'bab sna tshogs sgrub 'jal byed dgos khar skyel 'dren ha cang mang la lci ba yod kyang / bod zhi ba'i bcings 'grol 'thob tshun de snga'i bod sa gnas srid gzhung sogs sger chos 'go dpon rnams nas mi ser gyi lod+ngha re'i deb gsal khral rigs bsdu len byed pa ma gtogs spyi rnying lta bu'i zhi drag rkang 'gro lag 'don gyi khral rigs 'phar mas mtshon khral chad dang / bun chad rnams skabs de nas bzung shugs ma thub kyis mi ser rnams la bzod yang phran bu lag len mi bya mthu med kyi gnas la brten sa gnas srid gzhung gi sa rdzong rta khal rnams dgos nges rigs ma gtogs de snga'i 'char 'phar dza drag can gyi khral ngan de dag gang 'tsham nyung du song yod/ dus mtshungs krung dbyang nas bod la gtong gnang mdzad pa'i rgya rigs las byed rnams dang / bcings 'grol dam ga sogs gtsang khul gzhis rtse sa gnas lte bar byed pa'i stod smad lho byang gang sar nyin re bzhin phebs mkhan rnam par rta khal mang nyung la ma ltos pa satong dgos rung / sngar med yul srol gla 'bab zhu len bya rgyu yod par brten dus thog so sor le thogre/sa med par rang 'bab phyed cha shar gtong thub pa zhus yod/ 'on kyang skabs der phyi rgyal btsan rgyal ring lugs la rgyab brten bcol mkhan bod kyi kha bral pa 'go gte nyung shas de tshos 〈gros mthun 〉don tshan bcu bdun lag len rtsa ba nas bstar 'dod med pa'i khar/phyi nang gi los spyod pa'i dkrog gtam sna tshogs kyi shugs rkyen ngan pa bod ljongs khul gang sar khyab yod pa ma zad/ lhag par gzhis rtse sa gnas 'di dag la rgyu rkyen sna tshogs kyi rkyen pas dkrog gtam gyi shugs rkyen ngan pa de bas shugs che tsam thebs stabs rta khal gtong rgyu dang / nyer mkho bzan shing dang 'bru rigs sogs spus 'don rogs ram bya rgyus mtshon mdor na las 268

don che phra khas sgrub phyogs thad la gzhis rtse rdzong dang / rdzong tshab sogs 'go 'tsho tshos phyi tshul nas bla brang dang 'dra ba'i rogs ram 'khri sgrub bya rgyu yin khul gyi rnam pa tsam bstan kyang nang don las don gang cir khong tshos ka kor dang dus 'gyangs khag dkri sna tshogs kho nas rdzong gi phyed 'bab rta khal sogs bsgrub bya gang cir gra ma 'grigs yang yang bzos kyang nga tshos nang khul rtsod gleng yang yang rgyag ma dgos par bzod sran gang thub byas nas nga tsho rang nyid kyi phyed 'bab rta khal skabs mtshams so sor le thogs med pa bsgrub pa ma zad/rdzong gi rbek+tod 'bab rta khal sogs kyang zhol sde dga' spag de nyid dang nga rang gnyis nas phyogs gang sa nas rta khal thabs shes gla 'tshol byas te gla 'bab zhu len gyis/ don du dus 'gyangs ka kor med par las don khag legs grub zhus pa yin/gzhan yang skabs der mes rgyal nang sa nas bod la 'bras dang gro zhib sogs nyer mkho skyel 'dren gyi 'phrul 'khor bgrod lam de tsam bde po med stabs sa/zhis rtser bca' bzhugs bcings 'grol 'go dmag dang rgya rigs las byed pa sogs kyi bza' 'bras thad ldeng nges shig sa gnas nas nyo sgrub mkho sprong gnang rgyu sogs la dka' ngal nges can zhig 'phrad cing / dus tshod gang 'chams shig gi ring 'go dmag yongs dang las byed pa sogs kyis nyin re lto durngaske gcig rtsam pa ma zas na mi 'grigs pa'i khar sa phyogs gang sar gzhung 'a/ma nyams bzo'am yang na gsar bzo gnang rgyu'i lam bzo'i las khungs kyang btsugs zin pas 'kher dman las mi brgya phrag mang por bza' rtsam narngeri gtong bya dgos pa bcas la brten rtsam pa 'phon che tsam brngod 'thag byed dgos gshis/ gzhis rtse'i 'brel mtshungs lho byang nye 'khor 'ing khul du gzhung bla'i khongs gtogs chu 'khor brgya skor la rtsam pa brngod 'thag byas pa'i skyel 'dren gyi gla cha sogs kyang yul srol ltar zhus stsal gyis lo ltar 269

'bru ru'i khal stong phrag mang po 'thag las skyel 'dren bya rgyur yang rang nas lo shas ring zhor du 'go khrid las 'gan mi bya thabs med byung zhing / rdzong gi khongs gtogs chu 'khor rnams kyi 'go khrid khang gnyer klu lding pa de nyid nas nga la g.yas gzhogs g.yon 'degs kyis dmag sgar khag dang / lam bzo'i las khungs/ spyi phan las don khang sogs kyi nyer mkho rtsam pa brngod 'thag skyel 'dren bya rgyu'i las 'gan yang lo mang ring sgrub pa bcas so/

gzim gong sman pa mes po che brtan lha dbang gi lo rgyus mdor bsdus dang 'brel bla gcung rang nyid kyi lo rgyus rags rim/blakhong rang nyid kyi khyim tshang gzim gong zhes pa ni/ rin spungs rdzong bar thang chus khongs su gnas shing / gus tsho'i rus ni g.yu thog (gsar ma )yon tan mgon po'i gdung ma chad pa red ces pha mes gong ma'i bshad srol du 'dug cing / rang nyid kyi pha dang mes po tshang mas sman gyi lag len sbyang 'bras myong goms ma skyon tsam yod pa ma zad/ mes po tshe brtan lha dbang ni rang dpon lha klu bka' gung gi bka' 'brel gam bcar sman pa yin cing / lcags zam du lcags zam bla brang em rje zhes skabs der skad grags can zhig yod zer ba de'i sar dgung lo 9nas 17bar sman slob bzhugs pa dang / dgung 'o/ 17nas e lha rgya ri'i bla sman mkhas pa zhig yod pa'i sar dgung lo 25bar bzhugs/ de rjes lha klu'i bka' gung gzhung don skor rgya nag tu phebs skabs/zhabs gras bla sman pa'i ming 'dzin du lhan phebs gnang dgos byung zhing /bka' gung mar lam lam bar nas rtsa grib snyun phog gis gtso bor ljags sgrogs te gsung sgra ji bzhin ma thon khar/ dbu yu 'khor ba dang / phyag zhabs rengs po sogs kyis nyin re las nyin re snyun babs je sdug tu song nas 271

rgya bod gang gi bcos thabs byas kyang phan skyed ma byung bar zla bzhi tsam song thog rgya nag tu bod bzhugs am ban nas cha rgyus kyis sman pa mkhas pa chen po zhig sar ngo sprod byas nas bka' gung snyun babs la gser khab rgyab rjes nyin re las nyin re je dwangs kyis zhag bcu skor nas snyun gzhi legs dwangs byung bas sman pa der legs skyes rgya cher stsal ba dang sbrags ‘‘da lan khyed kyi nad bcos gser khab rgyag rgyu 'di ngos kyi zla gras sman pa 'dir sba gsang med par bslab rogs ’’zhes bod rnam 'brug ang dang tshogis mtshon pas skyes gya nom pa stsal te bka' nan chen pos gsungs par// rgya rigs sman pa des ‘‘khyed bod kyi dpon chen po zhig gi bka' bcags na ga la 'thad/ gzhan du na nged rgya rigs sman pa'i lam/ lugs la rang gi bu tsha las de min su la'ang bslab mi yong bas/ 'di'i lag len su la'ang ma slob ’’ces gsang rgya nan che byas nas lag len man ngag dang bcas legs nga/ra bslabs shes byung 'dugade rjes lha klu bka' gung bod du zhabs sor 'khod rjes/ lha klu'i em rje'i gser khab ces lha sa khul du skabs der skad grags dang ngo mtshar che tsam yod stabs sman rtsis khang gi bla sman mkhas dbang mkhyen rab nor bu nasatshokhyed kyi gser khab 'di'i slob dpon su yin sogs bka' brtsad dang 'brel lag len slob dgos gsung par bka' gsungs dang len gyis phyag len du phul ba nas bzung dbus gtsang stod smad/ khams bod gang sar lag len du dar nas deng skabs rgya gzer/ rtsa grib kyi 'gyel nub/ brgyal ba sogs nad gsar pa phog rigs la shin tu phan pa 'di/ gus tsho'i mes po tshe brtan lha dbang gcig po'i lag rjes yin/gus kyang rang lo 7nas bzung pha mes gnyis rmokas em chi bslab ste lo 17steng nad rtags dang / rtsa chu tsha grang / sman gyi sprod tshul shes khul gyis nad pa mchog dman gang la bltas nas re zung ma gtogs smad dpyad nad 272

steng du babs pa dang / kha dmar rjes dpag tsam min par tshud thub yod gshis/ tshang mas lo na la gzhigs pa'i ya mtshan du rtsis te skad grags byung yod pas/ sman rtsis khang bla sman mkhyen nor mchog nas gsan thos byung rkyen rtsa ra nang rje btsun ma la ‘‘khyed nas phru gu de yin gcigre/ nga'i sar 'khrid shog ’’ces bka/'a bstsal 'dug par brten// rje btsun mchog nas ‘‘khyed rang nges par bla sman pa'i zhabs su bcar dbos// mjal rten ngas phul chog ’’gsungs nas gru'u rtsi dmar po'i sku 'jug ldeng ba dang / dngul srang 3mjal dar a she bcas gnang ste rtsa ra nang rje btsun lhan du me yos (1927)bod zla 9tshes 3nyin sman rtsis khang bla sman pa'i sku gam du bcar skabs/ de'i nyin dang de'i sang nyin sogs sman skor bka' 'dri gnang ste ‘‘khyod phru gu kha bde po 'dug khyod tsho g.yu thog pa'i gdung yin zer ba kha tshabs chen po red/g.yu thog gi gdung yin na g.yu thog chen po nas khyod rang gi pa pha bar gyi mi thog rim pa shod dgos/ mi thog grangs gang phyin kyang shod dgos ’’zhes gsung nan bka' bkyon gnang byung ba dang / ‘‘da khyod rang la em rje zer ba de brdzun par 'dug em rje'i ming btags kyi min/ khyod rang sman dpe rgyud gsum sman gyi phan yon tsha ba'i le'u bcas tshig khyor po 'dug don shes kyi mi 'dug khyod rang la ‘bskangs gso ba lags ’zhes ming btags pa yin/phyin chad khyod tsho g.yu thog gi rus rgyud dang em rje zhes pa ming don mtshungs pa zhig ngas bzo gi yen/ de'i bar nga'i sar sdod/ lto gos kyang ngas ster chog ’’gsungs nas sman rtsis khang du lo ngo gnyis dang zla lnga sdod ring / rtsa bshad phyi gsum gyi 'grel pa/ byang khog yul thig rtsa rgyud sdong 'grems/bshad rgyud sdong 'grems/ gtar sreg bcas shes nas ‘‘da khyod rang sa/nas skabasagrong gseb tu phyin nas sman gyi 'gro don lhag bsam rnam dag gyis/nad ngo ma shes pa gal che 'dug na rgyud dang / lhan thabs zin tig bcas la 273

zhib tu ltos/ de nas kyang ma shes pa yid gnyis su 'dug na 'phral 'phral du zhu yig 'bul dgos ’’zhes gsungs pa ltar rang yul du log rjes zhu yig gang phul la gnad kyi man ngag rgyud kyi ra sprag tshang ma 'phral 'phral spyi smin dang /de rjes yang yang mjal skabs bka' 'dri bka' slob gang zhus na'ang bka' slob re rer gsungs pa ‘‘'di skor mkhan po dam pas gsungs/ yang 'di skor rgyal rtse tshong khang dge rgan rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyis gsungs pa ’’zhes sogs sku tshe nam thub bar bka' drin gyi zho shas 'tsho ba'i sman rtsis khang gi zhal slob rnams kyi gral mthar du ba gnam stong du 'khod pa'i bka' drin gzhal du dka'ab yin/ lcags rta (1930)lo kha reg yongs 'dzin rin po che smin gling ga rje rdo 'dzin gyi sku gam nas dngul chu btso bkru chen po'i phyag len gsan bzhes skabs ‘‘khyod rang nga dang mnyam du btso bkru'i lag len bslab dgos ’’gsungs nas byang chub lding du thog ma'i lta gon gra sgrig nas bzung bod zla 2pa'i nang nas lnga pa'i tshes 25bar rin chen ril bu'i skor/ dngul chu btso bkru'i skor/ bcud len skor lhan du thob/ dngul chu btso bkru dngos gzhi bod zla 3tshes 8nas bzung zla 4tshes 15bar g.ya' phyi/ dug 'don/btso chung / btso 'bring / btso chen/ 'dul bsres sogs kyi las byed smin gling dge slong gnyis dang / nga rang gis nyin mtshan kun tu ngal ba khyad bsad kyis zhabs 'degs zhu skabs/ rang nyid zas spyod ma bzo bas kha nang gi so rnyil sogs la skyon chag chen po byung ba las/ 'di skor grub nyin lcags zam ri rtser nyi dros skabs 'ja' zug pa sogs ya mtshan ngo mtshar rtags mtshan bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung bas rdo 'dzin rin po che'i zhal nas ‘‘btso bkru 'di phyi btso bkru/ nang btso bkru/ gsang ba'i btso bkru/ yang gsang gi btso bkru bcas sngon du gsal 'debs bka' 'khrid phul ba 'di'i rtags mtshan chen po 'di ni gtso bo rgyal gsung bslu med dang / lhag par skyabs rje 274

yongs 'dzin rin po che khyed rang gi thugs bskyed byin rlabs/ yang dgos dam tshig sel med lag len rnam dag byung na 'di 'dra yong gi red ’’ces gsungs nas phyi nang gsang ba'i rtags mtshan rnams dkar yol chus bkang ba'i khar mngon sum mig gi spyod yul du gyur nas skal bzang legs par thob zin pa yin/ de rjes tshur phu karma pa mkha' khyab rdo rje gong ma'i bla sman pa 'ju mi pham rin po che'i zhal slob snye mo ru em rje don grub mtshan can gyis snye mo dge 'dun sgang du (lo khams ma nges )zla 3tshes 8nas zla 4tshes 15bar btso bkru thengs gcig gi zhabs rogs gtso bo nga rang yin/ de min gra pa gcigadage rgan khong rang bcas mi 3yod/ de skabs khong la mi pham rin po ches zhe chen dgon du btso bkru gnang ba sogs kyi lo rgyus man ngag mang po gsung rgyu 'dug pas yid ches nges 'drongs lam 'gro phul du gyur pa byung ba dang /yang me byi lo kha reg rnam grol gling du zur mang sman pa matsā/ sa pa bgres po zhig kong sprul rin po che'i dngos slob sde dge em rje yar 'phel gyi phyag rgyun yin gsungs pa dang mnyam du zla 7tshes 8nas zla 8tshes 15bar mnyam du btso bkru lam ljogro yag po byung zhing / phyag len khungs dag 'dug de rjes (dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur rjes )rin spungs rdzong gi bka' 'brel rdzong gi em rje gnyis la btso bkru'i lag len slob dgos gsungs nas dgos mkho rdzong mi dmangs srid gzhung nas bstsal te dngul chu rgya srang 15dang khams brgyad/thal brgyad/ gser gyi mdzub rgyus la sgor med a na 11bcas kyis btso bkru zhag tshad thim nges/ de rjes mang sbyor dang / rat+na bsam 'phel sbyar nas lam 'gro legs zin bcas/ dngul chu btso bkru'i skor dang / rin chen ril bu rnams nya rong byang chub rdo rje'i phyag rgyun zin bris kyi lung rgyun yang smin gling mkhan po mkhyen brtse nor bu'i zhal mnga' nas legs par thob pa'i lung rgyun las med kyang / btso bkru'i skor la bka' khrid gnang skabs khyad par spu 275

tsam mi 'dug rin chen rin bu'i sbyar thabs/ 'thag thabs/ khyad par gyi mkha' 'gro'i bka' rgya yod ces pa'i gsang sman ngo mtshar shin tu che ba 'dugade nga/ga kyang gsang bsrung la thugs bsgom med par legs par thob zin pa 'dir phyis gcung rin po che naṭashrī kyang rten 'brel mjal dar a she dang /dngul shog chas bcas gnang ste ‘‘khyed kyi smin gling mkhan po mkhyen brtse nor bu dam pa'i sman gyi man ngag rnams snod ldanajidam gtsang em rje zhig la spel dgos ’’zhes nan che bka' bstsal byung /mdze bcos 'di rang nyid kyi skyes ma'i pha bo dong skye bu bdun gyi nang tshan bya skyas dpa' bo'i dbang phyug gi man ngag 'di dpa' bo'i dbang phyug gi rig ma gling shar rje btsun ma'i zhal nas legs thob zin te sman rtsis khang du sdod skabs chu sman gsang ba sbub 'dren gi gsang sman 11'bri gung nang du 'dug pa em rje dkon mchog bstan skyong lags dang mnyam du sman rtsis khang nas gtong gnang skabs 'bri mthil nas 'bri mthil gra pa la dwags pa lo 35skor slebs pa zhig dgon pa'i tho phyir lung stong zhig tu mdze nad mgo lus med par rma shu chu ser gyis khengs pa zhig skra dang / smin ma tshang ma snag bum ltar byi nas bltas na skyi g.ya' ba/ ya nga ba zhig 'dug par nad bcos byas nas/ nga rang gi bsam par drag gi red bsam pa yid gnyis tsam ma byung yang / yun ring gi nad pa dang / mi khyu nas bud pa rang ro rang gis mthong ba'i nyams thag du khaḥs mnar bar dge rtsa tshogs bsags kyi zhing khyad par can du bsam nas nad bcos byas par skabs der bod zla 5pa yin/ zla 9pa nang sman rtsis khang du nga rang brtsad bcad de 'bri mthil nas bang ma'i grwa pa zhig yong nas kha sngon mdze nad kyis mnar ba'i nad pa de seng drag rang la song yod/ da mi gzhan dang mnyam du bsdad na yong min sogs kyi spro 'dri dang /nad mjug sman len par slebs byung rkyen lam seng bla sman dam pa'i sku gam du 276

snga rjes yong rkyen rnams zhus par ‘‘'o na 'bri gung sman len kho rang 'khrid shog ’’gsungs te bka' 'dri gnang bar nga rang nas ji ltar zhus pa dang khyad med byung bar brten bang mir ‘‘khyod rang do nub gzhan du gnas tshang g.yar nas sdong/ gnangs nyin sman len par shog ’’gsungs song / bang chen bskyod tshar rjes ‘‘khyod nas nad pa de la bcos ji ltar byas pa yin nam ’’gsungs par rang gi ji shes rnams zhus par ‘‘'o 'o khyod kyi mdze bcos 'di man ngag khyad du 'phags pa zhig 'dug 'o na nad de ma byung gong du ltas ji ltar yong/ rjes bcos slar mi ldog pa'i gdengs ci 'dra yod ’’ces gsungs nas bka' 'dri gnang bar rang nyid nas gang shes rnams zhus par ‘‘de tsam shes pashāring dus dbang la gzhigs pa'i rgyud don cha mthun tsam 'grigs kyang /da dung rgyud dgongs par skabs ji bzhin shes kyi min 'dug ’’gsungs nas/man rgyud nas gza' klu rtsa dkar bcas le'u gsum gyi rgyud 'khrid kyang bla gcig slo/ba gcig tu skabs der nyin bcu gcig tsam gyi ring la thob pa yin/de'i gnangs nyin 'bri gung bang mi de la rin chen tsha sbyor chen mo brgya phrag grang sbyor bcu grangs/ mdze bcos phyag rdor ril bu shog chag chen po 1dngul chu rin chen 18 khyunge lnga rdog 4bcas bstsal te ‘‘nad pa kho rang la grwa tshang narngaske lto dang / lag sne bskur te pha yul du log thong / kho rang stod pa ba red/ gangs rin po cher bskor tshad gcig bsags na las nad thon gyi red/de min 'di nas nad mjug chod 'dug bshad na de sngon nad de sngon zhugs kyis mi ring bar slar nad smin nas na na khyod tsho sman rtsis khang nasatshom 'dzemabasdo kyang 'grig mkhan red gsungs byung zhes bshad nas nga tshor khag ngan yong gi red ’’ces gsungs pa bcas dang / yang rwa sgreng rgyal thog skabs dwags po gzim 'gag rtse nas gzim shag tu mdze nad kyi snyun te bzhugs par nga rang zhol lcang chung sgo sgor nang sdod sar sku mched chos mdzad lags phebs 277

nas phyag rtsa lta bar yong dgos gsungs pas lam seng mnyam du bcar skabs mdze nad kyis zhal dang / sku gzugs bum pa/ phyag zhabs thams cad rmar song ste phyag rtsa yang blta shes dka' ba dang / chu ser zhal ras nas babs par ras dkar chen po zhig mgul ba bzhes kyang / lam seng rlon par shar te chu ser khrom khrom du bar ma chad par babs kyi 'dug spyan gyi smin ma'ang skyes pa'i shul yang mi mngon/ dbu skra nag mchil tsam du bsdad 'dug par brten sman dgos tshul bka' phebs par/ gus ni grong gseb kyi sman pa mtha' gras shig yin/ sku'i snyun babs gzhi che gting zab 'di tsam blos 'khyud min la dgongs pa mtha' bskyel zhus par/ gsol sman dgos tshul bka' nan che gshis/ skun gzhi'i thad rang gis gang shes zhabs 'degs mi zhu tshad bral yang / 'di skor gus nas zhabs 'degs mi 'grub nges can zhes slar yang dgongs pa mtha' nan zhus kyang / de'i gnangs nyin slar yang yar shog gsungs don bcar skabs ‘‘srid skyong rin po cher bka' 'dri zhus par khyed rang la bsten dgos gsung gi 'dug ’’ces bka' phebs la brten gyen ldog ma nus par skabs der bod zla 12tshes 3nas mdze bcos dbu btsugs te phyi lo zla 4tshes 15la seng drags kyis zhi sder rgyal tshab rin po che'i mjal khar phebs pa dang sbrags lha sa stod bskor zhig tu phebus nas mar lam gong tshes nyin gyi dgongs dro khar stabs ma legs par g.yu thog zam steng du steng grib bzhes te lho rig gsum mgon po'i lha khang du lam seng gshegs/ de rjes rang yul dang / yar 'brog sogs la mdze nad 'khrul med na ba mi 3dang / mdze nad dang / pags nad chu ser nad gzhi'i dbye ba ma chod pa'i mi mang tsam sos nges byung song /gus rang lo 17nas em rje byas pa nas bzung da cha bgrang bya 77(1984)bar rang gi gang shes rnams nad pa mchog dman gang 'dra zhig 278

la'ang reg dug sman chen glang chen ghi wang / rin chen ril bu'i rigs la sngon gyi drang srong dge rgan rnams kyi mdzad lam bzhin sman rigs phran bu sprad blangs byab/ pa las/ de min sman rin dang / btang rag sogs kyi nye ring gtan nabasdo byed ma myong / gzhan yang nad pa bad smug dang dug rigs/ chu bsags/ bad kan mid chus/ bad kan pho thog skran nad/ rtsa dkar/gza'/ klu/ 'bam nad/ rims rigs/ mkhris ba rtsa rgyug mkhris nad k+ṣaḥya nag po sogs gso dka' mang por lag rjes nges kyi nad thog tu gnyen por babs pa dang / stes dbang gi drag pa dbye 'byed dka' ba las don du nad pa grangs las 'das pa mang por phan thogs byung yod/sman gyi yig lam yang blo gsar sman slob gzhan la phan phyir nad ngos 'dzin stangs/ man rgyud dang / lhan thabs su rgyas pa gsungs pa rnams nas blo 'dzin lta bder lhu 'don gyis rkang 'bam gyi le'u'i bar bsgrigs pa shog ldebs brgya yod pa zhig brag lha klu bsgugs su bla sman dam par spyan bstar zhus par thugs dgyes tshor gyi tshul bstan nas ‘‘'di yag po zhe drags byung 'duga'on kyang yig dbar 'di las che tsam 'jog dgos/ 'di'i mjug nges par du mgyosas tsam bris nas spyan zhu byung mtshams 'di nas bzo bcos byed kyi yin/ rtsom byang yang khyod rang gi ming rang la bzhag nas rjes su par la 'khod pa zhig byung na phan thogs chen po zhe drags yong ba 'dug khyod kyis 'di'i mjug nges par 'bri dgos/ mjug ma sgril na khyod rang la rtsam ldog gi nyes pa dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi bka' bcags pa'i chad pa sogs yong gi red ’’ces gsungs byung yang / de rjes mi ring ba nas ‘‘rig gnas gsar brje'i ’’skabs g.yu thog 'bum seng gi phyag bris red zer ba'i rgyud bzhi gser bris ma pang gi mtho tshad pod 1dang / rgyud bzhi'i chos 'byung byang pa rig ldan rnam rgyal grags bzang gis mdzad pa pod 1 'bri gung gter 279

sgrol ngh+ru rig 'dzin chos grags chab mtshan la phebs skabs zhal slob dkon mchog 'gro phacha/ la gsungs pa'i stabs bde'i snying po'i sbyar thabs man ngag 'bam bcos/ tshe 'dzin/ chu bcos gsang ba sbub 'dren/ gza' bcos dang / mdze bcos/ rim bcos/ bka' gter zung 'jug kyi snyan rgyud gsang ba gab dkrol bcas chos grags kyi gsungs pod chung 1bcas kyis mtshon pa'i sman dpe pod 67nyin gcig la me bsregs gtong skabs rang gis bsgrigs pa'i man rgyud dang / lhan thabs gnad bsdus shog ldebs 148kyang chabs cig song yang / rtsa chu'i gnad rub bsdus dang / sman gyi sbyar thabs lag len/ sman sbyor phyogs bsdus rin chen ril bu'i lo rgyus dang / phyogs bsdoms la sogs pa re zung bris te bod ljongs sman gyi grong khyer chen po sman rtsis khang gi mkhas dbang dbu khrid mang por bka' bcos zhu rgyu byung na ci ma rung snyam pa yod na yang / da bar dal khom med pa'i g.yeng ba dang / cha rkyen ma 'dzoms par bsam pa nam mkha'i pad mor gyur te lag len du thebs pa ma byung lags shing / da cha ni lo nas rkyen pas 'dren byed rab rib dang / rlung nad lta bus brjed nges dran shes med pas de 'dra phyogs bsgrigs ma thub par lus/ mdze bcos skor snga lo (1983)ljang mdze bcos sman khang gi yon krang lags nas 'phrod bsten cus kyi bka' 'brel mdze bcos skor yig cha zhig legs sgrig dgos zhes phebs par phyogs bsgigs kyis yig cha shog sgril gcig phul yang / bdag gi mdze bcos thad/tsho rtags gso rjes gcod thams cad man ngag rang yin zhing / gnad kyi man ngag khyad par can ni/ nad pa'i na tshul dang / phyi nang rtsa chu/ gsang bar blta rgyu sogs yin pas nad pa med par yig thog tu phul yang su la'ang phan thogs dka' banu/ na gal te nad pa zhig byung phyin 'tsho 'chi'i kha dmar dang / 'tsho thabs yod tshe 'a/ga rjes spyan bstar zhus chog pa bcas so/280
